chos spyod ngag 'don nyer mkho 'dod 'byung sa brtol ljon bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /na mo gu ru/sku gsum ston pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*/

tei:div.tei:p: 2008lor zhus/

chos spyod ngag 'don nyer mkho 'dod 'byung sa brtol ljon bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // na mo gu ru/ sku gsum ston pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*/ /rigs gsum rnam rol chos rgyal mes dbon sogs/ /brgyud gsum bla ma'i zhal skyin 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rtsa gsum gling pa brgyud bcas gtsug na rgyal/ /thog med dus nas bar med srid pa ru/ /rnam gsum duḥkhas gdungs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rin chen gsum gyi thugs rje'i gdugs dkar pos/ /rnam grol gtan bde'i grib bsil sbyin gyur cig /de'ang chos spyod kyi rim pa la'ang*/ mdo sngags gsar rnying gi phyag srol mi 'dra ba du mar bzhugs kyang da lam 'dir 'bras bu lam byed rdo rje theg pa'i spyi srol ltar nyin mtshan bar med sgrub pa kho nar lhur len zhing*/ rtag tu thun bzhi'i nyams len la gnas pa'i gang zag zhig gis/ thun mtshams sogs rtsa ba'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len dang sbyar tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ thog mar tho rangs mal nas gnyid sad pa dang mnyam du dran shes dang ldan pa'i ngang nas mdang gnyid du song nas da nangs sad kyi bar/ rmi lam tshun du sdig pa mthong na 'phral du bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la yi rang bya zhing smon lam gdab/ de nas gnyid rmugs dang le los dbang du mi gtong bar lus gnad legs par bsrang*/ dmigs rnam dang ma bral bar tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ de nas rlung ro gsum mam dgu phrugs su bsal ba'ang snod bkru bshal byas pa dang mtshungs/ de ma thag ngag byin gyis brlab pa'ang ngag sgrib dag cing ngag nus ldan du bya ba'i dgos pa yod/ de nas sems kyi kun slong legs par bcos shing khyad par du bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi rigs rnams ngag dal bus snyan pa'i dbyangs la sbyar nas mos gus kyis lus ba spu g.yo/ mig mchi ma 'khrugs/ /rnam rtog rang 'gags su 'gro nus pa'i gsol 'debs rtsal du 'don/

de nas dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ tshe mi rtag /las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs blo ldog rnam bzhi re re bzhin bsgoms pa'i phan yon/ dgos pa/ ma bsgom pa'i nyes dmigs sogs dran par byas la sems rnal du dbab/ lam thams cad kyi rmang gzhi skyabs 'gro/ theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib stobs bzhis sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis bsags pa sku gsum zhing khams 'bul ba/ rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la btsan thabs su bskyed par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi'i bskyed rim pa yin na dag rdzogs smin gsum ldan pa'i lus bskyed pa lha'i rnal 'byor/ ngag bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor/ yid sgom pa ting 'dzin zab mo'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar nyams su len/ rdzogs rim thun mong ba yin na/ gtso bo bum pa can la gnad du bsnun zhing*/ thun mjug tu 'khrul 'khor la bslab/ thun min gyi man ngag thob na bsam gtan sgom pa dang khregs chod thod rgal sogs dngos gzhi gang yin pa la gtso bo bya/ de bzhin thor thun song nas/ snga thun/ phyi thun/ srod thun rnams la dngos gzhi phal cher gong dang mtshungs la/ thun mtshams kyang snga dror yan lag bdun pa rgyas par song nas/ nyin mtshan gyi char byang sems sdom pa'i yan lag cung zad nyams pa gso ba dang*/ ma nyams kyang spel ba'i slad du 'bad dgos pa spyod 'jug sogs las gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha mi'i zol du byon pa o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i sdom chog bzhin bya/ spyir thun mtshams kyi las bzhi zhes pa/ snga dro bsang mchod mdor bsdus/ nyin gung chab gtor/ de rjes brjod med don bshags ltung bshags/ spyi bshags rjes phyag brgya re 'tshal srol mchis/ phyi thun mtshams gsol kha dang gsur mchod/ srod thun mjug lus sbyin mdor bsdus tsam bya ba rnams yin/

gzhan yang gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma nyin rer dus drug tu bgos nas 'don pa dang*/ bar gseng du gsol 'debs bsam lhun bar chad lam sel/ sgrol ma rnams dang zas kyi skabs su dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo 'don pa dang yon sbyong bsngo ba sogs rang gi dkor dang gzhan don sgrib sbyong la gal che/ de bzhin phyi thun gyi rjes su gdugs sher seng gsum tshe mdo'i gzungs/ tsakra bcu gsum sogs ma chad par byed na rang gzhan bar chad sel ba'i dgos pa yod/ thun so so'i mthar smon lam rnam gsum dang*/ kun bzang smon lam sogs snga 'gyur rang lugs thun min rnams res mos dang*/ srod thun mthar sku gsum zhing sbyong gi smon lam rjes srod nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs skabs thob kyi nyams len rim pa dang sbyar tshul sa bcad tsam 'dir bstan nas phra zhib gsham du 'god par bya ba yin la/ zhar byung rgyun spyod zhal 'don khag gcig dang*/ cho ga'i yan lag nyer mkho'i kha skong bcas phyogs gcig tu bkod pa la/ dang po chos spyod dngos la 'jug par/ thor thun gyi cha lag sngon 'gro dngos dang de'i thun mtshams dang 'brel ba'i le tshan gzhan bstan pa las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ thog mar tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnyid las ldang ma thag tu snying dbus kyi: gu ru mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas nam mkhar byon: sngags dang rol mo ḍā ma ru'i sgras: 'gro kun gti mug gnyid las bslangs par bsam: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: kye ma kyi hud gu ru rin po che: bdag 'dra blun rmongs 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gror: mkhyen rab thugs rje'i 'od stong rab bkyes nas: smag 'thug 'khor ba'i btson las bsgral du gsol: zhes pas gsol btab pas gu ru'i zhal dngos nas: legs par soms dang skal ldan rigs kyi bu: sangs rgyas sems can dbyings su mnyam mod kyang : da lta rmongs pa'i dus 'dir gnyid ma log:

tho rangs dus su bla ma spyi bor sgoms: dkon mchog gsum la snying nas gsol ba thob: sems can thams cad mgron gyi mchog tu gnyer: phyi nang gsang ba'i sdom dang dam tshig zungs: bsags sbyang spel ba'i gnad rnams yang dag bsnun: de phyir skal ldan brtson 'grus ma zhan ang : zhes gsungs shing dbugs dbyung stsal la spro ba bskyed: de nas rang gi smra byed byin brlab ni: dug gsum rlung bus rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya: de ni sgo gsum spyi'i byin rlabs mchog: rang gi lce dbang raṃ las ye shes kyi: gtum mo'i me yis bsregs te stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las gser gyi rdo rje ni: phyed pa'i mtshan pa rtse lnga'i lte ba ru: zla steng dhī las 'jam dbyangs dmar po ni: longs spyod rdzogs sku ral pod dbyangs can ma: dmar skya bde stong gnyis su med par sbyor: gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge 'bru gsum mtshan: thugs kar nya gang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: gnas pa'i thugs srog dhi':yig dmar po'i mthar: shes rab rang byung dpa' bo 'bru brgyad dmar: shes rab rang bzhin yi ge ā li dmar: rā ga'i mdangs ldan sgra bcas g.yon du 'khor: om̐ a ra pa tsa na dhī hrīḥ om̐ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ āḥ lan grangs gsum mam bdun gyi bar du brjod: de mthar snang ba thabs kyi yi ge ni: kā li dkar po shel dkar phreng ba bzhin: rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar bsam: om̐ ka kha ga gha nga : tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa: sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ lan bdun brjod: de mthar mi 'gyur gnas bya'i yi ge mchog: rten snying dkar po mu tig phreng ba ltar: 'od ldan rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor: om̐ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data: teṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shrā ma ṇaḥswā hā: lan bdun brjod: slar yang gsang sngags yig 'bru 'di dag las:

sna tshogs 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje: 'jam dbyangs dmar po'i ye shes sku dang ni: gsang sngags yig 'bru phyag mtshan ral gri dang : po ti'i rnam par lce steng dam tshig par: bstims pas gsung gi rdo rje 'grub par bsam: gsang sngags yi ge brgyad pa brgya rtsa bzla: de nyid 'od du zhu ba'i ye shes kyi: rdo rje'i ljags mchog shes bya'i chos smra bar: chags thogs med par gzungs spobs dbang bsgyur zhing : gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod 'grub par shog: ༈ phreng ba lag g.yon du bzung la/ rang gi lag g.yon tsan+d+ra zla ba la: gnas pa'i phreng ba sbrul 'khyil mdo 'dzin ni: gsung rigs rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dmar: rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa longs spyod rdzogs: rang 'od bde stong snyems ma dmar skyas 'khyud: brgya dang rtsa brgyad phreng rdog re re bzhin: ngo bo dam pa rigs brgya'i rang bzhin la: rnam pa yi ge 'bru brgya rang sgra bcas: gtso bo nyid la g.yas su bskor bar bsam: oṃ pad+ma sa twa sa ma ya: sogs nas/ sa twa āḥ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra bar+dha nā ye swā hā: lan gsum brjod/ slar yang de las 'od 'phros rgyal kun gyi: gsung rigs pad+ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: yig 'bru phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu dang : phyag mtshan pad+ma'i rnam par spyan drangs thim: 'od zhu yon tan ldan pa'i phreng bar gyur: dkyil 'khor lha rnams thugs dam bskul ba dang : gsang sngags bzlas brjod myur du 'grub par shog: ces sku dgongs las so/ ༈ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra bi mā na sā ra ma hā dzam+bha hūm̐/ oṃ sma ra bi mā na ska ra ma hā dza ba hūm̐/ zhes sbrel mar lan bdun bzlas pas de nyin bzlas brjod byas tshad grangs med du 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang*/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra bar+dha nā ye swā hā/ hrīḥbadz+ra dzi hwā man+t+ra dha ra bar+dha ni oṃ/ zhes pa'ang bdun nam gsum bzlas pas sngags kyi nus pa 'bum du bskyed par gsungs/

yi dam gyi bzlas pa'i thog mar 'di dang dbyangs gsal rten snying bcas bzlas pas phreng ba byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ skabs su kha zas la'ang btab na nus pa'i mthu bskyed par gsungs so/ dri med rdo rje'i gter ma dung 'gyur za yig bsten na sngags dmigs khyad par ba dang bcas skabs 'dir bsten/ ༈ sngags 'grub pa'i man ngag khyad par can ni/ sngags sgrub pa'i thun mgor rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i steng du bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po la 'khor nye sras brgyad dang gnas brtan bcu drug sogs 'phags tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba gsal btab la/ bla ma ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes thub dbang gi mtshan nas brjod cing*/ oṃ mu ne ma hā mu ne shākya mu ne ye swā hā/ ci rigs re bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs pas gang bzlas pa'i sngags rnams gegs med myur du grub pa'i mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thub dbang 'khor bcas 'od dmar ser bde ba chen po'i rnam par zhu ste rang gi spyi gtsug nas snying dbus su thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ ye dharmā tshar gsum mam gcig bzla'o/ /des sngags 'grub par 'gyur te sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu zhes pa las thub dbang gi sngags khyad par can mu ne 'di bzlas na sngags bsgrub pa la gegs med cing myur du 'grub par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bzhin rang gi nyams su blang ba'i don lcags khyi'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu la mi pham pas yi ger bkod pa dge/ // ༈ de nas sngon 'gro dngos la thun mong dang dang thun min gnyis las: thog mar thun mong sngon 'gro gter kha 'og ma ltar blo ldog rnam bzhi ni: bla ma mkhyen no:

lan gsum: thar pa'i gru gzings dal 'byor rin chen 'di: da res tsam las phyis nas rnyed dka' bas: gru 'di la zhon sdug bsngal mtsho bsgral nas: yang dag thar pa'i gling mchog nyams dga' bar: kun tu bzang po'i rgyal srid thob pa zhig: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje: mi lus don ldan 'grub par thugs rjes zungs: bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum: skye 'chi'i rang bzhin 'jig rten khams 'di na: ma shi gnyug mar gnas pa su zhig yod: de bas bdag nyid chos med shi ba'i 'og: gshin rje'i yul na sdug bsngal su yis bzod: dkon mchog thugs rje'i dpyangs thag zin pa zhig: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje: 'chi ba snying nas dran par thugs rjes zungs: bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum: bslu ba med pa kun rdzob rgyu 'bras chos: thog med nas bsags dkar nag las kyi 'bras: dus min rgyal bas kyang ni bcos su med: rang gis rang nyid bslu ba ga la 'gyur: bslu med rgyu 'bras spang blang mkhas pa zhig: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje: blang dor tshul bzhin nus par thugs rjes zungs: bla ma mkhyen no: lan gsum: 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal 'khor mo yug: ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: mtho ris cung zad bde yang 'gyur ba'i chos: bde ba'i mthar son bde chen thar pa'i gling : 'gro kun 'dren pa'i ded dpon bdag 'gyur bar: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig bka' drin mtshungs med rje: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par thugs rjes zungs: de ltar rgyun du nyams len 'dor med gces: gnyis pa gter kha gong ma ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la lnga: dang po chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten skyabs su 'gro ba la:

thog mar tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni: rnam dag mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od klong : bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma rje: rdo rje thod phreng mthing gsal rdor dril bsnol: lha lcam dmar mo rdo rje tshai bum bsnams: gnyis med 'khyud sbyor bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rab 'byams rgyal kun gtibs: nam mkhas gar khyab thugs rje'i 'od zer 'bar: bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub ma thob bar: rtse gcig mos gus gdung bas skyabs su 'gro: skyabs 'gro dngos ni: na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal skur: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: zhes skyabs 'gro ci 'grub bya zhing mthar tshogs zhing 'od zhu rang la bstims te mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog: gnyis pa theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni: smon 'jug don dam zung du 'jug pas/ hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: zhes ci nus brjod cing gtong len gyi dmigs pa'ang bya zhing mthar dmigs med ngang du mnyam par 'jog: gsum pa sgrib sbyong rdor sems sgom bzlas ni: āḥ bdag lus snang stong rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal 'od phung rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku pad zlar skyil krung bzhugs: thugs mchog dwangs ma lnga ldan 'od dpung klong : rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rin po che: gcer bu rus rgyan zla zhun 'bum gyi lhun: skyil krung mnyam bzhag thugs kar zla ba'i steng : skye med āḥyig mtha' mar yig brgyas bskor: de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i zhing kun mchod: thugs rje'i byin bsdus nus stobs tshad med bskyed: nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags bcas pa sbyangs: 'od zer mar 'phros khams gsum rigs drug gi:

duḥkha kun bsal phan bde'i stobs bskyed de: dran snang rang rig rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs: snod kyi 'jig rten mngon par dga' ba'i zhing : bcud kyi gzugs snang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: sgra grags thams cad rang byung snying po'i gdangs: dran rtog thams cad chos dbyings skye 'gag bral: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su lhun grub gyur: ces yig brgya dang yang snying 'bru lnga ci nus bzlas mthar snod bcud dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi thugs srog āḥyig la bsdu zhing dran rig mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag go /bzhi pa mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed maṇ+ḍal ni/ tshogs zhing sngar bzhin la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku'i zhing khams stong gsum bye ba brgya: longs sku'i bkod pa phung khams dbang po bcas: chos sku'i khyab brdal rig stong 'dzin med 'di: skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rje la 'bul: tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas yon tan mthar phyin shog: brgya stong grangs ma rdzogs bar 'bul zhing mthar chos dbyings mnyam pa chen por bzhag go /lnga pa byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ skad cig la gzhi lus zhing khams kyi bkod pa wal gyis gsal gdab la/ rang lus snang stong yi dam lha yi sku: spyi bor pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng : sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang : mtshan dpe dpal 'bar thugs rje'i byin 'od gtibs: mos gus gdung shugs drag pos rtse gcig gsal: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas sgo gsum gcig tu bsgril nas gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje mngon du gyur: sku gsum dbyer med bla ma rin po che:

gsol ba 'debs so thugs rgyud byin rlabs stsol: sku gsung thugs ldan dkon mchog gsum gyi ngang : rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs pa rtogs grol stsol: rtsa gsum dbyer med yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: mkhyen brtse nus ldan bla ma rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so rtogs pa mthar phyin stsol: rje btsun khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs: zhes kha zhe med par snying khung rus pa'i gting nas mchi ma 'khrugs nus pa'i gsol 'debs brgya stong grangs med bya/ snying po/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: kho na la 'bad/ spro na rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol gyi: bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni: chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa kun tu bzang : rang dbyings gsal dag rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang : thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul thub chen rdo rje sems: sku gsum ston pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs: don brgyud yongs rdzogs 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon: brda tshig mngon gyur dga' rab rdo rje rtsal: rig rtsal dbang thob 'chi med pad+ma 'byung : 'gro 'dren mchog gi sprul skur gsol ba 'debs: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod mtsho rgyal lcam: theg mchog bstan pa'i srol 'dzin rje 'bangs grogs: sku gsum rgyal tshab gter ston sprul pa'i sku: gang 'dul phrin las mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ bka' gter snyan brgyud zab don gdams pa'i mdzod: rgyal kun dgongs gsang ye shes gdod ma'i srog: mngon sum rjen par ston mdzad bka' drin can: kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs: snang srid rnam dag 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong : phung khams rnam dag zhi khro rab 'byams lha: rang sems rnam dag rig pa rang grol sku: gzhi grol rdzogs pa che la gsol ba 'debs: rje btsun chen po o rgyan rin po che: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa: ye nas sangs rgyas yin kyang ngo ma shes:

'khrul pa'i phu thag chod par byin gyis rlobs: don med srid pa'i bag chags las ldog ste: nyin mtshan bar med chos kyis 'da' ba dang : chos brgyad bag chags kun gzhi bcas pa kun: 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings su dag par shog: yin lugs cig car rtogs pas bdag grol nas: ting 'dzin mngon shes rdzu 'phrul grub rtags ldan: rtsol med mkhyen brtse'i thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol: phyam gcig 'od gsal snying po grol bar shog: dag snang phyogs med nyin mtshan 'od gsal ngang : bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: byams dang snying rje rgyun chad med pa yis: gang 'dul phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par shog: rtse gcig bsgrubs pas bla ma mnyes pa dang : dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung kun bral zhing : 'khru+ul gzugs gdos bcas lus ngag sems rnams kun: tshe gcig rang mdangs 'od skur dag par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra ma hā dz+nyā na dharma bud+dha yo gi ni sid+dhi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas dbang bzhi blang zhing dbyer med bsre ba ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma rgyal kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sku las ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ rang gi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo gang*/ bum dbang thob/ lus sgrib dag /lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag /slar mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag /lam rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag /slar snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo gang*/ sher dbang thob/ yid sgrib dag /lam zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag /slar lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo gang*/ dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag /lam a ti rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes thob/ mthar bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/

rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur/ thugs yid bsres la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag /mthar smon lam ni/ hoḥ kun gzhi mkha' ltar yangs pa'i klong : ka dag rang byung ye shes de: rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes: 'khor ba'i sems can snying re rje: byams mgon rgyal ba sras dang bcas: 'od gsal chen po'i dgongs pa yis: bdag la sangs rgyas yon tan kun: rdzogs nas thugs rjes stobs bskyed de: rtsol med 'gro don mthar phyin shog: ji srid nam mkha' ma zhig bar: mkhyen brtse ye shes rgyas pa yi: gang 'dul thogs med phrin las kyis: 'gro ba sangs rgyas sa thob shog: ces smon lam bya'o/ /de ltar chos sgo zhugs so cog dang*/ khyad par nges don sgom gyi nyams len la zhugs phyin chad 'jig rten blos btang*/ nam 'chi cha med rdog gtad bya/ tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod dang chos brgyad khe grags lo 'dod kyi bsam pa gtan nas spang*/ dman pa'i sa bzung zhing*/ ma ltogs ma 'khyags tsam la chog shes bya/ bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la dag snang*/ sems can la snying rje/ rgyu 'bras la zhib tshags/ slob sdom la mig 'bras/ dam tshig la srog bsdos kyis gzhan skyon la mi blta bar/ rang skyon kho na la brtag cing rang rgyud 'dul ba la nan tan chen pos bla ma'i zhabs tog chos kyis 'grub par bya'o// // ༈ rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje la bsten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcos med gdung dbyangs bzhugs so/ bla ma dang rang rig gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ gang zhig bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la/ bla ma sangs rgyas su lta ba'i mos gus med na rang sems sangs rgyas su mjal ba'i skal ba dang mi ldan pas na/ skyabs gnas ma lus pa thams cad bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su shes pa'i yid ches dang mos gus kha tsam tshig tsam min par sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pa'i ngang*/

dang po skyabs sems ni/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje sku gsum lha/ /dbyer med rang rig bla mar skyabs su mchi/ /gzung 'dzin 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i ma gyur 'gro/ /gdod ma'i gzhi la sad par dam bca'o/ gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ āḥ rang rig ka dag bla ma la/ /rang ngo shes pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang bzhi 'od gsal rgyan gyis mchod/ /re dogs spang blang dbyings su bshags/ /blo 'das rdzogs chen chos 'khor bskor/ /mnyam nyid chen por rjes yi rangs/ /'ja' lus rdo rjer rtag bzhugs gsol/ /'khor gsum yongs grol klong du bsngo/ /gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog /dngos gzhi ni/ āḥ gzhi dbyings chos nyid mngon sum klong*/ /nyams snang 'ja' tshon 'od phung dbus/ /rig pa tshad phebs ye shes sku/ /rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgyal/ /ma bcos bzhi ldan rnal 'byor chas/ /blo zad brtul zhugs mthar phyin phyir/ /rdo rje phyar zhing phur bu gzir/ /gzhon nu bu+um pa'i skur smin pa'i/ /dbang rtags bya rog prog zhu gsol/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid phyed skyil brjid/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus/ /rdzogs mtshon 'od zer 'ja' tshon dang*/ /lu gu'i rgyud dang rdo rje yi/ /me dpung tshwa tshwa 'phro ba yis/ /'khrul ba'i snang ba gtan nas brlag /srid gsum bag chags rgya mtsho skem/ /'khor 'das mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /ye grol rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhir/ /ma bcos zang thal chen por gdal/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ āḥ blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po/ /bsgom bya sgom byed bral ba'i/ /bsgoms med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ /gnam lcags rdo rje mkhyen no/ /snang bzhi dgongs pa'i rtsal chen/ /stan thog 'di ru rdzogs te/ /gzhi med rtsa bral chos sku'i/ /bstan srid myur du zin nas/ /don gnyis lhun grub mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab cing thugs yid bsres la rang ngo bskyang*/ spro na/ oṃ/ sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol 'debs so/

/gnad gsum dgongs pa rtogs par byin gyis rlobs shig /rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /mkhyen gnyis ye shes rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig /'jam dpal gshes gnyen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rgyal thabs spyi blugs dbang bskur byin rlabs stsol cig /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /phrin las nus mthu thogs med byin gyis rlobs shig /rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa lam lhongs byin rlabs stsol cig /'bar ba gsum gyi nyams rtogs rgyas par mdzod cig /'du ba gsum gyi phrin las 'phel bar mdzod cig /sku bzhi'i go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub par gyur cig oṃ āḥm hā gu ru e haṃ lo ha badz+ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes mtshan sngags ci nus bzlas/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ kun rdzob brda yi bla ma nyid/ /'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ /don dam chos sku'i bla ma ni/ /rig stong rjen pa'i ngo bor shar/ āḥphaṭḥ snang grags rig gsum bla ma yi/ /rdo rje gsum dang 'du 'bral med/ rjes thob kyi spyod lam bya'o/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'gro la bsngo/ /'khrul snang 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ /don gnyis phun tshogs dpal thob shog /gang dran ma bcos glog bzhin du/ /gnam lcags gu h+yas sug bris byas/ /des kyang byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang sngar bris pa la slar yang rang yul gnam lcags rtsa gsum gling pa'i thugs sprul sku phreng drug pa 'phags pa rgya mtsho rin po che mchog nas rtsa gsum gling pa'i bla sgrub cig dgos zhes 'brong bla karma longs spyod rgyud gsung bskul mdzad pa bzhin gsol 'debs dang mtshan sngags tsam gsar du bsnan zhing phul ba 'dis kyang dam pa'i thugs bzhed skong nus pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ byin rlabs sbrang char bskul ba'i rgyangs 'bod dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i gdung dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang po/ /dgongs brgyud gsal ba'i ston pa bcu gnyis/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma mkhyen no/ /ka dag gnas lugs rtogs par mdzod cig /longs sku+u'i ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ /brda brgyud dag pa'-i slob dpon rnam gsum/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma mkhyen no/ /lhun grub snang bzhi mthar phyin mdzod cig /sprul sku'i ston pa pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /snyan brgyud grub brnyes rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ /gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma mkhyen no/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol bar mdzod cig /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal/ /zab lam ston pa'i ma dang mkha' 'gro/ /mkha' 'gro gter brgyud bla ma mkhyen no/ /gzung 'dzin rang sar grol bar mdzod cig /sngags pa'i rgyal po gnubs ston mthu chen/ /so zur rma gnyags ska cog zhang gsum/ /dbang bskur byin brgyud bla ma mkhyen no/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin par mdzod cig /sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa/ /gter chen brgya dang gter phran stong rtsa/ /tshig brgyud shog ser brgyud pa mkhyen no/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa lam lhongs mdzod cig /rig 'dzin chen po hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul/ /rig 'dzin bzhi sogs lung bstan chos bdag /bka' bab don brgyud bla ma mkhyen no/ /'gro don mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig /o rgyan rig 'dzin 'gro 'dul gling pa/ /nges don bstan 'dzin chos dbyings rang grol/ /sku sprul brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhyen no/ /lus la bde ba 'bar bar mdzod cig /rig 'dzin chen po 'chi med nor bu/ /nges med phrin las 'gro ba 'dul mdzad/ /gsung sprul brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhyen no/ /ngag la nus pa thob par mdzod cig /mi 'jigs rdo rje snyan grags rgya mtsho/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzod pa rab brtan/ /thugs sprul brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhyen no/

/yid la ting 'dzin brtan par mdzod cig /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ar+ya dh+wa dza/ /tshe dbang bstan 'dzin nam mkha' tshe dbang*/ /'gro 'dul brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhyen no/ /dag snang phyogs med 'char bar mdzod cig /grub brnyes karma au ḍī ya sogs/ /gwa grwa brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhyen no/ /ri pa'i mchog sprul nyi zla zung mtshon/ /ri smad brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhyen no/ /dkon mchog seṅge bla rabs bla ma/ /sngon ne brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhyen no/ /hūm̐ kar rnam rol rig 'dzin rdo rje/ /'phen rabs brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhyen no/ khyad par skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ /brgyud srol kun 'dus rigs dang dkyil 'khor/ /ma lus spro zhing bsdu ba'i byed po/ gu ru nyi ma 'od zer mkhyen no/ /bstan pa'i nyin byed chu lha'i phag tu/ /yib tshe thugs bskyed skya rengs gsar pa'i/ /phrin las 'od stong phyogs med spro ba'i/ /bka' drin sum ldan bla ma mkhyen no/ /ma rig mun sel bla ma mkhyen no/ /thar pa'i lam ston bla ma mkhyen no/ /phan bde'i dpal sbyin bla ma mkhyen no/ /smin grol sgo 'byed bla ma mkhyen no/ /rang rig ngo sprod bla ma mkhyen no/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ tshe 'dir dal 'byor snying po lon par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas dran par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin nus par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin shes par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /thar pa'i lam la spro bas 'jug par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /mos gus dag snang bcos min shar bar/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bar/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig

/gdams ngag bdud rtsir nges pa rnyed par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems 'dres par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /snang srid lha yi phyag rgyar rdzogs par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /sgra grags rdo rje'i sngags su dag par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur smin par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /rtsa thig rlung sems las su rung bar/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /gzung 'dzin dbu ma'i dbyings su thim par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /bde stong phyag rgya'i grub mtha' snyogs par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /ka dag khregs chod gnas lugs rtogs par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /lhun grub snang bzhi'i lam rtsal rdzogs par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /'bras bu sku bzhi'i bstan srid zin par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /tshe gcig 'ja' lus chos skur 'grub par/ /dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /stan thog 'di ru byin gyis rlobs shig /thun mtshams 'di ru byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ zhes mos gus rtsal du 'don la gdung ba'i dbyangs snyan pos brjod par bya ba yin no/ zhes byin rlabs sbrang char bskul ba'i rgyangs 'bod dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i gdung dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di'ang rang slob bla ma mgon po'am don 'grub tshe 'phel gyis/ rang lugs gtsor gyur bla ma rgyangs 'bod cig 'bri rogs zhes/ dus ring mo zhig nas bskul ba rim lus su gyur ba'i khar slar yang rtsa gsum bka' 'dus sgrub chen skabs ci nas grub pa zhu zhes bskul ngo ma ldog par mchog gsum la mos pa'i gsol ba btab nas gang dran bris pas byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i rgyur gyur cig

rab byung 17 shing bya'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 18 la sgo chen sprul ming gsang sngags pas bal yul yang le shod a ti sgom grwa sna tshogs rang grol gling du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhi ka dag 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i klong*/ /lam gsal stong gu ru pad+ma 'byung*/ /don brgyud 'dzin ye shes mtsho rgyal mar/ /bdag gsol 'debs bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ /mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ bla ma mkhyen no/ rje btsun 'gran zla dang bral ba/ /pha mchog pad+ma yi 'byung gnas/ /rol rtsal ye shes kyi thugs nyid/ /cir snang chos sku ru grol mdzad/ /skyabs gcig ye shes kyi mtsho rgyal/ /bde stong zab lam gyi bdag mo/ /dgongs brda zab rgya yi gter mdzod/ /rten 'brel 'khor lo yi khyab bdag /drin can yab yum khyed ma gtogs/ /re ltos gzhan du ni mi 'tshol/ /yab yum khyed nyid rang shes so/ /thugs rjes da lta rang gzigs shig /sgo gsum bag med du shor tshe/ /'khor ba mtha' med kyi me 'obs/ /gang btab bzod glags rang med pa'i/ /thar med ngan song las skyobs dang*/ /mnar med ngan song du 'khyams pa'i/ /pha ma rigs drug gi sems can/ /las ngan sdig stobs can rnams la/ /thugs rjes da lta rang gzigs shig /mtha' med 'khor ba las skyobs dang*/ /mchog thun dngos grub cig stsol dang*/ /sku bzhis skye ba dang tshe rabs/ /'bral med rjes 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi/ /bskur mdzad bla ma khyed mkhyen no/ zhes pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rje 'jug dam pa sngags bla phun tshogs gis bskul ngor hūm̐ kā la karma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris// // ༈ ma ma sid+dhi sa ma ye hūm̐/ /gnas sems nyid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa ru/ /phas byin rlabs nyi zla yi zer ltar 'gyed/ /ma mtsho rgyal gnas lugs kyi skar 'tshogs bkra/ /rgyud sprin tshogs dengs par byin gyis rlobs/

/phyi 'byung lnga rang byung gi gnas mchog tu/ /pha o rgyan rtsi bcud 'bras bu rgyas/ /ma mtsho rgyal pad+ma'i tshom bu bkra/ /rkyen sad ser zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas rdzogs chen gsang sngags kyi pho brang nas/ /pha pad 'byung gsal stong gi chos dbyings khyab/ /ma mtsho rgyal zung 'jug gi bde stong 'khyud/ /bus bdag 'dzin chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon las 'brel zab gter gyi pho brang nas/ /pha thabs mchog sna tshogs rang sar grol/ /ma shes rab rten 'brel myur lam mkhan/ /bus bsam don 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ /bdag de ltar gsol ba rtse gcig 'debs/ /mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /phyi sprul sku'i bskyed rim la mi zhen par/ /lam snang stong gi ngang la mnyam par zhog /bar bzlas brjod kyi sngags la mi zhen par/ /sgra grags stong gi ngo bo so mar zhog /nang 'od gsal gyi nyams la mi zhen par/ /sems ci shar de chos nyid rol par zhog /lam phyi nang dbyer med ma bu 'dres/ /don de mthong rig pa'i btsan sa zin/ /bu snying gtam gyi zhal gdams de ltar ro/ zhes pa gsol 'debs zhal gdams snying nas gdams pa 'di'ang kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas slob ma pad+ma badz+ra gyis bskul ngor thun mtshams su sbyar ba dge// // ༈ gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i rgyangs 'bod ni/ e ma ho/ rgyal kun ngo bo pad 'byung*/ /gsang sngags mdzod 'dzin mtsho rgyal/ /gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes/ /gsol 'debs thugs rjes gzigs shig /g.yung ston ngan sngags kyi rgyal po/ /rgyal sras pad+ma dbang chen/ /mthu chen dum rgya yi zhang khrom/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzod/ /sprul sku nam mkha'i nor bu/ /karma las 'brel gling pa/ /chos rje 'gro ba kun grol/ /pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus drongs shig /gu ru dri med 'od zer/ /gar dbang grub pa'i dbang phyug /sngags nag zhwa gos rgyan can/

/kā la hūm̐ gi ngo bo/ /thugs rjes gzigs par zhu dang*/ /bstan dgra thang ma'i gnyen po/ /phung byed shān+tiṃ gar+bha/ /bya rog prog gi zhu gsol/ /ber phod gza' bdud kyi chas mdzad/ /gnam lcags thog rgod kyi rdo rjer/ /gsol 'debs bar chad kun zlog cig /rdo rje khrag 'thung gi skur bzhengs/ /dmod pa phyung rdeg gi spu gri/ /pha rol rgol ba'i sgyogs chen/ /hūm̐ nag drag rtsal khyed mkhyen no/ /ma rungs byad ma 'dul mdzad/ /drag rdzas thun dang zor 'phen/ /gnam lcags phur pa'i mtshon thogs/ /artsig khro rgyal gyi sngags bdag /log 'dren cham la phob cig /che mchog dpal dgu dang dbyer med/ /rdo rje gzhon nu dang sku mnyam/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gyi gling pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po khyed mkhyen no/ /gang bsam thogs med du sgrub mdzad/ /mtshungs bral mgon po khyed mkhyen no/ /kun 'dus sprul sku khyed mkhyen no/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin khyed mkhyen no/ /gter ston klong yangs khyed mkhyen no/ /'pho ba kun 'grub khyed mkhyen no/ /'ja' lus zag med khyed mkhyen no/ /pad 'byung dngos 'dra khyed mkhyen no/ /bdag gis dus rnams kun tu/ /gsol ba rtse gcig 'debs so/ /bar chad rkyen ngan zlogs shig /tshe 'dir dngos grub stsol cig /dbang bzhi lus la bskur cig /sku bzhi yongs rdzogs su gyur cig /snang sems chos skur rtogs nas/ /snang bzhi ro gcig 'char zhing*/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas thob mdzod/ rgyangs 'bod rig 'dzin ming gis sbyar ba'o// // ༈ de nas tshogs zhing smon lam bya ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /dpal thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*/ /yid rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhi gnas lugs kyi rang rgyud mthong ba dang*/ /lam rgya yan la 'khrul rtog mi 'byung zhing*/ /don sku gsum gyi lta ba gdeng thob nas/ /pha khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/

/gnas me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang nas/ /rigs drug pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems/ /yid rtse gcig gdung bas? gzhi gnas lugs kyi rang rgyud? lam rgya yan la 'khrul rtog? don sku gsum gyi lta b pha khyed rang lta bur? gnas ma la bam ri'i pho brang nas/ /dbyings rab 'byams dga' rab rdo rje la/ /yid rtse gcig? gzhi gnas lugs? lam rgya yan? don sku gsum? pha khyed rang? gnas ri bo rtse lnga'i pho brang nas/ /mkhas grub pa'i dbang phyug shrī sing*/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ /slob dpon nyid 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa nas/ /rje grub thob rig 'dzin rnam brgyad la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas nags tshal drwa ba'i pho brang nas/ /ma ḍāk+ki las kyi dbang mo la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas bsam yas dge gong gi pho brang nas/ /yab rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong nas/ /yum ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug nas/ /gnubs ston pa sangs rgyas ye shes la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas brda bzhi gsal rdzogs kyi pho brang nas/ /drin 'khor med bdud 'dul rdo rje la/ rtsa gsum gling pa'i mtshan gzhan yin mchan/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas dag pa rab 'byams kyi pho brang nas/ /rje grub dbang thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas dag snang mos gus kyi pho brang nas/ /rje grub thob mi 'jigs rdo rje la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas bslab gsum rnam dag gi pho brang nas/

/rje rig 'dzin snyan grags rgya mtsho la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas gang la gang 'dul pho brang nas/ /rlangs dpal seng gdung rabs rim byon la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas rdzogs chen zang thal pho brang nas/ /mgon khyab bdag ngag dbang phrin las la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas chos nyid mngon gyur pho brang nas/ /rje ngag dbang bstan pa dar rgyas la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas lung rtogs mkhyen brtse'i pho brang nas/ /mkhas grub brnyes dkon mchog seṅge la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi pho brang nas/ /'gran zla bral ye shes rgyal mtshan la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas gsal ba gsum ldan gyi pho brang nas/ /ngag bzlas pa mngon gyur seṅge'i mtshan/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas spros bral gnyug ma'i pho brang nas/ /sgrub gnad smin phun tshogs dar rgyas la/ /yid rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhi gnas lugs kyi rang rgyud mthong ba dang*/ /lam rgya yan la 'khrul rtogs mi 'byung zhing*/ /don sku gsum gyi lta ba gdeng thob nas/ /pha khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ 'di ltar dad cing gus pa'i blos/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rim byon gyi/ /gsol 'debs cung zad mtshams sbyar ba/ /'di yang au ḍi ming gis so/ gnas gze rgyal bdud 'dul sngags gling nas/ /rigs kun khyab ār+ya dh+wa dza la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? gnas ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas/ /nang rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /yid rtse? gzhi gnas? lam rgy don sku? pha khyed? rtsal rmad byung shugs 'chang gi pho brang nas/ /bka' skyong ba'i dam can gter bdag la/ /yid rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhi gnas lugs kyi rang rgyud mthong ba dang*/

/lam rgya yan la 'khrul rtog mi 'byung zhing*/ /don sku gsum gyi lta ba gdeng thob nas/ /pha khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ /sku gsum gyi dbang bzhi mchog thob nas/ /dran rig gi rgyal sa zin pa dang*/ /tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu yongs smin te/ /dpal yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /ces gdung ba'i gsol 'debs ni/ tshogs zhing smon lam mtshams sbyar shin tu rag las pa yin pas 'bad 'bung gtso che/ rtsa gsum gling pas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i gsol 'debs 'bral med rjes 'dzin gi smon lam byin rlabs myur 'grub ni/ gu ru na mo/ rgyal kun gcig 'dus o rgyan thugs kyi sras/ /rtsa gsum grub brnyes bud+dha dz+nyā na'i 'phrul/ /'dzam gling phan bde'i zab gter sgo 'byed pa/ /chos kyi gter mdzod rgya mtsho'i rig klong brdol/ /'gro don bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes mdzad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog khyung chen lta bu'i bla ma rin po che/ /las kyi 'phro sad mkhyen gnyis 'dab gshog rgyas/ /dpal rir pad 'byung yab yum dngos zhal mjal/ /smin grol mchog brnyes o rgyan gter bdag gling*/ /gsol ba 'debs so? g.yu 'brug lta bu'i bla ma rin po che/ /zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud nga ro yis/ /phyi rgol mu stegs kla klo'i bstan pa bsnub/ /mthu rtsal shugs ldan gnam lcags rdo rje la/ gsol ba 'debs so? seng chen lta bu'i bla ma rin po che/ /lung rtogs mkhyen rtse'i theg chen g.yu ral rgyas/ /log rtog bdud sde ri dwags klad pa 'gems/ /rnal 'byor sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /sman mchog lta bu'i bla ma rin po che/ /nyon mongs dug lnga 'khrul pa'i zug rngu'i nad/ /gdams zab thugs rje'i sman gyis sel mdzad pa/ /'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma las 'brel la/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /nor bu lta bu'i bla ma rin po che/

/zab chos mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod lde mig 'chang*/ /smin grol char 'bebs dgos 'dod re ba skong*/ /grub gnyis stsol mdzad lo ha badz+ra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /nyi zla lta bu'i bla ma rin po che/ /theg mchog sgron mes 'dzam gling mun pa sel/ /skal ldan don mdzad kā la hūm̐ gi mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so? rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab bla ma rin po che/ /'gran gyis zla bral mtshan dpe'i yon tan rdzogs/ /mthong thos 'brel thogs thar pa'i lam la bkod/ /bka' drin rmad byung rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /rang sems dbyer med bla ma rin po che/ /skyon gyis ma gos bla ma sprul ba'i sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan bla ma longs spyod rdzogs/ /ma bcos lhun grub bla ma chos kyi sku/ /sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog /de ltar gsol btab mos gus gdung ba'i mthus/ /bla ma mchog gis 'bral med rjes bzung zhing*/ /bstan dang bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs khur chen po/ /yang nas yang du ngal med khur stobs ldan/ mi mthun mi 'byung mthun rkyen kun 'grub ste/ /bla med bla ma'i bzhed don kun bsgrub cing*/ /smin grol dga' ston dpal la longs spyod de/ bskyed rdzogs snying po 'od gsal mngon gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /go 'phang la 'god 'khor ba dongs sprug shog /ces pa'ang gus pa nyal ba'i rmi lam 'od gsal nyams kyi snang ngor/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa dbu la sngags zhwa bya rog gis mtshan pa/ sku mdog dmar smug phod ka mthing gos bklubs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub sked par gtad de/ rje gang gi ring lugs kyi chos ka yongs rdzogs kyi gtad rgya dang bcas zhal gzigs byung tshe/ bka' drin ngoms med kyi yid la dad gdung cher skyes shing nyams dbyangs 'di gang shar bzo med du/

ngag dbang o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis sngon brag ke'u tshang gi yang dben bde chen chos gling du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bla ma mkhyen no/ /bla ma mkhyen no/ /bla ma mkhyen no/ /mtshungs med pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa/ /rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje/ /pad+ma gter bdag gling pa/ /sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal/ /karma las 'brel gling pa/ 'di yan rtsa gsum gling pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin/ thugs sras thugs mchog rdo rje/ /rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje/ /zur mkhar theg chen gling pa/ /kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa/ /kun bzang bde chen rgyal po/ /mthu chen kra ti sngags 'chang*/ /sku sprul o rgyan rig 'dzin/ /o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa/ /pad+ma nges don bstan 'dzin/ /nges don chos dbyings rang grol/ /gsung sprul 'chi med nor bu/ /thugs sprul mi 'jigs rdo rje/ /ngag dbang snyan grags rgya mtsho/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ /mtshungs med bzod pa rab brtan/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ /rje btsun bla ma mkhyen no/ /thugs rjes da lta rang gzigs shig /na mo bka' drin can gyi bla ma/ /sku drin can gyi bla ma/ /gsung drin can gyi bla ma/ thugs drin can gyi bla ma/ /gu ru pad+ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /'dug sa 'di ru byin gyis rlobs shig /gnas khang 'di ru byin gyis rlobs shig /mal sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /thun mtshams 'di nyid du? /'bral ba med par? /brtse ba chen pos? sku mnyam pa nyid du? gsung mnyam pa nyid du? /thugs mnyam pa nyid du? /mdzad pa mnyam pa nyid du? /nus mthu mnyam p /gdul bya mnyam? /smon lam mnyam pa nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /bla ma mkhyen no/ /lan gsum/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa'o/

/spros shing lcogs na/ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan bya la gal te ma lcogs na brgyud gsum gsol 'debs khol phyung ni/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rdzogs chen ston pa bcu gnyis sogs kyi gsol 'debs ni/ na mo hūm̐: bskal pa dpag med bkod pa nam mkha'i khyon: ye shes rdo rje rig pa'i khye'u chung : mngon rdzogs ston pa de la gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo bye ba mi mjed 'jig rten khams: ston pa mi 'khrugs pa la gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo 'bum phrag drod gsher 'jig rten du: ston pa 'jigs pa skyob la gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo brgyad khri mngal skyes gnas mchog tu: gzhon nu rnam par rol la gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo bdun khri sum cu rtsa gsum na: ston pa rdor 'chang sku la gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo drug khri gsang chen me ri 'bar: gzhon nu stobs ldan ston par gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo khri phrag srin yul ru lu'i gling : drang srong khro rgyal ston par gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo lnga stong rdo rje yangs pa can: ston pa gser 'od dam par gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo stong phrag sog po g.yu smin yul: ston pa blo gros rgyal bar gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo lnga brgya bya rgod phung ri ru: ston pa 'od srung de la gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo sum brgya rdo rje gdan drung du: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas de la gsol ba 'debs: tshe lo brgya phrag wā rā ṇa sī ru: ston pa shākya thub par gsol ba 'debs: ma la ri bo gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: ston pa rdo rje chos la gsol ba 'debs: dkar me gcig la gnyis mched snang tshul bzhin: sgrol ma brgya rtsa brgyad la gsol ba 'debs: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i bla ma mchog: nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la gsol ba 'debs: dgongs pa zab mo klong yangs nam mkha'i thugs: sa bcu lam lnga thogs med bgrod par shog: de nas rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa rgya gar gyi grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad sogs la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/

na mo hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos rang gsal skye med klong : sna tshogs gar mkhan byed las rnam sprul pa: las kyi dbang mo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog tu: slob dpon hūm̐ chen sku la gsol ba 'debs: sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: mañju shrī'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: dur khrod laṅka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: nā gardzu ni sku la gsol ba 'debs: pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: pra bha hastī'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: lhun grub gter gyi dur khrod gnas mchog tu: bi ma mi tra'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod gnas mchog tu: dha na saṃ skṛ'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod gnas mchog tu: rom+bu gu h+ya'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: dur khrod 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: shān+tiṃ gar+bha'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: snang srid klong yangs ye shes gcig tu shar: dgongs brgyud rdo rje sems dpar gsol ba 'debs: mtshon byed ri mo snang ba'i grwa zur tsam: brda brgyud dga' rab rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs: nyi ma gcig la mched pa'i 'bum phrag dbyibs: snyan brgyud mañju shrīr gsol ba 'debs: brda bzhi dgongs pa bka' bab rten 'brel snod: tshig brgyud shrī singhar gsol ba 'debs: smin grol dbang bzhi gsang ba shog ser mdzod: go byi de ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: rgyud lung dgongs pa gcig shes kun du grol: las kyi slob dpon sku la gsol ba 'debs: byin rlabs nus pa'i sprin phung cher g.yos nas: dbang bzhi grol lam thob par byin gyis rlobs: de nas gang zag snyan brgyud bod kyi grub chen rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ na mo hūm̐: kun tshang lhun grub snang srid bden gnyis dbyings: rgyal sras tshul byon rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : brda yi gsang mdzod ye shes mtsho rgyal lcam:

thun mong ma yin snying nas gsol ba 'debs: sangs rgyas ye shes brag la phur pa btab: nam mkha'i snying po nyi ma'i zer la chibs: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs: bla med rnal 'byor gsum la gsol ba 'debs: dpal gyi ye shes ma mo bran du khol: dpal gyi seṅges lha srin dam la btags: bai ro tsa na sgra tshad mtha' ru phyin: lta ba mthar phyin gsum la gsol ba 'debs: khri srong lde'u btsan mi g.yo ting 'dzin rnyed: g.yu sgra snying po'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur: dz+nyā na ku mās brag la bdud rtsi 'byin: sgom pa mthar phyin gsum la gsol ba 'debs: rdo rje bdud 'joms drag sngags mtha' ru phyin: ye shes dbyings ni mkha' spyod gnas su 'phur: sog po lha dpal gdug pa'i gcan gzan 'dzin: spyod pa mthar phyin gsum la gsol ba 'debs: sna nam ye shes bya ltar thogs med lding : dpal gyi dbang phyug phur pa gdeng tshad gum: ldan ma rtse mang mi brjed gzungs rnams thob: 'bras bu klong gyur gsum la gsol ba 'debs: ska ba dpal brtsegs gzhan gyi shes rgyud mthong : shud bu dpal seng chu bo gyen du bzlog: rgyal ba'i blo gros ro langs gser du bsgyur: gzhi yi klong gyur gsum la gsol ba 'debs: khye'u chung lo tsās nam mkha'i bya rnams 'dzin: dran pa nam mkhas byang g.yag dbus su 'gugs: 'o bran dbang phyug chu la nya ltar 'dzul: lam mchog mthar phyin gsum la gsol ba 'debs: rma thog rin chen pha wang zan ltar rol: dpal gyi rdo rje ri brag thogs med bgrod: rgyal ba byang chub nam mkhar skyil krung bzhugs: lang 'gro dkon mchog nam mkha'i thog rgod 'phen: rtogs pa mngon gyur bzhi la gsol ba 'debs: rig 'dzin 'dus pa dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i mdzod: snyan brgyud 'bras bu mi brjed dran pa thob: thugs rje nus rtsal phrin las stobs kyis phyug: snyan brgyud rje 'bangs rnams la gsol ba 'debs:

brda bzhi klong du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs: skabs 'dir gsol 'debs ci rigs pa dang*/ dngos gzhi thor thun la 'jug /bsngo smon dang bcas thun grol ma thag rgyun bsang mdor bsdus re byed srol yod pa'i rang lugs ni/ ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun bsang srid zhi dgyes skong bzhugs so/ gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: sbyin sreg me mchod mchod pa ni: dri spos sman dang longs spyod zas: sreg rdzas 'os pa thams cad bsdus: zhib par btags te rgyun mar skyong : me gsur btang ba'i dus skabs ni: tho rangs snga gong dag tu bya: me hom chung ngu'i nang du bsreg: chu gtsang bran zhing 'bru gsum brjod: sku gsung thugs yig gsum gyis spel: byang sems snying rje tshad med bsgom: mgron rnams bya rkang gling bus 'bod: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi: mgron rnams tshim phyir sbyin pa bya: sa ma ya: zhes pa bzhin bsang mchod rnams 'du byas la/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum dkon mchog rnam gsum rtsa ba gsum: gzhi lam 'bras bu ngo bo rang bzhin mchog: bde gsal mi rtog thugs la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ hūm̐: sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal kun grol zhing : tshad med rnam bzhi'i byang chub lam 'byongs te: ma gyur 'gro ba smon lam dpal zhing rnams: kun kyang bla med 'bras bu thob par bgyi: gsum pa bdag bskyed ni/ hūm̐: rang nyid snang stong kun tu bzang po'i sku: mthing kha mnyam bzhag chos sku 'gyur ba med: bzang mo yum 'khyud thabs shes bde chen ngang : snying rje'i zer 'gyed 'gro ba'i dpal du shar: oṃ sa man+ta bha dra mūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: ci nus dang*/ bzhi pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā wartā ya ā wartā ya ho s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rang byung me thab ni:

kha khyer mu ran dang bcas gsal ba'i dbus: sreg rdzas 'dod yon zag med mchod pa yis: kun bzang lha yi longs spyod lta bur gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hā sa bha dra su ru bhu pa ye swā hā: lnga pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang nyid kun bzang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥpad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: drug pa bsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yis byin gyis brlabs pa yis: kun bzang thugs kyi sprin las spros pa 'di: chos longs sprul sku sangs rgyas byang sems dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : dam can nor lha gter bdag 'khor bcas la: 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: spro na 'chi med bdud rtsi sogs bsang gzhung ltar dang*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ'achi med bdud rtsi yid 'ong lha yi bsang : dri zhim ngad pa mdangs ldan kyi li li: 'dod yon ro mchog gsur dud thu lu lu: g.yu dud sngon po sprin ltar thibs se thib: nyon mongs bsregs pa'i me zhags 'u ru ru: me dud mdangs ldan 'od zer re re la: mchod sprin lha mo grangs med zlos gar rtse: mchod byed sgeg mo lang ling bar snang gang : steng na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spungs se spung : bar snang bla ma rig 'dzin thibs se thib: yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs ya la la: ma sring mkha' 'gros gar byed shigs se shig: chos skyong dam can pho nya sha ra ra: nor lha gter bdag longs spyod kyi li li: yul lha gzhi bdag bzhad gad lhangs se lhang : rigs drug bgegs rigs dga' bro ya la la: phyi nang mgron kun mnyes tshim dgyes pa'i rdzas: 'dod rgu phun tshogs sprin phung bsang mchod kyis: ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams bsang bar bgyi: dge legs bkra shis phun tshogs stsal du gsol: hūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po bsangs: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba bsangs:

thog ma'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga bsangs: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen bsangs: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' bsangs: bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa bsangs: ston pa phyag na rdo rje bsangs: byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsangs: dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin rnam gsum bsangs: brda brgyud theg pa rim dgu bsangs: yum chen shes rab phar phyin bsangs: bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med bsangs: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas bsangs: bka' brgyad rig 'dzin brgyad rnams bsangs: rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga bsangs: tshig brgyud shog ser gter brgyud bsangs: rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad bsangs: hūm̐: che mchog he ru ka pa bsangs: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsangs: 'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu bsangs: badz+ra he ru ka pa bsangs: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs bsangs: bcom ldan khro rgyal gshin rje bsangs: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs bsangs: dbang chen khro rgyal rta mgrin bsangs: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs bsangs: sras mchog rdo rje gzhon nu bsangs: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs bsangs: bla med he ru ka pa bsangs: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs bsangs: yi dam gu ru drag po bsangs: go cha khro bcu'i lha tshogs bsangs: bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul bsangs: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs bsangs: khrag 'thung stobs ldan nag po bsangs: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs bsangs: legs ldan ma hā kā la bsangs: chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad bsangs: mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can bsangs: ma sring bye ba 'bum phrag bsangs: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi bsangs: chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad bsangs: dbang sdud dzam lha dmar po bsangs: longs spyod nor lha thams cad bsangs: zhing skyong dpal 'bar stobs ldan bsangs: las mgon bya rog gdong can bsangs: khyab mjug gza' mchog mgo dgu bsangs: btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa bsangs: snying srung mkha' 'gro sde lnga bsangs: gter srung myur mgyogs thams cad bsangs:

sde brgyad dam la gnas pa bsangs: sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad bsangs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu bsangs: bka' gter srung ma yongs rdzogs bsangs: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong gis khyab pa bsangs: longs sku rtsal las 'gyu ba bsangs: sprul sku sna tshogs cho 'phrul bsangs: zhing skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: sngags skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: mngal skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: lhan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: gnas chen dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: yul chen dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: 'thung spyod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: 'du ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: tshan+dho'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye tshan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: ra la'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: gnas yul zhing skyong mkha' 'gro bsangs: ma gcig rdo rje phag mo bsangs: khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro sde lnga bsangs: sha za ḍāk+ki 'bum phrag bsangs: las byed sman mo 'bum phrag bsangs: hūm̐: lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: gza' chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad bsangs: gdong mo brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: 'gyu ba bcu gnyis 'khor bcas bsangs: phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas bsangs: rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas bsangs: sde dpon brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: sa bdag rtsa gnyis 'khor bcas bsangs: lo zla zhag dus 'khor bcas bsangs: phyi nang lha srin sde brgyad bsangs: rtag chags yul skyong sde brgyad bsangs: yang gsang drag sngags sde brgyad bsangs: bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis bsangs: skyong ma ya ma bcu gnyis bsangs: srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu bsangs: rje yi mgul lha bcu gsum bsangs: 'bangs kyi srog lha bcu gsum bsangs: skyes lha che btsan bcu gsum bsangs:

yul lha zo dor thams cad bsangs: gangs gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsangs: sbas pa'i g.yu mtsho rtsa bdun bsangs: sgrub gnas chen po brgya rtsa bsangs: dben ri sbas gnas gzhi bdag bsangs: gter gnas sgrub gnas gzhi bdag bsangs: gzhi lam byes gsum gzhi bdag bsangs: g.ya' gangs tshal gyi gzhi bdag bsangs: chu brag shing spang gzhi bdag bsangs: yul 'di'i gzhi bdag zo dor bsangs: mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gzhi bdag bsangs: stong gsum snod kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: 'dzam bu gling gi zo dor bsangs: kyaiḥ rgya gar gling bzhi'i gzhi bdag bsangs: li bal kha che'i gzhi bdag bsangs: tho gar zhang zhung gzhi bdag bsangs: dur khrod brgyad kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i gzhi bdag bsangs: mdo khams sgang drug gzhi bdag bsangs: rgya nag yul bcu'i gzhi bdag bsangs: lho rgyal bod kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: chung ngu ming nas ma smos pa'i: khas zhan dbang chung gzhi bdag bsangs: rigs drug lan chags bgegs rigs bsangs: srid rtse mnar med yan chad rnams: thams cad chos nyid ngang du bsangs: rnam rtog chos sku'i ngang du bsangs: 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par bsangs: sems can sangs rgyas ngang du bsangs: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru bsangs: gang shar 'dzin med klong du bsangs: lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul bsangs: re dogs snang ba'i bag chags bsangs: rgyu 'bras blo yi bye brag bsangs: hūm̐: rang rig sangs rgyas stong rtsa bsangs: grags stong chos kyi rang mdangs bsangs: ma yengs dran pa'i dge 'dun bsangs: lta ba gtad med ye grol bsangs: sgom pa rang shar bzo med bsangs: spyod pa rgya yan lhug bzhag bsangs: kun gzhi 'khor 'das ro gcig bsangs: lam mchog ma 'gags zang thal bsangs: 'bras bu khregs chod ka dag bsangs: dbu ma rtsa yi sgron me bsangs: sgra gcan rlung gi 'khor lo bsangs: srog 'dzin sems kyi thig le bsangs: kun gzhi ma bcos lhun grub bsangs: stong pa ye nas sangs rgyas bsangs:

rgyu 'bras bden med shes pa bsangs: ngo bo gsal la 'dzin med bsangs: rang bzhin stong la ma 'gags bsangs: thugs rje 'dzin med sprul sku bsangs: gang 'dul der ston ngang la bsangs: bla med bsang mchod 'di bzhes pas: thams cad chos nyid klong du grol: kun kyang ye shes reg gyur cig: rig 'dzin srog sgrub las/ ri bo bsang mchod bzhugs so/ 'bru gsum dang nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum sogs kyis byin brlabs la/ bh+rūm̐: rin chen sna tshogs dwangs ma'i snod yangs su: 'jig rten srid pa'i 'dod rgu dam tshig rdzas: 'bru gsum ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pas: snang srid mchod pa'i 'dod rgur 'khrugs pa 'di: bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki chos srung dang : phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed dang : 'dzam gling gzhi bdag rigs drug lan chags mgron: khyad par bdag gi tshe 'phrog srog rku zhing : nad gtong bar chad rtsom pa'i 'byung po dang : rmi lam rtags mtshan ngan dang ltas ngan rigs: sde brgyad ma rungs cho 'phrul bdag po dang : zas dang gnas dang nor gyi lan chags can: grib dang smyo 'dre pho gshin mo gshin dang : gri bo the'u rang grong srin 'dre mo bcas: lan chags dmar po'i me la bsregs te 'jal: rang rang yid la gang 'dod 'dod rgu'i char: ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar nyid du: 'dod pa'i yon tan zad pa med par bsngo: bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang : dkon mchog dad gshin dkor la spyad pa rnams: sbyin sreg me mchod 'di yis dag gyur cig: me lce snang srid gang ba'i rdul phran res: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung mi zad pa: rgyal ba'i zhing khams yongs la khyab gyur cig: me lce ye shes 'od lnga'i mchod sbyin zer: rigs drug mnar med gnas su khyab gyur pas: khams gsum 'khor ba 'ja' lus 'od skur grol: 'gro kun byang chub snying por sangs rgya shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐:

zhes 'bru gsum brgya stong sogs gang 'grub mthar/ sku gsum dag pa snod kyi gzhal yas su: chos longs sprul gsum snang srid gzugs phung rnams: bdud rtsir zhu bas 'ja' 'od bar snang gang : 'khor ba myang 'das zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud: thog med dus nas da lta yan chad du: snang srid mgron du gyur pa yongs la bsngo: sa lam 'bras bu'i yon tan mthar phyin zhing : lta sgom spyod pa'i bar chad kun bsal nas: rmad byung kun bzang thugs kyi mkha' dbyings su: gzhon nu bum skur gtan srid zin par shog: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs pa'i mthar: 'og min pad+ma drwa bar sangs rgyas shog: phung khams bsreg rdzas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar: dkar dmar byang sems bsreg rdzas bde stong 'bar: stong nyid snying rje'i bsreg rdzas chos dbyings gang : snang srid 'khor 'das rdo rje'i 'od lnga'i gzhir: lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: sngon gyi lan chags thams cad byang gyur cig: da lta rgyud la mi gnas mthol lo bshags: ma 'ongs sgrib pa'i 'khor lor ma gyur cig: so thar byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa yi: sdom bcas bslab pa gsang sngags dam tshig rigs: tshor dang ma tshor nyams pa mthol lo bshags: nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang dag gyur cig: nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi gyur cig: mtha' mi dbus su 'ong ba'i sun ma zlog: chos mdzad bla ma gdan 'dren bar chad zlog: bod yul bkra mi shis pa'i ltas ngan zlog: gza' klu rgyal pos srog dbugs sdud pa zlog: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug zlog: bdag cag 'khor bcas bkra mi shis pa zlog: dam sri 'gong po'i mthu stobs nus pa zlog: ces rtsi shing sna tshogs pa'i bsang khag brgya dang brgyad sbyin sreg gi cho ga las byung ba ltar ri bo bsang mchod 'dis 'chi ba bslu ba dang*/ dkor sbyong bar chad kyi rigs sel ba rdo rje pha lam lta bu 'di ni/

sbas yul 'bras mo gshong gi gnas sgo 'byed pa'i cha las mkha' 'gro'i ḍā ma ru'i sgra las byung ba bzhin nor 'khrul med pa lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyis sbyar ba'o// // ༈ 'di yi skabs 'dzam gling spyi bsang dang*/ gzhan yang ci rigs par 'dzud/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo lha lcam man+da ra/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal gnubs ban lo tsā ba/ /rtsa gsum gling dang rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdor/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs bcas thams cad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i bsang mchod 'di phul bas/ /bdag sogs byang chub thob pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces rig 'dzin mi 'jig rdo rje'i sbyar ba'o// // mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i bsang ni/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs thugs kyi sku sprul pa/ /sems can kun la mgon skyabs mdzad/ /'og min gnas na bzhugs pa la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi skur bstan pa/ /'dren mdzad 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /dregs pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /ma hā kā lar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /brgyan pa'i bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces rlangs smyon gyis sbyar ba'o/ ༈ lha mo'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa ni/ bh+yoḥ 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma ti: 'dod rgu bsgyur ba'i dbyings phyug dpal 'bar ma: 'dod yon rnam lnga'i gser skyems 'di bzhes la: 'dod don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa gsum gling pas so// // ༈ dud sol ma'i bsang bsdus ni/ bh+yo/ byang shar thod pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan srung mthu mo che/ /zab mo rgyud kyi bstan 'dzin dud sol ma/ /las rnams kun 'grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bsang mchod zhes kha bsgyur

'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ rlangs smyon nas so// // ༈ zhing skyong ni/ hūm̐/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul rnams kun gyi bdag /nye ba'i 'thung spyod dpal gyi tsā ri ṭa/ /rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas/ /gā ya dha ra'i zhabs la bsang mchod 'bul/ rtsa gsum gling pas so// // ༈ btsan gyi bsang bsdus ni/ kyai/ dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i rol rtsal gyis/ /gtum chen shugs drag rdo rje'i me char can/ /mngon spyod dam tshig gnyan gyi las byed pa/ /rol pa bco brgyad 'khor tshogs dpung bcas bsangs/ /las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod// // ༈ gze rgyal bsang mchod ni/ kyai/ tsā ri ṭa dang gze rgyal pho brang nas/ /zhing skyong ma yo sku 'khor da tshur byon/ /gnam sar khyab pa'i 'dod yon bsang gsol bzhes/ /bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ ces pa'ang rtsa gsum gling pas so// // ༈ hūm̐: phyogs skyong zhing skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang : dregs pa sde brgyad dpal mgon bdun cu lnga: mgul lha brtan ma stong gsum gzhi bdag dang : khyad par yul rir gnas pa'i srung ma la: sreg rdzas 'bul lo grogs dang rogs dan mdzod: hūm̐: dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' zur phud lnga: lo zla zhag dus rgyu ba'i sa bdag dang : bgegs rigs len chags 'byung po rigs drug mgron: snga lus bor nas phyi lus ma thob pa'i: rig pa gtad med bar do'i sems can la: sbyin no bsngo'o tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shog: ༈ rlung rta spel thabs skor/ hrīḥ dge mtshan klung rta snyan ba dan che/ /'dod rgu kun 'byung mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di/ /ge sar skyes bu 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bsam 'dod kun 'grub phyogs las rnam rgyal mdzod/ ces pa 'di'ang shing sbrul zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga la mi pham pas bkod pa sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan bsdus pa ni/ oṃ/

gu ru yi dam rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i tog /dpung rgyan lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ bdag cag snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ rgud pa kun las myur du bskyab tu gsol/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā: dpung rgyan lha tshogs khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul mthus/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ rmi lam ngan dang bsam ngan sbyor rtsub zlog /byad kha phur kha 'thab rtsod 'khrugs slong zlog /srog lus dbang thang rlung rta rgud pa zlog /mi la na tsha phyugs la god kha zlog /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa sogs/ nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs mdzad du gsol/ zhes mañju gho ṣas so// // ༈ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan bsdus pa ni/ oṃ: thub pa'i dbang pos sum cu rtsa gsum na/ lha dbang lha min g.yul rgyal gzungs gsungs pa/ lha mo rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la: bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ rgyal bas gang gsungs bden tshig bslu med bzhin: pha rol g.yul sogs nyes pa kun zad cing*/ bdag gi tshe dpal rlung rta gong du bskyed: bkra shis bde legs rtag tu rgyas par mdzod: ces pa'ang gter chen dpa' bo chos dbyings rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can no// // ༈ 'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun sel bsdus pa ni/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis bdag cag gar 'gro yang*/ dgra jag chom rkun me chu gcan gzan sogs/ 'jigs pa kun skyobs bsam don lhun 'grub mdzod/ ces rdo grub gsungs su grags pa'i phyogs bcu'i mun sel bsdus pa'o// // ༈ bkra shis brtsegs pa ni/ oṃ: ngo mtshar bkra shis zhing gi lha rnams la: gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis rmad byung zhing*/ bde legs phan bde dpal gyi phun sum tshogs: rtag tu mi 'gyur byang chub ljon shing rgyas: chos mthun bsam pa ma lus 'grub pa ru/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros byin rlobs la/

dkar phyogs skyong bas rtag tu bsrung bar mdzod/ bkra shis brtsegs pa bsdus pa 'di sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'am gter sras rdor dgra'i dgongs gter las so// // ༈ oṃ: bkra shis phyogs bcu dag na legs bzhugs pa'i: bkra shis dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ bkra shis lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ bkra shis don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ sku dgongs las so// // ༈ sa bdag bshags 'bum bsdus pa ni/ kyai/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis/ gar 'gro gar 'dug gnas pa'i tshogs/ yul phyogs 'di la brten gnas pa'i/ lha klu gnyan gsum khyed rnams la/ pha ma snga rabs 'das pa dang*/ bu tsha phyi rabs yan chad kyi/ sa gnyan brkos dang rdo gnyan bslangs/ /chu gnyan dkrugs dang shing gnyan bcad/ /ro bag thab gzhob zor lam sogs ka ma ra dzās so mchan/ ma rig ma shes ci 'gal ba/ /mthol lo bshags so dag gyur cig oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a bhi la man dha la maṇ+ḍa le ma ye swā hā/ sa bdag bshags 'bum bsdus pa rā ga a s+yas mdzad pa'o// // gsol kha 'dir 'dzud/ yul lha mchod thabs ni: kyai/ sa yul 'di la gnas pa yi: lha gnyan klu gnyan btsan gnyan dang : yul lha gnyan dang nags tshal gnyan: yul lha mthu chen bzhugs pa kun: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snga ma legs pa'i gtang rag yin: phyi ma legs pa'i zhu skyems 'bul: da yang las kyi zhu 'bul ni: bzhes nas 'dod don sgrub tu gsol: ༈ dgra lha'i dpangs bstod ni/ rlung rta yar skyed kyi ba dan phyar la/ gri mtshon phye mar chang phud bsham/ bsang kha gso zhing 'di skad do/ /kyai/ lha ki ki ki la bswo bswo bswo/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum chos skyong sogs/ /skyabs kyi mchog gyur ma lus bsangs/ /bde chen skyed la nus rtogs spor/ /byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ge sar dgra lha'i rgyal po sogs/ /dzam+bu gling gi dgra lha bsangs/

/gsol mchod mi dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /dgra dpung 'joms pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /'go ba'i lha dang skyob pa'i lha/ /srung zhing skyob pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs/ /sdong grogs phrin las ma g.yel cig /brtan ma bcu gnyis zo dor sogs/ /gangs ljongs yul skyong 'khor bcas bsangs/ /dkar po dge ba'i dbu 'phang bstod/ /yul khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /phyogs bzhi'i 'byung bzhi spar sme sogs/ /lo zla zhag gi lha rnams bsangs/ /rlung rta skyed la rgud pa zhi/ /bdag cag lha ngo rgyal gyur cig /dzam lha pho dgu mo dgu sogs/ /nor lha gter bdag ma lus bsangs/ /phywa khug g.yang sdud mnga' thang spel/ /'byor zhing brtan pa'i rgyas thob cig /rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo/ /ki ki bswo bswo lha rgyal lo/ /kun 'dus sarba 'du 'du ho/ /stag seng khyung 'brug rlung rta yar skyed cig /ces ki bswo 'brug sgra ltar ldir zhing phye mar gtor/ bsang la bskor zhing skyems drangs/ /glu bro rta rgyugs sogs rang sems gzengs bstod cing rlung rta bskyed pa'i thabs la 'bad do/ /bod kyi gna' srol bzhin rlung rta yar bskyed mdor bsdus 'di'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas so// // ༈ mthar g.yang 'gugs pa ni mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas: kun bzang che mchog yab yum gyi: thugs rje rang rgyud smin mdzad pa: de ring 'od gsal g.yang 'gug go: bde chen lhun grub zhing khams nas: yi dam rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: byin rlabs dngos grub ster mdzad pa: bskyed rdzogs rten 'brel g.yang 'gug go: klong lnga zer phreng pho brang nas: pad 'byung rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs: zab chos gter gyi mdzod gling rnams: myur du 'gyed pa'i g.yang 'gug go: mtha' yas gang 'dul pho brang nas: grub thob rjes 'brang 'tshogs pa'i mchog: bka' bab gter la spyod mdzad pa'i: kun 'byung nor bu'i g.yang 'gug go:

gzi ldan me yi pho brang nas: chos skyong dam can gter gyi bdag: mthu stobs che btsan myur mgyogs pa: drag rtsal mthu stobs g.yang 'gug go: yid 'ong 'dod rgu'i pho brang nas: dzam lha dbang sdud nor bdag 'bum: snyan grags tshe chos bkrag dang mdangs: longs spyod srid kyi g.yang 'gug go: phyi rgyud rang rang gnas mchog nas: srid pa'i lha 'dre mgron gyi tshogs: lo legs bkra shis 'bru spel ba: 'dod rgu thun mong g.yang 'gug go: hūm̐: ye shes 'jig rten la sogs pa'i: srid pa chags pa'i lha 'dre kun: gser skyems phud mchod 'di bzhes la: phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i pho nyar rbad: 'dzam gling srid pa'i g.yang sdud la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: sngon gyi tha tshig ma nor bar: phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: g.yang skor de ni kyi li li: phywa skor de ni me re re: srid skor de ni spungs se spung : phywa g.yang char chen tshubs se tshub: gnas 'dir g.yang rten 'dzugs su gsol: brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phye mar gyi srung 'dzugs shing bkra shis pa'i tshig kyang brjod/ bdun pa bsdu rim bya ba ni/ hoḥ ye shes 'jig rten mgron gyi tshogs: mi dmigs klong yangs shugs 'byung gis: dgongs pa zang thal ngang du gshegs: badz+ra muḥ brgyad pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bdag gis bla med bsang mchod bgyis pa'i mthus: mgron rnams nam mkha'i mdzod la longs spyod nas: zad mi shes pas 'dod yon kun ldan shog: dgu pa bkra shis ni/ hoḥ chos dbyings thugs mchog rin po che: ma gyur 'gro ba sems can rnams: byang chub lam mchog rab 'byongs te: rtag tu bde legs bkra shis shog: zhes bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab byas kyang rung : rjes shes mi dmigs ka dag ngang la bzhag: zhes o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi cha lag dkar gsur tshig don sor bzhag gi rgyun bsang 'di'ang gnam sprul gsum pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis chog khrigs rdza spang gnam lcags ri khrod kyi 'don srol ltar bkod pa'o//

// rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skong gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pa tshims gyur cig /lan chags sha 'khon sbyang gyur cig /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /sgrib gnyis bag chags dag gyur cig /dam pa sku gnyis thob gyur cig /sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi mthus/ /'gro ba'i don du rang byung sangs rgyas shog /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma grol ba'i/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams sbyin pas grol gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam/ /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa sku nyid thob par shog /'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /sems can re ba skong mdzad pa/ /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ // ༈ sde brgyad gser skyems bzhugs so/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gser skyems sde brgyad cha snyoms las/ thog mar lha bshos ri rab mar chang 'o phud me tog rtsi sman mngar gsum sha sna khrag sna 'bru sna dar zab gang 'byor bshams la/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ldan pas rang nyid yi dam gang byed bsgoms la rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la ting nge 'dzin ngang nas 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ sku gsum brgyud gsum bla ma dang*/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang*/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ /mkha' 'gro nor lha gter srung tshogs/ /mchod yul gong ma thams cad la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang*/ /lha min dbang po thag bzang ris/

/klu yi rgyal po dga' bo dang*/ /mi'am ci ljon rta mgo dang*/ /gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang*/ /mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba dang*/ /chos skyong ma hā kā la dang*/ srin po laṅka mgrin bcu dang*/ /dri za zur phud lnga pa sogs/ /phyi yi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /yab gcig bdud rje nag po dang*/ /btsan rgyal yam shud dmar po dang*/ /yul lha phywa bsangs klu sras dang*/ /srog bdag rgyal po snying sbyin dang*/ /chos skyong gnod sbyin dmar po dang*/ /ma mo 'jigs pa'i glog 'byin dang*/ /dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dang*/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng dang*/ /nang gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /bdud po kha thun yak+ṣa dang*/ /gshin rje gshed po dmar po dang*/ /klu bdud nā ga rā dza dang*/ /gnod sbyin shan pa gri thogs dang*/ /ma mo srid pa'i khram 'debs dang*/ /btsan po yam shud srog len dang*/ /bdud po ri ti mgo yag dang*/ /srog bdag dung gi thor tshugs sogs/ /gsang ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /gza' mchog rgyal po rā hu la/ /skar mchog khram shing kha thor dang*/ /bdud mchog ma nu yak+ṣa dang*/ /btsan mchog gri btsan 'thu bo dang*/ /ma mchog lce spyang mdung 'dzin dang*/ /klu mchog klu rgyal dung skyong dang*/ /mgon mchog nag po lter dkar dang*/ /rgyal mchog li byin ha ra sogs/ /mchog gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /dpung g.yas dgra lhar sprul pa dang*/ /dpung g.yon ma mor sprul pa dang*/

/chu so bdud du sprul pa dang*/ /mgo bo srin por sprul pa dang*/ /mjug ma rmu ru sprul pa dang*/ /lag g.yas gshin rjer sprul pa dang*/ /lag g.yon klu btsan sprul pa dang*/ /mig dang snying dang mchin pa gsum/ gza' bdud nyid du sprul pa dang*/ /sprul pa'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /sa bdag hal khyi nag po dang*/ /klu bdud sgo ra nag po dang*/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*/ /phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang*/ /mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dang*/ /pho lha dgra lha srog lha dang*/ /mo lha mo sman la sogs pa/ /snang srid sde brgyad thams cad la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ zhes gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gser skyems 'di ni/ ser ba srung ba/ sre'u gso ba/ gtor ma 'phen pa/ mdos glud btong ba zor 'phen pa sogs las gang byed kyang sngon du 'gro ba'i sde brgyad mchod pa 'di med na byis pas mkhar las byed pa dang 'dra bas gal che gsungs so/ las gang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i sde brgyad mchod thabs gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // kyai/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ /yi dam ḍāk+ki chos skyong dang*/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ /dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang*/ /srid pa'i gza' mchog ki kang dang*/ /lo zla zhag dus za ma'i lha/ /yul lha gter srung ma lus pa/ /'khor bcas gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /bdag sogs grogs dang phrin las mdzod// // kyai/ sde brgyad spyi dang phyogs 'di ru/ /gnas pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag rnams/ /'dir gshegs gser skyems mchod pa bzhes/

/gegs zhi bsam don myur grub mdzod/ /༈ gnam sa snang brgyad las/ gang zhig gza' skar dang zhag dus ngan pa dang*/ nyi nag dang sa bdag stobs chen rgyu dus lta bur dbang med du phyogs bskyod dang ro bag zor las sogs bgyid dgos byung tshe bsang dang sde brgyad mchod pa sngon du btang nas lo zla'i phyogs gtsang gi gtor 'bul ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dbus gnas pa'i: lo zlar 'khor ba'i sa bdag dang : gza' dang rgyu skar 'gyu ba sogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang : nyu le bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis: mthun pa'i gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra dang gshed du ma 'beb cig: lha dang dpal du bskyed par gyis: ko long ru nga zhi ba dang : phrag dog gdug sems ma 'ching zhig: oṃ ma ma kun ta shra bā ṇa ye swā hā: phul lo: de nas spar kha ho yi phyag rgya phyogs su bstan cing : sa bdag gi sgrib shing gtong ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa'i tshe: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sa mtshams gzigs: srid snang tshogs drug zil gyis mnan: snod kyi 'gyu ba phra rags gzhom: 'byung lnga'i 'phro 'du dbang du bsdus: ye shes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yis: lo zla snyoms shing dgra gshed zhi: de bzhin de ring rgyu sbyor gyis: ye shes ho yi phyag rgyas bsdams: de 'og bsam yas mchims phu ru: gtsug lag sa 'dul bgyis pa'i tshe: dregs 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rdo rje mi shigs phyag rgya yis: 'khor 'das snod bcud shugs las mnan: srid pa gsum gyi sgrib shing gdab: lha 'dre 'khrugs grol gdug rtsub zhi: de bzhin de ring rgyu sbyor gyis: spar kha ho yi phyag rgyas bsdams: 'byung ba kun gyi phrag dog rnams: srung ba 'di yis zhi gyur cig: lo yi dgra gshed bsal du gsol: oṃ shang shang shing shing dha rod dha la ma ru pa ye ār+ya pa ra yang gyang ta shrī sarba e haṃ ya ti twa shud+dhe ho dz+nyā na badz+ra pañca ye swā hā:

lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra dang gshed kha dur kha bye ba thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: zhes gang dgos phyogs su 'dzugs: lo rgyal po zla ba blon po zhag dmag mi dus tshod mtshon cha rnams la dbang ba'i lo rgan drug cu spar kha brgyad sme ba dgu phyi nang gsang ba'i sa bdag gza' gyong po skar ma gung rgyu sgra gcan gdong 'jug sgyu skar nyer brgyad the se rgyal po la sogs pa sa bdag rgyal po rje blon hal khyi nag po pi ling rgyu ba sogs snang srid lha 'dre thams cad srid pa ho yi phyag rgya 'di la ltos shig /ru nga phrag dog ma byed cig dgra dang gshed du ma 'dzin par dpal dang mgon skyabs mdzod/ snang brgyad snying po ni: oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a bhi la man dha la maṇ+ḍa le ma ye swā hā: zhes ci nus bzlas so: mthar bkra shis brjod cing phrin las kyi bya ba gang dgos la 'jug go: 7 zhes pa 'di'ang rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi cha lag snang brgyad nas gu h+yas khol du phyung ba'o// // ༈ dag snang las: gu ru'i gsol 'debs rten 'brel nyes sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so: gang zhig las dang rkyen dbang gis: gang bsam thog tu mi khel zhing : bya ba mtha' ru mi 'khyol bar: bar chad mang zhing mi khas sdang : de tshe gu ru 'byung ba bzhir: dbang bsgyur 'byung bzhi'i phyag mtshan can: 'byung bzhi'i lha mo grangs med kyis: bskor ba mdun mkhar bsgom byas la: the tshom med par gsol 'debs gnad: sa ma ya: e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i: ma lus skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal mchog: blo gtad gcig chog gu ru pad+ma la: gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: phyi nang mchod 'bul nyams chag sding ltung bshags: yi rang bskul zhing dge ba byang chub bsngo: rgyu rkyen dbang gis phyi nang 'byung ba'i khams: rten 'brel nyes tshogs dbyings su zhi ba dang :
