legs tshogs dpal spel yid bzhin nor bu ltar: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ha ri ni sa sid+dhi hūm̐: rten 'brel snying po dang*/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i rten 'brel nyes tshogs thams cad myur du zhi bar gyur cig: oṃ sarba shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: phyi nang 'byung ba'i rten 'brel legs tshogs thams cad rab tu rgyas par gyur cig: bh+rūm̐ sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: phyi nang 'byung ba'i rten 'brel legs pa'i snang ba thams cad bdag gis dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: hrīḥsarba wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: phyi nang 'byung ba'i rten 'brel nyams pa'i 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i bar chad thams cad dmigs med kyi dbyings su brlag par gyur cig: hūm̐ sarba mā ra ya phaṭḥ brgya stong khri 'bum gsol btab na: bsam rgu 'grub par the tshom med: rgyun tu kha ton byed pa'i mi'i: nyes tshogs zhi zhing legs tshogs 'phel: ji ltar 'dod 'byung bum bzang bzhin: bya ba gang bsam thogs pa med: gnas skabs dang ni mthar thug la: ci bsam gegs med 'grub par nges: nyams su longs dang bden 'bras mngon: sa ma ya: zhes pa'ang rten 'brel rab tu 'grigs pa'i skabs shig tu nges gsang bstan pa'i srog shing*/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rdo rjes bkra shis pa'i rdzas bcas bskul ngor/ ka ma la rā dza dī pas shar mar bris pa don dang ldan par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ khrus kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa la/ thog mar bya ba'i rgyud du gtogs pa'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs ni/ hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa yi/ /rdo rje khro bo skur ston pa/ /rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa na ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje la bzhugs te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rje'i lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rdo rje khro bo las byung ba/ rdo rje'i snying po rab tu smras te/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jig bar byed pa/ rigs sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ rigs sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ gdon thams cad rlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/ rigs sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ sems can thams cad bsrung ba/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rmugs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi mthu chen po 'di/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥsh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+yathā/ om̐ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭā ya s+pho ṭā ya/ ghūr+ṇa ghūr+ṇa/ ghūr+ṇā pa ya ghūr+ṇā pa ya/ sarba sa twa ni/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ saṃ bo dha ya/ saṃ bo dha ya/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ sarba sha trūn na/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya/ saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bing+yā badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/

ma tha badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra su badz+rā ya swā hā/ he phu lu ni ru phul+lu/ gṛ ha na kul+lu/ mi li tsul+lu/ ku ru kul+lu/ badz+ra bi dzā yā ya swā hā/ kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā da ra ṇā ya swā hā/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+dha bhin+dha ma hā kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ban+dha ban+dha/ kro dha badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ tra sa ya tra sa ya/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañja nā ya swā hā/ ma tis+d+yi ra badz+ra/ shru tis+d+yi ra badz+ra/ pra tis+d+yi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra dha ra ya swā hā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā warta ya swā hā/ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭḥ na maḥs man+ta badz+ra ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā warta ya/ ma hā ba le/ ka ta be/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍal mā ye/ a ti badz+ra ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ting ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dz+wa ba ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dz+wa la swā hā/ na mo rat+na trā yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā na ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+yathā/ om̐ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da badz+ra/ bhin+dha bhin+dha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed/ /rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ /dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan/

/sems can dbang po nyams pa dang*/ /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang*/ /phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang*/ /lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang*/ /mdza' sdug skye bos sdang ba dang*/ /bran bza' la sogs gtses pa dang*/ /phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang*/ /nor 'grib pas ni gnod pa dang*/ /mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa dang*/ /'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa dang*/ /gza' dang sgyu skar byad stems dang*/ /mi gzad gdon gyis nyen pa dang*/ /mya ngan ngal las byung ba yi/ /rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang*/ /des ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yin/ /mdo sde dam pa nyan par gyis/ /gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing*/ /gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis/ /srog chags dag ni thams cad kyis/ /mi bzad pa yi nad rnams kyang*/ /de dag thams cad zhi bar lta/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /nor bu nyungs dkar dūr ba dang*/ /rin chen rma med tsan dan bcas/ /shel dang rdo rje me tog dang*/ /chu yis gser ram yang na ni/ /dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung*/ /gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkri zhing 'gang*/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas ni/ /rgyal pos rtag tu khrus gyis shig /om̐/ sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /rdo rje sku yi bkra shis shog /āḥ gsung mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi bkra shis shog hūm̐/ thugs mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /rdo rje thugs kyi bkra shis shog /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'god par shog /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī yak+ṣ+mī ka ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o/

/dus phyis dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas rgya dpe bzang po dang*/ rgya 'grel bzang po rnams kyi 'bru sbyor dang mthun par shin tu dag par bgyis pa'o// // ༈ dam grib nyes pa kun sel gyi bdag bskyed sgom bzlas bzhugs so/ na mo/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lhar/ /gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub mchog thob phyir/ /sme ba brtsegs pa bsgom par bgyi/ lan gsum gyis skyabs sems bya/

sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/ /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog / ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan steng du/ /rang nyid khro chen sme brtsegs ni/ /mthing nag 'od zer kun 'phro ba/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs par bsgom/ /gnas gsum yi ge'i 'phro 'du las/ /zhi khro'i tshogs kun spyan drangs thim/ /thugs kar pad nyi hūm̐ mthing mthar/ /bzlas sngags mgar me'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /me yi tshwa tshwa 'khrugs shing 'phro/ /gnod byed nyams chag kun bsregs gyur/ om̐ u tsi ṭa ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ u ṭa mu ṭa ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ mon ṭa kro ta ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ a ko kro ta ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ a bhu kro ta ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ u ṭa sha ta ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ e ling e ṭa ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ la mon tra ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ as ni pis ni tra ya tor ya tor ya swā hā/ om̐ bhur kur ma hā pra ṇa ye/ bhur tsi bhur ki bi ma le/ uts+tshuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ tor ya tor ya swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa ci nus bya/ mthar nyer bsdu ni/ snod bcud 'od zhu rang nyid ni/ de yang mi dmigs 'od gsal ngang*/ khro rgyal snang stong chen por shar/ mi mthun phyogs kun bsrung bar gyur/ om̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sme ba brtsegs pa 'grub gyur nas/ 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ de yis sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo smon dang shis brjod bya/ zhes nyams grib chen po la brgya/ 'bring la bdun nam nyer gcig /chung ngu la bdun bzlas la sna bug tu phu btab pas nyams grib thams cad nyi mas mun pa ltar 'joms par gsungs so/ yang chu la sngags btab pa'i khrus byas pas nyams sgrib dag cing sngags kyi nus pa'ang bskyed par gsungs pas da lta'i gsang sngags rnams la med thabs med pa'i gdams ngag zab mo'o/

/gzhan yang sdig ltung sbyang ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa'i sngags bzlas pas khrus bya ba dang*/ nyin zhag gcig gi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir mi g.yo ba'i chu srung sogs kyang shes shing nus na skabs 'dir bya/ khyad par rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam la slob pas ni/ dbang lha spyan drangs shing dbang bskur bar bsams pas dngos sam yid kyis khrus kyi bya ba tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa dang*/ nang gi khrus bdud rtsi ril bu myang ba sogs kyang bya'o/ /༈ nad rims srung ba'i skor la/ o rgyan rin po che'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du: 'ja' 'od mkha' dbyings rnam dag grub pa'i dbus: gtan gyi skyabs mgon rje btsun o rgyan la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: dus ngan skye 'chi'i drag gcod sdug bsngal la: sman pa'i rgyal po mdzod cig o rgyan rje: las dbang sngon gyi rkyen gyur sdug bsngal na: skyob pa'i ded dpon mdzod cig o rgyan rje: bsod nams las 'bras chung ba'i skal med la: longs spyod dpal 'byor rgyas shig o rgyan rje: ya nga skyi g.ya' bar do'i lam 'phrang las: sgrol ba'i ded dpon mdzod cig o rgyan rje: thar med las kyi dmyal ba'i btson dong las: 'dren pa'i ded dpon mdzod cig o rgyan rje: tshe la long med skye 'chi dgra sdang na: log lta rkyen dbang ma gtong o rgyan rje: yams nad 'go ba'i sdug bsngal dar ba'i tshe: srung skyob nad yams bzlog cig o rgyan rje: skal med bod kyi rje 'bangs sdug bsngal na: mtha' dmag g.yul 'khrug bzlog cig o rgyan rje: glo bur 'khrug rtsod yul gyi 'pho 'gyur la: myur du zhi bar mdzod cig o rgyan rje: nam yang 'khrul zhing 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: byang chub lam sna ston cig o rgyan rje: bdag gis rtse gcig gsol ba drag tu 'debs: thugs rje ma chung o rgyan sprul pa'i sku:

byin gyis rlobs shig gu ru rin po che: skyabs med bod kyi sems can rje 'bangs la: mchog thun dngos grub myur ba nyid stsol shog: de dang 'brel bar 'go ba'i rims yams nad srung ba'i sngags ni: om̐ na ga sha la duḥ sha la tri dza la kha thaṃ: 'go ba'i rgya nad gzer thung gis mi tshugs par srungs shig gi tra badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: nangs snga mor snar dud pa ma song gong du brgya rtsa re bzlas nas sna bug ru phu byas na 'go nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs so: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas gser gling nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ gter kha gsum tshogs man ngag ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /lcags kyi phag rgod mgo dgu pa/ /ngar ngar ngur ngur 'jigs pa'i sgras/ /klu gnyan sa bdag dpa' bkong zhing*/ /bu ga dgu nas me chen gyis/ /nad dang nad bdag gzhob tu bsreg /rdo rje'i so dang lce rnon pos/ /srid pa gsum po brngubs shing za/ /rmig bzhis ri dang rgya mtsho brlag /dpa' rngam phag rgod 'jigs pa'i steng*/ /rang nyid gu ru drag po ni/ /mthing nag stong zil chag pa'i mdog /sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung khros pa'i sku/ /dar dang rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /g.yas pas gnam lcags rdo rje gdeng*/ /g.yon pas lcags kyi phur pa 'dril/ /sku dbus ro rkyang dbu ma'i nang*/ /rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon po gsal/ /rtsa gsum kha na sprul pa'i khyung*/ /dkar dmar mthing ga'i rnam par bsam/ /spyi gtsug khyung chen 'bar ba lding*/ /yang sprul bye ba grangs med pas/ /srid pa gsum po khyab par 'gengs/ /mchu sder ring la phra ba yis/ /gnod byed snying la za bar byed/ /rjes su lce spyang mang po yis/ /sde brgyad sdong zla thal bar brlag /om̐ pad+ma sha wa ri phaṭḥ nan par shig: nā ga nan: tad+ya thā: sarba bi ri ta: ha na ha na badz+re na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ sngags dmigs bzlas pa phun tshogs na/ /rang srung rdo rje'i go khrab yin/

/pha rol mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa'i/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yin/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sku srung yin/ /de phyir snying gi thig le dang*/ /dbyer med gcig tu mi bsre rgyu/ sa ma yaḥ bu kun bzang rgya mtsho'i re dogs rnam rtog gi rkun bu 'gog pa'i ched du pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba'o// // ༈ drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung gi mngon rtogs: nad 'joms par bu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ khro rgyal stobs 'dus drag por 'dud: ma 'ongs yang mtha' rtsod ldan gyi: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: bod mi mgo nag bsod nams chung : mi dge dug sbyor nag po yi: bar chad ldang zhing dus min 'chi: mtha' yi mi bzhi dbus su bsnyeg: dam sri 'dre rgod tsha ngar che: sngar gyi chos khrims sil bur 'thor: chos rgyal dmangs kyi khol bur 'bebs: gtsug lag bya sprang yul 'dres 'dzin: bcos thabs ma mchis nad rigs dar: srin mos sha khrag dmar 'gyed gtong : grib btsan shan pa rlung ltar 'tshub: dmar nad lhog yams tre tre hoḥ rims yams me dbal sha khol gyis: bar chad sdang zhing mi thog 'bud: smyo 'bog snying gzer steng grib kyi: ltas ngan sna dgu ldang ba'i dus: srung thabs man ngag khyad par can: gu ru bdag gis legs par gdams: jo mo mtsho rgyal khyod nyid kyis: yi ger thobs la gter du sbos: gter bdag dge bsnyen bzhi la bcol: gzho stod ti sgro'i brag la sbas: yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: gnubs ban dz+nyā na'i skye ba ni: pad+ma gter bdag gling la sprod: dur khrod tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan: sa gzhi mthing nag 'jam pa'i dal: dkyil 'khor bri zhing mchod pa bsham: las rim gzhung bzhin shes par bya: yang na spros med lugs ltar bya: rang nyid drag po'i nga rgyal gyis: bskyed rim gsal zhing drag sngags bzlas: rims yams lhog rgod gdon gyi rigs:

sbur ma mes khyer ci bzhin du: gzhom zhing bsregs pa'i dmigs pa bya: rang nyid srung ngam nad pa la: rdzas kyi gdams pa 'di ltar bstan: nag po dgu dang khyung lnga sman: gri khrag ke tshe shang tshe dang : dug khrag thod rus phag nag khrag: 'dzin pa thar nu ra nag khrag: de dag sngags shing ril bu bsgril: lus la 'chang ngam lto ru btang : zhag bdun dag la lan re bskyar: yang na yul srung dar lcog 'dzugs: snga zhogs dud pa ma btang gong : sngags bzlas bskyed rim gsal gyur na: 'go nad srung bar the tshom med: srung ba bya na rdzas rnams byugs: lus la rgyun du 'chang bar bya: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: lan gsum: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim ni: dang po skad cig dran rdzogs su: snang stong ma bcos 'di ltar gsal: hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing brdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: gzhung chen mo las so/ hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ rgya gram: ram̐ las me ri kham̐ rak+ta: sum̐ las zhing chen keṃ ri rab: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas rdzogs: ye shes me zer srung ba'i gur: mi shigs pho brang rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: oṃ badz+ra e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na hūm̐: de nas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: dur khrod e yi sa gzhi dbus: lha klu sde brgyad bsnol ba'i khrir: dam sri bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ drag rtsal pad+ma khrag 'thung sku: sku mdog dmar nag me zer 'phro: zhal gsum phyag drug zhal gdangs khro: spyan dgu smin ma glog ltar 'khyug:

dbu la rigs lnga'i khyung chen rdzogs: g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje me: g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul: dur khrod dpal chas yongs su rdzogs: zhabs bzhi khro bo'i 'gying stabs kyis: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog zhon: sa bdag klu yi gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: shar du sgrol ging srog bdag mthing : g.yas gsum spu gri chu gri me: g.yon gsum thod khrag snying dang sdig: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan: me yi bya khyung dmar nag zhon: hūm̐: lho ru gtum ging sngo nag 'bar: g.yas gsum tsit+ta me chu gri: g.yon gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ lcags sdig me: dur khrod dpal chas rab tu rdzogs: 'joms byed bya khyung kham nag zhon: hūm̐: nub tu khro ging dmar nag gtum: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug thod: g.yon gsum 'khor lo spu gri sdig: khro chas rdzogs shing rngam pa la: srog gzan bya khyung ser nag zhon: hūm̐: byang du las ging ljang nag rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum tri shūl lcags sdig khyung : dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs la rngam: gtor byed bya khyung ljang nag zhon: kun kyang dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhal gsum gdangs shing spyan dgu bgrad: ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba brtsegs: dbu rgyan bya khyung dmag tshogs 'gyed: brkyang bskum khyung zhon gsal bar bskyed: mtshams bzhir khro bo sprul pa'i khyung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag rngam: gser mig zangs ra lcags mchu bgrad: me gshog rdeb cing khro sder bsnun: rgyal bsren dam sri'-i gnyen por bsgom: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ru: shar du ma mo sdig gdong ma: rgyal bsren 'joms pa'i gnyen por bsgom: lho ru ma mo chu srin gdong : klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen por bsgom: nub tu ma mo phag gdong ma: gson 'dre dam sri'i gnyen por bsgom: byang du ma mo khyung gdong ma: yams nad dus 'khrugs gnyen por bsgom: las kyi ma mo mched bzhi po:

gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams: gcer mo mtshan bsgrad stong khams nyul: chibs su lcags sdig mgo dgu bcibs: stobs kyis dpag tshad stong khams g.yo: yams nad 'joms pa'i gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: phyi rol sprul pa'i bya khyung 'gyed: gzhan yang las byed pho nya rnams: snang srid rol pa'i rtsal shar nas: chu zla rmi lam ji bzhin bsgom: spros med spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: dgongs shig che mchog drag po rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha': dus 'khrug yams nad rgyal 'gong dang : dam sri gnod byed kha dar bas: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: nad bdag choms la nad mkhar shigs: nad dal chod la yams dal sgyur: nad mtshon bsregs gtor rdul du rlog: sgrub pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams su: bya khyung sprul pa'i dmag dpung 'khrigs: me gshog rlabs bskyod stong gsum g.yo: drag sngags gzir 'debs srid gsum gzhom: yams nad gdug pa thal bar rlog: hūm̐: bskul lo rig 'dzin mthu ma chung : rbad do bya khyung rtsal ma zhan: brten no ma mo bang ma bul: g.yab bo sgrol ging rgyang ma ring : nad mtshon gdug pa'i dbal zor 'di: myur du gzhom pa'i phrin las mdzod: dzapa ྄bzla ba ni: gzhung dang man ngag gi dgongs pa'i dgos pa gsal btab la: ༈ bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid thugs kar nyi zla'i steng*/ /ye shes sems pa gsang bdag mthing*/ /de yi thugs kar ting 'dzin sems/ /snang mtha'i thugs kar thig le'i klong*/ /dmar nag hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng*/ /'khor ba'i 'od zer dpag yas 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal mchod byin dbang bsdus/ /nad gdon dgra bgegs tshar thag bcad/ /'gro ba'i sgrib dag snod bcud sbyangs/ /mdor na snang grags rtog pa'i chos/ /pad ma drag po'i sku gsung thugs/

/lha sngags ye shes rol par gyur/ zhes pa'ang gnam lcags gu h+yas rang gi dgos mkho'i ched gter gzhung dgongs pa dang mthun par sbyar ba'o// oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bsnyen pa dang : oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: zhes sgrub sngags ji ltar rem par bzla: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: snang srid thams cad drag po e yi klong : snod bcud gzugs snang yi dam lha yi sku: 'byung 'jug rlung rnams rang bzhin snying po'i sngags: khams kyi rang mdangs khro bo rol pa'i rtsal: gnas lugs ma bcos skye med yi ge hūm̐: rang rig ngo bo che mchog drag po rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng sku mdog mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing drag tu khros: rdo rje gri gug ral gri g.yas su thogs: bhan dmar thong gshol lcags sdig g.yon na bsnams: rdo rje sgro gdengs dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: rdo rje phag mo zangs mdog gri thod 'dzin: brkyang bskum ye shes gar gyis pang du 'khyud: 'bar ba'i zer ldan me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs byed drag po'i sku yi char: spyi bor snang mtha' rigs kyi bdag: steng du sprul pa'i bya khyung rngam: dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje 'jigs: mgrin par dbang chen rta mgrin gshe: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje gtum: lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu 'bar: gsang bar yak+sha khro bo brjid: phyag g.yas badz+ra kī la ya: phyag g.yon rat+na kī la ya: zhabs g.yas pad+ma kī la ya: zhabs g.yon karma kī la ya: gsang ba yum gyi gnas lnga ru: bde chen mkha' 'gro sde bzhis gar: gzhon nu rgyan rdzogs cha lugs 'chang :

drag po yab yum phyogs bzhi ru: 'jigs byed ging chen yab yum bzhi: sgrol ging gtum ging khro ging dang : las kyi ging bcas yab yum brgyad: mtshams su sprul pa yang sprul bcas: gzhan yang sgo skyong la sogs pa: dbang drag rdo rje srin po yi: sku gsung thugs kyi gzi brjid rnams: stobs bcu 'gyed phyir sprul pa'i lha: srid gsum mngon spyod las kyis sdud: stong gsum sde brgyad dam la btags: gling khams kun la 'dren zla bral: sku las khro chung tshwa tshwa 'phro: me ri 'bar mched wa la la: 'byung po mi dang mi min sogs: bgegs dang dam sri ma lus kun: drag po'i stobs kyis tshar bcad gyur: rang bzhin hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes hūm̐ sgra sgrogs shing snang srid thams cad res 'ga' khro bo khro mo res 'ga' hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan snang srid kyi khyon thams cad khengs par bsgom/ skabs su rang bzhin 'ub kyis bdag la bsdu ba mi dmigs gsal stong ka dag ngang la bsgom: rang nyid che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las kyi ging bzhi sprul pa'i khyung lnga sgrol ba'i ma mo bzhi khro bo rang 'dra dang bcas nas skar mda' 'khrugs pa ltar: me dpung gi rang bzhin 'bar zhing stong khams khengs bar 'phros pas: nad nad bdag dang bcas pa hub hub ljib ljib tu zos nas lhag ma med pa rdul du brlags par bsam: yang lcags sdig nag po bye ba dung phyur 'phros shing rgyal nad srog rlung du gyur pa rnams brlags par bsam: ging bzhi'i sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra tsakra kro ta tsaṇ+ḍa grī wa tsa tur kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ khyung lnga'i sngags ni: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa pañca hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro mo sha za bzhi la: oṃ ma mo mu kha le kro ti tsa tur baṃ ru lu ru lu bh+yoḥ phag sdig khyung lnga la:

oṃ wa ra hi pa paṃ khrom̐ ṭa ya bh+yoḥ dang po las sngags nad 'joms ni: oṃ ma hā gu ru khrom̐ ka ra ging ka ra tsa mun tri ta ya: ka la dun+ti tsit+ta la bh+yo bh+yoḥ oṃ she la du ging rā dza shig shig: nā ga du na dun+ti tri zlog zlog: oṃ a ka tsa tu mā ra ya rbad rbad: rak+sha du tri snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ tsha ba tsha nad mā ra ya nan nan: oṃ du na du na shig shig: hag tshal pa kha la dun+ti bh+yo bh+yoḥ ha ching rba du tri kha la bh+yo bh+yoḥ spel tshig sbyar: tsit+ta zung zung yaṃ yaṃ rmug rmug: chum chum baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad rbad: las sngags nad bdag 'joms byed ni: oṃ du ching nag po nad bdag gi srog la rbad rbad: pra ching nag po bdun drug gi sha la zo zo: khro chu khol ma rgya nad kyi snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bya khyung nag po rgyu gzer gyi snying la rbad rbad: lcags sdig nag po rgyal bsren gyi srog la chum chum: phag nag khro gtum rims yams kyi dbugs la sdud sdud: trig khrom̐ nag po sha khol gyi snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bhe tri nag po khrag skyug gi nad la thum thum: artsig nag po dmar bshal gyi srog la rngub rngub: ka ru nag po rgya 'brum gyi nad la shig shig: khe tra nag po rgyug gzer gyi srog la hur hur: yak+sha nag po 'go nad kyi srog la rbad rbad: trig khrom̐ ra tsa khrag skyug gi nad la rbad rbad: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa pañca 'byung lnga'i nad la shig shig: nad bdag rims bdag pho mo myog myog dril dril: thun thun rbad rbad swā hā: zhes drag sngags rnams yengs med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzla/ mthar bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung ye shes dkyil 'khor lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu gtso la bsdu: gtso nyid hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang dmigs med klong : ka dag rang byung shar grol klong du hoḥ a āḥ bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo:

sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral: gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: dmigs pa bskyed rim ltar la: de nas rim bzhin dmigs pa spro bsdu bya ste rdzas la sngags chu sbyar zhing rang ngam gzhan bsrung na sbyin: yang na nad pa sogs la sbyin na rdzas rnams mang bar bya: yul bsrung na: ras sam shing shun la bris te rgyal mtshan du gzugs pas rlung gi zer phog pa rnams la bsrung bar 'gyur ro: rang nyid nad pa'i sa ru 'gro na: snga zhogs dud pa sna la ma song dus: sngags rnams mang du bzlas shing sna bug tu spur bas srung ba'i mchog: yang na rdzas la sngags shing bu ga dgu dgag par bya: nad lam gcod pa ni shing tsher ma can la sngags te phyogs bzhir 'dzugs: mnan pa ni: liṅga bris shing 'gugs gzhug bya la: shing tsher ma can la sngags pas lan dgu brab ste: lam rgya gram du mnan: sreg pa ni: thugs dam bskul zhing sngags te tsher ma can gyi me ru bsreg: 'phang ba ni: thugs dam bskul te rdo thun gyi zor steng 'og phyogs bzhir 'phang : skyabs pa ni: sngags chu steng 'og khang khyim du steng 'og tu gtor: spo ba ni: dar lcog bris pas tshang : srung ba ni: lcags sdig pho mo gnyis kyi khog par sngags 'di 'bri zhing las sngags kyis rab tu gnas te la chas dril la 'chang : sdig pa pho yi khog par 'di bris: papaṃbadunadruganadalasrungasashig: sdig pa mo yi khog par: nghararimasayamasalasrungasashig: khang par 'dzugs na bya khyung pho'i khog par: garuḍapakhyingadza'agonadalasrungasashig: bya khyung mo yi khog par: khroṃthaḍagingahara'agoba'inadalasrungasashig: yul bsrung na phag nag po pho yi lto bar: ghakhyingarādzaganyan rgodalasrungasashig: phag nag po mo yi lto bar:

trishigaharalhogayamasalasrungasashig: ces bris te: thams cad la rdzas kyis byugs nas dril la thum dmar nag bya'o: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug mchog: yang zab drag po khyung zhon 'di: sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: ma 'ongs yang mtha' kha ral la: 'go nad sna dgu dar ba'i tshe: bsam gtan nyal chog bsgrub pa 'di: 'gogazand nathayan+dad: thugs sras bud+dha dz+nyā na yi: byin brlabs sprul pa shes rab can: pad+ma gter bdag gling pa la: sprod cig dge bsnyen sde bzhi rgya: gter srung sman mo mched bzhi khyod: dam chos 'di yi mel tshe gyis: dam nyams bdud rigs log lta can: snying med dred po skal chad mkhan: lag tu ma shor sa ma ya: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra smyo spyod can gter bdag gling pas 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen po nas gdan drangs shing*/ sbas yul pad+ma rong du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ gter gzhung gzhir bzhag gi chog khrigs 'di bzhin gnam sprul lnga pa bzod pa rab brtan gyi zhal 'don du bzhugs pas rje nyid kyis mdzad pa min nam snyam/ kho bos kyang chung ngu'i dus nad khrod dang ro sngas su yang yang bskyod dgos par 'go nad 'byung gis dogs nas yab rje gnam lcags bkra shis las zhal shes blangs te bsnyen tshad 'brel 'jog dang*/ rgyun khyer nyams len bya srol bzhin gu h+yas slar bsdebs pa lags// // ༈ khro rgyal sme brtsegs la brten nas: dam tshig nyams grib sbyong ba ni: zhi ba'i thab tu bud shing brtsig: me sbar bsang chus legs par gtor: rang nyid yi dam nga rgyal gyis: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: ye shes me phung cher 'bar dbus: hūm̐ las khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs: dud kha'i mdog can khro bo'i nyams: phyag gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad: dar dang rin chen sbrul gyis brgyan: zhabs gnyis dor stabs pad nyir bzhengs:

dam tshig ye shes dbyer med bsam: rang gi skra sen gos dum sogs: dam tshig nyams chag sdig sgrib dang : grib dang mi gtsang 'dus par mos: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: zhal du phul bas lhag med bzhes: dgyes tshim 'od zer 'bar ba yis: bdag gi mi mthun kun sbyangs bsam: til dang yungs kar cung zad bcas: om̐ bhur kur ma hā pra ṇā ya: bhur tsi bhur ki bi ma le: uts+tshuṣ+ma kro dha rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pā paṃ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā: skabs su las sngags 'di yang spel: om̐ ma ṇi dha ri hri da a nu pā sha dha ri hri da hūm̐ phaṭḥ lha nyid 'od zhu rang la thim: ye shes me yis sdig sgrib dang : grib dang mi gtsang thams cad kun: lhag med nyid du bsregs par bsam: me la 'gom pa lan dgu bya: thal ba sāts+tsha gdab pa'am: yang na chu bo chen por bskyal: 'dis ni dam tshig nyams chag dang : nyams grib tshe gegs ma lus zhi: bsod nams 'byor pa thob par 'gyur: zhes gsungs so/ thugs sgrub zhal gdams snying byang las so// de dag ni thor thun dang de yi thun mtshams dang 'brel ba'i cha lag go ༈ byang sdom blang chog dpal sprul gsung rgyun ltar bkod pa bzhugs so/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba byang sdom blang ba'i thog mar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan rjes su dran par bya ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes su 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni bsod nams dag gi rgyu mthun pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud mi za ba/ bzod pas rab tu brgyan pa/ bsod nams kyi gter rnams kyi gzhi/ dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis spras pa/

mtshan rnams kyi me tog rgyas pa/ spyod yul ran par mthun pa/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ dad pas mos pa rnams la mngon par dga' ba/ shes rab zil gyis mi non pa/ stobs rnams la brdzi ba med pa/ sems can thams cad kyi ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyal po/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon/ ye shes dpag tu med pa/ spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gsung rnam par dag pa/ dbyangs snyan pa/ sku byad blta bas chog mi shes pa/ sku mtshungs pa med pa/ 'dod pa dag gis ma gos pa/ gzugs dag gis nye bar ma gos pa/ gzugs med pa dag dang ma 'dres pa/ sdug bsngal las rnam par grol ba/ phung po dag las rab tu rnam par grol ba/ khams rnams dang mi ldan pa/ skye mched rnams bsdams pa/ mdud pa rnams shin tu bcad pa/ yongs su gdung ba dag las rnam par grol ba/ sred pa las grol ba/ chu bo las brgal ba/ ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes la gnas pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa ste/ 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku che ba'i yon tan yang dag pa rnams so/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos legs par gsungs pa/ yang dag par mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad pa med pa/ nye bar gtod pa/ 'di mthong ba la don yod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis so sor rang gis rig par bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la legs par brten pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mi mthun pa med cing 'dus pa dang ldan pa/

brten pa yod pa/ rgyu ba bcad pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun ni legs par bzhugs pa/ rigs par bzhugs pa/ drang por bzhugs pa/ mthun par bzhugs pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing*/ yon yongs su sbyong ba chen po/ sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ kun tu'ang sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa chen po'o/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /chos kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dge 'dun yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad byas pa'i/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog /byang chub kyi sems rin po che dngade ldan gang zag byang chub sems dpa' la khyad par du gus shing skyabs su gsol ba ni/ ngan 'gro'i las ni zlog bgyid cing*/ /mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ de nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/

chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir 'khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā wartā ya ā wartā ya ho s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing 'di dag tu lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya la sogs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha ne/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dz+wa badz+re/ ma hā bing+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ṭo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badz+re swā hā/ lan gsum/ de nas rgyal ba 'khor bcas bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan 'dren pa ni/ phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas/ /nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs te/ /dpag med zhing na thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/

khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnam kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag la/ /thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ zhes spyan drangs/ bzhugs gsol ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ gdan 'bul ba ni/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas sbyor ba tshogs gsog yan lag bdun gyi dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pa/ /bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyes bu khyu mchog khyod 'dra'i dge sbyong chen po gzhan dag lha yul sa la'ang med/ 'jig rten 'di na'ang yod pa ma yin rnam thos bu yi gnas na'ang yod ma yin/ lha yi pho brang gnas mchog dag na'ang med la phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag na'ang med/ ri dang nags su bcas pa'i sa steng rgyas pa kun tu bskor kyang ga la yod/ ces dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa ni/ skur gyur pa ni thams cad la'ang*/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' ba'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo/

/rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*/ /gang du byang chub la reg dang*/ /zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /zag med mya ngan 'das pa dang*/ /bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*/ /'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*/ /seṅge lta bur gzims pa yi/ /gnas de la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*/ /skur bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ de ltar tshigs bcad bstod pa gnyis res mos kyis 'don par bya/ de nas thub pa'i mdzad bcu'i bstod pa che ba ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis dang por byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ /bsod nams sogs zhes sam/ spro na kun mkhyen 'jigs gling gsungs thub ba'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bstod pa ni/ dga' ba brgya ldan 'chi med grong khyer nas/ /byang chub sems kyi dam pa tog dkar po/ /shākya'i rigs kyi thig ler 'dzin pa'i snod/ /sgyu 'phrul lha mo ri dwags mig can yin/ /'od stong shar gyi ri la chas pa bzhin/ /lhums kyi ge sar bzhad pa lum+bi'i tshal/ /tshangs dang dbang pos sri zhus mdzes byas shing*/ /byang chub rigs su lung bstan la phyag 'tshal/ /lang tshos dregs pa'i shākya gzhon nu'i dbus/ /sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rol rtsed mthu/ /kun gyis khyod la btud cing grags pa yi/ /skye dgu'i rnam shes mig dang rna bar rdzogs/ /'dod sred zhags pas gzhan dbang ma gyur bzhin/ /yab gcig dgyes slad btsun mo'i sgyu ma la/ /sgyu ma'i lta bas bltas nas rgyal po'i khab/ /bskyangs pas don kun grub pa la phyag 'tshal/ /shin tu g.yo zhing 'jigs pa rgyal srid kyi/ /lcags kyu'i dbang du ma gyur 'ga' med kyang*/ /nges par 'byung ba'i rkyen bzhis khyod kyi thugs/ /phrogs nas rang byung dge slong nyid du bstan/ /brtson 'grus rlabs kyis mi ngal nai rañjar/ /dka' thub gdung ba bzod pa'i snying stobs dang*/

/kun rtog 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i bsam gtan la/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs dgyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grangs med gsum gyi srid du rnam rig kun/ /tshogs gnyis tha gus bcings pa don yod phyir/ /byang chub shing drung bdud rnams skrag byas nas/ /mngon par rdzogs sangs rgya ba rgyal kun gshis/ /'khor ba gting mtha' med pa'i g.yang sa la/ /rgyug pa'i 'gro ba 'khor lo gsum gyi grus/ /bsgral nas thar pa dang ni rnam mkhyen gyi/ /go 'phang bkri ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtog cing dpyod kyang sdom pa min pa'i chang*/ /'thungs pas ches gzir mu stegs ston pa'i lce/ /mnyan du yod pa'i cho 'phrul mthus bcad pas/ /skyengs dang gzi brjid nyams pa'i cho ga rdzogs/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi la mchog thob khyod/ /skye rga na 'chi'i tshor ba mi myong yang*/ /nges par pha rol 'gro 'di mi sems rnams/ /skyo slad mya ngan 'da' ston der phyag 'tshal/ /bsod nams nyam chung gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /dkar po'i chos rab 'phel ba'i tshong zong ni/ /'dzad pa med pa'i ring bsrel cha brgyad du/ /bzhag ste chos kyi dbyings su gzims pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin nas/ khams gsum las 'das 'og min chen po ru/ /mngon par sangs rgyas sprul pa'i mdzad pa bcus/ /kun mkhyen khyed dang 'gro don mnyam par shog /de ltar mdzad bcu'i bstod pa rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung res chog /yang bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa'i phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seṅge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dwang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/

/rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ gnyis pa mchod pa'i yan lag ni/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ /dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ /sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ma rmos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg pa ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

/sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /traṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes bla ma 'phags pa'i lugs dang*/ spro na snying thig rang gzhung sku gsum maṇ+ḍal ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ stong gsum 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing ཿ rin chen sna bdun lha mi'i 'byor pas gtamasaḥ bdag lus longs spyod bcas pa yongs 'bul gyisaḥ chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i srid thob shogaḥ 'og min bde chen stug po bkod pa'i zhingaḥ nges pa lnga ldan rigs lnga'i tshom bu canaḥ 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam yas paḥ phul bas longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shogaḥ snang srid rnam dag gzhon nu bum pa'i skuḥ thugs rje ma 'gags chos nyid rol pa'i rgyanaḥ sku dang thig le'i 'dzin pa rnam dag zhingaḥ phul bas chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shogaḥ ces sku gsum maṇ+ḍal 'di ma bton kyang chad skyon du ni mi 'gyur snyam/ gang ltar yang 'dod gsol smon lam ni/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod/ /bdag lus longs spyod snang srid yongs bzhes nas/ /bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di 'bul bas/ /byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ /dus gsum bde gshegs dgongs pa rtogs pa dang*/ /srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing*/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /ces dang*/ de nas/

/me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*/ /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*/ /mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*/ /phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*/ /bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ lus 'bul ba ni/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /bdag gi sgo gsum gtan du 'bul bar bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su gzung bas na/ /srid la mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi/ /sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*/ /sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do/ /gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas/ /da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ /zhe sdang dang*/ /gti mug gi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ /mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ /pha dang ma la ma gus pa dang*/ /mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa dang*/ /grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa dang*/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa dang*/ /dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa dang*/

/sems can la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa la sogs pa sdig pa mi dge ba'i tshogs bdag gis bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ /gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ /'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /phyin chad sdom par bgyid lags so/ /mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ /ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*/ /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ zhes dang*/ bzhi pa rjes su yi rang sogs yan lag lhag ma bzhi ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*/ /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*/ /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /de nas tshad med bzhi'i blo sbyong ba ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig

/ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ de nas yongs su bzung ba'i gzhi gsum gtong ba ni/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /phangs pa med par btang bar bya/ de nas dgongs gsol sngon du 'gro ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang*/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes dang*/ de nas dngos gzhi smon 'jug stabs gcig tu blang ba ni/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub tu ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*/ /rim par bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ zhes sbrel ba lan gsum gyis sems bskyed blangs la/ mjug tu gzengs bstod cing dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /long bas phyags dar phung po las/ /ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar/

/de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la skyes/ zhes dang*/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ zhes dang*/ smon lam gyi rim pa ni/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*/ /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*/ /bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /ces dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa/ /sems can rnams la'ang de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog /ces brjod cing*/ rjes 'brel du tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs 'don pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ā mo gha shī la/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shud+dha sa twa pad+ma bi bhu ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta/ a wa lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ de nas smon lam gyi rim pa ni/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /nyon mongs pas tshul khrims 'chal ba las byung ba'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig /'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyi skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /nyon mongs pas mi brdzi bar rnam par grol ba'i bde ba la reg par gnas par gyur cig

/ces dang*/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /ces dang*/ rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /ces dang*/ gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong la goms pa'i mthus/ /rmi lam na yang sdig sems mi 'byung zhing*/ /byang chub sems dang nam yang mi 'bral ba'i/ /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang 'phags mchog sdug bsngal rang grol mi yi rdzu la zhugs pa mkhyen rtogs 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i gsung rgyun ji lta ba bzhin/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma las rim par brgyud/ rje btsun bla ma 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi bu chen dpal yul pad+ma nor bu'i mchog sprul thub bstan chos kyi glang pos gdan sa brda go dgon du klong snying rtsa gsum cho ga rnams dang lhan cig tu par bskrun mdzad pa nyid zhu dag ma grub khar 'don bya phal cher sogs khongs su bsdu ches pas/ kun gyis shar 'don mi bde bar brten dgos dbang gis yi ge'i zhu dag dang sogs khongs rnams nag 'gros su bkod/ yig chung gsal byed kyis kyang brgyan te 'jug bde bar bya bral sangs rgyas rdo rjes zad byed sa zla'i tshes 8 dge ba la sbas yul pad+ma'i tshal gyi sgrub pa grong du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo gsal a bhā yas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ snga thun gyi mjug tu chu gtor rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya ba la dang po/ ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las:

gtor ma bsdus pa byang chub chu rgyun bzhugs so: 'khor 'das zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: gtor mgron byang chub chu rgyun bstan: dang po chung ngu'i sbyin pa yis: dge tshogs dpag yas 'byung ba'i thabs: sems bskyed mchod sbyin 'di nyid zab: sa ma ya: gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ni: rin chen snod mchog gang rung du: rab ni sman bzang sbrang bu ram: dkar gsum dag gi ril bu bsgril: 'bring ni nas 'bras gro khre til: phye ma zhib 'thag ril bu bsgril: tha ma nas sam gang rung 'bru: snod gtsang dag tu legs par bsham: ting 'dzin rnam gsum mi dmigs ngang : khrus dang gtsang sbra dang bcas te: lha bskyed dmigs pa gsal bar bya: de yang theg pa che chung ste: rab ni stong nyid mchod yul bral: 'bring yang zung 'jug rten 'brel gces: tha ma dmigs pa sems bskyed gtso: sa ma ya: dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis dang po skyabs 'gro ni: na moḥ bla ma bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum: dkon mchog rnam gsum skyabs yul lha yi tshogs: rtse gcig 'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus kyis: bla med byang chub thob phyir skyabs su gsol: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang gsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don rtogs phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa rang nyid lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig pad zla'i steng : rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin bdud rtsi na ra ra: g.yon pas skyabs sbyin rigs drug sdug bsngal sel: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'gro ba'i mgon gyur gsal: oṃ lo ki shwa ra ya a wa lo ki te hri da ya swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: ci nus bzlas/ bzhi pa khrus gsol ba ni:

hūm̐: gnas lnga'i 'od zer phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas: sangs rgyas byang sems rigs lnga spyan drangs nas: dbang bskur sku gang khrus bstsal sdig sgrib dag: chu yi lhag ma 'od dpag dbu rgyan gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas rten khrus gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor la: sku gsung thugs yon nyon mongs mi mnga' yang : rigs drug sems can sdug bsngal sbyang slad du: ye shes lnga yi khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: shes bya'i las sgrib nyon mongs dag gyur nas: 'gro kun bla med byang chub thob gyur cig: khrus bya zhing*/ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: om̐ dz+nyā na pañca a bhi ṣe ka te kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: sku phyi/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ na bza' 'bul/ lnga pa khrus chu snod du gtams te yi dwags la sbyin pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: chu rgyun sbreng bzhin/ lan nyer gcig gam bdun gyis bsngo la: hūm̐: bdag nyid 'phags mchog kha sar pa ṇi yi: phyag nas babs pa'i bdud rtsi mchod sbyin gyis: stong gsum srid pa'i yi dwags tshims byas nas: nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod ldan par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum mam grangs med dang : oṃ dz+wa la mi daṃ sarba pre ta bh+ya swā hā: lan bdun/ sbyin pa 'di yis bsod nams gang*/ /de dag yi dwags phyi bzhin song*/ /yi dwags 'jig rten rab 'jigs las/ /de dag myur du grol bar shog /dmigs pas rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas snod bshal te dor nas gtsang ma bya: sa ma ya: dang po rin po che'i snod du gtor mchod bshams la: chu rgyun sbreng*/ oṃ aḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan nyer gcig gis bsngo: hūm̐: blo 'das chos dbyings yangs pa'i snod mchog tu:

zad med bcud mchog ting 'dzin rdzas kyis bkang : byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'di: bstan gnyis gtso bo shāka thub pad+ma 'byung : sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde: rig 'dzin drang srong grub thob brgyud par bcas: rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong nor lha gter gyi bdag: rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha grangs sam nyer gcig brjod: skabs 'dir kha bsngos brgyab kyang rung : gnyis pa mas mgron la 'bul zhing bsngo ba ni: gtor snod du rdzas gsar pa bshams la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan nyer gcig gis bsngo: hūm̐: snang srid snod mchog yangs pa'i snod nang du: bcud kyi 'byung lnga bdud rtsi'i rdzas su bsgyur: byin gyis brlabs pa'i longs spyod rgya mtsho 'di: dpal mgon bdun cu lha srin dregs sde brgyad: gza' klu rgyu skar brtan ma sa bdag sman: lo zla zhag dus chu tshod tshes kyi bdag: mgul lha bcu gsum gzhi bdag zo dor dang : bgegs rigs lan chags rigs drug snying rje'i mgron: bar dor 'khyams pa'i sems can ma lus par: bsngo'o lan chags sha 'khon 'khor gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: zhes nyer gcig gis bsngo: de nas gtor gzhong bshal te gtor ma nang du blugs la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan bdun gyis bsngo: hūm̐: rin chen yangs pa stong gsum snod kyi nang : zag med gtor mchod lhag ma bcud kyis bkang : byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di: glo bur lhags shing ming nas ma smos dang : khas zhan dbang chung ma rig ma thos sogs: gzhan yang sngon las 'phral rkyen dbang gyur pa:

rku 'phrog bcom gsum rdung rdeg srog bcad gtub: bu lon sha 'khon lan chags 'khor ba dang : lhag mar dbang ba'i 'byung po ma lus la: bsngos shing tshims nas re ba khengs gyur te: rnam mkhyen byang chub 'bras bu thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: nyer gcig gis bsngo bar bya: dzam lhar chu sbyin bya na 'dir sbyar/ mdun du pad zlar dzam las dzam lha ser/ /shing 'bras ne'u le bsnams shing brjid ldan bzhugs/ /pad nyir hūm̐ las dzam nag sbrul rgyan can/ /zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs thod khrag ne'u le bsnams/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od kyis ye shes bstim/ /dbang lhas dbang bskur rigs bdag dbu brgyan gyur/ /rang gi lag mthil zla steng yig 'bru lnga/ /rigs lnga zhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ rma dang me yi zug rngu zhi bar bsam/

oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hāḥ oṃ iṇ+ṭa ni mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā: dzam lha mnyes nas phyag gi ne'u le las/ /nor bu bskyugs nas gnas khang gang bar bsam/ /oṃ dzam+luṃ swā hā: oṃ sarba yak+sha dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/ dzaṃ sid+dhi pha la a la la hoḥs dngos grub blang*/ dzam lha ye shes pa rten la bzhugs shing dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ / mas mgron rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthar bzlas bya'i gzungs sngags g.yas su 'khor ba las sgra dang 'od zer gyis khams gsum snang bar byas/ dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bsgral bar gyur/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni sogs? oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs? oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ bi pu la gar+bhe/ ma ṇi pra bhe/ ta thā ga ta/ dha ri sha ni/ ma ṇi ma ṇi/ su pra bhe bi ma le sā ga ra/ gam+bhi re hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ bud+dha bi lo ki te/ gu h+ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te gar+bhe swā hā/ pad+mo dhā ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hrī da a nu ga te/ oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te pa ri sho dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ sho dha ni shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ a mi te/ a mi to bha be/ a mi te saṃ bha be/ a mi te bi krān+te gā mi ni/ ga ga ni kirti ka ri/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma dhā ri hūm̐/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+yai bhai ṣa dz+yai ma hā bhai ṣa dz+yai rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/

oṃ āḥhrī hūm̐/ oṃ hrī trai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/ om̐ pad+mo uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭḥ.oṃ āḥhrī hūm̐/ badz+ra sa ra pra ma dha na sarba karma a bā ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ bhurkuṃ ma hā pra ṇa ya/ bhur tsi bhur ku bi ma le u tsuṣ+ma kro dha rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya hu lu hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yaṃ ho? raṃ ho? baṃ ho? laṃ ho? e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ a a a swā hā/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharma ya/ na ma saṅgā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha sogs? sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs/ de nas chos ston pa ni: hūm̐: chos rnams rgyu med stong pa'i dbyings: rkyen gyis ma bsgyur dngos po med: 'dus ma byas kyi rang bzhin can: gsal stong ye shes snying po'i ngang : bla med theg chen sdom par gyis: byang chub so thar bslab sdom gyis: sdig pa mi dge bcu po dang : mtshams med lnga yi las rnams spongs: dge bcu sems bskyed ldan par gyis: srid par grub pa'i mgron rnams kun/ phan dge byang sems ldan gyur nas: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur thob shog: ces bsngo smon bya zhing : mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs pa ni: oṃ: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi: āḥmagron du gyur pa ma lus kun: hūm̐: dmigs med rang dbyings klong du gshegs: oṃ badz+ra muḥ bkra shis ni: hoḥ mtha' yas thugs rje sems can mgon gyur pa: gangs ri'i mdog can mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin can: 'gro mgon dpal du lham mer shar ba'i sku: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis shog:

ces me tog 'thor zhing bsngo smon gang rung gis rgyas gdab kyang chog: hoḥ bdag gzhan dus gsum kun bsags rnam dkar dge: 'khor gsum yongs dag dbyings su bsngos pa'i mthus: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa: kun bzang gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi mthus/ 'gro ba'i don du rang byung sangs rgyas shing*/ sngon tshe rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral pa'i/ skye dgu'i tshogs rnams sbyin pas sgrol gyur cig /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du/ longs spyod zad pa med pa dang*/ rtsod pa med cing tshad med pa/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang*/ gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'grub pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa/ snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /tshe 'di'i pha ma shi gson 'brel thogs dang*/ sha khrag 'o zho bkol spyod dud 'gro sogs/ /bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i sems can rnams/ /myur du sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /snang srid rnam dag ri bo po tā lar/ /rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo ye nas rdzogs/ /grags stong 'gag med yi ge drug ma'i sngags/ /rig stong 'phags pa'i rang zhal 'du 'bral med/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes gter gzhung sor bzhag ste cung zad rang lugs kha skong byed pa po ka ma rā dzas so// // rjes kyi bya ba ni: 'khor 'das thams cad chos sku'i klong ma 'gags pa'i rtsal las: sems can so so'i snang ngor longs sku sgyu ma'i sprul sgyur dang : bsdus bya kun rdzob tsam ma gtogs don la mchod yul sbyin mkhan ma grub pa: stong pa'i rang mdangs yin par thag bcad de: 'khor 'das ro gcig mi dmigs chos sku'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra kho mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: yang zab don bsdus mchod sbyin man ngag mchog: tshig nyung don che tshogs chen rab rdzogs pa'i: byang chub chu rgyun dge ba'i rgya mtsho bzhag:

'di nyid nyams su len pa'i skal ldan rnams: tshe 'dir bkra shis phyi ma byang chub thob: snying nas chos byed rnams kyis nyams su longs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe: rgyal sras pad+ma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor bra gad pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// ༈ klu gtor bsdus pa ni/ klu thebs yod pa'i dus bzang por rin po che sogs snod gtsang mar chu gtsang du me tog sil ma dang klu sman gtsang ma bshams la rang nyid kyang sha chang ma 'dres par gtsang sbra dang bcas la/ /rang nyid 'phags pa klu sgrub ni/ sangs rgyas sprul sku'i cha lugs gsal/ mdun du klu chen brgyad po ni/ /rab mdzes thal sbyar sbrul mjug can/ /kun kyang sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i klong du gsal/ /sangs rgyas phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ rgya mtsho dang 'dres klu nad zhi/ zhes chu rgyun sbreng bzhin du/ oṃ nā ga dha ra bā su ki mūṃ swā hā/ ci nus mthar/ oṃ nā ga ra tsa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ sangs rgyas thugs rjes klu rnams bde skyid ldan/ /nad zhi sdug bsngal dang bral 'jig rten na/ /bde legs rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bar shog /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang bstan 'gyur las khol du phyung ba'o// // ༈ rgyun gtor bsdus pa ngag 'don khol phyung ni/ rang nyid skad cig shākya thub/ /mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam par gyur/ /oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne ye swā hā: oṃ sarba ka ri hūm̐/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod/ /yangs shing rgya chen rnams kyi nang*/ oṃ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ /bcud rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/

/chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /lan chags mgron kun brngan pa sogs/ /sems can kun la phan gdag slad/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ nyer gcig gam bdun sogs brjod/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron/ /chos skyong srung ma phrin las sgrub pa'i mgron/ /rigs drug 'gro ba byams dang snying rje'i mgron/ /gdon bgegs sha 'khon lan chags bu lon mgron/ /de dag so sor mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /sbyin pas tshims shing sgrib gnyis byang gyur cig /dkor sgrib lan chags thams cad byang gyur cig /kun kyang rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grangs mang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan ras gzigs: 'phags pa rdo rje snying po la: sangs rgyas byang chub yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs kyis bskor: 'og tu gdon bgegs rigs drug dang : khyad par lan chags mgron kun gsal: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig las: byung ba'i rin chen snod yangs su: rang lus 'od du zhu ba las: gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs: rang sems kha sar pa ṇir gyur: mchod sbyin mgron rnams tshims par bsam: saṃ bha ra'i sngags kyis phul: oṃ: sdig sgrib thams cad zhi mdzad pa'i: 'phags pa rdo rje snying po dang : skyabs gnas mchod 'os rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bdag lus bdud rtsi'i gtor ma bzhes: byin gyis rlobs shig sdig sgrib sbyongs: dngos grub stsol cig bar chad sol: gdon bgegs 'byung po rigs drug dang : khyad par lan chags mgron rnams kun: zag med bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: lan chags bu lon byang bar mdzod: gnod 'tshe gdug sems kun zhi zhing :

byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod: /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du/ /longs spyod zad pa med pa dang*/ /rtsod pa med cing tshad med pa/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs/ thun mtshams chos spyod las so/ ༈thun mtshams bshags pa'i rim pa la/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo bzhugs so/ sems can thams cad dus rtag par bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje snying po rab tu 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen 'od 'phro l klu dbang gi rgyal po l dpa' bo'i sde l dpal dgyes l rin chen me l rin chen zla 'od l mthong ba don yod l rin chen zla b dri ma med pa l dpal byin l tshangs pa l tshangs pa'i byin l chu lha l chu lha'i lha l dpal bzang l tsan dan dpal l gzi brjid mtha' yas l 'od dpal l mya ngan med pa'i dpal l sred med kyi bu l me tog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i 'od zer rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa l de bzhin gshegs pa pad+ma'i 'od zer rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa l nor dpal l dran pa'i dpal l mtshan dpal shin tu yongs grags l dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po? shin tu rnam par gnon pa'i dpal l g.yul las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba l rnam par gnon pa gshegs pa'i dpal? kun nas snang ba bkod pa'i dpal l rin chen pad+ma rnam par gnon pa l de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang pad+ma'i gdan la rab tu bzhugs pa ri dbang gi rgyal po l de dag la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed gcig bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bdag gi skye ba 'di dang skye ba thog ma dang mtha' ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i skye gnas thams cad du sdig pa'i las bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'am/ mchod rten gyi dkor ram/ dge 'dun gyi dkor ram/ phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi dkor phrogs pa dang*/ 'phrog tu stsal ba dang*/ 'phrog pa la rjes su yi rang ba'am/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga'i las bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'am/ mi dge ba bcu'i las kyis lam yang dag par blangs pa la zhugs pa dang*/ 'jug tu stsal ba dang*/ 'jug pa la rjes su yi rang ba'am/ las kyi sgrib pa gang gis bsgribs nas/ bdag sems can dmyal bar mchi ba'am/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su mchi ba'am/ yi dwags kyi yul du mchi ba'am/ yul mtha' 'khob tu skye ba'am/ kla klor skye ba'am/ lha tshe ring po rnams su skye ba'am/ dbang po ma tshang bar 'gyur ba'am/ lta ba log pa 'dzin par 'gyur ba'am/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba la mnyes par mi bgyid par 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ye shes su gyur pa/ spyan du gyur pa/ dpang du gyur pa/ tshad mar gyur pa/ mkhyen pas gzigs pa/ de dag gi spyan sngar mthol lo 'chags so/ mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang*/ gcod cing sdom par bgyid lags so/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gi skye ba 'di dang skye ba thog ma dang mtha' ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa la zas kham gcig tsam bstsal ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang*/ bdag gis tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang*/ bdag gis tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang*/ bdag gis sems can yongs su smin par bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang*/

bdag gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa dang*/ bdag gis bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bzlums te bsdoms nas/ bla na ma mchis pa dang*/ gong na ma mchis pa dang*/ gong ma'i yang gong ma/ bla ma'i yang bla mar yongs su bsngo bas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis yongs su bsngos pa dang*/ ji ltar ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams kyis yongs su bsngo bar 'gyur ba dang*/ ji ltar da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams kyis yongs su bsngo bar mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /sdig pa thams cad ni so sor bshags so/ bsod nams thams cad la ni rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la ni bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs so/ bdag gi bla na med pa ye shes kyi mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig /mi mchog rgyal ba gang dag da ltar bzhugs pa dang*/ /gang dag 'das pa dag dang de bzhin gang ma byon/ /yon tan bsngags pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho 'dra kun la/ /thal mo sbyar bar bgyis te skyabs su nye bar mchi'o/ /lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ /gang yang yid kyi rnam gsum po/ /mi dge bcu po so sor bshags/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga/ sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /bdag dang sems can kun gyi sdig pa'i las/ /nyes par gyur gang mthol zhing bshags par bgyi/ /slan chad nam yang bgyid par ma gyur cig /las kyi sgrib pa'ang gtan du zad byed shog /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*/ /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/

/mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /gang gis mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis ltung ba bshags pa 'di bton pas/ /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar gyur/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /phung po gsum pa'i mdo rdzogs so// ༈ rjes su spyi bshags gong ltar dang ye shes sku mchog sogs dang brgya phyag re 'tshal srol yod pas de ltar bya/ ༈ snga thun yan lag song nas nyin gung zas kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa ni/ thog mar dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes su 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni bsod nams dag gi rgyu mthun pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud mi za ba/ bzod pas rab tu brgyan pa/ bsod nams kyi gter rnams kyi gzhi/ dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis spras pa/ mtshan rnams kyi me tog rgyas pa/ spyod yul ran par mthun pa/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ dad pas mos pa rnams la mngon par dga' ba/ shes rab zil gyis mi non pa/ stobs rnams la brdzi ba med pa/ sems can thams cad kyi ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyal po/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon/ ye shes dpag tu med pa/ spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gsung rnam par dag pa/ dbyangs snyan pa/ sku byad blta bas chog mi shes pa/ sku mtshungs pa med pa/ 'dod pa dag gis ma gos pa/ gzugs dag gis nye bar ma gos pa/

gzugs med pa dag dang ma 'dres pa/ sdug bsngal las rnam par grol ba/ phung po dag las rab tu rnam par grol ba/ khams rnams dang mi ldan pa/ skye mched rnams bsdams pa/ mdud pa rnams shin tu bcad pa/ yongs su gdung ba dag las rnam par grol ba/ sred pa las grol ba/ chu bo las brgal ba/ ye shes yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes la gnas pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa ste/ 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku che ba'i yon tan yang dag pa rnams so/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos legs par gsungs pa/ yang dag par mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad pa med pa/ nye bar gtod pa/ 'di mthong ba la don yod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis so sor rang gis rig par bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la legs par brten pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mi mthun pa med cing 'dus pa dang ldan pa/ brten pa yod pa/ rgyu ba bcad pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun ni legs par bzhugs pa/ rigs par bzhugs pa/ drang por bzhugs pa/ mthun par bzhugs pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing*/ yon yongs su sbyong ba chen po/ sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ kun tu yang sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa chen po'o/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*/

/gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun sde la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal/ sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /chos kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dge 'dun yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /bsam mi khyab la dad byas pa'i/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog /dkon mchog rdzas dang gzhan las 'phrog pa sogs/ /ma dag log pa'i 'tsho ba kun spangs nas/ /sdig med chos dang mthun pa'i kha zas kyis/ /lus kyi zo mdog rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ de nas kha zas om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas/ spyod bsdus las/ zas la cha bzhir bgo bya ste/ dang po lha la bshos gtsang phul/ /de rjes chos skyong srung ma la/ /gtor ma shin tu rgya cher btang*/ /rang gis zos shing 'thungs pa yi/ /lhag ma 'byung po kun la sbyin/ /zhes pa ltar ram/ yang na dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las gsungs pa ltar cha gsum du byas la/ thog mar/ om̐ gu ru badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis bla ma la bshos gcig phul/ de bzhin du/ om̐ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+ya badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la/ om̐ kā ma de wa maṇ+ḍa la badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la/ om̐ mañju shrī badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ lta bus 'jam dbyangs sogs gang mos kyi lha la/ om̐ shrī dharma pā la badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ om̐ ā kā ro sogs kyis 'byung po spyir lha bshos phul la/ om̐ ha ri te swā hās 'phrog ma la changs bu gcig byin/ om̐ ha ri te ma hā yak+ṣi ni ha ra ha ra sarba ra yaṃ ṇi k+ṣiṃ swā hās 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya la changs bu gcig

/om̐ agri bin+ḍa a shi bh+yaḥswā hās phud la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la changs bu gcig sbyin no/ /zas kyi dug la sogs pa zhi bar 'dod pas ni/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twa naṃ/ om̐ ba liṃ ta te dz+wa ba liṃ ni swā hā/ zhes lan brgyad bzlas nas mtheb srin gyis reg la bza' bar bya'o/ /bza' ba'i tshe yang zas la mi gtsang ba'i blo dang*/ skyo ba'i blo dang*/ srin bu'i rigs kyi grong khyer la phan gdags pa'i blo dang*/ zhi ba byang chub tu bgrod pa'i gru bo che dar gcig tu gnas par bya ba'i blos bza' bar bya yi/ chags pa dang sred pa 'phel ba'i blos mi bza'o/ /spyod 'jug las/ ran pa tsam du bza' bar bya/ zhes pas de'i tshul ni yan lag brgyad par lus kyi cha gnyis zas/ gcig skom/ gcig stong par 'jog par bshad pa ltar ram/ yang na zas kyi gzhi las 'byung ba ltar/ cha gnyis zas dang skom/ cha gcig stong par bzhag go /mthar yang*/ om̐ sarba uts+tshiṣ+ṭa biṇ+ḍa a shi bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la changs bu gcig sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas kha bkrus te/ yon sbyong ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun nas 'od kyi rgyal po me 'od rab tu gsal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ na maḥs man+ta pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ na mo mañju shrī ku mā ra bhu ta ya/ bo dhi sa twa ya/ ma hā sa twa ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ ni rā lam bhe/ ni rā bha se/ dza ya dza ya la bhe/ ma hā ma te/ dak+ṣe dak+ṣi ṇi me pa ri sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes gzungs 'di lan gcig brjod par byed pa des ni ri rab tsam gyi bsod snyoms kyang yongs su byang bar gsungs te/ gzungs 'di 'dul ba rnam par nges pa'i rgyud las phyung ba yin no/ /de nas lung las 'byung ba bzhin/ rgyal po sbyin bdag nyid de bzhin/ /gang yang sems can tshogs gzhan rnams/
