/nad med tshe ring phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bde ba'i gnyen thob shog /ces dang*/ sbyin pas 'byung po dbang du gyur/ /sbyin pas dgra rnams med par 'gyur/ /pha rol gnyen yang sbyin pa nyid/ /de phyir sbyin pa gtso bor brjod/ /sbyin pa 'jig rten rgyan yin zhing*/ /sbyin pas ngan 'gro ldog par byed/ /sbyin pa mtho ris skas yin te/ /sbyin pa zhi byed dge ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i longs spyod rnams/ /mi zad nam mkha' lta bu gang*/ /longs spyod de ni thob bya'i phyir/ /sbyin pa de ni yang dag spel/ zhes bsngo smon dang sbyin pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams brjod par bya'o/ /༈ yang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas kha zas nang gi tshogs 'khor du rol par 'dod na/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis kha zas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung du sbar la/ hoḥ bdag lus phung khams skye mched ni/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i ngo bo ste/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'gul bskyod thams cad bde ba che/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig bla na med/ /byang chub sems kyi sprin chen por/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du rol/ /rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs rdzogs nas/ /zas kyi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar/ /gtan pa med pa'i sbyin bdag kyang*/ /theg chen 'bras bur spyod par shog /ces rang gi phung khams skye mched gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba mchod pa'i tshul gyis tha mal gyi snang zhen spangs te tshim par longs spyad pa'i mthar/ bdag lus phung khams skye mched dang*/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ 'di ni grol tig las byung ba a nu'i lugs kyi nang gi tshogs 'khor ro/ / ༈ de nas ja mchod kyi rim pa ni/ na mo gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐/ hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid:

byin rlabs rtsa ba o rgyan rin po che: 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i: drin can bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul: zhi khro yi dam 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can: dngos grub rtsa ba thugs rje spyan ras gzigs: rta mgrin dbang chen 'khor 'das spyi dpal gtso: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa 'bul: ma mo mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mo ste: bar chad sel mdzad rdo rje phag mo yum: rigs kyi lha mo gsang ba ye shes dbyings: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul: hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: bdag gzhan rab gus gdungs bas mchod pa 'bul: khyed kyi ye shes thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis: mi rtog ting 'dzin ye shes bskyed du gsol: nyams rtogs rig pa'i rtsal chen sbar du gsol: sku gsum zhing khams 'byongs par mdzad du gsol: bskyed rdzogs don gnyis 'bras bu khong chud nas: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa chen thob nas kyang : sems can thams cad sangs rgyas ma thob par: 'gro ba'i don du lhun grub 'byung bar shog: ces bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las rtsa ba gsum gyi gsol 'debs rgyun khyer bsdus pa ja mchod du tshig bsgyur ba'o/ /༈ phyi thun gyi rjes su gsol kha rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa'i mthar dkar gsur dmar gsur rnams bya'o/ /༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: me gsur btang ba longs spyod gter mdzod bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: me gsur bya ba'i rim pa ni: phye mar dag la gzhi byas te: phun sum tshogs pa'i zas sna bsres: dri zhim bzang drug sman sogs sbyar: de dag me hom chung ngur bsreg: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsreg gtor bkru: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs: mchog gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : pha ma rigs drug la sogs la: 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i phan yon ni: yi dam dkyil 'khor dri yis mnyes:

yul lha gzhi bdag gsur gyis tshim: sngon las rigs drug sdug bsngal byang : lha srin rnams kyang re kha khengs: sbyin pas bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs: 'bras bus smon lam bden tshig 'grub: ces bslab pa byang sems spyi rgyud las: bla med nam mkha'i mdzod chen gyis: phyag rgya rgyu yi bsod nams tshogs: snying rjes sbyin sreg 'bras bu ste: tshogs drug mchod pa 'di kho na: zhes gsungs pa ltar: sbyin sreg gyi phan yon blo las 'das shing : sngon srin mo grong rgyun ma zhes bya bas: nyin re la 'dzam gling nas mi lnga lnga sha khral du bla khyer ba la: ston pa mar me mdzad kyis nam langs zhogs la dri zhim ro mngar bsregs shing smon lam mdzad: nyin gung longs spyod phud kyis bsngos: dgong mo sha khrag dmar gyi gsur mchod mdzad de: ting nge 'dzin gyis srin mo dbang du bsdus: deng phyin chad mi yi bla tshe mi 'phrog par byed pa srog gi glud du sbyin pa gsur gyi mchod pa 'di'i gyis la dam tshig bka' la gnas par dam longs gsungs te: srin mos snying rje bslab pa'i sdom pa zhus nas 'dzam gling 'dir gsur mchod sbyin pa ma chag na: bdag kyang snying rje la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro: zhes khas blangs shing dam du gnas: de ltar shin tu phan yon che bar grags: spyir nyin re bzhin gsur mchod ma chad par thon na: bka' yi mdo sde stong phrag brgya pa klog pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam mo: sa ma ya: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum brjod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dri gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a hu ti su ru bhu pa ye swā hā: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes me thab tu: sreg rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod: byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs dge 'dun tshogs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang :

dam can nor lha gter bdag srung ma la: 'bul lo thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sol: hūm̐: phyi rgyud dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs: lha klu sde brgyad gza' chen rgyu skar bdag: rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bcas: lo zla zhag dus bdag dang yul lha la: 'bul lo phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad sol: hūm̐: dri za gsur bdag bgegs rigs lan chags mgron: pha ma rigs drug bar do'i sems can dang : tshe rabs bu lon sha 'khon ma 'khor ba'i: sngon las 'phral rkyen khas zhan dbang chung la: bsngo'o sbyin no lan chags 'khor gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a hu ti hā sa bha dra su ru bhu pa ye swā hā: zhes 'di yi mtshams su ming nas ma smos pa kha bsngos byas kyang chog: dri gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: mdang da nangs shi ba lus snga lus bor zhing phyi lus ma thob pa rig pa gtad med du 'khyams pa'i bar do'i sems can rnams la 'bul lo: mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes par? rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan par? sna yi yul du dri zhim par? lce yi yul du ro mngar bar? lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam par gyur cig: yid kyi yul du rig shes dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs par gyur cig: om̐ḥhūm̐ḥtrām̐ḥhrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ḥlām̐ḥmām̐ḥpām̐ḥtām̐ḥ om̐ bo dhi sa twa sa ma ya: dharma dz+nyā na ma ma pā paṃ bi shwa dha na pa ri wā re swā hā: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ ma rig srid pa'i nang tshan bar do yi: yid lus la sogs rigs drug sems can rnams: bdag gis sbyin tshogs bsngo smon dge ba yis: bla med byang chub 'bras bu myur thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes bsngo smon ci rigs sna tshogs gang rung rgyas gdab pas chog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya:

gsang rgya: gtad rgya: u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs so// ༈ dmar gsur la brten nas rang gzhan gyi 'chi ba bslu ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ dmar gsur 'dod yon rgya mtsho 'di/ /dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams la/ /zas kyi nyer len mi mnga' yang*/ /mchod pa'i yul du dmigs nas 'bul/ /bdag cag bsod nams tshogs rdzogs nas/ /myur du ye shes mthong bar shog /mgon po yon tan mgron rnams la/ /zag med bdud rtsir dmigs nas 'bul/ /byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs las srungs/ /rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams kyis/ /rang rang 'dod pa'i longs spyod du/ /mthong nas zad med gter la spyod/ /dga' mgu tshims shing yi rangs nas/ /so so'i sdug bsngal bral bar shog /bgegs rigs lan chags mgron rnams la/ /pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med par bsngo/ /so so'i yid la gang 'dod pa'i/ /zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod du/ /gyur nas sha 'khon bu lon byang*/ /gnod sems 'khon 'dzin dag par shog khyad par gzhan gyi lus srog la/ /rnam par sdang ba'i gnod sbyin dang*/ /sha za 'byung po srin po'i gdon/ /tshe brku mdangs 'phrog srog len cing*/ /sha dang khrag la gdung ba rnams/ /dmar gsur 'dod yon kun khyab 'dis/ /ngoms shing tshims la mthun gyur cing*/ khro zhing gtum pa'i sems bor nas/ /byang chub sems dang ldan par shog /rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa dang*/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag mthus/ /byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin las/ /rang gi yul khams bsrungs pa bzhin/ /mthar thug rang gzhan don yod cing*/ /gnas skabs 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las/ /'gro ba mang po'i srog thar shog /gang zhig 'di ru lhags pa yi/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang gnas/ /'byung po gdug pa'i sems ldan kyang*/ /rgyud la byang chub sems skyes nas/

/gzhan la 'tshe ba'i blo spangs te/ /thar pa'i sa bon thebs par shog /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung? sogs dge ba bsngo/ spyir dus la nges pa med cing khyad par mun pa srod la gnod sbyin rnams gzhan gyi srog la 'tshe ba'i slad du rgyu ba yin pas/ de tshe dmar gsur sbyar zhing rang gi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub sems dang ldan pas chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa thun mong du gyur ba 'di byas na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin no/ /zhes pa'ang klong gsal ba dang chos ldan pas bskul ngor rig pa 'dzin pa mkhyen brtse'i lhas so// // ༈ rnal 'byor rgyun glud khyer bde ni/ glud dang gsur gang yang rung*/ 'bru gsum dang sam+bha ra mtshan bzhis brlabs/ ho/ glud gtor 'dod yon kun ldan 'di/ /phyogs 'dir gnas shing rgyu ba yi/ /re zhing chags dang gnod cing 'tshe/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yongs 'tshol sems/ /'byung po'i rigs su gyur rnams la/ /bsngo'o dga' mgu yi rangs tshim/ /'gal rkyen sdug bsngal 'khrul snang kun/ /bde chen klong du dag gyur cig khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams/ /sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang*/ /dran dang bsam dang gzung dang reg /glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ a āḥ zhes brjod/ 'di yis 'chi ba bslu zhing na ba sel/ /rgud pa gso zhing cho 'phrul zhi/ /rkyen ngan zhi zhing bsam pa 'grub/ /sa ma ya/ shing 'brug zla gsum tshes bzhi la dhis spel/ maṅga laṃ// // srod thun mthar lus sbyin bya bar rang lugs mdor bsdus ltar byas na/ ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ sgyu lus mchod sbyin bsdus pa 'don khrigs su bkod pa bzhugs so/ bdag med yum chen shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dbyer med rang rig ye shes mkha' 'gro la/ /btud de sgyu lus mchod sbyin bya ba'i thabs/ /bdag 'dzin rang grol gcod yul 'dir gsal bya/ de yang gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/

rig pa shes rab ral gri phyung rdeg gis: nyon mongs phra rags rtog pa'i lo 'dab gcod: bsdus bya sgyu lus 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las: sgrol ba'i ded dpon bdag med khye'u chung : rnam rtog lha 'dre'i yo lang sbyong ba'i gnad: ma gcig rdo rje'i tshig rkang sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin gcod yul nyams su len pa la/ spros bcas yo byad rkang gling ḍā dril sogs gcod yul spyi mtshungs dang spros med kyang rung la mtshan bcas dmigs pa dang mtshan med ting 'dzin lta dgongs kyi gdeng dang ldan pa gal che'o/ de la dang po rang nyid khros mar gsal ba'i ting 'dzin ngang rang snang dbang du sdud cing gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa ni/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bdag gi thugs kar gser gyi rdo rje ni: rwa dgu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa phyogs bcur 'phros: hūm̐ las dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag drag mo'i tshul: phyag g.yas mi lpags g.yang gzhi me 'bar bsnams: g.yon pas mi rkang tser tser drag tu 'bud: rtog med snying rje drwa ba'i 'od zer gyis: 'khrul rtog lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul ni: bzod glags med par dbang du bsdus nas kyang : ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis zil gyis gnon: brdal khyab sa gzhi rdo rje'i zhu lam la: khab len rdo yis lcags phye 'dzin pa ltar: ci bcol bka' nyan 'bros dbang med par gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ gnyis pa sngon 'gro skyabs yul gsal btab la skyabs sems dngos ni/ rig pa ngar bskyed stong pa'i rang sgra las/ phaṭḥ skyabs yul ngo bo stong pa'i rang rtsal nyid: ye nas rang ngo shes par skyabs su mchi/ rigs drug a 'thas gol ba'i sems can kun: bdag gzhan ro gcig rtogs pas sems bskyed do: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ gsum pa byin rlab bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ na mo: gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma steng : 'ja' tshon 'od phung gtibs pa'i dbus: kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dang :

dga' rab rdo rje shrī sing : 'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad+ma 'byung : ye shes mtsho rgyal man+da ra: sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa: grub thob brgyud pa byin rlabs can: bdud kyi gcod yul rin po che: gsol 'debs bu la byin gyis rlobs: ro snyom lam du lhong ba dang : brtul zhugs spobs pa mthar phyin nas: rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ba yis: lha 'drer 'gro don nus pa ru: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rjes zungs: rje yab yum gnyis ltar byin gyis rlobs: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ brgyud pa'i bla ma rang la bstims shing mnyam par bzhag /bzhi pa rnam shes spar zhing rang nyid dbyangs can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ru gsal ba ni/ phaṭḥ rang rig rnam shes ma sar sgo nga tsam: spyi bor skar mda' 'gyu bzhin gyen du 'phros: rje btsun mthing 'od 'bar ma'i thugs kar thim: gsal stong bde chen rnal 'byor ma ru gsal: dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin cing khro mo'i chas: dur khrod chas rdzogs kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: brkyang bskum gar stabs bam ro'i gdan la gsal: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ lnga pa lus sha khrag bdud rtsir byin gyis rlob pa ni/ phaṭḥ bdag lus phung po stong gsum khyab pa yi: mgo bo bhan+dha zangs gris rbad kyis bcad: snang srid khyab par yangs shing rgya che'i nang : phung po gtub pa srid pa'i dbyings dang mnyam: gri gug 'bar bas lan gsum dkrugs pa yis: sha khrag zad med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ drug pa bdud rtsi dkar 'gyed 'bul ba ni/ phaṭḥ rang nyid dbang sdud drag mo'i thugs ka nas: gri gug bhan+dha thogs pa grangs med 'phros: sha khrag stong gsum 'geng ba'i mchod sbyin 'di: ting 'dzin rtse gcig zas su byin brlabs nas: zangs gris dkrug cing bhan+dhar rab bskyil nas: sangs rgyas byang sems dam chos 'phags pa'i tshogs: pad 'byung rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho dang : rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la:

'bul lo bzhes shig dgyes pa bskyed gyur nas: bdag 'dzin 'khu 'phrig mi dmigs dbyings su zhig /phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥphaṭḥ sha khrag bdud rtsi dkar zhing snum pa 'di: rgyal ba'i bka' sdod bstan srung dkar po'i phyogs: srid pa chags pa'i gzhi bdag lha dang klu: dge bsnyen bka' skyong mthu ldan rnams la sbyin: rgyal bstan dar 'phel yid can 'gro ba kun/ dge bcu la 'god nag phyogs sems spang shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bdun pa dregs chen spyi la sha khrag dmar 'gyed 'bul ba ni/ phaṭḥ ro mchog bcud ldan sha khrag dmar mchod 'di: srid pa'i rtse dang mnar med yan chod kyi: dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad bye ba 'bum: nag phyogs gnod byed bgegs rigs lan chags sogs: 'byung po gdug sems ldan pa'i tshogs la bsngo: lan chags bu lon sha 'khon byang gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ brgyad pa lhag ma ging dang khas zhan dbang chung rnams la sbyin pa ni/ phaṭḥ ma phung po sha khrag lhag ma 'di: dur khrod bdag mo bye ba 'bum: keng rus gar bsgyur pho mo ging : dpag tshad khyab pa'i gnas nyul tshogs: gzhan yang khas zhan dbang chung rigs: snga phyi ma thob lha 'dre'i tshogs: sha khrag rus pa'i lhag ma bzhes: bsngos pa bzhin du tshims gyur nas: re ba'i bsam pa khengs gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ dgu pa chos ston cing byang chub lam du dgod pa ni/ phaṭḥ na mo: nyon cig snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs: rang rig chos sku ma mthong bas: 'khrul 'dzin las kyi 'byung por grub: lta ba ngo sprod ma thob pas: ma rig gnyis 'dzin ru trar skyes: ting 'dzin mchod sbyin ma thob pas: yid lus srid pa'i za 'dre grub: dbang sdud tshogs gral ma tshud pas: dge bcu phan sems snying rje bral: rigs drug 'khrul par grub pa yi: gnod byed lha 'dre bgegs kyi tshogs: deng nas byang chub ma thob bar: mi dge ba yi gnod sems spongs: phan dge'i rgyu 'bras chos bcu spyod:

snang stong yid lus rang mdangs ltos: grags stong rdo rje'i tshig la nyon: ro gcig sems nyid gnyug ma skyongs: dge 'dis don gnyis mthar phyin nas: bla med 'bras bu yongs rdzogs shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bcu pa mi dmigs mgron rnams mkha' la bstim pa ni/ bdag gi rnam shes rang sar phab pa ni: phaṭḥ rnam shes mkha' 'gro gnas gyur thig le ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan ma sar sgo nga tsam: spyi bor mar babs snying kha chos dbyings su: thim pas mi rtog rig pa rjen par shar: ka dag gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bcu gcig pa bsngo smon bgyis pa ni/ phaṭḥ gcod yul mchod sbyin zab mo bgyis pa'i mthus: rnam rtog lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul shes: re dogs bral zhing gdeng tshad ldan pa yi: sha khrag mchod pas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las sgrol shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ rjes bsngo smon sogs spyi mthun ltar bya la mi dmigs ka dag ngang la bzhag pa ni don gyi gcod yul yum chen mo'i dgongs pa rma med pa yin no/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zab gter thugs chen 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi cha lag sgyu lus mchod sbyin gyi ngag 'don go rim 'khrugs sdeb cung zad dang kha skong dgos pa rnams gsang ye'i gcod gzhung nas gsar bsnan dang 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa 'di'ang rang lugs sgrub sde'i nyams len la nye bar mkho phyir gi ban au ḍī'i thugs bzhed bzhin/ gnam lcags gu h+yas spel// // rjes su bsngo smon spyi dang sku gsum zhing sbyong smon lam grub mthar nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rdzogs kyi myong ba med pa'am rgyun gyi rnal 'byor lta bu seṅge nyal stabs kyis mgo byang du bstan la 'chi ba rjes su dran pas dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad cing gsol ba btab nas dge ba'i bya ba la ldang ba dang snang ba'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag ste/

/sangs rgyas chos kyi sku thob par gyur cig snyam du sems bskyed nas chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la blo gnas par bya/ yang sngon 'gro'i skabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgoms te gnyid 'od gsal du thim pa'i gsol ba drag tu btab pas bla ma spyi bor byon/ snying 'od kyi gur khang nang du rdo rje 'chang gi sku shin tu phra bar bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang gsal bar mos pa'i ngang nas gnyid log bskyed rim pa dang po bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su dkyil 'khor pa gsal btab/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud 'od kyi rang bzhin tu byas nas srung 'khor la bsdu/ de dur khrod/ de gzhal yas khang*/ de 'khor gyi lha la/ de yum/ de yab/ de thugs srog hūm̐/ hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu nas gyen rim nā da'i bar du bsdus/ de la sems bzung*/ mthar de'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang las gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /yang rdzogs rim mtshan bcas pa yin na lus gnad bca'/ rlung ro bsal/ 'jam rlung bum pa can bzung*/ dmigs pa lus kyi dbus su dhu ti gsal btab la lte ba'i man ngag a yig sbar bas spyi bo'i ham̐ zhu ba'i byang sems rgyun snying gar babs pa'i thig le la sems bzung bas bde stong ngang gis 'char ro/ /rdzogs chen pas nam gung shes bya bum par dril ba ni/ /snying pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa kha cung zad zum pa'i nang du a yig dkar po 'od 'bar ba bum nang gi mar me ltar 'bar ba la sems gtad de/ /snying gar 'jam rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba la lus stod smad 'dus pa ltar mos la nyal bas rmi lam med par gnyid gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'od gsal du 'char bar gsungs so/ /dbang po gnad du bsdu ba dang shes pa bum 'jug gi gdams pa bzhin gnyid la 'jug go/ // ༈ zhar byung rjes thob kyi nyams len dang 'brel bar gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma nyin rer dus drug tu bgos nas 'don par gsungs pa ltar bya na/

bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i mngon rtogs bzhugs so/ bla ma dang rdo rje rigs kyi ḍāk+ki rnal 'byor ma'i sku la 'dud/ de yang zab lam rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i phrin las rgyun khyer bsdus pa ni: thog mar gnas dben zhing yid du mchis par bya tshul la/ ljon pa khral khrol skyed mo'am nyams rtogs skye nges pa'i gling bya ri dwags snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len pa nyams rang bzhin gyis 'bar ba zhig rnyed na rab dang ma rnyed kyang snang ba dbang du 'dus pa'i spyod lam dang bstun nas nyams su len par brtsam pa la dang po tha mal rang rgyud dag pa rig pa khengs rnyog bral ba/ bar du lam dag par rig pa gzhi thog tu phebs pa/ tha ma tshogs drug dag pa'i rigs lnga bsgom don nyams su myong ba las/ bskyed rim lha yi gdeng zhes bya ba la/ snang tshul sgyu ma'i gar lta bu ste/ mkha' la 'ja' tshon lta bu'o/ /de yang dran pa gsal rdzogs nyid las bskyed par bya ba la/ de'i tshe 'dzin bya dag pa'i ngang sgo gsum lhug bzhag kyi rnam pas rig pa ngar bskyed bzhin tshigs su bgyis pa la/ hūm̐/ rang rig shes pa ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /dran rtog 'dzin med ngo bo gshis lugs hūm̐/ /yongs gyur bla ma rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ /'gag med gsal stong gzhon tshul zhi ma khro/ /za ber phod ka rin chen prog zhu dang*/ /rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ shes rab 'chang*/ /rgyal po rol stabs snang srid zil gnon ngang*/ /sku yi cha dang ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar lhags/ /sgyu ma'i gar ltar wal gyis gsal ba yi/ /thugs kar hūm̐ mthar snying po'i sngags phreng 'khor/ /'byung 'jug thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi ngang*/ /phyogs bcur 'phros pas byin brlabs thugs rgyud bskul/ /yig 'bru gsum gyis dbang bzhi snying po thob/ /rtsa khams zhing khams lha ru rtag mngon te/ /'phro 'gyu tshogs drug ka dag dbyings su grol/

/snang stong gsal stong bde stong rig stong ngang*/ /gshis lugs lta ba bla ma'i don rtogs nas/ /de bzhin he ru ka par 'grub gyur nas/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'ang bdag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor ram/ bsdus pa'i bsnyen sgrub 'di ltar skabs dang bstun par bya/ gzhan yang dge rtsa bsngo ba sogs spyi dang mthun/ bdag bskyed rgyun khyer 'di yang mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po gsang sngags bstan skyong gi bka' yis bskul ngor/ sngags 'chang gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba dge/ // ༈ de nas gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma'i rten bskyed ni/ oṃ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ rang lus 'dzin med spyi bo yi/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs las sprul pa'i rig 'dzin ni/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i sku/ /sku mdog dkar dmar skyil krung mdzad/ /gzhon nu lo brgyad lon pa'i tshul/ /sngags pa'i cha lugs mthing nag gos/ /rab byung cha lugs chos gos dmar/ /rgyal po'i cha lugs za ber gsol/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yon pas mnyam bzhag ka pā la/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang*/ /dbu la pad+ma'i snyan zhu gsol/ kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum mchan g.yon 'khyud/ /sna tshogs rin chen brgyan gyis mdzes/ /bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan pa la/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ ces dang ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang 'tshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol:

mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /lha bshos dri chab mchod pa bshams/ /bla re rgyal mtshan na bza' dang*/ /ba dan gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra/ /rin po chen dang me tog dang*/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang*/ /chos dang mdangs chen byang chub sems/ /mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /rtsa bar brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang*/ /chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyis dngos grub stsol/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem pas mdzad pa'o// // ༈ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma ni/ :nadasramarka : gu ru na mo: me pho rta'i lo rgyal zla ba la: dpal bsam yas su tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po btang ba'i dus su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la: dge slong nam mkha'i snying po dang : rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dang : lha sras mu khri btsan po dang lngas phyag dang bskor ba byas: rin po che'-i maṇ+ḍal phul nas zhus pa: kye slob dpon chen po lags: gsang sngags kyi chos gsungs pa thams cad kyi nang nas dam tshig bsrung ba gal che: de'i nang nas gsol ba 'debs pa gtso che bar gsungs gda' bas: bdag cag rnams la dang ba 'dren pa: byin rlabs che ba: gang zag tha mal pa blo rmongs pas tshig gi ra mdar sbran pas gsang sngags kyi lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskul ba: gu ru nyid kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa: nang nub tu gsol ba 'debs pa la tshig nyung la don 'dus pa zhig bdag cag dang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams la sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsung bar zhu zhes zhus pas: slob dpon chen po'i bka' stsal pa: nyon cig bod kyi skal ldan rnams: gsang sngags kyi theg pa 'di 'byung ba ni dkon te: sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su yang gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'di ma gsungs:

sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis kyang ma gsungs: ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsung bar mi 'gyur ro: ci'i phyir zhe na: 'gro ba rnams snod du ma gyur pa'i phyir ro: sngon bskal pa thog ma la bskal pa kun bkod ces bya ba byung ba'i tshe: sangs rgyas sngon byung gi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i bstan pa la gsang sngags rgya cher bsgrags so: da ltar gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la byon pa'o: da lta'i bskal pa bye ba 'das pa'i 'og tu bskal pa me tog bkod pa zhes bya ba 'byung ba'i tshe: sangs rgyas 'jam dpal dbyangs zhes bya ba da lta'i nga dang tshul mthun pa zhig 'byung ste: des gsang sngags rgya cher ston par 'gyur ro: bskal pa de gsum ni 'gro ba rnams snod du rung ba'i phyir ro: bskal pa de gsum ma yin pa dus nam yang gsang sngags mi 'byung ngo : de bas na bstan pa 'di la dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob: gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams ni le lo dang btang snyoms kyi dbang du ma song ba gal che: da gsang sngags nyams su len pa la dgos pa'i chos bzhi bya ba tshang dgos: de ma tshang na dam tshig nyams te 'khor bar 'khyams nges: ngan song du ltung nges: de ci'i phyir zhe na: dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang nyon mongs pa rang rgyud du spyad pas byang chub thob par ma gsungs so: dgos pa'i chos bzhi ni: sgo gsum tha mal du 'chor ba la 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod pa'i gdams ngag dgos: nyon mongs pa dug lnga stobs che na: dug lnga rang grol du shes pa'i gdams ngag dgos: 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i dbang du song na: re dogs bar chad du shes pa'i gdams ngag dgos: dam tshig gtsang ma bsrung ba la: skyes bus gzhu 'gengs pa lta bu'i gdams ngag dgos: de yang gsang sngags kyi theg pa ni u dum wā ra'i me tog lta bu ste 'byung bar mi 'gyur: gal te byung yang yun du mi gnas so:

de ni 'gro ba rnams snod du ma gyur pa'i phyir ro: da khyed rgyal pos dbu mdzad pa rnams nyon cig: bstan pa 'di la dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob: gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs: tshe 'di la byang chub thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis: rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig gtsang mar bsrung ba gal che: de ma bsrung na 'tsho byed kyi sman btsal bas reg phung gi dug dang 'phrad pa lta bu'o: dam tshig bsrung ba la dad pa dang brtson 'grus shes rab gsum tshang dgos: dad pa med na gsang sngags kyi snod du mi rung : brtson 'grus med na le lo can tha mal du 'chor: shes rab med na gsang sngags kyi lta spyod zab mo'i don mi shes: gsang sngags ni 'gro ba dad gus can gyi don du byon pa yin: de yang rang la gsang sngags ston pa'i bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos su shes pas gsol ba 'di ltar thob cig gsungs so: e ma hoḥ spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su: chos nyid dus gsum skye 'gag med pa'i ngang : bya bral lhun rdzogs bde ba chen po'i sku: nam mkha' bzhin du thugs rje phyogs ris med: bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams su: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: ye shes lnga ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i sku: thugs rje'i bye brag sna tshogs so sor ston: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: mi mjed 'jig rten dag pa'i zhing khams su: thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la byon: gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: ༈ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni: gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ rnam dag sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing khams su/

/tshe bdag snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag med/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /o rgyan gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ /dgongs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod kyi yul dbus dpal gyi bsam yas su/ /dge slong nam mkha'i snying po chos kyi rgyal/ khri srong lde'u btsan mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms lha sras mu khri btsan/ /las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga la gsol ba 'debs/ /lho phyogs shrī mang lam ri khrod pa/ /bzang po grags pa gter gyi sgo 'byed mkhan/ /pad+mas lung bstan chos bdag rgod ldem can/ /zhes su yongs grags dngos grub rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /sprul sku gter ston rnam gnyis l /ri rgyal shar 'dabs byin brlabs sgrub khang du/ /las can dbon po sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal/ /rgyal gyi shrī byang ljongs dben gnas su/ /mtshan ldan bla ma byams pa bshes gnyen zhabs/ /rig 'dzin gdung gsob rnam gnyis l /kun gzigs byang phyogs rgya mtsho'i chen po'i ngogs/ /sngon nas rjes dran chos rje sangs rgyas dpal/ /bde grol gsang sngags chos gling pho brang du/ /thugs sras mes ston nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /bstan pa'i srog shing rnam gnyis l /sbas yul yol mo gangs kyi rwa ba ru/ /sprul sku grags pa sngags 'chang shākya bzang*/ /bod kyi tshe brag dpal chen chu bo rir/ /rje btsun mnga' ris legs ldan bdud 'joms rje/ /bka' gter mnga' bdag rnams l /gu ru pad+ma'i e waṃ cog sgar tu/ /rig 'dzin chos rje thugs sras dbang po sde/ /sprul sku ngag dbang rig 'dzin rnam rgyal zhabs/ /rgyal khams phyogs med gdul bya'i re ba bskangs/ /sngags 'chang yab sras gnyis l /gnas chen ri rgyal dpal 'bar sgrub khang du/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang ma ṇi'i mtshan/ /de yi chos kyi bu dang rigs kyi rgyud/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug phyag rdor nor bu'i mtshan/ /rgyal sras sku mched rnam gnyis l

/bde ba'i rdo rjes legs bzhengs ghan+dho lar/ /pad+ma'i gdung gsob chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /rig 'dzin mchog de'i rjes su nyer bzung ba/ /za hor sngags 'chang zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal/ /mtshungs med bla ma rnam gnyis l /gtsang stod ru lag sgrol ba'i gtsug lag khang*/ /pad+ma'i sgrub phug rgyang gi yon po lung*/ /mi snang rgyas btab yid bzhin nor 'dra'i chos/ /dpal ldan lha mo dge bsnyen nor bu bzang*/ /gter gnas srung mar bcas l /chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong don 'dus pa'i/ /zab mo'i gsol 'debs lam zab le'u bdun/ /thun drug g.yel ba med pa'i nyams len la/ /dad shes btson pas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes pa 'di yang chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes/ mgo 'dom yul gyi dgon pas bskul ba'i ngor/ ling tshe rgyal po'i pho brang nyams dga' bar thun mtshams nyid du sbyar ba dge gyur cig // // de nas rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis zhus pa: kye slob dpon chen po lags: bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dad pa can rnams kyi don du: dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob pa: tshe 'di'i bar chad sel: phyi ma phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa: nang nub tu gsol ba 'debs pa'i chos shig zhu zhes zhus so: gu ru'i zhal nas: rgyal po chen po legs par gson cig: ces gsungs so: taṃ:thāmātra/t+ya/: e ma hoḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa rmad byung bsam yas la: khyad par 'phags pa'i bstan pa rnam gsum byon: sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhing khams 'dir: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa byon: bstan pa rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: 'og min lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang du: dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa yis: ma traṃ ru dra bka' sgo log pa las: 'gro drug sems can sdug bsngal nyam thag gzigs: thugs rje ngo mtshar can l

o rgyan? lcang lo can gyi pho brang dam pa ru: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bka' bgros mdzad: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi yis: log pa bdud kyi bstan pa 'dul bar mdzad: dus gsum bde gshegs rnams la gsol? o rgyan? ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser: bdud po ma traṃ ru dra drag pos bsgral: srin mo ma tshogs rnams la sbyor ba mdzad: gsang sngags bstan pa dang po de nas byon: gdul bya khyad par can la gsol? o rgyan? 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du: dus gsum skye 'gag med pa chos kyi sku: chos rnams rnam dag ye nas lhun gyis grub: sangs rgyas thams cad thugs las bskyed pa'i yab: chos sku kun tu bzang po la gsol? o rgyan? bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams su: gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngang : rnam par snang mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: sku yi rigs mchog rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: bud+dha rigs kyi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes ngang : rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: thugs kyi rigs mchog rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: rdo rje rigs kyi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? lho phyogs dpal ldan mdzes pa'i zhing khams su: nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : rin chen 'byung gnas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: yon tan rigs mchog rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: rin chen rigs kyi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ye shes ngang : snang ba mtha' yas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: gsung gi rigs mchog rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: pad+ma rigs kyi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su: phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes ngang : don yod grub pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku:

phrin las rigs mchog rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: karma rigs kyi lha tshogs l o rgyan? chos dbyings rol pa'i gzhal yas chen po na: nyon mongs dug lnga brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: khro bo'i rgyal po che mchog he ru kaḥ rigs lnga bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: kun bzang he ru ka'i lha tshogs l o rgyan? thugs rje rol pa'i gzhal yas chen po na: ma bdud dregs pa brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: mngon rdzogs rgyal po che mchog he ru kaḥ ye shes las grub ma mo'i 'khor gyis bskor: che mchog ma mo'i lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na: ma traṃ ru dra brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: thugs kyi bdag nyid badz+ra he ru kaḥ khrag 'thung khro bo 'bar ba'i 'khor gyis bskor: dpal chen he ru ka'i lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? mthing nag e las drag po'i gzhal yas na: gshin rje chu glang brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: 'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i gshed: gshed po khro bo dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi gzhal yas na: bdud nag pho mo brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma he ru kaḥ pad+ma rigs kyi khro bo rnams kyis bskor: rta mgrin dbang gi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na: pho bdud dregs pa brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dpa' bo'i sku: bdud 'dul khro bcu khra thabs 'khor gyis bskor: rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? pad+ma dbang gi gzhal yas chen po na: ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan steng du: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor: rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? dur khrod rngam brjid rol pa'i gzhal yas na: ti ra gan rkyal brdzis pa'i gdan steng du:

yum chen khro mo rdo rje phag mo'i sku: ma mo mkha' 'gro lha tshogs 'khor gyis bskor: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi pho brang du: rgyu 'bras bden pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing : sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor: sprul sku shākya thub pa la gsol? o rgyan? dha na ko sha klu yi pho brang du: thugs rje'i stobs kyis 'gro ba'i don la byon: rgyal ba'i dgongs pas 'gro drug rang grol mdzad: mkha' 'gro sde lnga ma mo'i 'khor gyis bskor: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje la gsol? o rgyan? rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i pho brang du: sangs rgyas sku yi sprul pa 'jam dpal dbyangs: steng 'og phyogs bzhir sku yis 'gro don mdzad: sku yi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? gnas chen ri bo ta la'i pho brang du: sangs rgyas gsung gi sprul pa spyan ras gzigs: steng 'og phyogs bzhir gsung gi 'gro don mdzad: gsung gi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor: spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? gnas mchog lcang lo can gyi pho brang du: sangs rgyas thugs kyi sprul pa rdo rje 'dzin: steng 'og phyogs bzhir thugs kyis 'gro don mdzad: thugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor: phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? steng phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du: 'phags pa 'jam dpal thugs kyi dgongs pa yis: lha dbang brgya byin gnas su gsang sngags byon: tshom bu 'bum dang bcas te mngon sangs rgyas: lha yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol? o rgyan? 'og phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum du: spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs kyi dgongs pa yis: klu rgyal 'jog po'i gnas su gsang sngags byon:

tshom bu 'bum dang bcas te mngon sangs rgyas: klu yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol? o rgyan? ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mo ru: phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yis: rgyal po dzaḥyi gnas su gsang sngags byon: gang zag las can ma lus byang chub thob: mi yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol? o rgyan? nub phyogs o rgyan dbang gi pho brang du: bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ste: 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro ba'i don la byon: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor: pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? chos sku longs sku sprul sku yang sprul dang : 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rig 'dzin byang sems la: bdag cag lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yis: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol? o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: zhes gsungs so: rgyal po chen po tshe 'di'i khe grags dang 'du 'dzi'i dbang du ma btang bar dus rgyun du gsol ba thob: gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dam tshig yin: dam tshig gi rtsa ba mos gus dang brtson 'grus yin: de gnyis kyi rtsa ba bla ma dang yi dam la gsol ba 'debs pa yin pas: brtson 'grus can gyis nyams su blangs na: tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs so: de nas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa: kyaiḥ slob dpon chen po lags: spyir sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhing khams 'dir: theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags byon pa 'gro ba yongs la bka' drin che lags: gsang sngags kyi lha thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: gsung theg pa chen po'i man ngag gis 'gro ba 'dren: thugs kyi dgongs pa dam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i dgongs pa zab mo mnga' ba: bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas ni bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis gzhan nas btsal du mi rnyed par 'khums lags pas:

bdag la tshig nyung la don 'dus pa: don zab la byin rlabs che ba: gu ru nyid la gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis byin rlabs nam mkha'i sprin ltar g.yo nus pa: bdag tha mal pa rnams kyis bod yul du gsol ba btab pas: gu ru nyid slar o rgyan du gshegs pa'i dus su mkha' 'gro'i gling nas thugs rjes bod kyi dad pa can gyi gnas su byon te byin gyis rlob nus pa zhig zhu zhes zhus pas: bka' stsal pa: nyon cig jo mo mtsho rgyal: khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i dbang gi rtog pa kha 'byams shing gnyis snang gi rtog pa bdag tu bzung bas 'khrul pa yin: nga nyid chos sku'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur: sprul sku'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bka' bgros te lho 'dzam bu'i gling du byon: khyad par bod yul mun pa'i gling du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar bya ba dang : gsang sngags 'bras bu'i chos kyis 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phyir: rin chen mtsho gling pad+ma'i sdong po las: rang byung sprul pa'i sku ru brda yis 'ongs: gang zhig las can skyes bu dad pa can: bdag la gdung ba'i sems kyis gsol 'debs na: rgyu 'bras rten 'brel smon lam khyad par gyis: sangs rgyas gzhan bas bdag nyid thugs rje myur: mtsho rgyal mos pas rgyun du gsol ba thob: ces gsungs so: de'i dus su zhal lho nub tu gzigs te: rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan: phyag g.yas pas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol: phyag g.yon pa jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi spyi thog tu bzhag ste: 'di skad ces gsungs so: e ma hoḥ 'di nas nyi ma lho nub mtshams shed na: gnas chen rdo rje gdan gyi nub byang mtshams: rnga yab gling phran za byed srin po'i yul: dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlabs pa'i: gling mchog khyad par can la gsol ba 'debs:

o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po 'das pa'i dus: ma traṃ ru dra bsgral ba'i rdzas brgyad la: gsang sngags 'byon pa'i gnas brgyad byin gyis brlabs: tsit+ta o rgyan gnas su babs pa las: rten 'brel khyad par can la gsol? o rgyan? rdo rje phag mos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'du ba'i gling : gsang sngags brda yi rang sgra di ri ri: gnas der phyin pa tsam gyis byang chub thob: gnas mchog khyad par can la gsol? o rgyan? zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo tsit+ta'i dbyibs: rtsa ba klu yi rgyal po'i gnas su zug: sked pa lhun chags mkha' 'gro'i gnas na brjid: rtse mo tshangs pa'i 'jig rten snyegs pa 'dra: ri rgyal khyad par can la gsol? o rgyan? dpal gyi ri bo 'bar ba'i rtse mo na: shar phyogs shel la lho phyogs baiḍūr+ya: nub phyogs rā ga byang phyogs in+d+ra'i mdog: phyi nang med par gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang : pho brang khyad par can la gsol b o rgyan? gzhal yas chen po'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dang : steng 'og thams cad rin po che las grub: khyams dang gru chad glo bur rigs bzhi yang : phrin las bzhi yi kha dog so sor gsal: lhun grub gzhal yas khang la gsol? o rgyan? rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba dang : drwa phyed mda' yab rin chen sna lnga gsal: sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor rgyan rnams kun: sna tshogs rin po che yis mdzes par brgyan: rin chen gzhal yas khang la gsol? o rgyan? dpag bsam shing dang bdud rtsi'i chu mig dang : 'ja' tshon sna lngas phyi nang sprin ltar gtibs: me tog pad+ma'i 'od kyis bar snang khengs: gnas de dran pa tsam gyis bde chen thob: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas la gsol? o rgyan? gzhal yas chen po de yi nang shed na: rin chen zur brgyad nyi ma zla ba'i gdan: ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i sdong po la: pad+ma 'byung gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku:

rang byung sprul pa'i sku la gsol? o rgyan? zhi rgyas dbang drag don la dgongs pa'i phyir: sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan rnams ma nges kyang : nyi ma stong gi 'od las gzi mdangs che: ri rgyal lhun po bas kyang brjid re che: ya mtshan sprul pa'i sku gsol? o rgyan? thugs kyi sprul pas 'jig rten khyab par 'gyed: spyan rtsa nyi zla lta bur 'khyil zhing gzigs: nam mkha'i glog las thugs rje'i phrin las myur: dgongs pa zab mo nam mkha'i klong dang mnyam: thugs rje khyad par can la gsol? o rgyan? 'gro la brtse ba'i thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad: zhal 'dzum mdzes pa'i mdangs ldan ya la la: 'brug stong ldir bas gsung gi gdangs sgra che: gsang sngags zab mo'i chos sgra di ri ri: tshangs pa'i gsungs dbyangs sgrogs la gsol? o rgyan? sprul sku chen po'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na: log pa'i dgra bgegs brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: rigs lnga bde gshegs bdud 'dul khro bo'i tshogs: sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan steng du: rigs bzhi'i ging dang mkha' 'gro sde bzhi tshogs: thams cad ma lus dur khrod chas dang ldan: mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: ye shes mkha' 'gro yab yum la gsol? o rgyan? gzhal yas chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i bar khyams dang : gru chad glo 'bur rig 'dzin mkha' 'gros khengs: lha dang lha mo mang po sprin ltar gtibs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? rin chen gzhal yas khang gi 'dod snam la: mchod pa'i lha mo char sprin lta bur gtibs: 'dod yon drug gi mchod pas 'jig rten khengs: kun tu bzang po'i mchod pas bde gshegs mchod: yon tan kun 'byung gi lha tshogs l o rgyan? gzhal yas chen po'i phyogs kyi sgo bzhi na:

rgyal chen sde bzhi bsgo ba'i bka' gnyan mdzad: lha srin sde brgyad bran dang pho nyar 'gyed: bdud dang mu stegs rdul phran bzhin du 'dul: chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs la gsol? o rgyan? hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: sgra dang rol mo mang po 'u ru ru: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: mkha' 'gro sde lngas gar byed shigs se shig: ging chen dpa' bos bro rdung khrabs se khrab: ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar thibs se thib: chos skyong sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: g.yas na pho rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab: dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldang thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda skad di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bo'i bshug glu kyu ru ru: hūm̐ gi snang glu mang po di ri ri: phaṭ kyi brda skad drag po sangs se sang : bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: thugs rjes gzigs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir thugs rjes dgongs te gshegs nas kyang : bdag gis byang chub snying po ma thob par: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral du gsol: mtsho rgyal de ltar mos pas gsol ba thob: pad 'byung bdag la 'gro ba'i don las med: dam tshig dbang gis bod kyi yul du 'ong : dad pa can la dngos su lung ston 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: gu ru'i zhal nas gsol ba 'debs pa la dang po lo rgyus brjod pas dwang ba 'dren:

yon tan mthong bas dad pa skye: yid khyed shes kyi dad pas byin rlabs 'jug: sems the tshom bral bas bsam pa 'grub: ces gsungs so: de nas dge slong nam mkha'i snying pos zhus pa: kye slob dpon chen po lags: bdag la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa: snang ba lha dang lha mor gsal ba: sgra grags tshad yi dam lha'i gsung du go ba: rtog pa ci shar chos nyid du grol ba'i gsol 'debs shig zhu zhes zhus pas: bka' stsal pa: e ma hoḥ spros bral bde chen rgyal ba kun tu bzang : rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas drug pa rdo rje 'chang : 'gro drug don mdzad byang chub sems dpa'i sku: chos sku longs sku sprul sku rnam pa gsum: rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung? grags ldan mchog skyong gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong : blo gros thabs ldan klu rgyal 'jog po dang : dri med grags pa las can rgyal po dzaḥ rig 'dzin lha dbang brgya byin la sogs te: rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan? chos sku kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa yis: rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje dang : shrī singha'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? rgyal ba chos kyi sku yi dgongs pa yis: bde gshegs rigs lnga rigs gsum mgon po dang : sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: sgyu 'phrul brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? 'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka'i dgongs pa yis: slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : ro langs bde ba'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: sku yi brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? pad+ma he ru ka yi dgongs pa yis: dbang gi lha mo nā gardzu na dang : pad+ma 'byung gnas bar du byin brlabs te:

'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: gsung gi brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? badz+ra he ru ka yi dgongs pa yis: dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : hūm̐ chen ka ra'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: thugs kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? che mchog he ru ka yi dgongs pa yis: sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin mang po dang : mi 'gyur nam mkha'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: yon tan brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa yis: lhun grub phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin dang : rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: phrin las brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? mngon rdzogs rgyal po che mchog he ru kaḥ ma rgyud lha mo yongs 'khyud bde ma dang : dha na saṃ skṛ'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: srid pa ma rgyud kyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul dgongs pa yis: raṃ bu gu h+ya tsan+d+ra'i thugs brgyud nas: shākya seṅge'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: mchod bstod brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? dpal chen stobs ldan nag po'i dgongs pa yis: slob dpon shān+tiṃ gar+bha'i thugs brgyud nas: rdo rje gro lod rtsal la byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: drag sngags brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? mgon po tshe dpag med kyi dgongs pa yis: lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī la thugs brgyud nas: 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: tshe yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol? o rgyan? rdo rje phag mo'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yis: mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can thugs brgyud nas:

rdo rje drag po rtsal la byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? rdo rje khrag 'thung thugs kyi dgongs pa yis: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs brgyud nas: 'dzam gling bod kyi las can byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: gsang sngags 'dus brgyud kyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa yis: sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i thugs brgyud nas: bo dhi sa twa'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: rgyu 'bras don ston gyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? rig 'dzin byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa yis: gang zag las can rnams la byin brlabs te: dus tshod 'di nas lnga brgya tha ma'i bar: gsang sngags bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i dam tshig can: gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa la gsol? o rgyan? 'di ltar mig gi yul du snang ba yi: phyi nang snod bcud dngos po thams cad kun: snang yang bdag 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog: gzung 'dzin dag pa gsal stong lha yi sku: 'dod chags rang grol gyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? 'di ltar rna ba'i yul du grags pa yi: snyan dang mi snyan 'dzin pa'i sgra rnams kun: grags stong bsam mno bral ba'i ngang la zhog: grags stong skye 'gag med pa rgyal ba'i gsung : grags stong rgyal ba'i gsung la gsol? o rgyan? 'di ltar yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi: nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang : sngon bsu rjes dpyod blo yis bcos mi gzhug: 'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol: rig pa rang grol gyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? phyi ltar gzung ba'i yul snang dag pa dang : nang ltar 'dzin pa'i sems nyid grol ba dang : bar du 'od gsal rang ngo shes pa ru: dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs rje yis: bdag 'dra'i rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs:

de ltar rgyun chad med par gsol ba thob: nam mkha'i snying po rig pa'i btsan sa zungs: bdag dang 'bral ba med par bde chen gnas su spyon: zhes gsungs so: de nas sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis zhus pa: kyai slob dpon chen po lags: nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i gsung : sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i thugs: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i thugs rje can: pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i sku: khyed las lhag pa gzhan na med: bdag dang ma 'ongs don ched du: nyid kyi byon tshul mdzad tshul la: brten nas dwang ba 'dren pa dang : yid ches mos gus skye ba yi: gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs pa'i gsung : bdag la thugs rjes gnang bar zhu: zhes zhus so: bka' stsal pa: nyon cig sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa: nga yi rnam thar mdzad tshul ni: bsam gyis mi khyab brjod mi lang : 'on kyang 'dzam gling bod yul du: sprul pas 'gro don byas pa'i tshul: cung zhig bshad kyis gus pas nyon: rgyun chad med par gsol ba thob: ces gsungs so: sanrathra/ e ma hoḥ lho nub rnga yab gling phran srin po'i yul: sin+dhu rgya mtsho rol pa'i mtsho gling du: klu rgyal 'jog po gnas pa'i khang steng du: pad+ma 'bar ba'i sdong po'i rtse las 'khrungs: rang byung ngo mtshar can la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan? pha dang ma med khye'u sprul pa'i sku: rgyu med rkyen med rgya mtsho klong las byon: ma rig log pa'i sems can 'dren pa'i dpal: bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ste: sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje la gsol? o rgyan? las can rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti yis: rgya mtsho chen po'i gling nas rnyed de byon: dad pas spyan drangs rgyal por mnga' gsol mdzad: rgyal srid chos kyi khrims kyis bde la bkod: rgyal po thor cog can la gsol? o rgyan? lho phyogs bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: rgyal srid spangs nas brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad:

ta na ga na'i sbyor sgrol dgongs pa yis: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus: shān+ta rak+ṣi ta la gsol? o rgyan? phyogs bzhi'i dur khrod kun tu spyod pa mdzad: ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs: rdo rje phag mo'i zhal mthong dngos grub thob: nam mkha'i gza' chen thams cad bran du bkol: rdo rje drag po rtsal la gsol? o rgyan? brag dmar bya khyung tshal gyi ke'u tshang du: slob dpon pra bha hasti'i spyan sngar byon: rnal 'byor yo ga'i chos la sbyangs pa mdzad: yo ga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal gzigs pa'i: shākya seṅge'i sku la gsol? o rgyan? rgya gar yul gyi phyogs bzhi'i gnas chen du: rig 'dzin grub thob mang po'i spyan sngar byon: yo ga rnam gsum chos la sbyangs pa mdzad: mtshan nyid rgyu yi chos kyi sgro 'dogs bcad: mkhas pa blo ldan mchog sred la gsol? o rgyan? brag phug mā ra ti ka'i ke'u tshang du: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin bsgrubs pa'i tshe: mgon po tshe dpag med kyis byin gyis brlabs: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i lus su gyur: 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol? o rgyan? za hor rgyal khams 'dul du gshegs pa'i tshe: ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can chos la btsud: ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan: rgyal khams thams cad chos kyis gang bar mdzad: pad+ma sam+bha'i sku la gsol? o rgyan? o rgyan rgyal khams 'dul du gshegs pa'i tshe: gshed mas me yi dbus su bsregs pa na: me dpung mtsho ru bsgyur te rdzu 'phrul bstan: in+d+ra bhū ti byang chub lam la bkod: sras mchog pad+ma rgyal po l o rgyan? 'og min gnas dang bde chen dur khrod dang : lhun grub brtsegs dang pad+ma brtsegs la sogs: rang byung mchod rten drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe: ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor gyis bskor: gu ru nyi ma 'od zer la gsol? o rgyan? lho phyogs rgya gar yul du gshegs pa'i tshe:

mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma yis byin gyis brlabs: mu stegs ston pa lnga brgya'i rtsod pa bzlog: ngan sngags bdag po mu stegs thog gis bsgral: 'phags pa seṅge sgra sgrogs la gsol? o rgyan? bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu: yang dag bde chen snying po bsgrubs pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub gnas der thob: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la gsol? o rgyan? byang phyogs rgyal po'i don la byon pa'i tshe: bod kyi gnod sbyin thams cad dam la btags: bsam yas mnga' gsol rgyal po'i dgongs pa bsgrubs: bod yul thams cad chos kyis gang bar mdzad: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol? o rgyan? bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang du: sgrub chen bka' brgyad gsang sngags dkyil 'khor du: las can rgyal po rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: gsang sngags 'bras bu'i theg pa rgyas par mdzad: bka' drin bsam las 'das la gsol? o rgyan? stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub ke'u tshang du: gdug pa'i mu stegs bdud dang dam sri btul: gnas chen gangs brag rnams la gter chen sbas: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i sems can thugs rjes gzigs: rdo rje gro lod rtsal la gsol? o rgyan? bod kyi gangs chen bzhi la sgrub khang mdzad: brag phug chen po brgyad la yang dben mdzad: phyogs bzhi'i brag la sprul sku'i zhabs rjes bzhag: grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi la phyag rjes bzhag: 'gro drug sgrib sbyong mdzad la gsol? o rgyan? lho phyogs mon kha'i brag la sku rjes bzhag: sku tshab gter lnga bod kyi don la bzhag: sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par mdzad: bod kyi lha gcig 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal: thugs rje khyad par can la gsol? o rgyan? lho nub rnga yab gling phran dpal ri'i rtser: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mang po'i rgyal po mdzad: sha za srin po thams cad dam la btags: bod la rgyun chad med par thugs rjes gzigs:

drin can sprul pa'i sku la gsol? o rgyan? lnga brgya'i tha mar bod kyi sems can la: las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal rgyun chad med: khyod kyi rnam thar dran cing gsol 'debs na: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol: rdo rje bdud 'joms legs par gus pas nyon: nga yi rnam thar dran cing gsol ba thob: tshe 'dir pad+ma nga yi byin gyis rlob: phyi ma byang chub lam la 'god par nges: zhes gsungs so: de nas lha sras mu khri btsan pos zhus pa: kye slob dpon chen po lags: dus ma 'ongs pa lnga brgya snyigs ma la thug pa'i tshe: sems can thams cad las ngan gyi dbang gis sdug bsngal sha stag la spyod dgos par gsungs gda': de rnams la thugs rjes gzigs nas sdug bsngal las skyob nus pa'i gsol 'debs shig zhu: zhes zhus so: bka' stsal pa: nyon cig mu khri btsan po: tsha ba'i yul med na rgya skyegs kyi nus pa mi 'go: dad pa'i zhing sa med na byang chub kyi myu gu mi skye: yid khyed shes kyi blo ma khel na dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs rgyang ring : nyon cig lha sras: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'gro ba'i don rgyun chad med par mdzad kyang : 'gro drug dug lnga'i bdag 'dzin stobs che bas: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par ma gyur: lha sras rang yang bod 'bangs phyi ma rnams sdug bsngal las skyob par 'dod na: yid khyed shes kyi dad pa brtan par gyis: blo dkon mchog gsum la gtod cig ces zhal chems bu 'bangs la zhog: dus rgyun du mos pas 'di ltar du gsol ba thob ces gsungs so: e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: mgon po tshe dpag med kyi thugs rje yis: 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i: dus gsum bde gshegs rnams la gsol? o rgyan?

sin+dhu rgya mtsho rol pa'i mtsho gling du: me tog pad+ma 'bar ba'i sdong po la: pha dang ma med rang byung shugs las byung : rgyu med rkyen med 'gro ba'i don la byon: rang byung ngo mtshar can la gsol? o rgyan? sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi sprul pa ste: rang byung mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par byon: nyi ma stong gi 'od las gzi mdangs che: khyod kyi sprul pas 'jig rten khyab par 'gyed: ya mtshan sprul pa'i sku la gsol? o rgyan? sangs rgyas thams cad gsung gi sprul pa ste: ma chags pad+ma'i sdong po'i rtse las 'khrungs: 'brug chen stong gi sgra bas gsung gdangs che: 'gro ba'i don du theg chen chos sgra sgrogs: 'brug ltar sgrogs pa'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan? sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi sprul pa ste: rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa'i klong las skyes: nam mkha'i glog las thugs rje'i phrin las myur: dgongs pa zab mo nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: cir yang sa le'i thugs la gsol? o rgyan? 'gro ba'i don du yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: khyod kyi mtshan thos tsam gyis sdug bsngal sel: 'ja' tshon bzhin du yon tan so sor gsal: skad cig dran pas byang chub lam sna 'dren: yon tan kun 'byung khyod la gsol? o rgyan? thugs rje'i phrin las dbang gis don mdzad pa'i: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi yis: nyon mongs gdul dka'i sems can thabs kyis 'dul: nam mkha'i skar ltar phrin las bsam mi khyab: phrin las rgya mtsho'i rlabs la gsol? o rgyan? steng 'og phyogs bzhir 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang : bod yul kha ba can du thugs rjes gzigs: bod kyi mnga' bdag rje 'bangs thams cad la: dus gsum rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs: 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral du gsol: zhes gsungs so: de nas 'khor gyi zhu ba po rnam pa lngas tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul: phyag dang bskor ba byas te zhus pa:

kyai slob dpon chen po lags: 'di lta bu'i gsol 'debs khyad par can gsungs pa bka' drin che lags: gsol ba 'debs pa la gang zag tha mal pa'i ca co'i sgra mi gdags shing : dus ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag rnams sdug bsngal gyis nyen pas: slob dpon nyid rjes su dran nas gsol ba 'debs na: ngag gi gdangs ji ltar du gdags lags zhes zhus so: bka' stsal pa: nga yi rjes 'jug 'khor ba spong 'dod rnams: dad gus mos pas rgyun du gsol ba thob: rtse gcig gdung ba'i dbyangs ni 'di lta ste: khye'u pha mar 'bod 'dra'i gdung dbyangs la: pi waṃ gling bu'i gdangs ltar snyan pa yis: nyin mtshan dus drug rnams su gsol ba thob: ma 'ongs tha ma'i dus su nub phyogs su: nga yi rjes 'jug sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa: 'gro don cher spyod lhag par nga la mos: the tshom chung zhing chos rgyal gdung brgyud skyob: de 'dra'i las can snyigs ma'i dus su 'byung : zhes pa las can don du gter du sbos: sā mā ṅga/ཿthā bā: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sa ma ya kha thaṃ: chu pho stag gi lo ru lag grom pa rgyang gi o rgyan sgrub phug nas sprul sku ri khrod pa bzang po grags pas gter gnas nas gdan drangs shing rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can la gtad nas rig 'dzin chen pos shog ser las bsgyur ba'o: 'di man sh+lau ka bzhi dang rkang pa gnyis po 'di khri srong rnam 'phrul dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis kha skong du mdzad: ces gsungs sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes bzhin/ gus shing gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs bur/ kye ma thugs rje'i gzigs shig ma hā gu ru/ byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun thod phreng rtsal/ bar chad kun sol bdud 'dul drag po rtsal/ dngos grub mchog stsol o rgyan rin po che/ da lta rtsod dus lnga brgya'i snyigs dus 'dir/ 'byung pos rgyud dkrugs skye bos log par 'tshe/ mtha' yi dmag dpung nad mtshon mu ge sogs/

byur dang ltas ngan gnod pa kun zhi zhing*/ rgyal ba'i bstan dang khyad par theg dgu srol/ de 'dzin tshogs rnams dar smin rgyas gyur cig /phun tshogs bsam yas lhun grub pho brang gnas/ pad+ma 'byung gnas lam zab chos ston pa/ theg chen rgyal srid rin chen bdun ldan chos/ skal ldan las can dag pa rnam lnga'i 'khor/ 'od dkar rgyal gyis gang ba'i bkra shis dus/ deng 'dir bsam pa lhun grub bkra shis shog /na mo gu ru/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas lho nub srin po'i gling du gshegs pa'i dus su: gong thang la thog tu lha sras mu khri btsan pos phyag dang bskor ba byas: zhabs spyi bor gtugs: na bza' sleb mo la 'jus te: spyan chab phyungs nas bshum zhing smre sngags kyi zhu ba phul: kye ma gu ru rin po che: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: mang yul gong thang gangs 'gram 'dir: bdag gi bu rgyud gnas byas te: dmangs su 'bebs shing sdug bsngal na: bod kyi rgyal po snying re rje: bdag gi bu rgyud su la re: las su dmag dang 'khrug pa byed: dben gnas gnyan po 'dral ba dang : ri klung jag pa'i rgyug sa byed: chos la sgrub long med pas ni: bla mchod rnams ni 'o re brgyal: phyis 'byung dad ldan snying re rje: gtsug lag khang du 'khrugs khang byed: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bshig: dam rdzas mi nag skye bos spyod: dben sar bon gyis bswo sgra sgrogs: chos 'khor 'jig la thug pa na: dam pa'i rten rnam 'o re brgyal: chos 'khor bka' srung su la re: che btsun zas ngan dug gis gsod: mi chen srog la hur thum byed: ya rabs mnong pos dmangs su 'bebs: snying brtse'i grogs kyis blo brku na: bod kyi zhang blon snying re rje: rgyal po'i thugs gces su la re: nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa dar: mtha' yi mi bzhi dbus su shor: 'dre bgegs 'byung pos tsha rag gtong : ci mi 'dod pa 'byung ba na:

bod 'bangs sdug pa snying re rje: skyabs med sems can su la re: khri srong lde'u btsan dgung la gshegs: gu ru o rgyan gnas su gshegs: mu khri btsan po bod du bor: yab rgyal po sku tshe thung lags so: gu ru thugs rje chung lags so: bdag gi bsod nams chung lags so: chos 'khor bstan pa nyams lags so: bod 'bangs skyid pa zad lags so: yab dang gu ru bzhugs dus su: mu khri btsan po'i mi 'gum pa: bdag gi blo gtad su la 'cha': snying brtse'i gros ni su yis 'debs: dam pa'i chos ni su la zhu: 'chi dus 'pho ba su yis 'debs: bar do'i sdug bsngal su yis sel: sgrib sbyong phrin las su yis mdzad: kye ma kyi hud thugs rje chung : zhes smre sngags 'don cing lha sras dran med du brgyal lo: de nas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rgyal po'i snyan khung du ljags kyi chab gtor nas dran pa gsos: lha sras kyi dbu sku pang du blangs te: 'di skad gsungs so: nyon cig bod kyi rgyal po dad pa can: las can mos gus ldan pa nga yi bu: khri srong lde'u btsan sku tshe mtha' ru 'khyol: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: bdag ni da dung bod kyi don la mchi: dad pa can la dngos su dam chos ston: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ma lus pa: nga yi zhal mthong tsam las dag par nges: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: 'di dang phyi ma bar do gnas gsum du: nga dang yang yang mjal zhing sdug bsngal sel: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: 'di nas skye ba bcu drug 'gro don mdzod: de nas o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du byon: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: mang yul gung thang gangs ri'i 'dabs 'di ru: nyid kyi gdung brgyud phyi ma 'byon pa rnams: gdung brgyud ma nor chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs: nga yis thugs rje rgyun chad med par gzigs:

thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: dben gnas chos mdzad dad gus ldan pa yis: rgyal ba'i bka' dang thugs rje'i gdul bya rnams: nga yi byin rlabs thugs rjes skyob lags kyis: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: skal med sdig spyod log lta bdud kyi rigs: rtog dpyod 'gran sems nag po'i sems can ni: bdag gis mi skyob las ngan dag la spyod: da lta'i nang blon nag po 'di rnams kyang : rje yi thugs dkrugs bdag gi dam las nyams: da dung ngan song gsum du nges par 'gro: 'on kyang nga yi zhal mthong gsung thos pas: tha ma las ngan dag nas bdag gi gdul byar skye: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: dus ngan tha mar mthar thug sleb ka ru: ri bo bkra bzang zhes bya'i shar 'dabs su: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gcig gi smon lam gyis: nga yi gter 'don lha sras gdung brgyud skyob: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: dus ngan tha ma'i sems can zog pos 'dul: de yi skyon gyis log lta'i 'dam la tshud: chos dang chos 'dra mi byed the tshom che: ri bo bkra bzang 'dabs su 'byung ba de: gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i bka' dang mthun: dge ba'i tshul spyod sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pas: gung thang rgyal po rjes 'bangs skyobs par nges: thugs ngal ma mdzad lha sras bod kyi rje: zhes gsungs so: de'i dus su rgyal po'i sdug bsngal sel byed nyon mongs rang grol zhes bya ba gsungs so: gu ru'i zhal nas lha sras nyid: bod 'bangs kyi don du thugs shin tu brtse bas/ ngas rgyal po'i gdung brgyud rnams la dus snyigs ma'i mthar thug pa'i bar du byin rlabs thugs rjes skyob kyi/ lha sras rang bod 'bangs la zhal chems 'di ltar du zhog ces gsungs so/ rigs bzang khungs btsun 'od gsal lha yi rgyud: mu khri btsan po man chad gdung brgyud ma chad par: bdag gi thugs rjes rgyun du bzung lags kyi:

sdig spyod grogs dang blon po'i khar ma btang : rgyal khrims chos kyi khrims kyis 'tsho bar mdzod: chos med dred po zol zog g.yo sgyu can: snyigs dus 'byung bas tshar chod chos khrims tshugs: chos bzhin spyod pas rgyal khrims bde bar 'gyur: sku srog nyen zhing mnga' thang 'phrog pa dang : rgyal po dmangs su 'bebs pa'i gal byung na: lha srin dpang du tshugs la bzlog par mdzod: snyigs dus gong thang rgyal por snying brtse'i phyir: brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i sked pa la: lha sras gdung brgyud skyob pa'i man ngag bdog: de dus skye 'gro mi rnams the tshom che: log lta ma byed nga'i bka' bzhin sgrubs: gung thang rgyal po'i bsam pa de yis 'grub: sdig spyod rgyal po bdag gis skyob mi 'gyur: zhes gsungs so: gu ru'i zhal nas: lha sras nyid kyi gdung rabs tha ma mang yul gong thang du nga yi gter gyis skyob pa'i dus su: bod sdug pa'i dus la babs pa yin te: sems can la ci mi 'dod pa 'byung : steng lha srin 'khrugs: 'og klu gnyan 'khrugs: bar gzhi bdag 'khrugs: sdig spyod rgyal po 'khrugs: dmangs phal pa 'khrugs: pha spun nang 'khrugs: de'i dus su sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' la thug: yi dam lha yi dngos grub yal: mkha' 'gro chos skyong ri rab la zhal gzigs: sems can gyi skyid pa zad pa yin: gung thang rgyal po yon mchod rje 'bangs rnams: nga yi bka' bzhin sgrubs la gter gyi chos la spyod: pad+ma bdag gi thugs rje myur la stobs che ba de'i dus su 'byung ngo : dus rgyun chad med par nga la gsol ba thob: ces gsungs so: e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i byin rlabs g.yos: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas byin brlabs te: 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro ba'i don la byon: 'gro don rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p

rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan man chad nas: chos rgyal gdung brgyud mtha' la ma stongs bar: dus gsum rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs: bod kyi chos skyong rgyal po'i gnyen gcig pu: rgyal po chos spyod skyong ba'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p sku ni lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can yongs la gzigs: ma rig log pa'i sems can 'dren pa'i dpal: nyon mongs gdul dka'i sems can thabs kyis 'dul: brtse gdung rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i tshe: nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon: nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs la bcibs te byon: yar ngo tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: 'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lnga rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na:

dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste:

sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p 'gro drug sdug bsngal chen pos nyen pa dang : khyad par bod kyi rje 'bangs sdug bsngal na: dad gus mos pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan thugs rjes 'pho 'gyur med par gzigs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsungs nas: lha sras la thugs brtse bas dgongs te yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag bcu gsum gnang ngo : de nas lha sras kyis gus pas phyag dang bskor ba byas: gu ru o rgyan gyi yul du zhal gzigs nas nyi zer la bcibs nas bzhud do: lha sras mu khri btsan pos nyon mongs rang grol gyi man ngag dang : yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag bcu gsum zhal chems dang bcas pa mang yul gyi brag rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba la gter du sbas: gter bdag bse'i lha mo mched bzhi la bcol lo: nam zhig dus kyi mtha' ma la: nga yi gdung brgyud sdug pa'i dus: ri bo bkra bzang shar 'dabs nas: las can skyes bu byung ba'i tshe: de tshe de yis rnyed gyur nas: bdag gi gdung brgyud skyob par shog: ces gsungs so: :sāmāṅka: lha sras mu khri btsan po'i zhal nas: nga yi bu 'bangs dad gus ldan pa rnams: bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs de: skyabs bla ma dran dus na gsol ba thob: yab rgyal po la gsungs pa de: srod drag po'i dus su gsol ba thob: ma jo mo mtsho rgyal la gsungs pa de: tho rangs rgyas pa'i dus su gsol ba thob: dge slong nam mkha'i snying po la gsungs pa de: nam langs zhi ba'i dus su gsol ba thob: sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms la gsungs pa de: dgong mo dbang gi dus su gsol ba thob: lha sras mu khri btsan po la gsungs pa de: nam gung mun pa'i smag la gsol ba thob: bu gung thang rgyal po la gsungs pa de:

nyin gung brel ba spongs la gsol ba thob: spyir sdug bsngal gyis nyen dus gsol ba thob: bdag rgyal po'i gdung brgyud ma nor zhing : chos tshul bzhin spyod pa'i las can la: spyir sangs rgyas thams cad bka' drin che: sgos gu ru'i bka' drin bsam mi khyab: bdag chos skyong rgyal po'i ngag la nyon: dus rgyun du mos pas gsol ba thob: ces gsungs so: gung thang rgyal po la gsungs pa'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma zhes bya ba 'di ni: lha sras mu khri btsan pos ru lag gram pa rgyang gi lha khang du sbas so: gter bdag lha mo drel zhon la bcol lo: sā mā ṅga: thābā: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: chu mo lug gi lo ru lag rgyang gi lha khang nas: sprul sku bzang po grags pas gter nas bton te: rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can la gtad: rig 'dzin chen pos shog ser las bsgyur ba'o: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: ྀatshaḥ ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las: gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs: longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bdag gi bla ma ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sku: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs thos bsam mdzad: bod yul dbus su zhal byon dregs pa btul: o rgyan yul du sku bzhugs 'gro don mdzad: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas bdag sogs lam sna drongs: dgongs pas bdag la dngos grub stsol: nus pas bdag sogs bar chad sol: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol: nang gi bar chad nang du sol: gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sku yi ngo mtshar mthong ba'i tshe: g.yas pas ral gri'i phyag rgya mdzad: g.yon pas 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs gyen la gzigs:

rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin 'gro ba'i mgon: thugs rjes bdag l brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? dam chos rin chen gsan pa'i tshe: sku gsal 'od zer mdangs dang ldan: phyag g.yas sde snod glegs bam bsnams: g.yon pas phur pa'i pusti bsnams: zab mo'i chos rnams thugs su chud: yang le shod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? dam can dam la btags pa'i tshe: dri med gnas mchog nyams re dga': rgya gar bod yul sa mtshams su: byin gyis brlabs nas byon pa'i tshe: dri bsung spos ngad ldan pa'i ri: me tog pad+ma dgun yang skye: chu mig byang chub bdud rtsi'i chu: bde ldan de yi gnas mchog tu: skyes mchog tshul bzang chos gos gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams: g.yon pas rin chen za ma tog: rak+ta bdud rtsis nang du gtams: mkha' 'gro dam can dam la btags: yi dam zhal gzigs dngos grub brnyes: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? rgyal ba'i bstan pa btsugs pa'i tshe: g.ya' ri nags la sgrub pa mdzad: bsnyen phur nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phang : rdo rje'i phyag rgyas blangs shing bsgril: bsgril zhing tsan dan nags su 'phang : me 'bar 'khrugs shing mtsho yang skem: srib kyi mu stegs sa gang bsregs: yak+sha nag po rdul du brlag: 'gran gyi do med bdud kyi gshed: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? srin po'i kha gnon mdzad pa'i tshe: khye'u chung sprul sku'i cha lugs can: ya mtshan gzugs bzang kha dog legs: tshems 'grigs dbu skra ser la mdzes: dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs gsol: phyag g.yas 'khar ba'i phur pa bsnams: bdud dang srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: g.yon pas seng ldeng phur pa bsnams:

mos pa'i bu la srung skyob mdzad: mgul na lcags kyi phur pa bsnams: yi dam lha dang gnyis su med: gnyis med sprul sku 'dzam gling brgyan: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? 'dre yi yul du dgongs pa'i tshe: me dpung shod kyi sa gzhi la: mda' rgyang gang gi mtsho nang du: pad+ma'i steng du bsil bsil 'dra: pad+ma'i nang na dgongs pa mdzad: mtshan yang pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su byon: de 'dra'i sprul sku ya mtshan can: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐: bod kyi nyi ma mdzad pa'i tshe: dad ldan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal: gang la gang 'dul skur bstan nas: gtsang kha la yi la thog tu: dgra lha'i dge bsnyen dam la btags: yul ni tsha ba'i tsha shod du: lha yi dge bsnyen dregs pa can: nyi shu rtsa gcig dam la btags: mang yul de yi byams sprin du: dge slong bzhi la dngos grub gnang : khyad par 'phags pa'i rig 'dzin mchog: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐: dpal mo thang gi dpal thang du: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: bod yul kha la'i la thog tu: gangs dkar sha med dam la btags: 'dam shod lha bu'i snying drung du: thang lha yar bzhud dam la btags: has po ri yi yang gong du: lha srin thams cad dam la btags: che ba'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis: la las srog gi snying po phul: la las bstan pa bsrung bar byas: la las bran du khas blangs byas: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs po che: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i: gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? dam pa chos kyi bstan pa ni: rgyal mtshan lta bur btsugs pa'i tshe: bsam yas ma bzhengs lhun gyis grub: rgyal po'i dgongs pa mthar phyin mdzad: skyes mchog gsum gyi mtshan yang gsol:

gcig ni pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes: gcig ni pad+ma sam+bha wa: gcig ni mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes: gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? bsam yas mchims phur sgrub pa mdzad: rkyen ngan zlog cing dngos grub gnang : rje blon thar pa'i lam la bkod: gdon gzugs bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs: chos sku dri med rin chen bstan: skal ldan sangs rgyas sa la bkod: thugs rje? brtse ba'i? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? de nas o rgyan yul du byon: da lta srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: mi las lhag gyur ya mtshan che: spyod pa rmad byung ngo mtshar che: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs po che: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? oṃ āḥhūm̐? sku gsung thugs ldan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal: sgrib pa kun spangs khams gsum sa ler mkhyen: dngos grub mchog brnyes bde chen mchog gi sku: byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad nges par sel: thugs rjes? brtse bas? dgongs pas? nus pas? phyi yi? nang gi? gsang ba'i? gus pas? oṃ āḥhūm̐? oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes pa'ang rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul pa'i gter ston chen po o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas zla nyin kha la rong sgo'i dpal chen po'i zhabs 'og nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi zhal gdams snying byang yid bzhin nor bu las: phyi gsol 'debs kyi sgrub pa khol du phyung ba ste: 'dis kyang bstan 'gro'i bar chad dang rgud pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing : dge legs kyi don thams cad yongs su grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ dus gsum sangs rgyas gu ru rin po che: dngos grub kun bdag bde ba chen po'i zhabs: bar chad kun sel bdud 'dul drag po rtsal:
