gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pas seng chen gnam brag gi g.yas zur brag ri rin chen brtsegs pa nas spyan drangs pa dus babs kyi gsol 'debs 'di nyid byin rlabs shin tu che bas kun gyis kha ton tu gces par zungs shig/ // ༈ rgya gar paṇa chen bod la bka' drin che: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la 'das grongs med: da lta lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: zhes pa 'di ni rgyal sras sman lung pas mdzad par grags so// // ༈ gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub ma ni/ e ma hoḥ mtsho dbus ge sar pad+ma'i sdong po la/ /sku lnga ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i lha/ /rang byung chen po pad+ma yab yum ni/ /mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /lan ngan spyad pa'i rnam smin mthus bskyed pa'i/ /nad gdon bar gcod dmag 'khrug mu ge'i tshogs/ khyod zhal dran pa'i mod la zad byed pa'i/ /zhal bzhes snying nas bskul lo o rgyan rje/ /bsam pa myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dad dang tshul khrims gtong la goms pa dang*/ /thos pas rgyud grol khrel yod ngo tsha shes/ /shes rab phun sum tshogs pa'i nor bdun po/ /sems can kun gyi rgyud la rang zhugs nas/ /'jig rten bde skyid ldan par dbugs 'byin mdzod/ /bsam pa myur du? /gang la nad dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod rkyen/ /'byung po'i gdon dang rgyal po'i chad pa dang*/ /me chu gcan gzan lam 'phrang 'jigs pa che/ /tshe yi pha mthar gtugs pa'i gnas skabs kun/ /skyabs dang re sa gzhan du ma mchis pas/ /thugs rjes zung zhig gu ru o rgyan rje/ /bsam pa myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes bod khams nad mug mtha' dmag zhi zhing bstan 'gro'i bde skyid gso bar phan na snyam pa dad ldan rnams kyi thugs la gzhug

/ces pa 'di'i sh+lau ka dang po kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i mkha' 'gro yang tig gi rgyab chos zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung mchod brjod las byung zhing*/ de phyin kun mkhyen gnyis pa rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can no// // 'di la dogs pa sel ba ni/ nga yi rjes 'jug ces tshig rkang drug po 'don cha ma yin par nges kyang*/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi ljags bsgrigs mas kha bskangs nas le'u bdun nges par tshang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med kyang bsam lhun gung thang la thog tu gsungs pas gnas mi mtshungs pa bden mod/ don la zhu ba rnams lngar spyir btang du bla ma sku gsum gsol 'debs dang*/ dmigs kyi zhu ba po so sor le'u re re gsungs pas le'u drug tu 'byung la/ lha sras nyid kyis nga yi bu 'bangs dad gus ldan pa rnams: bla ma sku gsum zhes pa nas: gung thang rgyal po la gsungs pa de: nyin gung brel ba spongs la gsol ba thob: ces pa lha sras mu khri rjes gong gi le'u drug gi khar bsam lhun bzhag ste bdun du mdzad pa mngon sum grub la/ mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyis kyang le'u drug pa'i rjes su bsam lhun 'jug pas rgyu mtshan de ltar na gung thang rgyal po zhu ba po rnam lnga'i gral yang ma yin/ bsam lhun gsungs pa'i skabs su med mod kyang*/ gdung brgyud du ma 'ongs lung bstan pa ni/ mang yul gung thang gangs ri'i 'dabs 'di ru/ zhes sogs nas gung thang rgyal po'i bsam pa de yis 'grub/ gsungs pa'i bar du lung bstan mdzad pa nyid kyis gsal lo// // ༈ o rgyan rin po che'i gsol ba 'debs thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru dā+e wa ḍāk+ki nī ye/ bdag nyid spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo yi/ /'od klong nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs gdan du/ /ma bcos lhun grub gu ru pad+ma'i sku/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'od dpung 'bar/

/sku bzhi lhun grub longs sku'i mtshan dpe ldan/ /lnga ldan thig le 'ja' 'od zer thag 'tsher/ /'gag med 'od snang mtha' yas dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rje btsun o rgyan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gzhan smin cing grol bar mdzad pa dang*/ /ka dag gdod ma'i rang ngo shes pa dang*/ /rang sems chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba ru/ /mchog thun 'bad med bdag gzhan don grub nas/ /skye dang tshe rabs 'bral med rjes 'dzin shog /ces dad ldan gyis bskul ngor sngags 'chang kā las bris// // ༈ thugs dam gnad bskul ni/ phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan las thugs rje'i phrin las myur/ /bod khams skyong ba zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin/ /o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /bzod med gdung shugs drag pos snying nas 'bod/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mtha' la thug ba'i tshe/ yul lha yul phud 'byung pos shul bzung na/ /gzhi bdag gnas su 'khod cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /nag phyogs mi dang 'dre bdud kha dar na/ /dkar phyogs dbugs dbyung mdzod cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /chos skyong rnams kyi dam bca' btang gyur na/ /dam tshig phyag rgyas chings shig pad+ma 'byung*/ /dam med shi 'dres bar chad rtsom gyur na/ /'dre rgod dam la thogs shig pad+ma 'byung*/ /skye 'gro'i shes rgyud bgegs kyis brlabs gyur na/ kha khrol bgegs tshogs bskrod cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /smon log dam sris bstan la bar gcod na/ /drag rtsal shugs kyis sgrol cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /rgya 'dre 'gong pos bod khams phung gyur na/ /mthu stobs nus pas thul cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /mtha' bzhi'i dmag gi mtshon kha ldang ba na/ /mtha' dmag dus 'khrug bzlog cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /lha srin ma mo'i dal yams 'thibs pa na/ /thugs rje sman gyis sos shig pad+ma 'byung*/

/'brog pa phyugs nyes yus ba lo nyes na/ /'bru nor longs spyod spel cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /sa yi bcud nyams skye 'gro'i g.yang nyams na/ /bcud g.yang byin chen phob cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde dang bcas pa rnams/ /dar zhing rgyas par mdzod cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /chos med bdag sogs 'khor bar 'khyam pa na/ /bde chen zhing du drongs shig pad+ma 'byung*/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gol sar 'phyugs gyur na/ /don dam rang ngo sprod cig pad+ma 'byung*/ /skye ba 'di dang phyi ma thams cad la/ /'bral med thugs rjes gzigs shig pad+ma 'byung*/ /mdor na sdug bsngal nyes tshogs ci byung yang*/ /rtag tu thugs rjes skyongs shig pad+ma 'byung*/ ༈ zhar byung rgyun spyod rang lugs gtso gyur rgyun khyer phyogs bsdus skor las/ thub chog byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru shākya mu ne/ de yang mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'chag dang 'dug dang 'greng dang nyal ba na/ /mi gang thub pa'i zla ba dran byed pa/ /de yi mdun na rtag tu ston pa bzhugs/ /de ni rgya chen mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ sku lus dag ni gser gyi mdog 'dra bas/ /'jig rten mgon po kun nas rab tu mdzes/ /dmigs pa 'di la gang gi sems 'jug pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni mnyam bzhag yin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa mtshungs pa med pa thub pa'i dbang po rjes su dran pa'i rnal 'byor du bya ba ni/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs sogs skyabs sems dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang ste/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa'i don yid la dran pa'i ngang nas/ āḥ skye med stong pa nyid dang rten 'byung gi /snang ba 'gag med zung 'jug sgyu ma'i tshul/ rang mdun nam mkhar mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /rin chen seng khri pad nyi zla ba'i steng*/ /ston pa mtshungs med shākya seṅge ni/

/gser gyi mdog can mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /chos gos gsum gsol rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas sa gnon phyag rgya legs brkyangs shing*/ /phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams/ /gser gyi ri ltar gzi brjid dpal 'bar ba/ /ye shes 'od zer drwa bas mkha' dbyings khyab/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad gnas brtan bcu drug sogs/ /'phags tshogs rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor zhing*/ /dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis las/ /rnam grol bde ba mchog gi dpal stsol ba/ /skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid chen por gsal/ zhes de ltar sangs rgyas kyi sku la dmigs te de na dngos su bzhugs yod snyam pa'i sems bskyed ma thag tu/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi sku la phyogs dang dus gang du yang nye ring mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ gang du dmigs pa de nyid du nges par bzhugs par 'gyur te/ mdo las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa/ /de yi mdun na de bzhugs te/ /rtag par byin gyis rlob byed cing*/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ /rgyal ba de nyid la dmigs nas tshogs bsags pa yang mi zad pa'i dge rtsa chud mi za ba yin te/ phal po che las/ rgyal ba de dag thos mthong mchod pa byas pas kyang*/ /tshad med pa yi bsod nams phung po 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad spang 'gyur du/ /'dus byas 'di nang bar ma dor ni zad mi 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ de'i mdun du smon lam ji ltar btab pa yang de bzhin du 'grub ste/ 'jam dpal zhing gi yon tan bstan pa las/ /chos rnams thams cad rkyen yin te/ 'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas/ /gang gi smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshul rnams la dad pa brtan po bskyed de/ snying rje chen pos rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i zhing*/ /bzung nas smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab/

/pad dkar ltar bsngags mtshan thos phyir mi ldog /ston pa thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gzhan sgo gsum dge tshogs longs spyod bcas/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du dmigs nas 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung ma lus pa/ /snying nas 'gyod pa drag pos so sor bshags/ /'phags dang so so'i skye bo'i dge ba ni/ /dus gsum bsags la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /zab cing rgya che chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshul/ /phyogs bcur rgyun mi 'chad par bskor du gsol/ khyod ni nam mkha' lta bu'i ye shes sku/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs mod kyi/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor skye 'jig tshul ston kyang*/ /sprul pa'i gzugs sku rtag tu snang bar mdzod/ /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun la phan slad du/ /chos kyi rgyal po rtag tu mnyes byed cing*/ /chos rje rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /bdag cag snyigs ma'i 'gro ba mgon med rnams/ /thugs rjes lhag par bzung ba'i bka' drin las/ /zhing dang dus 'dir rin chen rnam gsum gyi/ /snang ba ji snyed khyed kyi phrin las nyid/ /de phyir skyabs mchog mtshungs med gcig pu ru/ /yid ches dad pas snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /sngon gyi dam bca' chen po ma bsnyel bar/ /byang chub bar du thugs rjes rjes 'dzin mdzod/ ces yid ches kyi dad pa drag pos ston pa dngos su bzhugs yod snyam pa'i sku la rtse gcig tu dmigs te/ bla ma ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci 'grub dang*/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i tshul du sher phyin yi ge nyung du las gsungs pa'i gzungs ni/ tad+yathā/ om̐ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes ci rigs dang*/ om̐ man chad ci 'grub tu bzla'o/

/'di dag gi skabs su ston pa'i yon tan rjes su dran te/ dad pa'i sems kyis rtse gcig tu sku yi gsal snang la dmigs nas/ mtshan brjod pa dang*/ gzungs bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis/ ston pa'i sku las ye shes kyi 'od zer sna tshogs pa'i snang ba chen pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad bsal zhing*/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi yon tan tshul bzhin du skyes te phyir mi ldog pa'i sa non par bsam la de ltar ci nus su brtson par bya'o/ /thun mtshams rnams su maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod pa dang*/ thub bstod kyi rigs dang*/ snying rje pad dkar/ rgya cher rol pa/ skyes rabs sna tshogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sogs mdo gang 'dod ci ltar nus par bklag /dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bla med byang chub tu bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /spyir 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi skabs kun tu ston pa nyid ma brjed par dran pa dang*/ mtshan mo yang ston pa dngos su bzhugs pa'i sku yi 'od kyis phyogs thams cad nyin mo shin tu dwangs ba'i dus lta bur snang ba'i 'du shes kyi ngang gnyid log par bya/ dus rgyun du ston pa nyid kyis sngon ji ltar thugs bskyed pa'i tshul las brtsam ste/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rnam par thar pa la rjes su gzhol ba'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i dam bca' lhod med pa'i ngang nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyi dang khyad par zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor la ci nus su brtson pas dal 'byor thob pa don ldan du 'gyur te/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di nyid kyi mtshan thos pa tsam zhig gis rim gyis byang chub chen po'i lam las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba mdo du ma nas gsungs la/ gong du bstan pa'i gzungs 'di las sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung zhing*/ gzungs 'di rnyed pa'i mthus shākya'i rgyal po nyid sangs rgyas shing*/

spyan ras gzigs byang chub sems dpa'i mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ gzungs 'di thos pa tsam gyis bsod nams rgya chen po tshegs med par 'thob cing las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang ba dang*/ sngags bsgrub pa na bgegs ma mchis par grub par 'gyur ro zhes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge nyung du zhes pa de nyid las gsungs shing*/ bka' gzhan las kyang gzungs 'di lan gcig bzlas pas bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyad khri'i bar du byas pa'i sdig pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ba sogs phan yon tshad med pa dang ldan zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i snying po dam pa nyid du gsungs so/ /dad pa bskyed pa dang zhi lhag gi rnal 'byor la ji ltar brtson pa'i tshul zur du bshad par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni bslab gsum nor bu'i mdzod mnga' dpon o rgyan bstan 'dzin nor bu nas bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas te nan tan du bskul ba yid la 'jags pa'i steng du nye char yang dpon rin po che nyid nas sprul pa'i sku 'jigs med pad+ma bde chen la sbran te/ rin chen dang po sogs bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas kyi skyes dang bcas myur du grub par gyis zhes dam pa zung gi bkas bskul ba la brten nas/ ston pa mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob cing*/ dus mthar chos smra ba'i ming tsam 'dzin pa shākya'i rjes 'jug mi pham 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos/ rdza rdo rje 'phan phyug gi ri zhol phun tshogs nor bu'i gling du/ kun ldan lcags byi gsar tshes cho 'phrul chen po'i yar tshes brgyad la grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan 'gro la phan pa rmad du byung ba rgyun mi 'chad par byed pa dang*/ tshul 'di mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyud la ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i byin rlabs mtshungs pa med pa mngon du 'jug gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gnas brtan phyag mchod dang 'brel bar cho ga mdor bsdus bya tshul bzhugs so/

oṃ swa sti/ pan chen shākya shrīs mdzad par grags pa'i gnas brtan phyag mchod dang 'brel bar cho ga mdor bsdus tsam bya tshul gyi ngag 'don ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang?lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang? skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ /tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings dag stobs kyis/ /snod bcud bde chen zhing gi bkod pa'i dbus/ /yid 'phrog nor bu'i gzhal med khang chen por/ /rin chen seng khri pad zla'i gdan mchog dang*/ /dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang zhing spyod gyur cig /ces dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi sngags lan gsum rol mo bcas bya/ spos btul zhing gdangs dang bcas/ lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa bzhi'i dbus/ /rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du/ thugs rjes rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams/ /rnam grol lam la 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon/ thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*/ /shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skems shing*/ /rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bka' sdod pa/ /phyogs bcu'i nyan thos dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal/ /yon sbyong mchod pa'i gnas su spyan 'dren gyis/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seṅge yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag /gsung rang rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa'i/ /dgra bcom gnas brtan chen po bzhugs so 'tshal/ /dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod gyis gshegs su gsol/ /thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyan mtshan 'dzin/

/yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas/ /dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po dang*/ /gser be'u bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog /'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin/ /lam phran bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len/ /lam bstan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa/ /dgra bcom gnas brtan chen po 'di dag ni/ /bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren gshegs/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin cing*/ khyad par can gyi phrin las chos skyong ba'i/ /gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs/ /bde gshegs bka' lung gtsor mdzad bstan pa srung*/ /rang don dor nas 'khor ba'i nags tshal du/ /gzhan don lhur mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug po/ dam bcas thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs/ /dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshig nyan pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal/ /bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ rol mo bcas bcas spyan drangs/ ji snyed su dag sogs nas/ bdag gis bstod/ de nas/ ༈ mtshungs med blta bas mi ngoms pa/ /gser gyi mdog can mdzes pa'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs/ /sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*/ /bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /gangs ri chen po ti se na/ /'phags pa nas brtan yan lag 'byung*/ /dgra bcom stong dang sum brgyas bskor/ /spos phor rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal/ bla ma'i? bstan p drang srong ri yi shel nags la/ /'phags pa gnas brtan ma pham pa/ /dgra bcom brgya phrag gcig gis bskor/ phyag gny-is mnyam gzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal/ bla ma'i? bstan p lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug na/ /'phags pa gnas brtan nags na gnas/ /dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor/

/sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p dzam+bu gling gi zangs gling na/ /'phags pa gnas brtan dus ldan ni/ /dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor/ /gser gyi rna kor 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p siṅga la yi gling na ni/ /gnas brtan rdo rje mo yi bu/ dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor/ /sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p chu bo ya mu na'i gling ni/ 'phags pa gnas brtan bzang po ni/ /dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas skor/ /chos 'chad mnyam gzhag mdzad? bla ma'i? bstan p gnas mchog dam pa kha che na/ /'phags gnas brtan gser be'u/ dgra bcom chen po lnga brgyas bskor/ /rin chen zhags pa 'dzin? /nub kyi ba lang spyod na ni/ /bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog /dgra bcom chen po bdun brgyas bskor/ /phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad? bla ma'i? bstan p byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni/ /'phags pa gnas brtan ba ku la/ /dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyas bskor/ /phyag g.yon ne'u le 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p pri yang ku yi gling na ni/ /'phags pa gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin/ /dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor/ /rin chen prog zhu 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la/ /'phags pa gnas brtan lam phran brtan/ /dgra bcom stong dang drug brgyas bskor/ /phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad? bla ma'i? bstan p shar gyi lus 'phags gling na ni/ /bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len/ /dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor/ /glegs bam lhung bzed 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p lha gnas su cu rtsa gsum na/ /'phags pa gnas brtan lam bstan ni/ /dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyas bskor/ /glegs bam chos 'chad mdzad? bla ma'i? bstan p ri yi rgyal po ngos yangs la/ /'phags pa gnas brtan klu yi sde/ /dgra bcom stong dang nyis rgyas bskor/ /bum pa 'khar gsil 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p ri yi rgyal po bhi hu la/ /'phags pa gnas brtan sbed byed ni/

/dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor/ /phyag gnyis glegs bam 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p ri yi rgyal po gangs can la/ /'phags pa gnas brtan mi phyed pa/ /dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor/ /byang chub mchod rten 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p 'phags pa'idage bsnyen dharma tā/ /ral pa thod bcings glegs bam khur/ /snang ba mtha' yas mdun na bzhugs/ /rnga yab bum pa 'dzin? bla ma'i? bstan p brtson pas go bgos mthu stobs can/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa legs skyong ba'i/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes tshar gsum sogs ci nus/ me tog dam pa sogs nas/ sh+lau ka gsum/ mchod par bgyi/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha ne/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dz+wa badz+re/ ma hā bing+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ṭo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badz+re swā hā/ sngags dang rol mo bcas bya/ spro na maṇ+ḍal ci nus 'bul/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs/ phyir bsngo'o/ gzungs bzla bar spro na/ thub dbang 'khor bcas kyi mtshan nas bos te thugs dam bskul bar bsams la mos pa rtse gcig pas/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni shākya mu na ye swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzlas mthar/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos gnas brtan bcu drug gis/ /bstan pa yun ṛng gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid gnas brtan bcu drug gi /'khor tshogs srid mtsho las brgal nyon mongs med/ khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas par? sems can kun gyi bsod gyur dgra bcom pa/ /rig dang zhabs ldan skye dgu'i sbyin gnas che/

/'phags pa'i gang zag chen po tshogs rnams kyis/ /bstan pa yun ṛng gnas par? bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel 'gyur zhing*/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog /bsod nams rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par dag gyur te/ /smon lam rgya mtsho ma lus yongs rdzogs nas/ /'jig rten kun las khyad par 'phags par shog /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /phrin las bsgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med/ /bskal par mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje yis/ /nyan thos tshul bzung srid pa ji srid bar/ bstan pa skyong zhing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zab cing rgya che'i gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /rgyal chen bzhi yi bkra shis shog /phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig /ston pa 'jig rten khams su sogs bkra shis shog /ces sogs bkra shis ci rigs brjod mthar rol mo bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang mañju gho ṣas bris pa dge/ // ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'od dpag med kyi ye shes snying po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs ni: spros med lta bu bstan par bya: dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum dkon mchog rnam gsum rtsa ba gsum: gzhi lam 'bras bu ngo bo rang bzhin mchog: bde gsal mi rtog thugs la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ hūm̐: sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal kun grol zhing :

tshad med rnam bzhi'i byang chub lam 'byongs te: ma gyur 'gro ba smon lam dpal zhing rnams: kun kyang bla med 'bras bu thob par bgyi: gsum pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang rig ma bcos ngang nyid las: dran rig ye shes lha sku yis: gtad med shes pa'i ngo bo bzung : ma bcos snang stong 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: chos dbyings ka dag rang byung klong : ma bcos zang thal pho brang dbus: rang rig hrīḥlas 'od dpag med: a mi dhe wa sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gsal stong ngang : zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan mtshan dpes brgyan: thugs rje'i spyan gyis phyogs bcur gzigs: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag bde stong ngang : zhabs gnyis skyil krung lham me ba: 'khor 'das bral ba chos kyi sku: thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar: a mi dhe wa g.yas su 'khor: spro bsdu zang thal stong pa'i dbyings: ma 'gags thugs rjes 'gro kun skyob: snang ba stong gzugs sgyu ma'i ngang : sgra grags ngo bo brag cha'i dbyangs: 'gyu ba dran rig blo bral chos: phyi nang 'od dpung 'ja' lus bsgom: 'khor ba myang 'das 'gro drug tshogs: thog ma'i sangs rgyas don rtogs shog: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥ zhes sngags phreng 'dzin med stong pa'i rang mdangs las: grags stong dran stong zung 'jug ngang la bzla: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris: tshe gcig sangs rgyas bgrod pa'i lam: yang zab chos sku'i sgrub pa nyid: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing*/ chos gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: spyan ras gzigs kyi yi ge drug ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yi ge drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni:

'di nyid spros med lugs su 'dod: rnam snang ldan pa'i lus kyi ngang : rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: snang stong ma bcos 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: skad cig dran rdzogs chos dbyings pho brang dbus: rin chen sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan khri'i steng : rang rig hrīḥlas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar po zhi 'dzum shel gyi mdangs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi mtshan dpe gzi brjid 'bar: rin chen sna tshogs dbu rgyan cod pan 'phur: snyan cha mgul rgyan rin chen se mo do: g.yas g.yon dang po shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: nor bu phyag rgya thugs kar thal mo sbyar: lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs smad dkris mdzes: rdo rje skyil krung thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs: 'ja' lus 'od gsal snang stong lhang nge ba: phyi nang sgrib med zang thal ngang la bsgom: thugs kar hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: nyon mongs las sgrib bag chags kun dag nas: rang lus shel sgong dri med lta bur gyur: slar yang thugs nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: snang gzugs thams cad 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: sgra rnams thams cad grags stong yig drug dang : dran rig 'gyu ba thugs rje chen po'i klong : mtha' yas sems can 'gro kun rigs drug rnams: 'jig rten dbang phyug go 'phang thob gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra hūm̐: zhes thugs rje chen po bsgoms: gzugs sgra rig gsum ma bcos gnas lugs ngang la bzhag: sa ma ya: e maḥ myur zab spros med sgrub pa 'di: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas gnas nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sprul sku pad 'byung gi sgrub thabs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sprul sku rig 'dzin sgrub thabs ni: 'di nyid spros med lugs su 'dod: ma bcos snang stong 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: skad cig dran rdzogs ma bcos lhun grub zhing : ye shes sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i pho brang dbus: pad+ma nyi zla seng khri'i gdan steng du: rang rig hūm̐ las pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'od stong 'bar: khro 'dzum spyan gyi thugs rjes dbyings su gzigs: pad zhwa sgro dar rin chen rgyan gyis spras: phod kha chos gos za 'og ber chen gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas ka pā la: tshe bum dang bcas gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ brten: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rgyal po rol stabs kyis: mu stegs bdud dang dam sri zil gnon tshul: mtshan dpes rab rgyan bde chen gzi 'bar bsgom: thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar badz+ra gu ru 'khor: phyi nang bar chad rkyen ngan dbyings su sgrol: spro bsdu sngags phreng 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: drag po'i mthu stobs 'gro ba'i bsod nams kun: 'ub kyis bsdus nas rnal 'byor bdag la thim: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'ja' lus srog bsgrubs nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes sngags phreng spro bsdu zung 'jug ye shes lnga'i rnal 'byor du bzla'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris: byin rlabs bla med gsang ba nyid: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ༈ tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs so/ āḥ rang lus tha mal gnas pa'i mdun mkha' ru/ /o rgyan dri med dha na ko sha'i mtsho/

/gting zab yan lag brgyad ldan chus gang ba'i/ /dbus su rin chen pad sdong 'dab rgyas steng*/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*/ /mtshan dpe dpal 'bar mtsho rgyal yum dang 'khril/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas thod bum bsnams/ /dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /'od lnga'i klong nas bde chen gzi byin 'bar/ /'khor du rtsa gsum rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs/ /byin rlabs thugs rjes char 'bebs bdag la gzigs/ /rgyal kun ngo bo 'chi med ye shes skur/ /gdung shugs drag pos dad phyag rtag tu 'tshal/ /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du dmigs nas 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung ma lus bshags/ /sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan gyi/ /khyab bdag gcig pu mgon po'i rnam thar la/ /snying nas yi rang dad pas gsol 'debs shing*/ /zab rgyas chos kyi char chen 'bebs par bskul/ /rang gzhan dge ba'i dngos po kun bsdoms nas/ /'gro khams rgya mtsho ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /mgon po khyed kyi rnam thar rjes bsnyegs te/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren pa'i don du bsngo/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus mkhyen brtse'i gter chen po/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon rin po che/ /lnga bdo'i rgud pas mnar bzhin gdung shugs kyis/ /gsol 'debs bu la brtse bas thugs rjes dgongs/ /dgongs pa'i klong nas thugs rjes rtsal phyungs la/ /mos ldan bdag gi snying la byin gyis rlobs/ /rtag dang mtshan ma myur du bstan pa dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ces tshig bdun gsol 'debs ci nus 'don/ mos gus kyis gsol ba btab pas bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams dang thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer sna lnga ba thag ltar brkyangs pa rang gi snying khar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par bsam la/ skabs su badz+ra gu ru ci rigs bzlas thun mthar/

bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum las/ /'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung nas su/ /rang gi gnas gsum thim pas sgo gsum gyi/ /sgrib sbyangs sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer gyur/ ༈ /mthar ni bla ma 'khor bcas 'od du zhu/ /dkar dmar thig le hūm̐ gis mtshan pa ru/ rang gi snying gar thim pas bla ma'i thugs/ /rang sems dbyer med lhan skyes chos skur gnas/ a āḥ zhes brjod la ye nas bcos bsgyur spang blang las 'das pa/ rang gi sems nyid chos sku chen po'i rang zhal blta/ slar sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba thams cad bla ma'i rang bzhin du bltas la dge ba bsngo zhing shis pa brjod la dge legs su bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes brgyad la tshe rabs thams cad du gu ru pad+ma'i bran du smon lam 'debs pa mi pham rnam rgyal pa'i yid kyi mtsho las byung ba dge legs su gyur cig/ // rdo rje tshig bdun dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod dpal gyi bum bzang bzhugs so/ āḥlas chos dbyings dang mnyam ka pā lar/ /om̐ las snang srid 'dod yon tshogs su bshams/ /hūm̐ gis bde chen ye shes rol par bsgyur/ /hrīḥyis rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes par bskang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥs byin gyis brlabs/ /tshogs zhing spyan 'dren mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren na: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: tshogs mchod ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bla ma rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa yi:

rtsa gsum kun 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs: bdag gzhan sgo gsum dge tshogs longs spyod bcas: snang srid 'dod yon dgyes dgu ma tshang med: kun bzang bde chen tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'bul: thugs brtses dgyes bzhes thugs dam skong gyur cig: gsol ba 'debs so gu ru rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: mos ldan bu la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: /dam tshig nyams chag thams cad sbyang du gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sgrol/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing*/ /tshe bsod nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa'ang gser 'phyang gi lor dbo zla'i tshes bcu la 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i yid kyi mtsho las byung ba'o// // ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub gsol 'debs dngos grub snying po bzhugs so/ / e ma ho/ gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku 'od ma'i 'gyur/ /longs spyod yongs rdzogs rgyal sras snying rje'i gter/ /gang 'dul der ston sprul sku pad+ma 'byung*/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa bar bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'byung lnga rnam dag o rgyan bde chen rgyal/ /'khrul snang rang grol o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen/ /'byung ba'i 'jigs skyob o rgyan dpa' bo gyad/ /dbyings rig mnyam sbyor rdo rje rnal 'byor lha/ /dug lnga rang grol lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbul phongs gdung sel o rgyan nor gyi lha/ /dug lnga'i nad 'joms o rgyan sman lha dang*/ /pha rol bdud rgol 'joms mdzad rdo rje'i gur/ /bdud bzhi mthar byed o rgyan phyag rgya gyad/

/phrin las thogs med lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /hor sog g.yul bzlog dregs pa zil gnon rtsal/ /lam 'phrang 'jigs skyob gu ru nyi ma 'od/ /zab gter sgo 'byed o rgyan yi dam lha/ /bar chad sgrol mdzad dpa' bo ging la sogs/ /gang 'dul der ston lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku lnga mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul bcu gsum sogs/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor zhi dang khro bo'i sprin/ /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid can/ /gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar chad dbyings su zhi/ /don gnyis 'bad med bsam don chos bzhin grub/ /mthar thug rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams su/ /rang rig pad 'byung dbyer med sangs rgyas shog /ces pa'ang nyer mkho'i ched du rang slob au ḍī'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor gnam lcags bstan 'dzin pas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub snying po'i bcud bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dhe ba ḍāk+ki nī ye/ gu ru'i thugs sgrub rgya mtsho'i bcud phul rmad/ /bde gshegs gcig la dkyil 'khor kun 'dus pa/ /rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos sde bsam lhun ma'i/ /dkyil 'khor dril sgrub snying bsdus 'dir gsal bya/ de'ang thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi man ngag sgrub thabs bcu gsum dang bcas phyogs bsdus/ spyi dril gsol 'debs ye shes sprin phung bsnyen sgrub dang sgrub chen sogs nyams len la 'jug pa'i skabs rgyas par mi lcogs na/ thun bzhi dang spros med kyi skabs don bsdus nas nyams su lain par 'dod pa la/ thog mar sbyor ba'i chos spyi mthun ltar byas la/ dang po sngon 'gro la skyabs sems ni/ skyabs yul gsal gdab la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur/

na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ dkar gtor spyi mthun/ gsum pa bgegs gtor ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bhū ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs bkug /sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛh+na daṃ ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa'i bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad gu gul bdug rol mo 'tsham rngam bya'o/ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku las sprul pa'i khro bos nam mkha' gang : gsung las sprul pa'i khro mos sa gzhi gang : thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog bar snang gang : gnyis med sprul pas 'khor yug khyon kun khengs: phyi nang bar med ye shes me dpung 'khrigs: glags lta'i bdud bgegs dam sri tshar chod cig: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: lnga pa byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub zhing :

lnga ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i pho brang nas: rigs 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i shugs mtshon nas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med lhug par deng stsol shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ mthar me tog bkram brdung dang bcas byin chen dbab/ drug pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen po'i dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ sngon 'gro spyi'-i rim pa'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid du: brtse ba'i snying rje chen por shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐: gnyis pa gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'og min lhun grub rin chen gzhal med khang*/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang rgyan kun rdzogs/ /dur khrod rdo rwa me ri srung gur brjid/ /pho brang lte bar rin chen zur brgyad dang*/ /rigs lnga'i khri 'phangs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : dbus su hūm̐ las ma hā gu ru rje: snang srid zil gnon dmar smug khro 'dzum sgeg: 'dab ldan dar gyi snyan zhu gsang gos dkar: dar dmar chos gos mthing nag phod chen gsol: smug nag ber phyam snyan rgyan mgul rgyan mdzes: rdo rje bhan+dha tshe bum kha ṭ+wāṃ brten:

zhabs gnyis swag lham rgyal po rol pa'i stabs: 'gying bag brjid ldan gzi 'od phyogs bcur khyab: dbu gtsug kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab sogs/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma rnams/ /snang stong sku yi phyag rgya 'od stong 'bar/ /o rgyan snang mtha' bde gshegs rigs lnga sogs/ /dbus phyogs chos sku'i tshom bu 'ja' tshon bkra/ /de yi phyi rim phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhir/ /gnas pa'i pad+ma nyi zla'i lte ba ru/ /'byung lnga dag pa o rgyan bde chen rgyal/ /tshogs drug lhug bzhag o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen/ /'chi 'pho 'jigs skrag rang grol dpa' bo gyad/ /mkha' spyod zab lam ston mdzad rnal 'byor ma/ /rang rang cha lugs rigs kyi tshom bu rdzogs/ /de yi phyi rim 'ja' zer mu khyud kyis/ /gtams pa'i 'dab brgyad 'od lnga'i drwa ba mdzes/ /phyogs bzhir dug lnga'i nad sel sman gyi lha/ /dbul phongs gdung sel o rgyan nor lha dang*/ /pha rol rgol 'joms gtum chen rdo rje'i gur/ /hor sog dmag bzlog phung byed bdud dgra gzhaum/ /shar lhor dregs pa zil gnon thod phreng rtsal/ /lho nub zab gter sgo 'byed yi dam lha/ /nub byang sbas gnas sgo 'byed nyi ma 'od/ /byang shar dregs pa zil gnon he ru kaḥ /rang rang phyag mtshan rigs kyi tshom bu bcas/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs mkha' la 'ja' ltar gsal/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkhar sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha: dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs tshom bur 'khrigs: rin chen zur brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad las bzhi'i gar: /mtshams brgyad ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sogs/ /rigs kyi ḍāk+ki 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas: gru chad bar khyams khor yug gnas yul gyi: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki ging chen sgo skyong sde: bar snang lha klu gnod sbyin mi'i rig 'dzin: rgya bod mkhas grub bka' brgyud bla ma rnams: thugs rje'i sprin gtibs byin rlabs char rgyun 'bebs:

'dod snam mchod sprin lha mos gar stabs bsgyur: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba yi: /phyi 'khor dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' dang bstan skyong sogs/ /'khor 'das dbyer med dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang*/ /nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du/ /snang la rang bzhin ma grub gsal bar bsgom/ /de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: 'og min zhing dang rnga yab dpal ri nas: pad 'byung rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: gsang ba'i pho brang gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa spyan drangs shing byin dbab pa ni/ dri bzang gi spos gtong zhing rol mo gling bu'i dbyangs snyan dang bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: bzhi pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng : gu ru bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams: 'gro ba'i don la dgongs te bzhugs: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas sogs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul:

nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog sogs: sbyor sgrol gsang ba kho na nyid: tshogs mchod dza gad chang la sogs: gzhan yang spyan gzigs du mar bcas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza hoḥ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta gu h+ya sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na king ni ri ti bha ling+ta pū dza hoḥ.āḥ drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chu bo bzhi rdzogs bde chen 'dus pa'i sku: sku gcig sku lnga mtshan brgyad bye ba brgyad: rnam 'phrul bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i sprin bkod cing*/ /rlabs chen gdul bya skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: theg pa 'dzin 'chang rig 'dzin bla ma dang : sgrub pa bka' brgyad zhi khro yi dam lha: gnas yul zhing skyong dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: chos dbyings ye shes rol pa chen po'i lha: shes rab dbyings las thugs rje thabs kyi skur: rtsol med rang shar phyogs bcu'i zhing kun gyi: rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor ma lus rdzogs: gnyis med rang snang gsal stong ye shes lha: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgu pa dzapa ྄la dang po gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub tshar gcig dang*/ dzapa ྄bskul ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: ye shes dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul la: 'gro ba'i don phyir phrin las gter chen gyi: dgongs pa klong yangs byin rlabs shugs 'byung bas: sgrub la smin grol gdams pa zab mo mchog: 'bad med myur ba nyid la stsal du gsol:

bsnyen dmigs gsal gdab pa ni/ thugs kar don gyi ye shes sems/ /rig stong rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang*/ kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /mi shigs thig ler hūm̐ gi mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /rig stong ka dag ngang du blta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ las sbyor ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum bzla zhing stong tshig phul/ ༈ de nas tshogs 'bul bar spro na/ rang lugs gsol ka rnams grub nas/ na raka bshags pa'am bsdu na brjod med don bshags la sman raka gtor ma'i skong bsdus tsam sbyar ba dang*/ rang lugs rig 'dzin srog sgrub gtor bsngo'i byin rlabs nas spyan 'dren bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ dang po tshogs sbyang spel ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? lan gsum gyis spel/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ lhun grub rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho nas/ /bla ma bder 'dus sku gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul bcu gsum 'khor tshogs bcas/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /sna tshogs gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas/ /o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong nor gyi bdag: gter bdag gnyan po skyong la sogs: rig 'dzin bder 'dus dkyil 'khor la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: phyi snod srid gsum yangs pa sogs 'phro skyong zhing*/ bzhi pa skong ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod mdzes pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: gsang mchod bde stong chags med ye shes rdzas: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: spyan gzigs dkor cha yid 'ong mnyes pa'i rten: rol mo sgra snyan gdangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i glu: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing bar chad sel gyur nas: mchog thun 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yig brgya bzla/ drug pa bsgral bstab ni/ dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha truṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐: shes bya lta ba gyad kyi phur pa yis: nga bdag srid pa'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: sha khrag klad rus phung por spungs pa 'di: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā raṃ khā hi: zhes bsgral zhing bstab bo/ tshogs la rol/ bdun pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mi g.yel zhing : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi/ brgyad pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig rgyal ba thugs dam can: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha tshogs mthu ma chung : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: mthu chen khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: bar chod rtsom pa'i log 'dren rdul du rlog: oṃ gu ru dhai wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dgu pa tha tshig bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la: bka' 'dus snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i spyan snga ru: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bstan srung phrin las bsgrub pa khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub mchog stsol bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan pa: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: so so'i bran g.yog yang g.yog 'khor bcas kyis: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mdzod: oṃ ma ma hring hring bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gcig rta bro ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum 'dus pas bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyun lam chod: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyi: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gnyis pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs ngo bo lhun grub ka dag la: bder 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang snyan grags stobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus rnams: skad cig nyid la deng 'dir thob gyur cig:

oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs/ gsum pa rjes chog la drug /dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ gu ru dā+e wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i rang bzhin mtha' bral ye shes klong : longs sku'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dzin bral la: sprul sku ji snyed 'gro ba'i mgon mchog che: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha la bstod par bgyi: gnyis pa nongs bshags ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying brtan bzhugs bya/ gsum pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa haṃ/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas lhun grub chos dbyings ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs khyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhan pa'i 'gog lam bsal bya'i phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bla med bder 'dus rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing : pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra zhes: bde chen yum mchog man+da ra: pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis dang bsngo smon rgyas bsdus ci rigs brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus man ngag sgrub thabs bcu gsum dang bcas phyogs bsdus/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes phyogs bsgrigs spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam lhun ma rgyas pa sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral bar bzhugs kyang*/ 'di nyid rgyas drag pas spros med bsnyen sgrub thun bzhi sogs la sbyar ba'i skabs su mi bde zhing*/ rtsa ba gcig dril ni cung bsdus che bas bsam lhun dkyil 'khor bcu gsum chig dril nyams len la sbyar dka' bar ma zad/

skabs 'gar dus mchod dang rgyun bkol ngag 'don tshogs 'bum bsags pa bcas rang gzhan dgos mkhor gal che bar sems te/ gter gzhung dgongs pa gzhir bzhag cing kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams kyang rang gzhung las blangs te/ 'phri snon cung zad bcas bal yul yang le shod gnam lcags sgom sder/ rab byung 17pa'i me khyi'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 15nyin gnam lcags pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis/ 'phral mar bris pas nor ba mchis na rtsa gsum lhar 'chags shing dge bas rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa las: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril bzhugs so: pad+ma he ru ka la 'dud: pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa yi: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril ba: spros med don gyi rnal 'byor che: gu ru'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod skyabs sems dang : tshogs bsags mchod pa byin brlab sogs: ji ltar rigs pa sngon song nas: zhes pas/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ gsum pa mchod pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ

om̐ sarba a haṃ dz+nyā na a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lnga'am bdun gyis brlabs: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim ni/ ma bcos lhun grub ngang nyid du: rang byung dran rdzogs 'di ltar bsgom: om̐ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gdod ma'i stong nyid ngang las snying rje'i rtsal: hūm̐ dmar 'od kyis 'phro 'dus snod bcud sbyangs: stong gsal ngang las rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang : dur khrod rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas dbus: pad nyi dregs pa rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i steng : sa bon khra thabs tshul du babs pa las: che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po rtsal: dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar khro zhing gtum: spyan gsum sdang mig sma ra smin ma gzengs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra sgrogs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes snang srid zil gyis gnon: g.yon pas phur pa ma rungs snying la gzir: lcags sdig tshwa tshwas dam 'gong hub hub za: dbu gtsug rta mgo rdo rje dbyings su 'tsher: 'jigs pa'i gad mos stong gsum 'gul zhing 'khyom: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du rngam: gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: drag me dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong na rol: spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med pas mtshan: sku la zhi khro rab 'byams sprin phung 'phro: gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge gsal zhing 'bar: thugs ka'i 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ rak+sha srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas: stong gsum dregs pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po'i skur bzhengs nas: ma rungs log 'dren 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hrīḥ pad+ma kro dha he ru ka e h+ya hi hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: bskyed pa'i dam tshig rten la gnyis med bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas brda yi dad phyag 'tshal: drag po'i nyer spyod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs phyag rgya'i gar gyis mchod:

shrī he ru ka badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs?pañca a mṛ ta ta na ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bzlas pa sngags kyi 'phro 'du ni: thugs kar pha lam rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: sngags phreng dus mtha'i me lce 'bar ba yis: dregs pa tshar bcad rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs nus stobs bdag thim gnyis med gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ pad+ma he ru ka artsig nirtsig sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ sgra dag ting 'dzin gsal bar 'bum phrag bzhi: bzlas pas khrag 'thung chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs: thun mthar mchod cing bstod la bzod par gsol: lha dang rang sems dbyer med 'od gsal ngang : bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas gdab bo: zhes pas/ shrī he ru ka badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs? pañca a mṛ ta ta na ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang : ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya bzla'o: mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs bya la: bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung ye shes dkyil 'khor lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu gtso la bsdu: gtso nyid hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang dmigs med klong : ka dag rang byung shar grol klong du hoḥ a āḥ bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo:

kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral: gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rdzogs rim thugs ka'i hūm̐ dmar kho na la: rlung yig rig pa dril la mdung tshugs gtad: 'das pa 'gags shing ma 'ongs ma skyes pa'i: da lta'i shes pa rig stong lam du khyer: bdud dang dam sri rgyal 'gong la sogs pa: thams cad sems kyis snang ba kho na te: sems la ngo bo ngos bzung mtshan ma med: stong gsal don gyi pad+ma khrag 'thung che: gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang rig 'di ka rang : 'khor 'das gnyis med chen por la bzla'o: de ltar goms 'dres brtan pa thob pa na: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos kun zil gyis gnon: rdo rje he ru ka dpal mngon sum 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma khrag 'thung gi: smin grol spros med don gyi gdams zab 'di: ma 'ongs don phyir rin chen gter du sbas: las 'phro can gyi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter gyi snying po'o// // ༈ rdor sems 'khor 'das rang grol gyi rgyun khyer snying po dril ba bzhugs/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchi/ /zung 'jug bde chen mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /oṃ/ kun bzang rgyal ba ye sangs rgyas/ āḥ'agag med longs sku rang rtsal rdzogs/ hūm̐/ sgyu ma'i zung 'jug gsal snang las/ /rang snang sprul pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ /phyi dang nang med zang thal klong*/ /'ja' 'od ye shes lnga ldan gtibs/ /de dbus rin chen khri 'phang du/ /pad nyi zla ba'i lte bar hūm̐/ /gnas 'gyur rdo rje pad+mar gyur/ /de nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su/ /rang nyid longs sku rdo rje sems/

/dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan 'bar/ /phyag gnyis snang stong rdor dril brten/ /dbyings phyug sngon mo gri thod 'khril/ /phyed skyil bde stong ting 'dzin ngang*/ /rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rigs bdag mthing*/ /gnas lngar dam pa rigs brgya rdzogs/ /sku lus 'ja' zer 'od phung gi /spyan stong dbus su yum chen stong*/ /zung 'jug gzi brjid cher rgyas bsgom/ /thugs dbus pad zlar rdo rje yi/ /lte bar hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od zer spro bsdu don gnyis byas/ /snod bcud rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /lha sngags ye shes rol par blta/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: yig brgya'ang ci nus bzla/ dmigs pa gsal gdab bzlas par 'bungs/ /skyo tshe 'byin 'jug rlung gis bzla/ /mthar ni ka dag ngang du bzhag /rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes ni/ /gnyug ma don gyi rdo rje sems/ /'dzin med lta ba'i rang zhal blta/ a āḥ sgyu ma'i rtog tshogs lha ru ldang*/ /dus gsum dge tshogs 'gro la bsngo/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas sa thob nas/ /don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis shog /ces rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la nye bar mkho phyir gter gzhung gi bcud bsdus te rgyal ba'i sprul ming pas sbyar ba'o/ /bkris// // ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po rab gsal bzhugs so/ pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ na mo/ bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor/ /gus pas skyabs mchis bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub myur du 'thob bya'i phyir/ /'dod 'byung dbang gi rgyal po myur bsgrub bgyi/ dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad gcig gis/ /snang srid bde chen pad+ma 'od/ /rang byung sprul pa'i pho brang dbus/ /nor bu'i khri 'phang pad nyi'i gdan/

/rang rig hrīḥdamar yongs gyur pa'i/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang sdud dmar: zhal gsum phyag drug sgeg cing sbom: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil: dbu skra rin chen rgyan ldan brjid: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le mdzes: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu pad+mas sdud: rin chen rgyan ldan dpa' zhing brjid: brkyang bskum rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: g.yas su lha lcam sgeg mo dmar: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ma: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par bsgom: gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng*/ /dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon tshul/ /thugs kar rdo rje hrī mthar sngags/ /bde chen rang bzhin zhing kun khyab/ /rgyal ba mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ /'bar ba gsum gyis bdag nus bskyed/ khams gsum brtan g.yo snang grags sems/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa las/ /'du ba gsum gyi phrin las sgo/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mos/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ci nus bzlas la mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bsdu la rjes shes pad+ma rgyal po'i nga rgyal ngang bsngo smon sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang lha 'di nyid la mi 'phrog pa'i yid ches nges shes rnyed pa'i pad+ma'i rig sngags 'dzin pa pad+ma myu gu klu'i ming nas/ gter gzhung nas btus la zur rgyan phran bu bcas/ rab byung 17 me sprel lo zla ba 8 tshes la the pe e waṃ du bris pa'o// // ༈ bka' brgyad rgyun khyer ni/ rang nyid ting 'dzin rnam gsum dran rdzogs su: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas lte ba'i dbus: byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing zhabs brgyad 'gying : dbyings phyug yum 'khyud gri gug thod khrag 'dzin:

gzi brjid gar dgu ldan pa gtso bo'i gnas: lnga dang yan lag bzhi ru rim pa bzhin: gshin rje rta mgrin yang dag ma mo phur: drag po 'jig rten dmod pa bya rog gdong : rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud gtso 'khor dur khrod chas: rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon 'khor bcas gsal: me dpung klong bzhugs dpal rngam brjid par gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig bdag la bstim: gnas dang phyag bgyis mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling+ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dgu ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod cing bsnyen sgrub bya/ de tsam spros pa 'di ltar ro: 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya: hūm̐: dran rdzogs wal gyis che mchog yab yum gnas: dpal chen gtso brgyad yum sbyor gar dgu ldan: phyag mtshan sa bon la sogs ma 'dres gsal: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags phreng sham bur khā hi tsam sbyar kyang chog /med kyang mi dgos/ spros pa de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐ mūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti aṣ+ṭa baṃ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ spros pa de tsam mi lcogs na hūm̐ mūṃ: kro ta kro ti wa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐: rang la tshang : rgyud las kyang : skye med rdo rje ngo bo nyid: rdo rje hūm̐ ste hūm̐ sgra can: rdo rje rnon po ral gri can:

rdo rje sku ste rang byung ba: rdo rje snying po skye med klong : ngo bo hūm̐ dang rdo rje'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar: hūm̐ tsam mi lcogs na: rgyud las: e ma sprul pa'i 'khor rnams nyon: dang po rang byung chen po'i dbus: ma 'gags stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid: bsdu bya snang ba'i yul las 'das: gnyis med ngo bo de kho na: zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o: ྀatsha: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas pad+ma sbas tshal rong nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las: bsrung bzlog rgyun khyer ngag 'don bzhugs so: mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i rgyun khyer ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: 'khor ba dong sprugs sems bskyed do: snang srid ye stong rdzogs pa che: de'i ngang chos 'byung gzhal yas khang : me rlung thog ser 'khrugs pa'i dbus: pad nyi bam steng rang gi sems: skad cig dran rdzogs mkha' 'gro ma: mthing nag seṅge'i gdong pa can: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad: ljags brkyangs g.yu ral nam mkhar gzengs: skam rlon thod pa'i dbus rgyan dang : do shal dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang bsnams: gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bcug: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs 'gying : thugs ka'i bh+yo mthar sngags g.yon 'khor: de 'og me rlung thog mtshon 'khrugs: phyi nang ban bon byad ma yis: sngags zor rbod gtong ngan pa kun: bsad bcad brlag gtor phyir bzlogs nas: tshur 'dus mtshon cha sna tshogs gyur: me dpung 'bar bas bskor bar gyur: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ hūm̐ badz+ra tu ra na ma swā hā: e sa bh+yo zlog: e ka ya ma du tri rbad: ces bskyed rim gsal ba'i ngang nas ci nus bzlas: thun mthar mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma hūm̐ du gyur nas nam mkhar thim:

snang srid brda mtshon gsal stong zung 'jug ngang la bzhag: de ni rgyun khyer bsrung bzlog go: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so/ ༈ 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi bsnyen sgrub sogs nyer mkho'i phrin las snying po gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so: dpag yas mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang ches dbar bas/ /log rtog smag rum mthar mdzad khro bo'i dbang*/ /'jigs byed dug ri'i lha la nyer btud nas/ /phrin las snying po gsal byed 'di na spro/ de yang bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi tshe/ dang po ni las can dag thun drug gam/ thun bzhi nges par rang lugs pa rnams/ gzhung gi phrin las thun thams cad la bgyis na/ bsnyen grangs gnod phyir mi lcogs shing*/ de la thor thun snga thun la gter gzhung ltar dang*/ de phyin gyi thun lhag ma rnams 'di ltar 'jug pa bde phyir spros pa ste/ brgyud 'debs spyi ltar bya sngon 'gro skyabs sems ni: na moḥ 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: kun 'dus khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gus pas skyabs mchis 'jam dpal mchog 'grub shog: gtor mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dug lnga rgyu can las byung ba'i/ sku dang ye shes mchod sprin rgya mtsho ni/ phyi nang dpag med khengs pa'i bdud rtsi mchog: sku mchog bdud rtsi gnyis bsdus thabs shes 'bar: zung 'jug gnyis med dgyes pa chen por bskyed: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum: lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i zhing rdul 'byung lnga'i khams: ye nas e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ri rab steng : rdo rje rgya gram gzhal yas lte bar hūm̐: yongs gyur 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri nag:

dbu dgu so bzhi'i phyag la sku smad dbal: rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo zhal gsum sbyor: bde chen bskul ba'i mkha' nas sras bzhi 'gyed: sgo skyong las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum: ma 'dres gtso 'khor dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas lnga'i sa bon gyis: 'og min zhing dang lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas: rang rang pho brang klong nas spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs bdag 'jam dpal gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs rab 'jigs dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri gshegs? sras mchog rigs bzhi? sgo skyong yang 'khor gshegs? oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol phyag mchod ni: hūm̐: las gshin dug ri khro bo'i tshogs: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs: rab gus dwang bas phyag bgyid do: phyi mchod lha mo gar sgyur 'bul: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta 'bul: spyan gzigs bkram pa sna tshogs 'bul/ bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: oṃ puṣ+pe sogs? rū pa sogs? oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥ skye med ngang las ma g.yos rigs kyi bdag: longs sku tshe yi mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod: stobs ldan dbyings phyug khro tshul dpa' stobs can/ mu stegs 'joms mdzad 'jam dpal nag por bstod: gtum drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: srog la rngam byed 'chi bdag gshin rje ni: phas rgol kun gyi gshed ma lho phyogs bdag: 'jigs byed kun gyi sde dpon khro bo rgyal: stobs ldan dug ri yab yum sku la bstod: shar lho nub byang gshin rje'i dur khrod nas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rol pa'i gar: rigs bzhi yum sbyor ma sring dbang du sdud: sras mchog rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

gzhan yang 'jig rten gshin rje'i bka' sdod pa: pho nya las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum/ rlung ltar 'tshub cing dgra yul phye mar brlag /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus la bdag bstod do: 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs: deng 'dir thugs dam gnyan po'i rgyud bskul nas: rig 'dzin sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bstan la sdang ba'i log 'dren rtsad nas chod: thugs dam dus la ma 'da' sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bzlas pa la 'jug khar rang nyid gtso bo sku mdog zhal phyag la sogs pa'i rnam pa gsal ba dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal shugs drag po rgyun ci ring du bsgoms nas de la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo rnams kyi thugs kar thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor gyi lte bar yab rnams hūm̐ mthing khog par ya dmar nag gis mtshan pa dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar bh+yo dmar nag /rigs bdag gi thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar ser dbang rtags 'jam dpal nag po'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga sgo ma bzhi yi thugs kar dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes pa rnams rang mdog gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i mtha' skor du rang rang gi srog sngags rnams rang mdog la gting mdangs dmar gyi ngad kyi tsha zer 'khyugs pa g.yas bskor du rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar srid gsum 'gul ldeg chem chem du g.yo zhing 'khor bas/ thugs dam rgyud bskul thugs srog gi 'od kyis sngags phreng rnams gsal ba'i stobs shugs bskyed/ sngags phreng rnams kyi 'od sgras thugs srog nus stobs rgyas/ zung 'jug gi 'od dang sgras nyi zla g.yo zhing tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i klong las drag sngags me dpung mtshon cha thog rgod tshwa tshwa drag tu 'khor zhing*/ mched pas srid pa gsum gyi bdud rigs log para'adren pa thams cad bsad gtub thal bar brlag cing de dag gi stobs rtsal nus pa rang la thim pas gzi brjid ches cher rgyas par bsam/

yang skabs su thugs srog sngags phreng 'od kyis rtsa khams bskul bas sku'i dpa' stobs cher g.yos pa'i shugs kyi phyi dbyings 'byung ba'i khams rnams g.yo zhing 'khrugs pas/ log 'dren byad ma rnams 'byung ba rang gshed du gyur nas rang byung gi mtshon chas gtub cing gtor te las byed kyi pho nyas hub der lhag med du zos nas/ lhag mar 'dzin pa'i snang ba yang las rlung gis spur/ ngar 'dzin gyi rtog pa phra rags ye shes 'bar ba'i dbus su bsregs/ tshe srog dwangs ma bkrag mdangs 'od lnga'i thig ler g.yo ba rnams rigs bdag gi 'od zer gyis 'ub 'ub bsdus te/ bum pa'i bcud 'khyil zhing rgyas te lud pa rnams tshangs bug nas dbu mar brgyud de/ rtsa chen rtsa phran sogs rtsa gnas thams cad mchi med bdud rtsi bcud kyis gtams pas gzi brjid rngam pa'i stobs shugs ches char 'bar zhing*/ khyad par du yang bsgrub bya dang srid gsum khams na gnas pa'i byang chub sgrub pa sogs/ rnam dkar gyi mos 'dun phra rags dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'byung khams stobs su smin te tshe bsod dpal 'byor nus stobs dkar po dge ba'i rten 'brel thams cad 'phel ba'i shugs dang*/ spobs pa'i stobs rgyas te snang stong khro rgyal gyi sku yi rnam rol gtso 'khor tha mi dad pa yom yom shig shig 'khrug 'khrug pa bro 'dus yi rnam par gsal ba dang*/ yang skabs su dkyil 'khor lha yi 'khor lo rnam par mched de/ chos dbyings kyi khyon gang bar phyam brdal/ slar rim par tshur 'dus thugs srog yungs 'bru tsam la shes pa gtad pa sogs/ ting 'dzin 'phro 'du'i rtsal sbyangs shing*/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka a kro ti ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas pa'i skyon drug spangs te gcig dril mos 'dun rtse gcig tu bsnyen pa dang*/

las rlung gi rdor bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas kyi skyo sangs dang*/ nyams kyi rtsal 'don phyir rngam dbyangs kyi bzlas pa sogs sgrub pa'i nyams dang sbyar te/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi srog thob nges su bsnyen cing bsgrub par bya/ gzhung las bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bshad pa yang las rung tsam du dgongs pa las/ gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum gyi blo bsnyen tshad yang*/ gzhung tshig kho nar bcad dus su 'dod pa la ni ma lags so/ de ltar lus snang stong lha sku/ ngag grags stong gsung sgra/ yid bde stong zung 'jug khyab brdal chen por dbang 'byor ba rnams gang 'dul der ston gyi ting 'dzin 'bum phrag cig car du 'gyed pa la 'di ltar spros che ru mi mtshar yang*/ dang po las can blo rmongs rnams zab lam du 'jug bde phyir/ 'jam dpal ye shes rol pa'i mdzod chen las/ cung zad phyung ba ste rang bzos sgro btags ni ma lags so/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod bshags gsol ni/ a li sku yi bskyed rim dang ka li gsung gi bzlas brjod/ yig brgya thugs kyi ting 'dzin zab mo'i klong du ma gyur bas nyams chag bshags shing*/ rten 'brel snying po'i sgo gsum ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas shing brtan par mos la/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya sbrel ba dang*/ rten 'brel snying po rnams gsum gsum bzla'o/ oṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañca rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ āḥ 'khor 'das snang grags rdo rje gsum gyi dbyings/ sku gsum ngang rdzogs 'od gsal thig le gcig /ma skyes ma 'gags dran shes so ma'i ngang*/ mtha' yas 'gro rnams rtag tu la gnas shog /ces nyer bsdu dang bsngo ba bya ste thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug

/bsnyen rtags rdzogs nas bskang brgya dang*/ me mchod ci nus su 'bad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dmigs gsal pa'i lam 'dir gcig dril rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du brtson pa la las bzhi lhun grub gcig chog yid bzhin nor bu'i ting 'dzin chos zab pa dang yon bdag sogs thag ring bsgrub bya gal chen la/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa'i dmigs phran sogs zhib cha mtha' dag rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhal lung las longs shig /de ltar 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi/ phrin las zin bris snying po gsal byed ces bya ba dang*/ 'jam dpal ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du rnam par rol pa'i lta sgom gyi drod dang khungs ldan gyi man ngag zung 'brel du bkod pa 'di yang 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i gsang mdzod du mngon par phyug pa/ me nyag sgom chen pad+ma rgya mtsho dang tshe rabs du mar mngon spyod dmod pa'i phrin las kyi bka' bab yongs su grub pa sngags 'chang kun dga' blo gros zung gis nan chen gyis bkas bskul ngor ma ldog par/ phyogs med spyod pa'i dā ri dra skyid grong smyon pas khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gshin rje rol pa'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyun khyer ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed sku: mthing nag rab 'khros za byed ma he'i zhal: phyag gnyis dpa' ba'i mtshon cha gri thod 'dzin: gtum rngam mi bzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: dor stabs zhabs kyis dam sri pho mo mnan: dur khrod bdag mo ro langs yum dang sbyor: sku las skyes pa'i rdzu 'phrul me dpung 'khrigs: snang srid zil gnon gar gyi nyams su bsgom: oṃ ya ma rā dza sa twa me ya: ya me dho ru ṇa yo dha ya: ya dha yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya: yak+ṣe ya tsa ṇi ra ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā: zhes pa 'di sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rje'i zab gter las so//

// ༈ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dug ri me 'bar las: khro chu dug gdong gi mngon rtogs las sngags dang bcas pa bzhugs so: bla ma dang gshin rje gshed la gus pas 'dud: de yang 'jam dpal dpa' bo rab tu khros pa'i bdag nyid khro chu dug gdong chen po'i bskyed chog la mngon par rtogs pa rtsom par mos pa dag gis: thog mar sgo gsum a 'thas su mi btang zhing bag yod go cha btsan pos spobs pa lhur blangs te: rang bzhin gdod nas phyi'i snod dang nang gi bcud ma lus kun gshin rje srid pa 'khor lo bya ba 'phro 'dus sgyu ma'i gar ltar 'byung bar ma zad: deng phan chad 'gong por re zhig la gol nas sku'i rol pa rtsal gyis spro bsdu he ru ka ma mthong na skye 'chi la ya nga nas bar gcod la zad mi long ba'i rnal 'byor pa de: sbyangs spel bsgyur gsum gyi lam dang las su 'jug pa ni: sku gshin rje bzhad pa khro bo'i nyams kyi lus sprul bsgyur bgyis pas bdag gi gnyan po gdod nas rang shar yin pas bar gcod bdud las rgyal ba dang : gsung 'byung ba lnga'i rlung gi rang sgra: rtsa yi lam bha ga'i sbubs su 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi rang bzhin chu klung rgya mtsho'i rgyun ltar gyur bas gzungs rig sngags me ltar mched pas phas kyi rgol ba shugs las bcom ste: ngag gi bzlas pa rgyun mi chad pa'i: gzhan gyis dmod pa'i gnyan po de khas bzlog pa dang : thugs gshin rje mkha' ltar g.yo med phyogs lhung bral ba'i sems kyi de nyid gdod ma'i gshis lugs gnyug ma'i lhan skyes la 'chi bdag bdud kyi duḥkha dang bral ba'i ye nas skye ba med cing phyis kyang 'gag pa zad pas shi 'phos sogs 'jig rten gyis ltar snang ltar mi mngon pa rgya mtsho smig rgyu'i rnam pa: gya gyur snang ba ltar shes pas nga bdag gi sems su snang ba de: rtog med kyi shes pa rang byung ba'i gnas su khegs pas ming bdag gi mtha' las 'das pa:

'chi bral rang byung : stong pa'i cha ma 'gags pa gsal ba'i nyams su mi zhen pas dgongs klong de las mi g.yo bas na pha rol pos bgyis gdug rtsub shugs la bsal ba'o: de ltar nyams su myang bar 'dod pa: bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum spros med kyis char 'gro ba'i rdzas la mi brten zhing rang nyid yi dam bdag 'jug gis cho ga 'bral blag med par bsgrub bya spro bsdu'i rnal 'byor gyis: thog mar gnas gang rung ngam: yang na phrin las dang mthun par: shes pa bag phebs pas gdan du 'khod: 'don sgom tshig don dran rdzogs su: gsal gdab pa ni: hūm̐: skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkha' yangs pa ru: rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar smug lha lcam mthing 'od 'khril: de la 'jam dpal bka' bab brgyud pas bskor: phyogs dus rgyal kun byin rlabs 'dus pa la: bdag dang 'gro kun byang chub snying po'i bar: rtag par rtse gcig gdung bas skyabs su mchi: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i 'dun pa sems bskyed kyis: kun kyang 'jam mgon go 'phang mchog 'grub shog: gnyis pa ni:

hūm̐ ya bh+yoḥbh+rūm̐: snod bcud thams cad drag po e yi zhing : mthing nag zur gsum dug gi dud sprin gtibs: 'byung ba tsha grang g.yo ba'i ngar sgra sgrogs: khro chu'i zi ra me dpung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: phyi rol mtshon cha sna tshogs drwa mig gtams: me ri 'tshub cing lcags sdig bya khyung 'phro: srid pa'i rlung yang mi bgrod gur khang nang : de dbus gnam lcags rgya gram ti ra'i steng : rdo rje mthing nag rab 'bar lte ba'i srog: yi ge hūm̐ ya bh+yo dang phyag mtshan las: 'od zer lnga ldan me ltar phyogs bcur 'phros: dgra bgegs tshar bcad tshe bsod 'ub kyis bsdus: phyag mtshan sa bon la thim gnas 'gyur te: dran rdzogs skad cig 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: khro chu dug gdong mthing nag rngam pa'i sku: g.yas dkar g.yon ljang zhal gsum gtum la 'bar: spyan rtsa rab g.yo sdang mig phyogs bcur bgrad: shangs nas dud sprin gtib cing sgrol mche gtsigs: dbu skra dmar ser thod skam phreng bas brgyan: spyi bor dug dang khro chu gnam lcags kyi: mchod rten gsum ldan de nang rigs gsum mgon: rang sngags ye shes rang sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: phyag drug g.yas gsum gnam lcags dgra satwa gdengs: g.yon gsum byad ma'i tsit+ta srog snying bsnams: spu gri chu gri'i sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: dur khrod chas brgyad 'jigs pa'i gar dgu ldan: dpal chas rngam pa'i snang srid skar ltar 'khrugs: lte bar las kyi chu srin sgrol mche gtsigs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal gsham thog ltar 'bebs: dam sri byad ma'i snying khar bsnun par gsal: pang du 'khyud pa'i yum mchog srid pa'i bdag: dmar nag gri thod 'dzin pas mgul du 'khyud: dur khrod chas ldan zung 'jug gtum pa mo: stong khams sreg pa'i tshwa tshwa sku la 'phro: yab yum me dpung dug rlung dbus su gsal: hūm̐: g.yas su sku dang gsung gi sprul: 'chi bdag nag cing tshe bdag dmar:
