g.yon du thugs dang yon tan sprul: srog bdag ser nag be wa khams: mdun du za ba ljang nag ste: lnga po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gtso bor chas mthun rab tu rngam: rgyab tu ya ma rā dza mthing : g.yas g.yon seṅge phag gi gdong : rtsa zhal las kyi chu srin khro: g.yas gsum ral gri khyung sdig thogs: g.yon gsum sbrul zhags glog ltar 'khyug: kun kyang byad ma 'joms par gsal: hūm̐: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min zhing khams nas: 'jam dpal khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku: gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes gnas nas spyan drangs te: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa bskyed: phrin las rnam bzhi'i rtsal phyungs la: phyi nang mi mthun bar chad sol: dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar bcad nas: sku gsum lha ru bdag gyur te: bskyed pa'i khro rgyal sku ru shar: drag sngags rdo rje'i rang sgra sgrog: gnas pa hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du la: bdag med ye shes me dpung 'bar: snod bcud gshin rje gshed po yi: rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ngang du gsal: oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma rak+sha kro ta pa tsa la ti: kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i snying po gcig tu bsgril te nyams len rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bya zhing : spros bcas sgrub chen ltar bcad rgyar gnas skabs sam: spros med rgyun du nyin re bzhin bskyed rim tshar re nas bzlas pa la 'bung bar bya'o: yang gnas skabs su sgrub pa po'i phyi nang gi bar chad bzlog pa ni: sngags stong tshar song nas sham bu 'di sbyar te lag rdeb dang bcas pa bya: e ka ya ma du ru tsa sha na byad ma nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags zlog:

mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags zlog: yi dam lha yis bka' chad zlog: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i sun kha zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i khram kha zlog: bdud kyis bar du gcod pa zlog: btsan gyis shwa rdel sprugs pa zlog: sde brgyad rtsis la thebs pa zlog: 'byung pos thod zor 'phen pa zlog: lha min dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: phyogs skyong bcu yis hom yar zlog: rgya gar yi ges dmod pa zlog: rgya nag bsgyur gto gtong ba zlog: zhang zhung dzo zor 'phen p sum pas glang zor 'phen pa zlog: ban+des sngags zor 'phen pa zlog: bon pos gtor zor 'phen pa zlog: drang srong dmod pa zug pa zlog: skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa zlog: dmag jag dgra rkun thams cad zlog: brgya yis ya kha dmod p stong gis bram mchu sdig pa zlog: gson 'dre pho mos gdug rtsub zlog: gnam gyis dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa zlog: lo nyes sad ser mu ge zlog: sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog: skeg dang phung sri lang ba zlog: god sri gyod byur thams cad zlog: gri sris shes rgyud dkrugs pa zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: byad zor phur kha thams cad zlog: ban gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: bon gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: pho bdud mo bdud dal kha zlog: spyi bdud chung bdud dal kha zlog: bzlog cig bsgyur cig mā ra ya: e ka du na e sa bh+yo zlog: ces sngags lan gsum bzlas nas bzlog pa bya: byad ma 'bum rdeg gi sngags zlog yin pas rnal 'byor pa gang la la zhig gis rgyun du mi chag par bzlog pa 'di bgyis na phur thogs stong la 'gras kyang byad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro: yang sde brgyad kyis rgyun du za kha zug na sngags 'di la bzlog pa sbyar te:

e ka sa du mā ra ya a sha ru di tsa na sde brgyad yongs kyi byad kha zug pa thams cad e thum phrom ya zlog: des ni sde brgyad kyis 'tshe ba thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro: yang dur sri dang shi sris rgyun du gnod na sngags 'di bzlas la bzlog pa gong bzhin bya ste: oṃ pra sod: chu sod: dur rta sod: dur mi sod: snying mgo la chod snying mgo la rbad: ka la dzaḥ kaṃ shaṃ dri rbad phaṭ swā hā: des ni shi ba'i gshed kha dang dur sgo bye na nges par bzlog go: yang dgra dang rkun jag gis sdang na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: oṃ e hri hūm̐ thun ta sha kra ru ya phyogs thams cad kyi dgra sri ya ma nan brub bzlog yaḥ e thum tso ra mi li mi li thar ni dgra rkun thams cad ching ya zlog zlog: des ni dgra sri langs pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro: yang yul la 'khrug rtsod kyi sri che na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: a tri la dri sha dri ya 'byung po kha kha ru ṇi gri sri phe sha dur kha trig ya ma ya yul gyi 'dre chag dang 'khrug rtsod gri sri thams cad zlog zlog: yang zhing khang nor rdzas la dbul sri zhugs na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e kra ma kra ma pri ta ki ra ya dbul sri mi la dri thun da ra da ra bsod nams dang phyugs g.yang nyams pa thams cad zlog zlog: yang mi kha gleng gzhi sgrogs shing g.yengs na: sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e kha thun he brub ti laṃ tha raṃ yaṃ khaṃ mu ra tri ya snang srid yongs kyi dmod pa'i mi kha thams cad zlog zlog: des ni gleng gzhi'i mi kha las grol bar 'gyur ro: yang gson 'dre pho mos gnod pa byung na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e ha sa ha sa ka la ku ru bhū ta nan ka li shaṃ du ru nan mi pa kā ya 'jig rten srid pa'i sdug 'dre pho mo'i gdug pa zlog: des ni gson 'dre'i gnod pa las grol lo:

yang lo dgra gshed 'phrad pas gnod na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e ya ma su tri ra tri sha ma sha na su ma tri ya ma yo ra tri ye 'byung ba dgra gshed 'phrad pa'i gdug pa thams cad zlog zlog: des ni 'byung ba dgra gshed 'phrad pa las grol lo: yang rmi lam rtags mtshan ma ngan pa byung na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e bh+yo thum rbad lok+t+ri pā la baṃ shag ru lu this pa de ya ma tri ya ma tri thun nan rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad zlog zlog: des ni rmi ltas mtshan ngan las grol lo: yang pha rol gyis gtad khram du tshud na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e ka ya he kro ta kā la ya ghṛr ma ṇa ma ru ti sarba satwaṃ bha ya pha rol gyi byad gtad du bcug cing khram la btab pa thams cad mā ra ya zlog zlog: des ni byad gtad du bcug pa las grol lo: yang chos sgrub pa rnams la bar chad kyi bgegs zhugs na sngags 'di'i sham bur bzlog pa bya ste: e ya ma a ti sha trig thun ya ma kha thun nṛ tri ra ha la ma dkar po'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad mā ra ya zlog zlog: des ni sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad las grol lo: de ltar phrin las so so'i sham bur gzhung sngags kyi mjug tu sbyar zhing gnad che na bzlog pa brgya re bya ba khyad chos yin no: gzhan gzhung sngags dang bzlog bya rnams rlung la bskor kyang rung : yang pha rol gyis dmod pa zhi bar 'dod na bzlog pa'i tshig kha bsgyur byas nas 'di ltar shes par bya: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags zhi bar gyur cig: ces thams cad kha sgyur bya yang rung : rlung 'khor mi bya na zhi ba zhes mi dgos: spyir gang zag so so'i blo dang bstun: spros med sgrub pa bya ba'i tshe bzlog pa'i sham bu 'di dgos par ma lags kyang spyir them byang ma bral nas rang gi las phran de ltar 'khor los bzhag pa yin: de yang las phran dgos sam mi dgos gang zag so so'i lta ba rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad la rag las:

rab lta ba rang byung gyad kyi lha yin zhing de la snod bcud thams cad dag pa chos sku 'ba' zhig mthong bas zlog byed kyi gnyen po mi dgos te lta ci smos: 'bring phra rags kyi rtags phra mo nyi ma shar gyi zer gzengs pa lta bu rnam pa sna tshogs 'char ba rnams kyi bdag 'dzin gyi duḥkha bzlog pa ste shin tu dgos pa'o: tha ma sngon las 'phral rkyen zad mi shes pa chu bo gcong rong 'gro ba'i gnyer ma 'byung ba rnams la bden pa'i tshig brjod pa kho na gtso che de'i ched du las phran gyi sham bu nges par dgos pa'o: khyad par gshin rje khro chu 'di kun gyi nang nas thun mong ma yin pa'i lha yin: ci zhe na rigs bdag sku gsum gyis mtshan pas brgyud pa'i brgyud pa gzhan nas mi dgos: sku stod khro rgyal me ltar 'bar bas stobs bcu gzhan nas mi dgos: sgyu 'phrul dbal gshog ldan pas bgrod 'gyu rtsal mi dgos: lte ba chu srin rngam zhal ldan pas za byed las mkhan gzhan nas mi dgos: sku smad mtshon phur zur gsum ldan pas gsod byed pho nya gzhan nas mi dgos: rang bzhin khro chu'i ngar dang ldan pas srung 'khor gur khang gzhan nas mi dgos: shugs la me dpung dug rlung gtibs pas sreg gtor las mtha' gzhan nas mi dgos: sku la rang bzhin dkyil 'khor rdzogs pas bsgral ba'i tshe lung spar chog mi dgos: snying po'i stobs kyis sa bcaru bsnyegs pas rgya khyon a 'thas dmigs pa mi dgos: ci zhe na nges don de ltar rang sar gdod nas sprul pa'i khro rgyal chen po 'di shin tu byin rlabs dang nus pa che zhing gzhan la ma 'brel khungs brda yod pa'i mtshan nyid kyang de lta bu ste man ngag zab pa'i lo rgyus so: sa ma ya: e ma gsang bcud snying po yid bzhin nor 'jo las: zab pa'i mthar thug srog 'dzin nā da'i khrag: las 'phro can la brda bzhin mngon phyung nas: snyigs dus yid kyi sgron me rab tu bsngags:

ma 'ongs yang mtha' rtsod ldan tha ma ru: rigs sras brgyud 'dzin zhig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos glang lor khrom gzigs me 'bar mtsho nas gdan drangs shing : 'brug lor sbrul gyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin dpal bde chen bdud 'dul gling gi gzim chung lhun grub mngon dga' ru shog ser nas zhal bshus so: dge'o/ ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ spros med rgyun khyer snying po dril ba bzhugs so/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi dgongs pa yis: lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lī la thugs brgyud nas: 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: tshe yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs: skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni: hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro rnams tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shing : thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥtshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ ces sngon du 'gro bas dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ mkha' dbyings rlung me sa chu las: 'byung lnga yum gyur gzhal yas khang :

ma bcos lhun grub zhing khams nas: chu nang zla shar dkyil 'khor gsal: hūm̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na bh+rūm̐: lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: dran rig rang snang gnyis med zla gdan du: shes rig ngo bo g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : gsal stong hrīḥlas tshe bdag yab yum ni: gu ru pad+ma gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: tshe yi bdag po pad+ma dbang gi lha: sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: longs spyod rgyan ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis ni: mnyam bzhag sbyor tshul tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: sems kyi dwangs ma dkar dmar bcud kyis bkang : phyed skyil pang du shes rab kun 'dus ma: dmar mo chags nyams bcu drug lang tsho ldan: rin chen rgyan ldan tshe bum mda' dar 'dzin: dga' bzhi dbang sdud tshe yi bcud 'dzin bsgom: phyi rim sgo ma tshe yi las byed ma: dkar ser dmar ljang lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: rang mdog rgyan ldan gar stabs khro chags can: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: phyag g.yas tshe bsod bcud bsdus tshul du bsgom: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams nas kyang : tshe yi lha tshogs gsal 'tsher gzi 'bar bsgom: 'od 'phros tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rnga yab mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i zhing : bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: tshe bdag pad+ma yab yum dang : sgo ma mkha' 'gro tshe bdag rnams: mkha' spyod tshe yi gnas mchog nas: gshegs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal sdig bshags mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags: phyi nang gsang gsum sprul pa'i tshogs: sku bzhi lhun grub mchod pa bzhes: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza hoḥ ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta kha raṃ khā hi:

ma hā pañca rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa bya ba ni: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung pad+ma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bde stong gar sgyur gsang ba'i yum: 'chi med bcud 'dzin yab la bstod: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan ldan mdzes: lha lcam tshe yi bdag mor bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus khams lngar bstim: rlung lnga'i grogs mdzad bde skyed ma: rigs bzhi tshe yi lha la bstod: dmigs pa ni: rang gi thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje ni/ /rgya gram lte bar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i dbus/ /thugs srog hrīḥdamar gsal 'tsher g.yas g.yon du/ /tshe dang srog rten aḥdakar nṛḥljang mtshan/ /hrīḥmathar sngags phreng dmar po g.yas skor las/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /slar 'dus phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin mthu dang*/ /nyi zla rgyu skar sa chu me rlung bcud/ /'khor 'das kun gyi tshe dpal bsod nams kun/ /āḥnṛ hūm̐ gi rnam par 'ub 'ub tu/ /rim par bsdus shing tshe bum mer gyis khengs/ /spyi bor bla ma'i ngo bo tshe dpag med/ /yab yum sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar rgyun/ /lhan cig tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun gang*/ /dwangs ma 'bru gsum la thim bkrag mdangs 'bar/ /'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog thob dmigs/

oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa āḥyur+dz+nyā na hrīḥ ci nus dang*/ khyad par rdzogs rim dang sbyar na rang gi dbugs tshur rngub pa dang 'khor 'das snang srid kyi tshe bcud rnams tshur bsdus thugs ka'i srog yig la thim par bsgoms shing*/ nang 'jug kho na grangs bsags pa dang sngags rnams kyang yid bzlas rkyang pa bya/ thun min rlung bum can 'byongs na de nyid gnad du bsnun pa dang*/ de ltar ma nus na'ang*/ rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum dang sbyar nas 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab par bya ba ste 'di ni tshe sgrub kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /mthar yang nyi zla'i gwa'u kha 'grigs nas/ /'bru gsum tshud pa'i rdo rje rgya gram gyi/ /rwa bzhis rgyas gdab rwa rtser me tshwa 'phros/ /rtsa gnas ba spur rta mgrin grangs med bstim/ /sngags phreng drwa bas gwa'u bcings pa yis/ /bar chod srung zhing tshe bdud bsregs par mos/ oṃ badz+ra āḥyur gar+bha h+ya ghṛ wa hri da ye swā hā/ de nas spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum yang*/ /ye shes bdud rtsir 'od zhu srog rten la/ /thim pa'i rgya mdud steng du tshe dpag med/ /dkar gsal tshon gang 'gyur med rtag bzhugs mos/ zhes pas rgyas gdab/ oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa āḥyur+dz+nyā na hrīḥmā ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: brjod de nas 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhag skye 'chi med pa'i rig pa ni/ /gdod nas dag pa'i tshe dpag med/ /ngo shes g.yo med gdeng thob na/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku 'grub 'gyur/ /de phyir nyams len gnad 'di gces/ /spro na tshe 'gugs pa ni/ de nas mdun bskyed rang nyid pad+ma'i sku: tshe lha rigs lnga 'dus pa'i ngo bo la: gsol btab mos gus gdung bas thugs dam bskul: 'khor 'das bcud bsdus stobs rtsal gzi byin bskyed: mda' dar sna lnga g.yab cing tshe 'gugs bskul: zhes pas/ rgyas na tshe 'gugs thugs rje'i pho nya bya/

bsdu na/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin la: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin pa mo: lha klu mi yi bcud bsdus nas: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: tshe yi rig 'dzin myur 'grub mdzod: de nas rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab la: sra brtan 'gyur med rgya yis gdab: rim bsdus 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams: brtan par gyur cig badz+ra hoḥ thun mtshams rgyas gdab dmigs med dbyings su bzhag: rjes su dngos grub len pa ni: hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor srid kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe yi dbang bzhi smin grol mchog thob nas: tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor rgyas thob gyuracig: ces rtsa sngags bzla zhing de'i mthar/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ mi dmigs snang mtha'i dkyil 'khor tshe yi dal: dgongs pa zang thal chos sku'i klong du bsdu: rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs rgyal sa zin: ma bcos spros bral ngang du a la thim: aḥ.aḥ.āḥ zhes dmigs bral chos nyid sgyu ma'i ngo bo skyongs: bsngo smon bya ba ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'chi med gsang ba'i dal bzung nas: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i mthus: dge bcu rgya mtshos sems can smin gyur nas: kun bzang pad 'byung go 'phang thob gyur cig: bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: zung 'jug tshe la rab tu gnas dbang ba'i: 'chi med bdud rtsis rab tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: mthar bsngo smon shis brjod ci rigs pas mtha' rgyan par bya'o: gzhan yang rdzas sman bcud len la brten nas tshe gso thabs dang*/ bsnyen tshad rtags rnams gzhung chen mo las gsal ba bzhin nyams su len no/ /phan yon ni rtsa ba las/ rtag tu tho rangs nyi shar khar: brgya tsa re re nges par bzla:

snum zad mar me bsnan pa'am: nad pa sman gyis gsos pa ltar/ zad pa bsring zhing bri ba 'gengs: nyams pa spel lam rgyas par byed: tshe la rang dbang thob par 'gyur: mdor na rang don gzhan don dang : gdul bya phrin las 'dod pa'i don: ji ltar bsgrub cing rnal 'byor pa'i: sku tshe ring nas ci bsam 'grub: de bas mchog thun gang bsgrub kyang : tshe sgrub pa la nan tan 'tshal: tshul bzhin sus bsgrubs tshe mthar phyin: tshe tshad dag la dbang 'byor bas: bya byed gang brtsam rgyas bsdus dang : spang blang ji ltar 'dod bzhin chog: ces gsungs so/ zhes pa'ang rang slob ye shes rgyal mtshan nas 'di ltar bris zhes yangayang bskul zhing yi ge'i mthun gyur kyang mdzad par brten sgo chen sprul ming nas gter gzhung dgongs pa bzhin sbyar ba'o// // ༈ tshe sgrub yang snying 'chi bdag zil gnon las: h+ya ghṛ wa khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi gsang sgrub kyi rgyun khyer bzhugs so: stong pa'i ngang las e mthing chos dbyings klong : ma bcos lhun grub dbang chen pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rang bzhin rdzogs: phyi nang zang thal me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: sra brtan mi shigs rdo rje'i brag chen dbus: pad+ma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan steng du: rdo rje dmar nag lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan: dran rdzogs gnas 'gyur pad+ma he ru kaḥ khro rgyal stobs 'dus dmar nag dbang gi sku: zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas dkar g.yon mthing ba: dbus dmar rngam la khro zhing rab tu gtum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing gzigs: dbu skra thod phreng spyi bor rta dbu gsum: a mi dhe wa rigs bdag cod pan brgyan: g.yas gsum rdo rje dbyug tho ral gri 'dzin: g.yon gsum bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ phur pa 'dril: ral gri'i sgro gshog seng glang zhing chen gos: khrag zhag thal tshom rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan: mi mgo'i phreng ba dug sbrul lhu tshigs dkris: sku smad phur gsham zur gsum chu srin rngam:

phag mo mthing nag gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: thod skam dbu rgyan phag zhal pheṃ sgra ngur: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: thugs kar hūm̐ dang tha ma sngags kyis bskor: ba spu bu gar me yi bya khyung 'phro: tshwa tshwa'i zer 'phros snang srid dbang sdud bsgom: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya kro ti wa ra hi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rtsa gsum gling pas tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs pa'i 'chi bdag zil gnon gsang sgrub las rgyun khyer gud du phyung ba'o// // ༈ spyi khyab phyag rdor sgom bzlas ni/ spyi chings gsum gyi nyams su blang*/ na mo/ mchog gsum ngo bo lhag pa'i lha/ /gsang ba'i bdag por skyabs su mchi/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir/ /phyag na rdo rje bsgom par bya/ lan gsum/ āḥ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /rang nyid khro rgyal gtum po mthing*/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang*/ /sdigs mdzub mdzad cing khro chas rdzogs/ /pad nyi sa bdag bsnol ba'i steng*/ bzhengs stabs bskal me'i klong na rol/ /spyi bor khyung lding klu gdon za/ /rang 'dra'i khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrigs/ /gnas gsum yi ge om̐ āḥhūm̐/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gyur/ /thugs srog hūm̐ las 'od zer gyis/ /lcang lo can nas spyan drangs bstim/ /thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal mchod 'gro ba'i las sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par sa bdag sde brgyad kyi/ /gdug rtsub nad gdon tshar bcad de/ /srid gsum khro bo'i zhing du gyur/ /om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ bzlas pas nad gdon kun las grol/ /thun bsdu dge bsngo shis pa brjod/ /ces pa dus mthar mkho che phyir/ kho bo pad rgyal gling pa yis/ /gsang ba'i man ngag gzhung bzhin du/ /gzhan phan kun slong dag pas bris/ /rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin shog

/dge'o/ / ༈ gu ru drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i gtum po klu 'dul gyi gsang sgrub rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ phyag rdor gtum po klu 'dul gyi rgyun khyer nyams su len pa la/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dpal chen kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sgo gsum rtsol bral ngang gis skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro ba srid bsdus kun gyi ched: bdag gis dpal chen bsgrubs nas go 'phang dgod: lan gsum/ hūm̐: mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: pad+ma nyi ma sa bdag steng : bdag nyid gtum po sku mdog mthing : phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje dang : lcags kyu 'dzin cing steng gdon gzir: g.yon pas sbrul zhags klu gnyan 'ching : sdigs mdzub rtse la khyung khra 'gyed: dmangs rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan dmar 'khrugs: dbu skra kham nag thod skam brgyan: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: spyi bor sku yi bya khyung dkar: rgyal rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: phyag g.yas gsung gi bya khyung dmar: bram ze klu sbrul zhal du gsol: phyag g.yon thugs kyi bya khyung sngo: rje rigs klu sbrul zhal du gsol: gdol pa nag po zhabs 'og mnan: ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ gi mthar: sngags phreng 'gal me g.yas su 'khor: 'od zer me dang thog ser 'phro: gza' klu sde brgyad gnod byed kun: gzhob rgod thul thul tshig par bsam: rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci 'grub bzla/ khyung sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: khroṃ gha ru ḍa haṃ sa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces ci nus su bzla zhing dmigs med ka dag gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor ye shes dbyings su mu/ /sgo gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i go dang ldan/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gzhan 'gro la bsngo/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /rjes shes bsngo ba dang smon lam sogs spyi dang mthun par bya'o/

/zhes pa'ang rang slob au ḍī'i bzhed skong slad gter gzhung rgyun khyer la sngon rjes cung zad spros pa po ni gu h+ya'o// // rta phyag khyung gsum gyi rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ rang rig rtsa gsum yi dam lhar/ /rang ngo shes par skyabs su mchi/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal phyir/ /ye shes khro bo bsgrub par bgyi/ hrīḥ gzhi dbyings stong chen yangs pa'i klong*/ /gzhi snang rang byung gzhal yas dbus/ /dug gsum klu srin bsnol ba'i steng*/ /rang rig ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag /gnas gyur khro rgyal rta mgrin mthing*/ /zhal gsum phyag drug spyan rtsa 'khyil/ /rta dbu rigs gsum rta skad 'tsher/ /dbu skra dmar ser thod skam brgyan/ /dar nag cod pan dug sbrul 'khyugs/ /g.yas gsum ral gri dbyug to khyung*/ /g.yon gsum lcags kyu thod khrag sbrul/ /rab 'jigs dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs/ /yum mchog phag mo klu 'dul ma/ /g.yas pas gri gug sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /g.yon pas bhan dmar sdig pa bsnams/ khro mo'i spyi bor phag zhal ngur/ /rus brgyan gcer mos yab la 'khril/ /me ri smug nag klong du gsal/ /spyi bor gnam lcags ga ru ḍas/ /me gshog krang kring klu gnyan za/ /mdun du sprul pa'i lcags sdig 'khyugs/ /rgyab tu dug gi phag rgod ngur/ /klu srin rgyal 'gong 'dre rgod dang*/ /dam sri 'joms pa'i gnyen por gsal/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng*/ /gsang bdag mthing nag rdo rje dang*/ /sdigs mdzub mdzad cing khro chas rdzogs/ /de yi thugs dbus hūm̐ mthing mthar/ /drag sngags 'od zer me tshwa yis/ /'khor ba'i dug gsum gdon bgegs sreg /snod kyi 'jig rten khro bo'i zhing*/ /bcud kyi skye 'gro'i lus ngag sems/ /dpal chen gsang gsum ye shes dbyings/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /che btsan 'gran zla bral bar dmigs/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ

oṃ badz+ra pā ni hūm̐/ om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ bsdu na/ om̐ badz+ra kro ta hrīḥhūm̐ khroṃ phaṭḥ ces pa'ang lho 'brug chos kyi rgyal po'i ljongs/ 'brug shar phyogs bkra shis g.yang rtse'i mnga' sde'i nang gses gtsang mkhar slob grwar 'dus pa stong tsho du mar/ gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung bgyis skabs rgyu rkyen du mas nyer mkhor rig ste/ gnam lcags bstan 'dzin ming gis rab byung 17 shing bya'i lo'i bod zla 12 pa'i tshes 29 la bris pa'o// // ༈ rje btsun khros ma'i rgyun khyer bde chen rab 'bar ces bya ba bzhugs so/ rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ skyabs yul yid kyis gsal gdab ste/ skyabs yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza/ zhes mi phyed pa'i gdung ba drag pos/ na mo: bde chen rab dga' ye shes g.yo ba'i mchog: grol lam pho nya'i bde stong bskyed pa'i phyir: nyon mongs rab dben chags med zung 'jug can: mchog gi dpa' mo'i sku la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde chen mchog la 'god 'dod kyi blos/ hoḥ dga' ba rab g.yo mchog gi dga' ba ster: dga' bral lhan skyes dga' ba'i gzi 'od 'byin: dga' ma dbyangs can dpa' mo bsgrub pa'i phyir: dga' chen khyod bdag bsten par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ lnga pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'dir gshegs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /bla med gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dge tshogs kun tu bzang po'i rgyur bsngo'o/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ aḥ ka dag skye med chos sku'i klong*/ /lhun grub snang ba yum lnga'i dal/ /ma 'gags thugs rje khros ma'i sku:

mthing nag khro zhing rab tu rngam: ngur ba'i phag zhal spyi bor brgyan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum la gshe: sgeg pa dgod pa dpa' mo'i chas: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: rtse gsum tri shul gru mor brten: chas ni dur khrod rgyan dang ldan: brkyang bskum gar gyi nyams 'gyur can: 'bar ba'i me dpung klong du bskyed: rang rtsal rigs bzhi'i 'khor tshogs dang*/ /rtsa gsum ḍāk+ki 'phro zhing 'du/ /thugs kar kun tu bzang mo yi/ /snying dbus dga' ba 'khyil ba'i klong*/ /hūm̐ mthing mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng*/ /g.yon 'khor 'od kyis zhing kun khyab/ /rgyal mchod 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs/ /tshur 'dus gzi byin nus stobs rgyas/ /rtsa khams thams cad mkha' 'gro'i sku/ /rlung khams thams cad nā da'i sgra/ /thig le bde ba chen po ru/ /dag pa'i dga' bzhi ye shes rtsal/ /'bar ba'i bde stong nyams rtogs 'ur/ /phyi nang snod bcud snang grags sems/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje gsum gyi da lar sad/ om̐ badz+ra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus dang*/ 'byin 'jug rlung la bslab cing bde stong nyams rtsal sbyong*/ mthar rdzogs rim bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snang srid thams cad mkha' 'gro'i zh-ing : rang lus 'byung ba gdos bcas bral: sgra rnams brag cha'i gdangs bzhin grags: 'gyu ba dran rig ka dag ngang : rol rtsal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: gsal stong 'dzin med lam du shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes bsdu la ldang*/ bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o/ zhes pa 'di'ang ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas chen rnams su mchod mjal skabs bar gseng du rab byung 17mchu zla'i dmar phyogs la gu h+yas sug bris bgyis pa'o// // ༈ lha mo khro gnyer can gyi byad khrol gser gyi lde mig rgyun gyi nyams len dril sgrub bzhugs so/

de'ang 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma dang gzhan gyis mi thub pa gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo ngan sngags kyi g.yul bzlog drag mo khro gnyer can ma ste/ rig sngags kyi lha mo rtsa ba sum dril zhes pha rol gyi byad rgol dam sri pho mo'i gnod pa zhi bar byed pa'i man ngag zab mo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: 'khor ba dong sprugs sems bskyed do: 'gro kun byad phur g.yul rgyal phyir/ /rig sngags lha mo bsgrub par bgyi/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma a las zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid bam̐ dmar po tām̐ ljang gu mūm̐ dkar po ste yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ri khrod kyi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ljang mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma zhabs bzhi dang ldan ma/ g.yas zhal gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo 'dzum bag dang ldan ma/ rtsa zhal ljang mo 'phags ma ri khrod ma rgyas par bzhad ma/ g.yon zhal dmar mo drag mo rdo rje khro gnyer can ma mche ba gtsigs ma/ phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gdugs dkar dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin ma/ bar pa gnyis kyis dgra satwa dang zhags pa thogs ma/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs ma/ dbu la rin chen rgyan cha rnam par spras shing shing lo'i cod pan rnam par spras ma/ sku stod dar ljang yug gos gsol nas nor bu dang rin chen rgyan drug spras ma/ sku smad dar dmar ang rag gsol nas zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs ma/ sku la ye shes kyi 'od zer dang 'ched pa'i me dpung 'bar bas bskor nas bdud dang mu stegs tshar gcod ma/ snang la rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ma'i skur gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum dang*/

thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar nyi dkyil la baṃ tām̐ mūm̐ gyi mthar sngags phreng dmar nag me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro bzhin rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar drag tu 'khor ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas nus stobs gzi byin cher 'bar/ slar sngags phreng las 'od zer me chu rlung gsum thun mtshon gyi rang bzhin srid gsum khyab par 'phros pas/ snang srid 'byung lnga'i byad 'dre gtad bdag thams cad byad ma rang gshed du dbab nas mnan bsregs gtor bas rjes med du brlag cing mi dmigs par rgya yis btab/ snang grags rig gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du lam gyis gsal bar dmigs la/ rtsa ba gsum dril gyi nye snying ni/ om̐ badz+ra bi dho bi dho bhi dza ya a dzi ti ma a par dzi te ma ma tshin+dha ya ha ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub mthar/ pha rol rig sngags kyis byad du bcug pa dang mnan pa bcings pa bskrad pa gzir ba thams cad byer byer khrol khrol shig shig bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa sarba tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa sarba maṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭḥ sogs dang spro na gzungs ring yang ci nus bzla/ de nas 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ: ye shes lha mo 'od rab 'byin: nyon mongs kun gyi sman pa mchog: sdug bsngal nad las grol mdzad ma: thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo: byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba 'dren: mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing : nyon mongs sgrib pa sbyong mdzad pa: rgyal ba sras dang bcas la bstod: thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'od: lha mo'i sku yi gzi brjid kyis: gzhan gyis dmod pa'i rig sngags dang : dug dang nad mtshon chu la sogs: pha rol rgol ba'i byad gtad rnams: lha mo khyed kyis zhi bar mdzod: rgyal yum sgrol ma khyed sku? sogs sh+lau ka gnyis brjod/ gzhan yang bsngo smon shis brjod sogs spyi ltar dang rjes shes mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/

/zhes pa'ang rang gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor khyer bde ru gter gzhung las cung zad btus pa'o/ rab byung ri zla'i shing bya lo'i dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs su khyung nag sngags pas btus shing rdo ban gyis bris so// // bla ma'i thugs sgrub kyi ma rgyud 'pho ba ka dag ye grol mtshams sbyar gyis brgyan pa dpag med myur lam bzhugs so/ bla ma dang rang rig gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ de'ang sdig po che btsan thabs su 'pho bar byed pa ma bsgom sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i gdams pa bstan pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum mo/ de la dang po skyabs sems ni/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum mkha' spyod lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: zhes lan gsum sngon du 'gro zhing rang don sbyangs pa dang*/ de nas gzhan don las su sbyor ba ni/ kyai/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo zhes tshe 'das kyi ming nas bos la ma yengs par nyon cig /lan gsum 'bod ces pas/ hoḥ khyod la 'chi ba mi rtag pa zhes bya ba slebs pa yin no/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi spyi bor dbu ma'i yar sna rgya skar kha phyes pa ltar yod pa'i steng na/ pha drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi zhal dgyes 'dzum mu le/ thugs brtse ba chen po'i nyams 'gyur gyis skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dgongs te/ lam sna 'dren pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa la/ zab lam 'pho ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad/ byin rlabs kyi nus rtsal 'ur re/ gdams ngag gi grol klong shig ge /don brgyud kyi nyams rtogs lam me/ mkha' spyod mkha' 'gros gar byed khyugs se/

bde stong gi 'ja' 'od thig les phyogs mtshams gang ste/ g.yas bskor gyi rnam pas sprin 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa/ zhal mjal ba tsam gyis sdig sgrib rang sar dag nas zag med kyi bde ba rgyud la skye ba/ nyams rtogs ting 'dzin gyis nus shugs bskul nas/ drin can bla ma la skyel ma'i 'du shes/ rje btsun pad 'byung la bsun ma'i 'du shes kyi sgo nas/ bya rgod 'gugs rnyi la zin pa thar 'dod kyis nam mkha'i mthongs la lta ba bzhin/ blo thag rbad kyis chod la rig pa rnga yab dag pa'i zhing du/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med pa'i thugs kar 'dun pa gtad par gyis shig /de'ang rgyud las/ rlung gi gzhu la rig pa'i mda' brgyud de/ phaṭḥkyi sgra dang bcas 'pho dgos par gsungs pa bzhin/ 'pho bya 'pho byed gnyis su med par chu dang chu 'dres pa ltar rig pa rtse gcig gis gsol ba phur tshugs su thob la dmigs pa 'di ltar sgoms shig /ho/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lus 'di tshe 'das yin na khyed rang gi lus de zhes kha bsgyur chog

mchan/ skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs dang ldan pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa: spyi bor phag zhal ngur ba: phyag na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams shing gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa: gcer mo nu ma bha ga rgyas te: dar dmar po'i cod pan 'phur ba: rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa: zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar gyis bam ro'i snying khar brdzis shing 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs pa'o: rnal 'byor ma'i khog pa stong pa phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i dbus su: rtsa dbu ma phyi sngo la nang dmar ba: mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa: drang ba chu shing gi sdong bu lta bu: srab pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu: dmar ba rgya skag gi khu ba lta bu: gsal ba til zhun gyi mar me lta bu stai: mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa sgoms shig: de'-i yar sne tshangs bug dang : mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa ste: snying khar tshigs kyis bcad pa'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa: de'i steng du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo: thig le dkar dmar 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa: rgya sran rdog pau tsam zhig: 'phar la khad pa: 'phur la khad pa: spu rtse brgyar gshags kyi rtse mo rlung gis bskyod pa ltar ram: āḥdakar gcig tu sgoms shig: yar sne rgya mthongs kha phyes pa ltar yod pa'i steng du: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma: rnam pa rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar gsal he ru ka'i cha lugs can: gar gyi nyams ldan ḍā ma ru dang bhan+dha bsnams pa snang la rang bzhin bral ba: de'i phyogs bzhir gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro bzhi mkha' la spyod pa'i rnam 'gyur du sgoms mdzod: 'o de'ang rgyud rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ nyes pa kun gyis ma gos pa/ /'pho ba'i sbyor ba sgrol ba'i mchog /sdig sgrib kun gyis mi gos te/ /'khor ba'i pha rol mchog tu sgrol/ zhes gsungs pas/ mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'i sdig can yin yang*/

'pho ba thebs na ngan song du mi 'gro ste/ rab dag pa'i zhing khams/ 'bring lha gnas gtsang ma/ tha ma'ang mi lus chos ldan du skye ba/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka'/ ye shes mkha' 'grau'i gsang tshig yin pas/ mos gus dad pa drag pos/ rig pa rtse gcig tu gtod la gsol ba phur tshugs su thob cig /de nas bla ma rgyangs 'bod bya ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum de mkhyen no/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga de mkhyen no/ sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po de mkhyen no/ /rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje de mkhyen no/ /gu ru shrī singha de mkhyen no/ /mkhas pa bi ma mi tra de mkhyen no/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas de mkhyen no/ /mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal de mkhyen no/ /lha lcam man+da ra ba de mkhyen no/ /gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes de mkhyen no/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje de mkhyen no/ /o rgyan rog rje gling pa de mkhyen no/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /zab lam dbu ma'i chos sgo yar phyes la/ /skal ldan tshe 'das thar pa'i lam sna drongs mdzod/ na mo gu ru: spyi bor bde chen 'khor lo'i 'od klong : gu ru snang srid zil gnon de yis: zab lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo yar phyes: skal ldan thar pa'i lam la drongs mdzod: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i gnas nas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal de yis: zab lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo yar phyes: skal ldan thar pa'i lam la drongs mdzod: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i 'od klong : rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag drag rtsal de yis: zab lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo yar phyes: skal ldan thar pa'i lam la drongs mdzod: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i gnas nas: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de yis: zab lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo yar phyes: skal ldan thar pa'i lam la drongs mdzod: ces dang rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa ma nyams pa ni/

om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos sku yum chen mo la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: longs sku mthing 'od 'bar ma la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sku sprul rdo rje ḍāk+ki la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsung sprul pad+ma ḍāk+ki la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: thugs sprul gsang ba ye shes la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: yon tan rat+na ḍāk+ki la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs:

phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phrin las karma ḍāk+ki la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: rnal 'byor ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams gtso bo gu ru la bsdus shing*/ rang rig rnam shes gu ru'i thugs dang dbyer med du bsre ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: rigs 'dus he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: rnam shes dbu ma chos dbyings lam brgyud de: he ru ka yi thugs yid dbyer med shog: hika: phaṭḥ rang nyid la yin na hika dang gzhan la phaṭḥkyis 'phang bar bya'o/ dmigs pa ni/ phaṭ ces skar mda' chad pa ltar dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi gtsug gu ru pad+ma'i thugs kar bstim zhing*/ gu ru yang zhing khams su gshegs pa'am bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres la rgyun ring ka dag gi ngang du bzhag go /'pho rlung sbyong skabs yin na/ spyi gtsug bu ga he ru ka'i zhabs g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis/ dbu ma'i bu ga bkag par reg tsam dang ka zhes mar phab la snying dbus su bstim mo/ mthar rang nyid tshe dpag med kyi skur ldang la tshe sgrub dmigs gnad dang ldan pas tshe gzungs bzla ba dang*/

de'ang dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag par bya/ gzhan la gdab na bsngo ba dang smon lam sogs mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /de ltar gter gzhung rtsa ba dang chog khrigs 'dra min gnyis tsam snang ba rnams gung bsdebs/ 'khor lo'i mgon po nyi ma 'od zer nas 'di ga'i 'pho lung thob cing gzhon skabs cung zad sbyangs pa rnams/ ci dran man ngag gis zur brgyan te slad mar rgyun mi nyams pa'i ched nar 'gros kyi tshul du/ sgo chen sprul ming 'dzin pa'i rmongs brtul gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis/ rab byung bcu bdun me khyi lo dbo zla'i bcu bdun nyin sbyar bas/ yi ge'i 'du byed sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med kyis mdzad pa'i dge bas/ mgon med bar do'i sems can rnams rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ dag snang sgrol chog tshogs gnyis myur lam gsal byed kyis brgyan pa bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru ār+ya tā re ye/ /bla ma yum chen 'phags mar 'dud/ spyi don gsum gyi dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med par bcom ldan 'das ma mngon sum du bzhugs par bsam la/ kyaiḥ 'od dpag med mgon phyag gi dkyil 'khor dang : 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan las legs 'khrungs pa'i: ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i sprul gzhi myur zhi yum: bcom ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid nyer gcig gar: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las myur ma dpal: dbyer med rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rjer: phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: na moḥ skyabs yul rgya mtsho'i ngo bo rje btsun mar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba'i ma gyur 'gro: rje btsun 'phags ma'i go 'phang sgrub par bgyi: lan gsum/ hoḥ rje btsun 'phags ma rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung snying nas bshags: yi rang bskul zhing bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs:

dge tshogs 'phags ma'i go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo: gnyis pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnas yul rnam dag g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing : kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i bkang ba'i dbus: tāṃ: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs 'phags ma'i skur: gsal ba'i gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge dang : thugs srog 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas kun: rje btsun 'phags ma'i rnam par spyan drangs la: sgyu 'phrul lha mo nyer gcig rol gar bcas: dbang po mngon sum bzhin du lhun ner gsal: zhes mdun mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod bstod lan gsum bya dgos pa'i dang po ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang : bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs maṇ+ḍal 'bul: bdag gzhan myur du tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: 'di nas byang chub snying po thob kyi bar: 'bral med thugs rjes zungs shig rje btsun ma: bstod pa rgyas pa'am/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyan sngar thugs bskyed rgyal ba'i yum gyur ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las kun sgrub ma/ /myur ma dpa' mo dbyangs can ma dang bsod nams mchog gter rnam rgyal rig byed ma dang 'jigs byed ma/ /gzhan gyi mi thub gzhan las rgyal dang seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal nor ster ma/ /bkra shis don byed dgra dpung 'joms mdzad khro gnyer ldan mdzad rab zhi ma dang 'bar ba'i 'od can ma/ /dpag med gnon ma rma bya chen mo mi pham rgyal mo ri khrod ma dang 'od zer can mar 'dud/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol phyir byang chub thob 'dod bdag kyang khyod la re'o rje btsun ma/ zhes tshar gnyis brjod/ ces skyabs par zhal gyis bzhes nas phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi 'og tu bdag sogs 'khor bcas tshud par bsams la sngar bzhin mchod bstod gnyis pa la bstod pa gsum/ gsum pa la bstod pa bdun brjod rjes su gong gi kyaiḥ 'od dpag med mgon sogs nas dbang bskur stsol:

ces dang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gnas gsum las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser rim cig car: bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob: 'phags ma dgyes bzhin 'od zhu rang la thim: rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gsal bas: gsal stong zung 'jug don gyi 'phags mar blta: oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā: zhes bzlas/ gsum pa ni: om̐ pad+mo sa twa sa ma ya sogs nas sa twa āḥs nongs pa bshags/ hoḥ ma dag nyes tshogs 'phags ma'i spyan sngar 'chags: sgo gsum rnam dag ye shes lam la spyod: dus gsum dge tshogs zag med dbyings su bsngo: zung 'jug 'phags ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog: byang chub bar du bla ma rje btsun mas: 'bral med thugs rjes skyong ba'i bkra shis shog: ces pa'ang rgyun khyer dang grangs bsog la nye bar mkho phyir 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas phrin las kyi gnas chen seng rdzong gu ru'i bzhugs khri'i ke'u tshang nas gsal byed cung zad bcas bris pa sid+dhi rastu// // sgrol ma'i tshogs bsdus ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ tshogs gzhong rnam dag pad+ma 'bar ba ru/ /tshogs rdzas ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin/ /zag med 'dod yon rgyan gyi rol mo mchog /mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor gyur/ tāṃ/ po ṭa la sogs rab 'byams zhing kun nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur tā re ma/ /rnam 'phrul nyer gcig rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor sprin/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /'dod yon zag med tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /mi mthun 'gal 'khrul nyams chag nyes ltung bshags/ /gzung 'dzin nyon mongs ye shes chen por stobs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen dbab tu gsol/ /lhag ma bshal chur re kun mnyes shing tshim/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag sol/ 'jig brgyad zhi sogs las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /dag pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ye shes pa rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/

/slad nas dam tshig dbang gis 'byon mdzod la/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes su zungs/ /don gnyis bsam kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ ces pa'ang sgrub bla mgon po lha dar gyi bzhed skong du pad+ma rnam par rgyal bas bris pa dge/ // po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas/ /tāṃ yig ljang gu las 'khrungs shing*/ /taṃ yig 'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol/ /sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /kun nas dwang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul/ /'phags ma'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga/ /sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /so so'i skye bo la sogs pas/ /dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i/ /bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang*/ /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*/ /blo yi bye brag ji lta bar/ /che chung thun mong theg pa yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stongs bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ /sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol/ /bdag gi bsod nams ci bsags pa/ /thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas/ /ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi/ /'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ /dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'o/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig ni/ om̐/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ /spyan ni skad cig glog dang 'dra ma/

/'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi/ /ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma/ /phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun tu/ /gang ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i zhal ma/ /karma stong phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis/ /rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma/ /phyag 'tshal ser sngo chu las skyes kyi/ /pad+mas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma/ /sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zhi ba/ /bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyi ma/ /phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor/ /mtha' yas rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod ma/ /ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i/ /rgyal ba sras bcas shin tu bsten ma/ /phyag 'tshal tut+tā ra hūm̐ yi ges/ /'dod dang phyogs dang nam mkha' gang ma/ /'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyis mnan te/ /lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma/ /phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa/ /rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod ma/ /'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma/ /phyag 'tshal trad ces bya dang phaṭ kyis/ /pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis mnan te/ /me 'bar 'khrug pa shin tu 'bar ma/ /phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen po/ /bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma/ /chu skyes zhal ni khro nyer ldan mdzad/ /dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma/ /phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i/ /sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma/ /ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor lo brgyan pa'i/ /rang gis 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' bas brjid pa'i/ /dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreng ba spel ma/ /bzhad pa rab bzhad tut+tā ra yis/ /bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams/ /thams cad 'gugs par nus pa nyid ma/ khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūm̐ gis/ /phongs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma/ /phyag 'tshal zla ba'i dum bus dbu rgyan/ /brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma/

/ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med las/ /rtag par shin tu 'od rab mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal bskal pa mtha' ma'i me ltar/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na gnas ma/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dga'/ /dgra yi dpung ni rnam par 'joms ma/ /phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gi /mthil gyis bsnun cing zhabs kyis brdung ma/ khro gnyer can mdzad yi ge hūm̐ gis/ /rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma/ /phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma/ /mya ngan 'das zhi spyod yul nyid ma/ /swā hā om̐ dang yang dag ldan pas/ /sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i/ /dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma/ /yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ni bkod pa'i/ /rig pa hūm̐ las sgrol ma nyid ma/ phyag 'tshal tu re'i zhabs ni brdabs pas/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma/ /ri rab man dā ra dang 'bigs byed/ /'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba nyid ma/ /phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pas/ /ri dwags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma/ /tā ra gnyis brjod phaṭ kyi yi ges/ /dug rnams ma lus pa ni sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po/ /lha dang mi'am ci yis bsten ma/ /kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis/ /rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i/ /spyan gnyis po la 'od rab gsal ma/ /ha ra gnyis brjod tut+tā re yis/ /shin tu drag po'i rims nad sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pas/ /zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma/ /gdon dang ro langs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams/ /'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bstod pa 'di dang*/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig ༈ lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pa'i/ /blo ldan gang gi rab dad brjod pas/ /srod dang tho rangs langs par byas te/ /dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster/ /sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba/ /ngan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa nyid do/

/rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis/ /myur du dbang ni bskur bar 'gyur la/ /'di las che ba nyid ni 'thob cing*/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang mthar thug der 'gro/ /de yi dug ni drag po chen po/ /stan la gnas pa'am gzhan yang 'gro ba/ /zos pa dang ni 'thung pa nyid kyang*/ /dran pas rab tu sel ba nyid 'thob/ /gdon dang rims dang dug gis gzir ba'i/ /sdug bsngal tshogs ni rnam par spong ste/ /sems can gzhan pa rnams la yang ngo*/ /gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na/ /bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur zhing*/ /nor 'dod pas ni nor ni nyid 'thob/ /'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te/ /gegs rnams med cing so sor 'joms 'gyur/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so/ ༈ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ /sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol/ /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang*/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba mchog thob nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa la/ /bar chad gdon bgegs rims dang nad la sogs/ /dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ /'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las ni 'das pa yi/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i don rnams ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /sgrub la brtson zhing dam chos 'phel ba dang*/ /rtag tu khyod sgrub zhal mchog mthong ba dang*/ /stong nyid don rtogs byang sems rin po che/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces 'dod don gsol 'debs rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/

/rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /bzang spyod nas so/ bdag gis tshe rabs kun tu bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma/ /sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhing dpa'/ /yum gyur ut+pal bsnams pa'i bkra shis shog /'phags pa rin po che'i mdzad pa'o/ rgyal yum sgrol ma khyed sku ci 'dra dang*/ /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams su/ khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /mdo sde las byung ba'i tshig kha bsgyur ro/ khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang*/ /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ snying po la/ om̐ ta re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ om̐ tā re tāṃ swā hā/ ༈ sgrol ma dkar mo'i bstod pa ni/ om̐/ rje btsun ma 'phags sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma/ /mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog 'dra zhing*/ /zla ba la ni rgyab brten can/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcu drug lo lon lang tsho ldan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras/ /'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum/ /'phags ma sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor lo dkar mo'i 'od zer dkar/ /rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad/ /yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can/ /'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni ngag dbang grags pa'i rgya gzhung ngo*/

/zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la/ /rin chen me tog mang po gcal du bkram/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /yum gyur sgrol ma khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sho lo ka 'di las sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma/ /lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni/ /bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang*/ /nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las/ /nus ldan khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /'phags ma khyod la dad byed pa/ /de la rtag tu bu bzhin dgongs/ /bdag kyang khyod la gsol 'debs kyis/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol/ /lha mo sku mdog zla 'dra'i mdog /sgeg cing dul ba'i cha byad can/ /gzugs bzang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /mdzes pa dar gyi smad g.yogs can/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan dbus su/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bag can/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ /lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud/ khyod la bag tsam bstod pa ni/ /bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa la/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi gyur cig /mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par shog /ces 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ bar seng rnams su yang gdugs sher seng gsum tshe mdo gzungs tsakra bcu gsum pa rnams gsung srol ltar 'god pa la/ ༈ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i sgom bzlas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su bgrod pa'i gdams pa bya rgyal khyung gi rta pho bzhugs so/ na mo shākya mu na ye/ tshe dpag med pa'i yum mchog gos dkar mo/ /rab tu khros pa'i lha mo 'di yin pas/ /bde ba can du skye ba de yi don/ /ma mgon lcam dral dam la btags pa'i phyir/ /thub pa'i gtsug tor nas ni lha 'di sprul/ /byad kha zlog par zab pa'ang de yi don/

/zhal nas ma gsungs thub pa'i gtsug tor nas/ /mdo dang gzungs kyi sgra grags gtsug tor zer/ /'di nyid bya ba'i rgyud ni yin na yang*/ /bya rgyud bla med ltar du nyams len pa/ /dze tā ri dang rdo rje gdan pa sogs/ /grub chen mang pos mdzad ltar nyams len byed/ dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nas/ bi ma mi trar brgyud pa rnying ma'i lugs/ gu ru khrag 'thung nag po'i gter ma dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho brgya rtsa'i rgya gzhung dang*/ mthong ba don ldan dbang phyug rdo rje sogs/ bod gzhung tshad ma rnams kyi bcud bsdus te/ nyams len bde zhing byin rlabs che ba 'di/ nad gdon byad ka gtad gnan zlog pa la/ rdo rje pha lam ral gri nyid dang 'dra/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams bgrod 'dod na/ bya rgyal khyung chen chibs nas 'gro dang mtshungs/ de phyir 'di la rgyun du nyams len mdzod/ āḥ chos rnams smra bsam brjod med stong pa nyid/ /oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i gdugs dkar yongs gyur las/ /dran rdzogs dam ye dbyer med rang nyid ni/ /rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog chen mo'i sku/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar lha mo ni/ /dbu stong mdun zhal sgeg pa gnyis brgya dkar/ /g.yas zhal gnyis brgya 'jigs rung dgod pa ser/ /rgyab zhal dmar po nyis brgya gshe la rngam/ /g.yon zhal ljang gu nyis brgya snying rje zhi/ /steng zhal sngon po gnyis brgya drag la gtum/ /dbu rer rdo rje mtshan rtags spyan gsum gsum/ /sku mdog dkar zhing spyan mig bye ba 'bum/ /zur mig bgrad dang glog ltar drag tu gzigs/ /g.yas phyag lnga brgya g.yon phyag lnga brgya yis/ /thams cad bsam chod ral gri 'bar ba 'phyar/ /zhabs g.yas lnga brgya brkyang bas 'jigs kun mnan/ /zhabs g.yon lnga brgya bskum pas gdon kun mnan/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun cod pan 'chang*/ /dbu gtsug gdugs dkar bdun ni brtsegs mar 'khor/ /ba spu thams cad ye shes 'od zer 'bar/

/lha rdzas na bza' zhi khro'i rgyan dang ldan/ /dpral bar rnam snang thugs kar oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par snang mtha'i thugs kar āḥdamar po/ /thugs smad rdor sems thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ /thugs dbus zla steng oṃ yig dkar po'i mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od kyis sgrib bsal mthu stobs rgyas/ /ya so khro bcu ma so khro mo bcu/ /sma ra me dpung ral gri ngar ma'i lce/ /mgrin par nyi zla rang lus me dpung 'bar/ /gnod byed thams cad gzhob thul bsregs par gyur/ de yan chad mngon rtogs blo la ma zin kyang*/ dmigs pa bsgom pa kho nas chog pa ste/ bsgoms pa tsam gyis mnan gtad ngag mnan sogs/ grol bar gu ru khrag 'thung nag pos gsungs/ 'di ni ngag tu 'don pa gal che'o/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo/ /phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /rdo rje mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen pos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma/ kun nas bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la nyin dang mtshan du bsrung du gsol lo/ /tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badz+ra dha ra ni/ ban+dha ban+dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ ban+dha phaṭ/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ bdag dang bsrung bya'i lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa dang bcings pa thams cad phyes phyes/ khrol khrol/ mnan pa dang*/ bcings pa dang bsdams pa thams cad sarba a pā na ya swā hā/ zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar der rab bdun 'bring dang lnga tha ma tshar gsum tsam ni brjod pa'i rjes/ snying po ni/ nye snying sngags 'di nyid rang gi gang mos bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/

nye ba'i snying po'o/ /'di bar thal rdeb zlog pa bya bar spro na/ hūm̐/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs rnams/ /mthu stobs thogs pa mi mnga' zhing*/ /thugs rje'i smon lam mthu btsan pas/ /bdag gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol/ /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog /dgra 'dre'i bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog /mas kyi sri ru langs pa zlog /dpral ba'i gshed du bskos pa zlog /pha mes dur sri langs pa zlog /mi la nad du gtong ba zlog /phyugs la god kha byed pa zlog /gnam gyi dal kha thebs pa zlog /sa yi dug mda' g.yos pa zlog /sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog /skeg dang phung sri langs pa zlog /mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog gyur cig /ces pa 'di grub thob las kyi rdo rje'i mdzad pa'o/ 'di ltar sgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /mi gtsang lus 'di bor bar gyur ma thag /bde ba can du rdzus te skye bar shog /skye ma thag tu sa bcu rab bgrod nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /bde gshegs thub pa'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*/ /bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed tshar bcad nas/ /bde legs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde mchog gdugs dkar can gyis bkra shis shog /de nas sgom mkhan sems la hrig ger blta/ /ci yang ma mthong ngang du sa ler bzhag /rgyun du dmigs pa la sogs ma gsal kyang*/ /sngags thung gnyis po spyod lam kun tu 'don/ /kye ma sngon tshe bsod nams dman pa'i mthus/

/zos pa med cing mdo yig zer ba'i dpe/ /byas pa med kyang gtad yig nang du thim/ /ban bon mang po'i mthu gtad zhabs su song*/ /na tsha rkyen ngan mang pos rgyun du mnar/ /'chi ba dran cing dam chos 'dod na yang*/ /dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa'i skal pa med/ /nam 'chi cha med 'chi ba bzlog thabs med/ /shi nas gar 'gro cha med a tsa ma/ /rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal che/ /de 'dra yid la dran mkhan mi yod na/ /gdams pa 'di la rgyun du yi dam mdzod/ /sngon tshe chos rgyal khri srung lde'u btsan gyis/ /mtha' dbus mkhas pa brgya rtsa gdan drangs nas/ /bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur thams cad bod du bsgyur/ de dus rgyal po'i byad bzlog la/ /bka' 'gyur nang nas 'di las zab ma rnyed/ /rgyal po'i byad bzlog sku rim 'di la byas/ /rgya gar mu stegs rgya nag hwa shang dang*/ /bod kyi bon pos brub kyang gnod ma nus/ /dus phyis sog po o red rgyal po'i des/ /'di la rgyun du thugs dam zhal 'don mdzad/ /dkar bstan rtsad nas brlag kyang gnod ma thub/ /de phyir byad bzlog 'di las zab pa med/ /gzhan yang 'di yi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i don/ /shin tu bsdus te tshigs su bcad smras pa/ /sangs rgyas bye ba grangs med du ma yi/ /byin rlabs bsod nams rang gis thob par gsungs/ /mtshams med lnga dang las kyi sgrib pa rnams/ /thams cad ma lus byang zhing dag par 'gyur/ /rang gi tshe dang bsod nams stobs cher 'phel/ /nam zhig 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /bde ba can gyi zhing der skye bar gsungs/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen bzlog phyi ma zhing khams thob/ /phyir mi ldog pa gtan gyi 'dun ma ste/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob la thag nye ba/ /'di 'dra rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /rā ga ā s+yas gzhung dang man ngag bsdebs/ /pad+ma mthar phyin zhes byas yi ger bris/ /'di la sngags sgra ma dag 'gal 'khrul sogs/

/mchis na ye shes spyan ldan rnams la bshags/ /dge bas 'gro kun bar chad rkyen zhi nas/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /skyes nas gzhan don dpag med 'grub par shog maṅga laṃ// ༈ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i snying po bzhugs so/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wa ti pra dz+nyā pā ra mi ta hri da ya/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ bam po gcig go /bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa nyid la rnam par blta zhing*/ phung po lnga po de dag la yang rang bzhin gyis stong par rnam par blta'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des ji ltar bslab par bya/ de skad ces smras pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis tshe dang ldan pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shā ri'i bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des 'di ltar rnam par blta bar bya ste/

phung po lnga po de dag kyang rang bzhin gyis stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no/ /stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa rnams stong pa'o/ shā ri'i bu de ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid de/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma dang bral ba med pa/ bri ba med pa/ gang ba med pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na stong pa nyid la gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ 'du byed med/ rnam par shes pa med/ mig med/ rna ba med/ sna med/ lce med/ lus med/ yid med/ gzugs med/ sgra med/ dri med/ ro med/ reg bya med/ chos med do/ /mig gi khams med pa nas yid kyi khams med/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du yang med do/ /ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas/ rga shi med/ rga shi zad pa'i bar du yang med do/ /de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba dang*/ kun 'byung ba dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ lam med ye shes med/ thob pa med/ ma thob pa yang med do/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' rnams thob pa med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten cing gnas te/ sems la sgrib pa med pas skrag pa med de/ phyin ci log las shin tu 'das nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to/ dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags/ rigs pa chen po'i sngags/ bla na med pa'i sngags/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam par byed pa'i sngags/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ mi brdzun pas na bden par shes par bya ste/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags smras pa/ tad+ya thā/ 'di lta ste om̐ ga te ga te gshegs ma gshegs ma pā ra ga te pha rol tu gshegs ma pā ra saṃ ga te pha rol tu yang dag par gshegs ma bo dhi swā hā/ byang chub gzhi tshugs/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ legs so legs so/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji ltar khyod kyis bstan pa bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la spyad par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo rdzogs so/ na mo/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi bden pa'i tshig rnams 'grub par gyur cig /ji ltar sngon lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don zab mo yid la bsams shing*/ tshig kha ton du byas pa la brten nas bdud sdig can la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don zab mo yid la bsams shing tshig kha ton du byas pa la brten nas bdud sdig can la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig

/med par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*/ /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ /spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang sogs bya'o/ /de nas/ ༈ seng gdong ma'i bzlog pa ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i lha mo ni/ /drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can/ /ye shes me yi 'od zer 'phro/ /seṅge'i gdong can lha mor 'dud/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ ci mang bzlas/ mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can khyod kyi rigs sngags bzlas pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen/ mdor na bkra mi shis pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs dag ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag yid gsum rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ khyod kyi rigs sngags bzlas pa'i mthus/ /gnod byed ma lus zhi ba dang*/ /ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ ces pa 'di yang rje btsun mi bskyod rdo rjes so/ /dge'o// // ༈ sri bzlog tsakra bcu gsum pa'i gzungs ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thā/ om̐ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni ye swā hā/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung ba dang*/ skyabs pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ sri ngan pa thams cad las thar bar mdzad du gsol/ du ru du ru tsakra/ dza ya dza ya tsakra/ ha na ha na tsakra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya tsakra/

ghin du ma le e nan tsakra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la tsakra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ tsakra/ sarba sha gi ni a pa ra ṇa tsakra/ bha la ya bha la ya tsakra/ na ga sha ya na ga sha ya tsakra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ tsakra/ bha ma bha ma tsakra/ sa man+ta ka ra tsa tri ti ni ga na tsakra/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ chos mdzad pa dang*/ dkar po'i phyogs mtha' yas pa la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig /thul cig /rkyen dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog cig /byer cig /srungs shig /nad sri dang*/ 'chi sri dang*/ god sri dang*/ rta sri dang*/ yer ba'i sri dang*/ lo'i sri dang*/ zla ba'i sri dang*/ zhag dus kyi sri dang*/ kha smras kyi sri dang*/ sri ngan pa thams cad zlog cig /gzhan yang sri ngan pa thams cad las rnam pa kun tu srungs shig /zlog cig /zhi bar gyur cig /bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ nad rims dang*/ gdon dang*/ sngags zor dang*/ rbad 'dre dang*/ rbod gtong dang*/ glo bur gyi nad dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa dang*/ phyogs ngan pa dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ na sri dang*/ 'chi sri dang*/ dur sri dang*/ rgan sri dang*/ gzhon sri dang*/ dar mi'i sri dang*/ lo'i sri dang*/ zla ba'i sri dang*/ zhag gi sri dang*/ za ma'i sri dang*/ skag bdun zur dang*/ phyi rkyen dang*/ gdon sum brgya drug cu dang*/ rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dang*/ ltas ngan mi mthun pa brgyad cu rtsa gcig gis gnod pa thams cad dang*/ ma rungs pa dang*/ gdug pa can thams cad 'joms par gyur cig /bzlog par gyur cig /bsgyur bar gyur cig /bsrung bar gyur cig /thub par gyur cig /de ltar brjod pas yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ sri yi gnod pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang*/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /tsakra bcu gsum pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/

༈ mi kha dgra zlog bzhugs so/ rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug gshin rje gshed/ /rtsa gsum chos skyong bcas pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i/ /mi kha gleng gzhi smra brjod ngan pa kun/ /skye med chos nyid stong pa brjod bral klong*/ /bzlog go ye shes 'bar ba'i mtshon gyis zlog /bsgyur ro snang srid bde chen klong du sgyur/ /brjod pa'i sgra kun rgyal kun gsung rdo rje/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal ya ma ri/ /ye shes mchog gi ngo bor byin brlabs nas/ /bkra shis bde legs phyogs las rnam rgyal mdzod/ /om̐ wā gī shwa ri mūm̐/ om̐ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ mi kha smra brjod ngan pa thams cad bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog /ces 'di nyer mkho'i ched klong chen ye shes rdo rjes bkas bskul bzhin maṅga las gang shar smras pa'o// // ༈ rgya nag skag zlog bsdus pa bzhugs so/ smra ba'i seṅges bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sri keg than ltas ngan pa bsgyur du gsol/ /rgyal po'i chad pa phas kyi 'jigs pa sogs/ /mtshang 'bru rtsod dang rgol ba bzlog tu gsol/ ces mi pham pas so// // ༈ rdo rje sder mo bsdus pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum dang khro mo rdo rje sder mo la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag cag la nad thams cad dang*/ gdon thams cad dang*/ rkyen ngan pa thams cad dang*/ bar chad thams cad dang*/ bsam pa ngan zhing sbyor ba rtsub pa/ rje dpon dang*/ yul mis dgra bsdo ba dang*/ pha mtshan dang*/ spun zla dang*/ zhang nye dang*/ ma sru dang*/ grogs po dang*/ mag pa dang*/ tsha yug dang*/ bran 'khor dang*/ khyim mtshes sogs dgra sdang ba thams cad rigs sngags 'dis bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /tho bas brdung ngo*/ /phyag rgyas mnan no/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra ṇāṃ/ oṃ gha gha ghā tā ya ghā tā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya/

bdag cag la snga dgra lag tu brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra khyi ltar zug pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad phaṭ phaṭ/ kī li kī lā ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra dha rod adz+nyā pa ya ti kā ya wāk+tsit+ta/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ om̐ a kro de ka murka ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ om̐ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na ha na da ha da ha/ pa tsa bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bho dha ri u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭ/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i rdo rje sder mo khyod/ /mkha' mnyam bde la rol mdzad khro mo'i sku/ /chags pa'i mdangs kyis khro bo'i sku la 'khril/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ rā ga a s+yas sbyar ba'o/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /gnod 'dzin sder mo drag shul can/ khyod la 'dud do dgra dpung choms/ /sdang ba thams cad med par mdzod/ ces pa 'di yang mkha' spyod gling pas so// // ༈ thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus o rgyan sman lha'i rgyun khyer bsdus pa ni/ hrīḥ baiḍūr+ya yi mdwangs ldan 'chi med tshe yi lha: dug gsum nad sel pad 'byung sman pa'i mchog: rnam rgyal phyag mtshan skye 'gro'i tshad gdung sel: o rgyan sman gyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes dang*/ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: zhes grangs mang dang*/ sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru baiḍūr+ya/ pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+yathā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye/ ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring ngam/ /yang na/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye/ ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ ci nus bzlas/

dge ba 'di sogs bsngo ba bya'o/ gter gzhung nas khol du phyung ba'o// // ༈ lo gyon ma ni/ oṃ/ rje btsun lo gyon lha mor phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon gyi thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin/ /'jig rten khams kyi sems can sdug bsngal ba'i/ /nad kun zhi zhing tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇa ye swā hā/ ces pa'ang slob dpon skal ldan ngor kā ma la rā dza dī pas so// // ༈ mdo las byung ba'i tshe gzungs ni/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi mchog /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyān su bi nish+tsita te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ya dz+nyā na sam+bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dha ngharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ lo brgya thub cing ston brgy sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ /bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*/ /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa ste/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ // ༈ snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin chen bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen 'bar ba dbang gi pho brang du/ /bde stong so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes sku/ /ma chags bde ldan pad+ma'i rang bzhin las/ /rdo rje nyi ma snang ba chen po'i dpal/ /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje chos/ /'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rjes rjes chags gzugs/ /pad+ma rgyal pos 'khor 'das mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /snang srid zil gnon dbang chen he ru ka

/gsang ba ye shes badz+ra wā ra hī/ /bde mchog 'dod pa'i rgyal po bde chen gter/ /ma lus skye dgu'i yid 'phrog rig byed ma/ /mchog thun phyag rgya'i dbang phyug bde stong gar/ /dbang mdzad rdo rje dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs/ /snang stong mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nyid du/ /rdo rje sku yi gar gyis srid gsum g.yo/ /'gags med gsung gi bzhad sgras khams gsum 'gugs/ /'od zer dmar pos 'khor 'das yongs la khyab/ /srid zhi'i dwangs bcud g.yo zhing sdud par byed/ /rdo rje chags pa chen po'i thugs kyis ni/ /rnam gnyis dngos grub 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol zhing*/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa chen po yis/ /snang srid bde ba chen por sdom byed pa/ mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar can/ /til gyi gong bu phye ba bzhin bzhugs pa'i/ /rab 'byams rtsa gsum dbang gi lha tshogs la/ /gus pas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'dod rgu'i dpal mtha' dag /thogs med dbang du byed pa'i dngos grub stsol/ ces pa'ang rab tshes sa yos zla7tshes1la dhī ming pas spel/ gsol ba btab na gang zag su yang rung ste dbang gi las kun ji ltar bsam pa bzhin 'grub par gdon mi za'o/ /dar dmar la bris te phyar ba'am/ me rlung la 'khor lo byas kyang 'grub bo/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ cho ga spyi'i zur rgyan sna tshogs rat+na'i mgul chun yan lag nyer mkho dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ 'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ las gang zhig rtsom pa'i thog mar 'di tshar gcig brjod na grub pa bde ba yid bzhin du byed par 'gyur bas ci nas yid la bya'o/ /om̐/ snang srid rnam dag rang bzhin lhun grub pa'i/ /bkra shis phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /kun la phyag 'tshal bdag cag bkra shis shog /sgron me'i rgyal po rtsal brtan don 'grub dgongs/
