/byams pa'i rgyan dpal dge grags dpal dam pa/ /kun la dgongs pa rgya cher grags pa can/ /lhun po ltar 'phags rtsal grags dpal dang ni/ /sems can thams cad la dgongs grags pa'i dpal/ /yid tshim mdzad pa rtsal rab grags dpal te/ /mtshan tsam thos pas bkra shis dpal 'phel ba/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po byams pa'i dpal/ /sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'phags mchog kun tu bzang*/ /ut+pal rdo rje pad dkar klu shing dang*/ /nor bu zla ba ral gri nyi ma yi/ /phyag mtshan legs bsnams bkra shis dpal gyi mchog /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen gdugs mchog bkra shis gser gyi nya/ /'dod 'byung bum bzang yid 'ong ka ma la/ /snyan grags dung dang phun tshogs dpal be'u/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan dbang bsgyur 'khor lo ste/ /rin chen rtags mchog brgyad kyi phyag mtshan can/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes bskyed ma/ /sgeg sogs ngo bo dran pas dpal spel ba'i/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa chen po bde 'byung sred med bu/ /mig stong ldan dang rgyal po yul 'khor srung*/ /'phags skyes po dang klu dbang mig mi bzang*/ /rnam thos sras te lha rdzas 'khor lo dang*/ /tri shul la dang mdung thung rdo rje can/ /pi waṃ ral gri mchod rten rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /sa gsum gnas su dge legs bkra shis spel/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag cag deng 'dir bya ba rtsom pa la/ /gegs dang nye bar 'tshe ba kun zhi nas/ /'dod don dpal 'phel bsam don yid bzhin 'grub/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /ldang tshe brjod na de nyin don kun 'grub/ /nyal tshe brjod na rmi lam bzang por mthong*/ /g.yul du 'jug tshe brjod na phyogs las rgyal/

/bya ba brtsam dus brjod na 'dod don 'phel/ /rgyun du brjod na tshe dpal grags 'byor shis/ /bde legs phun tshogs bsam don yid bzhin 'grub/ /sdig sgrib kun byang mngon mtho nges legs kyi/ don kun 'grub pa rgyal ba mchog gis gsungs/ /rab tshes me sprel lor rgyu skar rgyal gyi dus bzang po'i cha la 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i yid mtsho las byung ba'i nor bu'i do shal chen po maṅga laṃ// // ༈ tshig bdun gsol 'debs pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i lugs srol byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba ni/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes lan gsum bya: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐:badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥsarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ gu ru mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: bdag cag mos pa'i bu rnams la: lus la sku yis byin gyis rlobs/ ngag la gsung gis byin gyis rlobs/ yid la thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ dbang bzhi bskur bar byin gyis rlobs/ sgrib bzhi dag par byin gyis rlobs/ lam bzhi 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ sku bzhi thob par mdzad du gsol/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhe wa dhak+ki ni: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca om̐: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter ston bde chen gling pa'i gter ma'o/

de nas thub pa'i mdzad bcu'i bstod pa che ba ni/ thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /gzhan gyi mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ /gser ri lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis dang por byang chub thugs bskyed nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad cing*/ /dus 'dir mdzad pa rgya cher 'gro ba yi/ /mgon gyur khyod la bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ /lha rnams don mdzad 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas/ /lha las babs nas glang chen ltar gshegs shing*/ /rigs la gzigs nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma'i/ /lhums su zhugs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba bcu rdzogs shākya'i sras po ni/ /bkra shis lum+bi'i tshal du bltams pa'i tshe/ /tshangs dang brgya byin gyis btud mtshan mchog ni/ /byang chub rigs su nges mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu stobs ldan mi yi seṅge des/ /a gha ma ga dhar ni sgyu rtsal bstan/ /skye bo dregs pa can rnams tshar bcad nas/ /'gran zla med par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten chos dang mthun par bya ba dang*/ kha na ma tho spang phyir btsun mo yi/ /'khor dang ldan mdzad thabs la mkhas pa yi/ /rgyal srid skyong bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i bya ba snying po med gzigs nas/ khyim nas byung ste mkha' la gshegs nas kyang*/ /mchod rten rnam dag drung du nyid la nyid/ /rab tu byung bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtson pas byang chub 'grub par dgongs nas ni/ /nai rañja na'i 'gram du lo drug tu/ /dka' ba spyad mdzad brtson 'grus mthar phyin pas/ /bsam gtan mchog brnyes mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog ma med nas 'bad pa don yod phyir/ /ma ga dha yi byang chub shing drung du/ /skyil krung mi g.yo mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /byang chub rdzogs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes 'gro la myur du gzigs nas ni/ /wā rā ṇa sī la sogs gnas mchog tu/

/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas gdul bya rnams/ /theg pa gsum la 'god mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyis rgol ba ngan pa tshar bcad phyir/ /mu stegs ston pa drug dang lhas byin sogs/ /'khor mo 'jig gi yul du bdud rnams btul/ /thub pa g.yul las rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa gsum na dpe med yon tan gyi/ /mnyan du yod par cho 'phrul chen po bstan/ /lha mi 'gro ba kun gyis rab mchod pa/ /bstan pa rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /le lo can rnams chos la bskul bya'i phyir/ /rtswa mchog grong gi sa gzhi gtsang ma ru/ /'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i sku gshegs nas/ /mya ngan 'da' bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag nyid du 'jig pa med phyir dang*/ /ma 'ongs sems can bsod nams thob bya'i phyir/ /de nyid du ni ring bsrel mang sprul nas/ /sku gdung cha brgyad mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub bstod chung ba ni/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ /sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas/ /nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs/ /de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po dga' ldan lha yi yul du byon/ /rgyal po'i khab tu yum gyi lhums su zhugs/ /lum+bi ni yi tshal du thub pa bltams/ /bcom ldan lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhal yas khang du ma ma brgyad bzhis mchod/ /shākya'i grong du gzhon nus rol rtsed mdzad/ /ser skya'i gnas su sa 'tsho khab tu bzhes/ /srid gsum mtshungs med sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grong khyer sgo bzhir skyo ba'i tshul bstan nas/ /mchod rten rnam dag drung nas dbu skra bsil/ /nai rañja na'i 'gram du dka' thub mdzad/ /sgrib gnyis skyon dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po'i khab tu glang chen smyon pa btul/ /yangs pa can du spre'us sbrang rtsi phul/ /ma ga dha ru thub pa mngon sangs rgyas/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /wā rā ṇa sīr chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/

/dze ta'i tshal du cho 'phrul chen po bstan/ /rtswa mchog grong du dgongs pa mya ngan 'das/ /thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /mdzad pa'i tshul la mdo tsam bstod pa yi/ /dge bas 'gro ba kun gyi spyod pa yang*/ /bde gshegs nyid kyi mdzad dang mtshungs par shog /bde bar gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*/ /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*/ khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad gdon dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang*/ /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ ༈ e ma hoḥ spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su: chos nyid dus gsum skye 'gag med pa'i ngang : bya bral lhun rdzogs bde ba chen po'i sku: nam mkha' bzhin du thugs rje phyogs ris med: bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams su: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: ye shes lnga ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i sku: thugs rje'i bye brag sna tshogs so sor ston: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: mi mjed 'jig rten dag pa'i zhing khams su: thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la byon: gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: ༈ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa yis: rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje dang : shrī singha'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? ༈ 'di ltar mig gi yul du snang ba yi:

phyi nang snod bcud dngos po thams cad kun: snang yang bdag 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog: gzung 'dzin dag pa gsal stong lha yi sku: 'dod chags rang grol gyi bla ma la gsol: o rgyan? 'di ltar rna ba'i yul du grags pa yi: snyan dang mi snyan 'dzin pa'i sgra rnams kun: grags stong bsam mno bral ba'i ngang la zhog: grags stong skye 'gag med pa rgyal ba'i gsung : grags stong rgyal ba'i gsung la gsol? o rgyan? 'di ltar yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi: nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang : sngon bsu rjes dpyod blo yis bcos mi gzhug: 'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol: rig pa rang grol gyi bla ma la gsol? o rgyan? phyi ltar gzung ba'i yul snang dag pa dang : nang ltar 'dzin pa'i sems nyid grol ba dang : bar du 'od gsal rang ngo shes pa ru: dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs rje yis: bdag 'dra'i rang rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs: ༈ rdzogs pa chen po thod rgal gsol 'debs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs so/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs so/ /ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gu ru shrī singha la la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /'chi med pad+ma 'byung la gsol ba 'debs so/ /lha lcam man+da ra ba la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la gsol ba 'debs so/ /gter ston brgya dang rtsa brgyad la gsol ba 'debs so/ /drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dag pa rig 'dzin yab yum la la gsol ba 'debs so/ /'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu la gsol ba 'debs so/ /chos bdag mkha' 'gro sde lnga la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so/

/chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar byin gyis rlobs shig /nyams snang gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs shig /rig pa tshad la phebs par byin gyis rlobs shig /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs shig /'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /'pho ba chen po 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs shig /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig /ces pa 'di rdzogs chen pad+ma rig 'dzin gyis ri dam gangs kyi 'dam khrod du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ o rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ e ma hoḥ chos sku kun bzang drug pa rdo rje 'chang : ston pa rdor sems bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal: mgon po tshe dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs: dbyer med pad+ma de la gsol ba 'debs: sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: gsung gi bdag nyid dbang chen rta skad 'tsher: thugs kyi bdag nyid yang dag he ru kaḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bu la gsol ba 'debs: yon tan zil gnon che mchog he ru kaḥ phrin las bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mngon rdzogs rgyal: dpal chen thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs: sku yi dbyings su sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i ngang : gsung gi gdangs skad yan lag bcu gnyis ldan: thugs kyi dgongs pa zang thal yongs la khyab: mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo rje la gsol ba 'debs: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: thugs kyi dgongs pa las can bu la gtad: brtse bas zhal chems bod 'bangs yongs la bzhag: drin can sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: bka' drin dran no gu ru rin po che: thugs dam zhal bzhes dgongs pas bzung du gsol: dus ngan 'di la re ltos gzhan ma mchis: thugs rjes gzigs shig o rgyan sprul pa'i sku: mthu rtsal nus pas dus ngan g.yo 'khrugs zlog: byin rlabs ye shes dbang chen bskur du gsol:

nyams dang rtogs pa'i rtsal shugs rgyas pa dang : bstan 'gror phan pa'i mthu rtsal rab ldan cing : tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zab pa skor bdun las: rnam thar dpag bsam ljon shing las khol du phyung ba'o// // ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan bzhugs so: bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra kho mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: gu ru rje la bka' gnang legs zhus te: sngon 'gro skyabs yul theg chen rim dgu brtsams: sa ma ya: dang po rang nyid rnam snang ldan pa'i lus zungs dang : dang po sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ mtha' yas sems can bde dang ldan: sdug bsngal srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol: don gnyis bde dang mi 'bral zhing : rtag par chos 'khor bskor du gsol: gnyis pa skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni: na mo hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud ye nas zang thal ngang : rang lus rnam dag ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: dbu ma bde chen 'khor lo'i spyi gtsug dbus: pad+ma nyi zla thabs shes spel ba'i steng : rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan lha lcam zung 'jug 'khril: de yi spyi bor rigs bdag rdo rje sems: dkar gsal mdangs ldan rdor dril yum 'khyud bsnol: de yi spyi bor ka dag kun tu bzang : mthing 'od mnyam bzhag bzang mo bde stong 'khril: skyabs yul rnam gsum longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: dkyil 'khor gtso bo rang rang phyag mtshan ldan: g.yas su rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : dgongs brgyud gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang : mthing nag rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs: ston pa sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: rgyab tu pad+ma nyi zla'i khri 'phang steng : las dbang mkha' 'gro mthing ka thabs shes phyag: brda brgyud slob dpon mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: g.yon du rin chen khri 'phang dar 'bol steng :

sangs rgyas ye shes he ru ka pa'i chas: dmar smug rdo rje phur pa 'dril thabs gdeng : snyan brgyud grub thob rje 'bangs 'bum gyis bskor: mdun du sna tshogs pad+ma byol song khrir: che mchog smug nag gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril: rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin cing bka' brgyad lha: de yi phyi rim phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang : byang sems rig 'dzin brgyud bcas 'bum gyis bskor: mkha' la shar ba'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ltar: dran rdzogs rtse gcig snang stong lam gyis gsal: de yi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas rnams: mos gus gdung shugs gsol ba 'debs pa yis: byin rlabs 'bad med thugs rjes rlabs chen spyod: dkyil 'khor gtso bo gcig dril deng 'dir bsgrub: ces mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis: dang po bla ma chos sku'i gsol 'debs ni: na mo hūm̐: e ma hoḥ chos dbyings ka dag lhun grub pho brang nas: kun bzang thog ma'i mgon por skyabs su mchi: ye shes lnga ldan ma 'gags pho brang nas: rdor sems longs spyod rdzogs la skyabs su mchi: sna tshogs rang shar rdzu 'phrul pho brang nas: sprul sku thod phreng rtsal la skyabs su mchi: gcig shes kun grol lta ba'i pho brang nas: brda brgyud mtsho rgyal sku l bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod chen po ru: pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku l ra ga ra ti'i gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: blo ldan mchog sred sku l bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod chen po ru: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku l dur khrod so sa gling gi gnas mchog tu: nyi ma 'od zer sku l za hor siṃ ha gsang ba'i brag phug nas: shākya seṅge'i sku l rdo rje gdan gyi gnas mchog dam pa ru: seṅge sgra sgrogs sku l stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub gnas mchog tu: rdo rje gro lod rtsal l chos sku longs sku sprul sku yang sprul la: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

de nas rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi gsol 'debs ni: dbyangs snyan po'i 'di ltar gdab: na mo hūm̐: bskal pa dpag med bkod pa nam mkha'i khyon: ye shes rdo rje rig pa'i khye'u chung : mngon rdzogs ston pa de la skyabs su mchi: tshe lo bye ba mi mjed 'jig rten khams: ston pa mi 'khrugs pa l tshe lo 'bum phrag drod gsher 'jig rten du: ston pa 'jigs pa skyob l tshe lo brgyad khri mngal skyes gnas mchog tu: gzhon nu rnam par rol l tshe lo bdun khri sum cu rtsa gsum na: ston pa rdor 'chang sku l tshe lo drug khri gsang chen me ri 'bar: gzhon nu stobs ldan ston par? tshe lo khri phrag srin yul ru lu'i gling : drang srong khro rgyal ston par? tshe lo lnga stong rdo rje yangs pa can: ston pa gser 'od dam par skyabs su mchi: tshe lo stong phrag sog po g.yu smin yul: ston pa blo gros rgyal bar? tshe lo lnga brgya bya rgod phung ri ru: ston pa 'od srung de l tshe lo sum brgya rdo rje gdan drung du: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas de l tshe lo brgya phrag wā rā ṇa sī ru: ston pa shākya thub par? ma la ri bo gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: ston pa rdo rje chos l dkar me gcig la gnyis mched snang tshul bzhin: sgrol ma brgya rtsa brgyad l byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i bla ma mchog: nye ba'i sras chen brgyad l dgongs pa zab mo klong yangs nam mkha'i khyon: sa bcu lam lnga thogs med bgrod par shog: de nas rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni: na mo hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos rang gsal skye med klong : sna tshogs gar mkhan byed las rnam sprul pa: las kyi dbang mo'i sku l dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog tu: slob dpon hūm̐ chen sku l sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: mañju shrī'i sku l dur khrod laṅka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: nā gardzu ni sku l

pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: pra bha hastī'i sku l lhun grub gter gyi dur khrod gnas mchog tu: bi ma mi tra'i sku l gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod gnas mchog tu: dha na saṃ skṛ'i sku l he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod gnas mchog tu: rom+bu gu h+ya'i sku l dur khrod 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: shān+tiṃ gar+bha'i sku l snang srid klong yangs ye shes gcig tu shar: dgongs brgyud rdo rje sems dpar? mtshon byed ri mo snang ba'i grwa zur tsam: brda brgyud dga' rab rdo rjer? nyi ma gcig la mched pa'i 'bum phrag dbyibs: snyan brgyud mañju shrīr? brda bzhi dgongs pa bka' bab rten 'brel snod: tshig brgyud shrī singhar? smin grol dbang bzhi gsang ba shog ser mdzod: go byi de ma'i sku l rgyud lung dgongs pa gcig shes kun du grol: las kyi slob dpon sku l byin rlabs nus pa'i sprin phung cher g.yos nas: dbang bzhi grol lam thob par byin gyis rlobs: de nas gang zag snyan brgyud kyi gsol 'debs ni: na mo hūm̐: kun tshang lhun grub snang srid bden gnyis dbyings: rgyal sras tshul byon rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : brda yi gsang mdzod ye shes mtsho rgyal lcam: thun mong ma yin snying nas? sangs rgyas ye shes brag la phur pa btab: nam mkha'i snying po nyi ma'i zer la chibs: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs: bla med rnal 'byor gsum l dpal gyi ye shes ma mo bran du khol: dpal gyi seṅges lha srin dam la btags: bai ro tsa na sgra tshad mtha' ru phyin: lta ba mthar phyin gsum l khri srong lde'u btsan mi g.yo ting 'dzin rnyed: g.yu sgra snying po rtogs pa mngon du gyur: dz+nyā na ku mās brag la bdud rtsi 'byin: sgom pa mthar phyin gsum l rdo rje bdud 'joms drag sngags mtha' ru phyin: ye shes dbyings ni mkha' spyod gnas su 'phur:

sog po lha dpal gdug pa'i gcan gzan 'dzin: spyod pa mthar phyin gsum l sna nam ye shes bya ltar thogs med lding : dpal gyi dbang phyug phur pa gdeng tshad gum: ldan ma rtse mang mi brjed gzungs rnams thob: 'bras bu klong gyur gsum l ska ba dpal brtsegs gzhan gyi shes rgyud mthong : shud bu dpal seng chu bo gyen du bzlog: rgyal ba'i blo gros ro langs gser du bsgyur: gzhi yi klong gyur gsum l khye'u chung lo tsās nam mkha'i bya rnams 'dzin: dran pa nam mkhas byang g.yag dbus su 'gugs: 'o bran dbang phyug chu la nya ltar 'dzul: lam mchog mthar phyin gsum l rma thog rin chen pha wang zan ltar rol: dpal gyi rdo rje ri brag thogs med bgrod: rgyal ba byang chub nam mkhar skyil krung bzhugs: lang 'gro dkon mchog nam mkha'i thog rgod 'phen: rtogs pa mngon gyur bzhi l rig 'dzin 'dus pa dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i mdzod: snyan brgyud 'bras bu mi brjed dran pa thob: thugs rje nus rtsal phrin las stobs kyis phyug: snyan brgyud rje 'bangs rnams l brda bzhi klong du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs: de nas tshig brgyud shog ser brgyud pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni: na mo hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: che mchog zhi khro'i sku la skyabs su mchi: me long ye shes e yi pho brang nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha l mnyam nyid ye shes e yi pho brang nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha l sor rtog ye shes e yi pho brang nas: pad+ma gsung gi lha l bya grub ye shes e yi pho brang nas: phrin las phur pa'i lha l snang stong lhun grub e yi pho brang nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha l grags stong ye shes e yi pho brang nas: bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs la skyabs su mchi: gsal stong ye shes e yi pho brang nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha l bde stong ye shes e yi pho brang nas:

dmod pa drag sngags lha l rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang bstan pa'i bya ra ba: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sku l dkyil 'khor gsang ba gdams pa'i srog 'dzin pa: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i sku l smon lam dbang chen mi brjed gzungs bzhi thob: rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal l 'brel tshad don ldan tshogs gnyis mtha' ru phyin: tshig brgyud shog ser brgyud par? don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas dbang lung khrid kyi brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni: na mo hūm̐: 'khor 'das snod bcud dag pa lha yi zhing : gzugs rnams yi dam sgra grags chos dbyings gdangs: dran rig 'od gsal stong nyid lhag ge ba: dbang bzhi theg pa'i rim par gsol ba 'debs: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun tshogs kyi mchog: phyi yi skyabs yul rnams l bla ma rnams dang yi dam mkha' 'gro ste: nang gi skyabs yul rnams l chos sku longs sku sprul sku rnam pa gsum: gsang ba'i skyabs yul rnams l rtsa dang rlung dang bde chen thig le gsum: don gyi skyabs yul rnams l lta ba dang ni sgom pa spyod pa gsum: lam gyi skyabs yul rnams l gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu rnam pa gsum: grogs kyi skyabs yul rnams l ngo bo dang ni rang bzhin thugs rje gsum: gzhi yi skyabs yul rnams l bde dang gsal dang ting 'dzin mi rtog gsum: khregs chod skyabs yul rnams l de ltar skyabs mchis gsol btab gdung ba'i mod: phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras brgyud bcas ma lus pa: skyabs yul lnga tshom sku la rim par thim: lnga ldan rnams kyang gtso bo gu rur thim: 'od du zhu nas sku gsung thugs yon tan: byin rlabs yi ge 'bru lnga spyi bor thim: tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun ltem gyis gang : ka dag zang thal gsal stong 'od lnga yi: rang bzhin 'bar ba 'od gsal snying por gyur: kā ya sid+dhi om̐: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sa ma ya a we sha ya a āḥ

zhes dmigs pa rnams gzhung gi tshig ltar bya: dbang bzhi blang : tha ma spros bral 'od kyi gong bu can gyi rang bzhin du bzhag go: sa ma ya: s+yaṃ3 bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: dkyil 'khor kun gyi sngon 'gro'i phyir: skyabs yul rim pa e ma hoḥ thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dbyair chai+ai+ai+ai+ai: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas sbas yul pad+ma rong nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o: dge'o// // ༈ o rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i 'khrungs rabs bsdus pa bcu gsum ma snang gsal me long bzhugs so/ e ma ho/ 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i klong yangs nas/ /kun bzang thog ma'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang*/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /longs sku rtsal snang 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /de drung khye'u lha bu 'od zer zhes/ /nyi zla'i zer chibs drwa ba'i rnal 'byor ston/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'od srung mdun du dge slong ku sa li/ /phar phyin drug ldan mdzod dgu theg pa'i brgyan/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus chos sku? /shāka thub spyan sngar gnas brtan bzang po ba/ /shing rta'i srol 'dzin rgyal tshab dam pa rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus chos sku? /lho nub za hor shākya pra bha wa/ /rgyal sras sprul tshe pra bha hastī mjal/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus chos sku? /rgya gar shar phyogs grub chen sa ra ha/ /rtsa rlung dbang sdud gnyug ma lhan skyes 'phrod/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus chos sku? /rgya gar shar gling lha lcam bde chen mtsho/ /phag mos zhal gzigs he ru ka pa'i yum/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus chos sku? /bde byed brtsegs par 'jam dpal bshes gnyen pa/

/gshin rje'i bka' bab zab mo'i gter dang 'phrod/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus chos? /gu ru'i spyan sngar sangs rgyas ye shes mchog /rdzu 'phrul brtul zhugs brag la phur pa gdab/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus chos sku? /mu stegs bzlog pa'i rten 'brel dus la bab/ /gshin rje'i bdag nyid dum rgya zhang khrom pa/ /gsol b /'ja' lus? /lha srin gdug pa'i dal kha dgra la 'beb/ /drang srong sku brnyes bon po drag rtsal can/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus? /snang ba'i shan 'byed rdzogs chen bla med rtogs/ /bstan gnyis gling pa rtsa gsum chos kyi mdzod/ /gsol b /'ja' lus chos sku? /bod yul 'dul zhing bden gnyis gdul byar gzigs/ /dri med kun dga' sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gsol b /'ja' lus chos sku? /lho brag mon kha ma nges tshul 'dzin pa/ /sngags 'chang pad+ma dbang gi bdag nyid la/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /'ja' lus? /smon lam dbang gis zab gter sgo 'byed pa/ /gu ru'i rgyal sras u rgyan gter bdag gling*/ /gsol b /'ja' lus? /'di nas yang 'phos rnga yab dpal ri ru/ /rgyal sras bde ba'i ye shes rdo rje rtsal/ /smon lam dbang gis bod yul yang sprul 'byung*/ /'brel tshad don ldan tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /dpal ldan bla mas tshe rabs rjes 'dzin shog /ces dad ldan grwa slob mang pos bskur ngor sngon gyi kha byang dang bstun nas gter bdag gling pas thun mtshams su bris/ yi ge pa yang bdud 'dul rtsal gyi bgyis/ maṅga laṃ// // ༈ o rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i skyes rabs gsol 'debs smin grol lam 'god bzhugs so/ chos dbyings ngo bo bde chen rang bzhin las/ /rnam mkhyen thar pa'i sgo gsum legs 'byed pa/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung*/ /dam pas rjes bzung 'phags pas lung bstan pa'i/ /byin brlabs bka' gtad bka' yi bsdu ba po/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/

/gang des byin brlabs gsang gsum rol pa'i gar/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul srid gsum zil gnon rtsal/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ /rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol/ /gnam lcags rdo rje bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal/ /grub pa brnyes mdzad hūm̐ nag drag rtsal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol/ /rdo rje grub mchog khams gsum dbang bsgyur rtsal/ /rje btsun karma las 'brel gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal stsol/ /nam mkha' dbal chen g.yung drung sems dpa' rtsal/ /gsang ba tha nag mu stegs 'dul mdzad par/ /gsol 'debs mtha' 'khob bdud bzhi 'dul bar mdzod/ /rdo 'chang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ku sa lar/ /gnas brtan bzang po shākya pra bha war/ /gsol ba 'debs so bden gnyis don rtogs stsol/ /sa ra ha dang lha lcam bde chen mtsho/ /dum rgya zhang khrom bon po drag rtsal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so ka dag don rtogs stsol/ /bstan gnyis gling pa dri med kun dga' ba/ /gter chen pad+ma gter bdag gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gtan gyi bla mar shog /dam pa nyid la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /skye dang tshe rabs gtan srid thams cad du/ /rje btsun gu ru'i go 'phang thob pa dang*/ /'ja' lus 'od phung chos skur grol nas kyang*/ /thog ma'i sangs rgyas rang dbyings der rdzogs shog /ces gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid bla ma bsam gtan rgya mtsho dang*/ bu slob skal ldan rnams kyis bskul ngor/ sngags 'chang snyom las pa gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes gnas chen dga' ba lung gi zhol du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ rgyal kun phrin las rdzogs pa'i mthu stobs dbang*/ /pad+ma thod phreng mkhar chen ye shes mtsho/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rnam rol sgyu 'phrul gar/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /snyigs dus gdul bya 'dul phyir rigs sngags rgyal/

/dbyings rig shugs 'chang zab gsang gter gyi bdag /skal ldan rnams la rang byung ye shes ston/ /thugs mchog rdo rje rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dbyings khyab brdal 'dus ma byas pa'i ngang*/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i thugs rje'i rang rtsal las/ /rnam sprul dpag yas 'gro ba'i dpal du shar/ /thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar dri med ko la she/ /rnam sprul 'gro ba'i don mdzad bi ma la/ /srong btsan sgam po'i dus su chos blon mgar/ /rje btsun pad+ma'i drung du shud dpal seng*/ /'od kyi glang po dam pa sangs rgyas dang*/ /me long rdo rje yar lung sprul sku dang*/ /ye shes dbang mo chos dbyings rgya mtsho sogs/ /'brel tshad don ldan mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang bod yul snyigs dus gdul bya'i ngor/ /smug nag rdo rje gar dbang las rab rtsal/ /skal ldan rnams la rang byung ye shes ston/ /gdul bya mthar phyin mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /'phags mchog khyed kyi thugs rje'i ye shes kyis/ /bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang ba bzhi zad dbyings rig dbyer med pa'i/ /mchog gi rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog /ces pa'i gsol 'debs tshan gsum 'di lcags zam mchog sprul bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'o// // ༈ pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs gnas ri so dgu ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ gu ru na mo/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi hrīḥ /mtha' bral kun khyab rgyal ba'i dgongs bcud las/ /legs sprul ngo bo gzugs skur tshul bstan mdzad/ /pad sdong las 'khrungs mtshan dpe'i rgyan spras pa/ /pad 'byung sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang de'i thugs rje ye shes 'od dkar gyis/ /'gro la snyoms mdzad gang 'dul der ston tshe/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon mchog thugs kyi sras/

/o rgyan gter bdag gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /bag chags gtan 'khyams dmus long 'dren slad du/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rig 'dzin ye shes sde/ /sangs rgyas mi gzugs legs bstan yid bzhin nor/ /pad 'byung zab gsang dpag dka'i dga' ston che/ /yongs grags gter bdag gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /zab mo chos kyi gter 'byin dus bab tshe/ /gter srung dam gnas rnams la tha tshig bsgrags/ /bar chad mi mthun bdud rigs sgrol mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal la gsol? gnas chen 'bri gung ti sgror gnas pa'i tshe/ /mkha' 'gros gdan drangs rnga yab zhing du bslebs/ /gu ru'i zhal mjal dbang lung mngon sum thob/ /rig 'dzin rgyal sras dam par? /gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang nas/ /zab chos snying byang gsal mdzad bzhes pa'i tshe/ /gnod sbyin gza' btsan shan pa bran du khol/ /ma rungs bstan dgra ma lus tshar gcod mdzad/ /gnam lcags rdo rje de la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas chen a mye mu khri bya ba nas/ /rtags rgya gnad bdun kha byang gdan drangs tshe/ /kun dga' gzhon nus brag dmar dbyings su bskyel/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon du gyur la gsol? /yer pa zla ba phug gi gnas mchog nas/ /'chi med dam rdzas skye bdun gdan drangs tshe/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ye shes grogs su gyur/ /dpal gyi ye shes grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung zin gnas chen sha 'ug stag sgo nas/ /btsan rgod rol pas dngos su spyan drangs nas/ /yang phur gdan drangs bstan dgra dam la bzhag /mthu stobs thogs med de la gsol? /sham po gangs rir rdzu 'phrul glog ltar myur/ /gza' rgod dug mtsho'i shog dril gdan drangs tshe/ /'brug sgra thog bcas gza' rgod dngos su thim/ /dmod las thogs med rtsal l /dwags la sgam po dpal gyi ri bo nas/ /maṇ+ḍal mtsho nas bla rdo gdan drangs tshe/ /nyams snang 'od kyis snang srid sgyu mar shar/ /sgrub pa'i srog shing 'dzin la gsol?

/gnas chen tsā ri ye shes 'khor lo nas/ /zil chen phug nas tshe rta gdan drangs tshe/ /mkha' 'gro sprin gtibs brag la tshe chu brdol/ /grub thob sa ra ha par gsol? khrag mtsho khol ma dmar nag rak+ta nas/ /sngags bdag ma mo'i chos ka bzhes pa'i tshe/ /mtsho 'khrugs rba khol srid gsum 'ur gyis khengs/ /dregs pa kun 'dul rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ khrag 'thung legs ldan zhing skyong bla mtsho nas/ /chos skyong seng gdong zab gter gdan drangs tshe/ /ma hā kā las bya ra tha tshig phul/ /ye shes las rab rtsal la gsol? /rngam pa sgra sgrogs dur khrod nags tshal nas/ /dregs pa'i yang rgyud bla rdo gdan drangs tshe/ /dpal gyi las mkhan so so'i khas blangs bsgrubs/ /rdo rje me 'bar rtsal la gsol? /gnyal smad dge ri brag gi yang rdzong nas/ /gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i chos ka gdan drangs tshe/ /ro snyom baṃ chen tshogs kyi dngos grub thob/ /brtul zhugs spobs pa ldan der gsol? /mkha' 'gro gter gnas gzho stod ti sgro las/ /drag po khyung zhon chos bka' spyan drangs tshe/ /nyams snang pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams bgrod/ /gu rus rjes gnang thob la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbus yul bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar nas/ /rtsa gsum thugs sgrub gter rgya gdan drangs tshe/ /bsam yas pad 'byung 'ja' 'od tshul gyis shar/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling par gsol? /kong yul lha lung brag gi gnas mchog nas/ /dregs pa phyag rdor chos ka bzhes pa'i tshe/ /kong btsun de mos gter gyi rgya grogs mdzad/ /gnod sbyin dbang sdud rtsal l /rag ne brag dmar btsan rgod pho brang nas/ /rdo rje gro lod gter rgya zhal phyes tshe/ /'bar ba spun bdun phrin las glog ltar myur/ /karma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ khams phyogs rtse drug mkha' 'gro'i gsang phug nas/ /'khrul med lung bstan ji bzhin gter bzhes tshe/ /sdang sems gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad mdzad/

/'chi med rdo rje de la gsol? /gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod gnas mchog nas/ /mtha' dmag zlog byed drag po'i chos bzhes tshe/ /lha bdud btsan rgod ma lus bran du bskol/ /dus 'khrug mtshon dal dmag dpung bzlog par mdzad/ /hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal la gsol? /gter gnas khyad 'phags ḍāk+ki'i snying phug nas/ /tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud bzhes pa'i tshe/ /gter srung shan pas shog dril phyag tu phul/ /pad+ma gter bdag gling par gsol b /yon tan gnas mchog gze rgyal gangs khrod nas/ /dmag zlog ru dar nag po bzhes pa'i tshe/ /bdud rigs 'gong pos tho 'tshams sdang gyur tshe/ /srog dbugs rab bsgral rnam shes chos dbyings spar/ /rdo rje grub mchog rtsal l /gtsang chen rgyud klung dge bsnyen pho brang nas/ /'dod 'byung gu ru nor lha'i chos bzhes tshe/ /yul gru bde ldan longs spyod rab rgyas mdzad/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de l /rga rgyal 'od gsal rdo rje'i gnas mchog nas/ /rdzogs chen 'khor 'das yongs grol zhal phyes tshe/ /rdzu 'phrul rlung ltar 'od gsal phug tu byon/ /las 'brel 'dren mchog de l /'jigs byed gza' bdud chen po'i pho brang nas/ /dug ri khro 'dus chos skor bzhes pa'i tshe/ /gza' bdud ki kang shog dril dngos su phul/ /gshin rje'i bdag nyid de l /rdo rgyal ston pa'i dbu rtse rim gong mar/ /bon chos zab mo'i chos ka bzhes pa'i tshe/ /brag la ya mtshan ngo mtshar zhabs rjes bzhag /grub pa'i mchog brnyes de l /mdo khams rong gi cha mtshams wa lung nas/ /tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab bzhes pa'i tshe/ /brag dmar rngams la bya ltar lding mdzad pa/ /grub pa'i he ru ka l /dpal ri nye mtshungs gro lod pho brang nas/ /gsang ba snying sgrub chos skor bzhes pa'i tshe/ /rdzu 'phrul nyams kyis mkha' lam shugs kyis bgrod/ /kun yid tshims par mdzad l /sbas gnas byang gi pha wang rta mgo nas/

/kro ta h+ya'i chos skor bzhes pa'i tshe/ /nyams snang shugs 'byung rdo brag zan ltar bsgyur/ /nus rtsal grub mchog de l /pad+ma sbas pa'i lung gi gnas mchog nas/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ /gnod sbyin seng gdong sgrom bu dngos su phul/ /gu ru'i rgyal tshab de l /ka ma ru yi byang phyogs cha mtshams su/ /mdong chu gtsug lag byams chen sku cha nas/ /phyag mthil shog dril dngos bab bkra shis gang*/ /phrin las grub pa'i dbang por gsol? /da rung sbas yul gnas mchog phag mo gsang ba lung*/ /phyag rdor mtsho nas ma mgon gdan drangs tshe/ /klu rgyal me 'bar shog dril dngos su phul/ /kun gyis dad pa thob l /gnas chen g.yu mtsho kung lung pho brang nas/ /sku tshab shog dril dam rdzas spyan drangs tshe/ /rdzu 'phrul bkod pa bstan l khrom gzigs gshin rje me 'bar pho brang nas/ /dug ri me 'bar la sogs gdan drangs tshe/ /gza' dang klu yis shog dril dngos su phul/ /bsad pa'i las kun 'grub l /brag gad o rgyan khrus chu'i gnas mchog nas/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal chos bka' gdan drangs tshe/ /gnyan rgod dug gdong mgo dgu bran du bskol/ /srid pa stobs ldan rtsal? /sgrub pa'i gnas mchog pad+ma shel phug nas/ /thugs rje chen po'i chos bka' gdan drangs tshe/ /rma rkung dge bsnyen gter rgya'i tha tshig phul/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjer gsol? /rgyang phu gangs kyi rwa ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /bka' brgyad yang snying 'dus pa gdan drangs tshe/ /lha btsan chen pos gter sgrom dngos su phul/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal l /sgrags kyi yang phug seṅge gnam rdzong nas/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus yang snying gdan drangs tshe/ /brag dmar klong la bya ltar thogs med lding*/ /kun gyi 'khrul 'dzin zhig l /mye bo lha mo brag gi dben tshal nas/ /srid pa ma rgyud chos bka' gdan drangs tshe/ /dge bsnyen chen pos mtsho nas shog ser phul/

/kī la drag sngags sgrogs l /zangs ri rtse dgu mdo khams sku rgyal nas/ /g.yu mtsho'i klong nas zab rgya gdan drangs tshe/ /zangs btsan 'bar bas rtags rgya stong du 'byed/ /rnal 'byor rlung zhags 'phen la gsol? /rdza rgyud na bun dge bsnyen pho brang nas/ /mtsho rgyal gsang gter rtags rgya gdan drangs tshe/ /mngon spyod las kun 'grub l /dge bsnyen mtsho nas bla rdo gdan drangs tshe/ /rdo rje legs pas bka' bzhin rogs dan bgyis/ /gzi brjid 'od 'bar rtsal? /lci rgyud smug po lha rtse'i gnas mchog nas/ /phyag rdor dregs brgyad las mtha' gdan drangs tshe/ /nā ga rak+shas gter rgya dngos su phul/ /bstan dgra ma rungs 'dul l/ /gnas mchog bre khu brag gi chos sgar du/ /tsha la bon gyi dgra lhas bon lung bstan/ /g.yung drung dbal gshen rtsal? /dhe wa nā ga ko ṭa'i gnas mchog nas/ /zab rgya rtags bdun shog ser phab pa'i tshe/ /mkha' spyod klong las shar l /brag ri nag po lcags mkhar 'dra ba'i shed/ /dus tshes rnams su yang yang lung bstan shar/ /phyogs med he ru ka l /'gro don phyogs med rgyal khams rlung bzhin bskyod/ /nges med sbas tshul 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul/ /bla med theg mchog gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor/ /rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang por? /bgrang yas sa yi zab mo'i gter 'byin dus/ /rmu rgod 'khor ba'i 'gro ba 'dren slad du/ /tha mal sna tshogs spyod pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /'dren mchog zla bral de l /mtshungs med 'gro mgon de l /gar dbang rdo rje de l /de ltar mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i bdag sogs rnams/ /rjes su 'dzin cing yongs su smin grol mdzod/ /sku gsum zhing khams mchog la rab dbang zhing*/ /sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i stobs ldan shog /ces gter gnas dang grub rtags sogs mang du yod kyang*/ gsung rgya grol pa'i gter gnas dang*/

grub rtags sogs gsol 'debs gnas ri so dgu ma sbas yul pad+ma'i tshal du rtsa gsum gling pas sbyar ro/ /slar mos gus kyi gsol 'debs gter gnas kyi grangs rnams kyi byung ba dad pa'i nor ldan ma ti'i mtshan gyis kha gsab tu bris pa dge'o// // maṅga laṃ/ bkris/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng mdzes zhes bya bzhugs so/ kun bzang rdo sems dga' rab shrī sing*/ /pad+ma kā ra rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /so zur gnubs gnyags gter ston brgya rtsa sogs/ /bka' gter bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang*/ /thugs rje lung rtogs mnyam pa'i mthu mnga' yang*/ /nags khrod dam par sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /'khor 'das chos skur rtogs pa'i klong chen pa/ /dri med 'od zer zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag o rgyan chos kyi rje/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol/ /rtag tu 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi rnam 'dren saṃ bha wa'i/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa'i mthu stobs can/ /yang zab chos sgo rdol mdzad rtsa gsum gling*/ /chos kyi rgyal mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gu ru'i rnam 'phrul 'bum lnga'i sprin chen gyis/ /snyigs ma'i gdung sel 'gro mgon mdo khams pa/ /nyid las lhag pa'i rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i mgon/ /grub dbang thugs mchog rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge'i rnam par 'phrul/ /rdo rje phur pa'i grub brnyes rig pa 'dzin/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag rwa ston pa/ /stobs ldan rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung gi rig 'dzin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs 'phrul/ /sgrags kyi yang rdzong sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsug /las kyi 'phro sad zab mo'i gter kha 'byin/ /dri med gling pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

/dbu ru gzhung du chos rgyal khu dbon sprul/ /grub pa'i 'bras thob 'khor 'das chos skur rdzogs/ /thugs tig phrin las yangs pa'i khyon kun khyab/ /klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gsol ba 'debs/ /a tsar ye shes dbyangs sprul 'brug thang pa/ /bco brgyad gter 'byin rnam bzhi'i phrin las kyis/ /snyigs dus 'gro 'dul mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ /kun bzang bde chen rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /gnubs ston nam snying bsam bzhin 'phrul pa'i gar/ /mkhas shing grub brnyes phrin las pha mtha' yas/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug kong smyon kra ti pa/ /karma rig 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /smra ba'i nyi ma dkon seng paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mkhas grub chen po kun dga' blo gros dang*/ /mnyam med sgam po bzang po rdo rje dang*/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ār+ya dh+wa dza dang*/ /mtshungs med karma au ḍi yā na sogs/ /chos bdag lung zin brgyud par bcas pa yi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnubs chen dngos snang rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /gsang gsum mi zad chu zla'i rol gar las/ /ngo mtshar sku yi rnam 'phrul grub pa'i dbang*/ /o rgyan rig 'dzin zhabs l gdod ma'i mgon po o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling*/ /pad+ma nges pa don gyi bstan pa 'dzin/ /theg mchog don gzigs chos dbyings rang grol sogs/ /'dren mchog zla bral rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ 'di rnams spo bo khrom gzigs gdan rabs so/ ma 'gags gsung gi rnam rol sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas rnam mang 'gro ba 'dul/ /zab mo'i don gzigs sbas gter gnas sgo phyes/ /kun bzang 'chi med nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ gsung sprul sprul brgyud mi gsal/ 'khrul med thugs kyi 'od zer bdal ba las/ /'gyur med dgongs pa'i rtsal chen dbyings su rdzogs/ /snang sems dbang thob chu la sāts+tsha btab/ /mi 'jigs rdo rjer brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/

/ngag la dbang bsgyur snyan grags rgya mtsho'i gter/ /mtshungs med gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /tshe dang sgrub mnyam 'khrul zhig bzod pa'i mtshan/ /mtshungs med 'gro mgon rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ thugs sprul khyung po gsang sngags chos gling gi gdan rabs so/ ma yo gangs rwar lung bzhin theg gling 'phrul/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dren mchog 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /rgyal ba'i sras po tshe dbang bstan 'dzin dang*/ nam mkha' tshe dbang rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling gi gdan rabs so/ yon tan sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam na yang*/ /bka' drin sangs rgyas kun gyis zla med pa'i/ /rig stong chos sku'i rang zhal ston mdzad pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba 'debs so rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig mgon med mkha' mnyam 'gror/ /myur du sgrol cig 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas/ /byin gyis rlobs shig blo sna chos la sgyur/ /chos kyang yang dag lam du 'gro ba dang*/ /lam gyi 'khrul snang ka dag dbyings su sad/ /snang bzhi'i ye shes chos nyid zad sar sbyor/ /'pho ba chen po rdo rje'i sku thob shog /tshe 'dir 'chi med rig 'dzin thob nas kyang*/ /nam mkha' ji srid phrin las rnam bzhi yis/ /'bad med lhun grub gzhan don mthar phyin nas/ /'gro kun phyam gcig sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /ces pa'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter ring lugs dus rgud kyi dbang gis nyams dman zhing gang las byung ba'i brgyud rim kyang 'dren shes par dkon pas chos bdag brgyud 'dzin bcas kyi gsol 'debs zhig bris 'dun yod thog dad brtson mtshungs med rang slob ye shes rgyal mtshan nas kyang ched du bskul zhing yi ge 'du byed kyi mthun 'gyur mdzad par brten gus rmongs sgo chen sprul ming 'dzin pas me yos gro bzhin zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyin bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi gam zhe chen dgon gyi yang dben du sbyar ba 'dis kyang tshul 'di'i bstan pa dar rgyas yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig

// // ༈ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba gsum gang yin kha bsgyur lha tshogs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs sad par bsam la skyabs sems sogs bya'o/ /mthar dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim zhing rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /las bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la:

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas/ mthar khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur pas phrin las mdzad par mos: rdor dril bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thabs kyi rdo rje las sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro bar gyur: om̐ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ āḥlas dbyings phyug yum lnga'i rang bzhin shes rab dril bu'i rnam pas sems can thams cad rig pa sad par byed pa'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad par gyur: om̐ ma hā ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes dril bu lan gsum dkrol/ rdor dril thabs shes kyi phyag rgyas snying khar bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐: thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon: ma lus 'gro rnams sad pa dang : sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: om̐ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ āḥ lan gsum/ ༈ phur bu ma hā shū n+ya tas sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las phur bu ni: skad cig dran rdzogs sras mchog skur gyur pas: gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi yi ge las: 'od 'phros dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid chen po ru: dbang thob khams gsum ma lus dus gcig la: yongs su sgrol ba'i nus pa dang ldan gyur: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan bdun nam nyer gcig brjod cing bskor te 'debs/ de nyid 'od zhu phur bu rnam par gyur: bla med byang chub sgrub la bar chad rigs: ma lus gzhom zhing mchog thun dngos grub kun: myur du thob pa'i dpal dang ldan par shog: ༈ om̐ āḥhūm̐: rol sil la chab bran te/ bzung dang ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor bkod legs par: rgyal kun mchod rdzas lha yi sil snyan sogs: dbyangs snyan rol mo chos kyi dbyings khyab pas: 'gro kun gdod ma'i gzhi la sad gyur cig:

om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā: zhi rol bcas spel/ drag po'i rigs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnyis snang 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba las: gnyis med 'jigs bral he ru ka yi dal: dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i dam tshig rdzas: rkang gling thod rnga la sogs rab tu sgrogs: om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: dharma dhā tu āḥ rkang gling thod rnga rnga chen rnams brdung ngo*/ /༈ dkyil 'khor spyir bran la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos kun 'od gsal stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : snang ba thams cad ye dag rgyal ba'i zhing : srid pa thams cad lhun grub mchod pa'i rgyan: kun bzang rnam 'phrul rgya mtshor gnas gyur cig: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa sogs nas s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā: rol mo sna tshogs rgya cher spel zhing mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs/ ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dkar gtor 'dod yon char 'bebs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon la lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: dkar gtor bya ba'i rim pa ni: bse phor zangs snod rin chen snod: 'bru bcud gser skyems dkar gtor bcas: chu gtsang bran la 'di skad do: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma nāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na na twata om̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: om̐ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐: om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gser skyems mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las om̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: om̐ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya: sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ tsogs/ om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: om̐ dz+nyā na ā wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐:

om̐ na maḥ sa man+ta bud+dha nam gra he shwa ri pra bhañja te ma hā sa ma ya swā hā': om̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ om̐ las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang : trām̐ las sna tshogs rat+na'i snod: hrīḥlas gsung dbyangs drug cur ldan: āḥlas ci 'dod phun sum tshogs: so so'i dga' mgu tshim byed pa: 'dod pa'i yo byed chen por gyur: hūm̐: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : grub pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad kyi: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan la gnas pa yi: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad rgyu skar brgyad: sde brgyad sde dpon sum cu rtsa gnyis dang : phyogs skyong bcu dang sa bdag dmu sman dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i dregs pa sde bcu gnyis: dpal gyi mgon po chen po bdun cu lnga: rgyal chen bzhi dang dus kyi skyong ma 'bum: mkha' la rgyu ba'i yid gzugs gzhi bdag dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba'i lha: skyes lha yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha: khyad par rin chen gter gyi srung ma dang : pha ri tshur kha g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ri: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gnas pa'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams: 'dir gshegs gser skyems phud dang gtor ma bzhes: bdag gi legs nyes bya ba ci la yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: rin chen gter gyi sa 'di myur du stsol: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: las bzhi phrin las gang bcol myur du sgrubs: lo legs nad zhi sa phyogs bkra shis nas: dkar po dge bcu sgrub pa'i rogs dan sgrubs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hiḥ zhes dkar gtor phyogs gtsang sar phul zhing : bkra shis pa'i phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya:

gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: pad+ma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: dkar gtor 'dod yon kun khyab bzhugs so: yang dag rdo rje khrag 'thung bzhad par 'dud: sa ma ya: 'dod yon zad med rin chen gter gyi mdzod: snang srid dgyes pa'i mchod gtor dpag dka'i khyon: mos blo'i re skong bdud rtsi sprin phung 'di: mtsho rgyal bdag gis gzhan phan spyi la bkod: sa ma ya: de yang ye shes dang spyi rgyud skyong ba'i srung ma la gser skyems dang brngan cha dkar gtor 'bul ba ni: rin po che'i snod du lha bshos dkar po 'dab ma brgyad kyis brgyan pa la mar mtshon bzang po'i spra btab: gser skyems brgyud ldan dang zung gcig tu byin gyis brlabs la 'bul zhing bsngo ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dkar gtor dang gser skyems 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum brjod rgyas pa sngags drug phyag drug bya: de nas 'bul ba ni: hoḥ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma dang gser skyems gnyan po 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni rin chen gter gyi srung ma gnyan po dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi phyag drug ma ning nag po gdong bzhi pa bram ze gzugs can srog bdag nag po bya rog gdong can sogs ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po yum mchog si na ra ma sprul pa bam ro pho mo bka' 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

hoḥ sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po btsan rgod bse yi khrab can 'khor shan pa brgyad sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ drang srong gza' mchog rā hu la ma mo sngags bdag e ka dzā ṭi skyes bu dam can rdo rje legs pa gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen chen po gnod sbyin rgyal po dpe dkar la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ lha chen po brgyad klu chen po brgyad gza' chen po brgyad rgyu skar lha mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad phyogs skyong gnyan po bcu 'jigs byed chen po dgu rgyal chen sde bzhi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ phyi yi lha ma srin sde brgyad nang gi lha ma srin sde brgyad gsang ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad drag po sngags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad las byed myur mgyogs kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad 'jig rten rtag chags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i zhing skyong gnas sum cu rtsa bdun gyi mkha' 'gro dur khrod brgyad kyi dpa' bo gangs can bod kyi brtan ma bcu gnyis skyong ma bcu gnyis ya ma bcu gnyis rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum la sogs la gnas shing 'gyu ba rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: khyad par du yang gnas chen po rgya gar rdo rje gdan rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga li yul lcang ra smug po za hor siṃ ha la nub phyogs o rgyan yul byang sham bha la bal yul 'phags pa shing kun gangs ti tshe la phyi chu bar mkha' spyod tsā ri mtha' 'dul yang 'dul kyi gtsug lag brgya dang rtsa brgyad la sogs pa la gnas pa'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐:

i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: 'di man bdag gis 'dzud pa yin/ khyad par sngar nas 'byin pa'i gter gnas che phra rnams la smos pa ni: 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro: dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang : brag yer pa: mon sha 'ug stag sgo: yar lha sham po gangs: tsā ri dmar nag rak+ta gzi chen gsang phug zhing skyong bla mtsho rngam pa sgra sgrogs gnyal smad dge ri brag lha gnyan dwags lha sgam po bsam yas mchims phu kong po rdo rje brag la sogs dbus kyi cha 'dzin pa'i gter gnas srung ma rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: khyad par lho brag ne'i brag ri rtse drug jo bo gze rgyal spu ru spur bcas gnas gzhi a mye mu khri mkha' 'gro snying phug dge bsnyen pho brang : rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa mdo khams sku rgyal shen ne lho wa lung sogs mdo khams kyi gter gnas rnams kyi srung ma yi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: khyad par lho phyogs pad+ma bkod kyi cha dar sna pha wang stag mgo: bal phu lung rngam pa rong mgon po'i bla mtsho: rdo rje gter phug: mdong chu gtsug lag: gdong pho brang gnas: phag mo gsang ba lung gi phyag rdor bla mtsho: 'ja' tshon phug: o rgyan khrus chu: brag gad pad+ma shel phug: seṅge gnam rdzong : mye bo lha mo brag: mgron thang dge bsnyen: gnas mdo: khrom gzigs dag pa shrī: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i bla mtsho: ma rkung lung gi g.yu mtsho la sogs gter gnas de nyid la gnas pa'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: khyad par da lo'i lo: da zhag gi zla ba: de ring gi nyi ma gza' tshes grangs rgyu skar la dbang ba sngon chad gang du 'gro ba phyin chad gang du gnas pa khyad par yul phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po gtsor byas pa mtho ba gnam la gnas pa dma' ba sa la gnas pa skye ba shing la gnas pa brtan pa sa la gnas pa sra ba brag la gnas pa

'gyu ba chu la gnas pa mched pa me la gnas pa g.yo ba rlung la gnas pa rten pa'i mkhar la gnas pa dben ri dang gtsug lag khang la gnas pa la sogs pa snang zhing srid pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig lha srin gzhi bdag sde tshogs rnams: bdag gis gsang sngags gnyan po dal bzung phyir: khyed rnams phrin las rogs dan ma g.yel sgrubs: chos nyid tshig la mi nyan gang yang med: rgyal ba'i gsung la mi bden gang yang med: zab mo'i don la mi sems gang yang med: mna' dang khrims la mi 'jigs gang yang med: ri rab zom du mi gnas gang yang med: 'byung 'jug rlung gis mi zin gang yang med: skye 'gro lam la mi 'gyu gang yang med: longs spyod chu la mi 'thung gang yang med: rgyu 'bras las la mi bzlog gang yang med: de ltar 'phags pa'i tshig la snyan gsan phyir: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes nas: bdag gis bla med byang chub sgrub pa la: 'gal rkyen spang zhing mthun rkyen bsam don spel: mi mthun bar chod zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rje btsun slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa: tha tshig gnyer ba'i srung ma dam tshig can: gter gyi bdag po mgon chen sde lnga dang : las su chas pa'i srog bdag bya rog mtshan: ma gza' rdor legs btsan rgod klu bdud che: shel ging rgyal po li byin bhi ha ra: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi: phyogs skyong bcu dang 'jigs byed chen po dgu: rgyal chen sde bzhi gling phran bdag po dang : bya ra dus 'dzin gzhong thogs rtag tu myos: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad tshogs: sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag bco brgyad dang : dge bsnyen nyer gcig yul gyi zhing skyong bcas: gnas kyi mkha' 'gro dur khrod dpa' bo ging : brtan ma skyong ma ya ma bcu gnyis dang :

spar sme lo zla dus dang chu tshod bdag: rgya gar rgya nag bal bod mtshams shed nas: mnga' ris dbus gtsang mdo khams sgang drug sogs: sbas yul dang ni rong chen ma lus pa: khyad par yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po dang : gar 'gro gar 'dug gzhi lam byes gsum gyi: rogs dan mel tshe sgrub pa'i srung ma rnams: mchod sbyin gtor ma gser skyems 'di bzhes la: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las rnams la: phrin las sna tshogs thogs med bsgrub pa dang : mdun nas bsu zhing rgyab nas skyel ma mdzod: la chu'i 'phrang sgrol chom rkun 'jigs las skyobs: dmag 'khrug nad yams lo nyes zhi ba dang : dgra gyod kha mchu rgyal po'i 'jigs pa srungs: dal bab mtshon dang dug las rgyal bar gyis: rig sngags dmod sogs pha rol gdug pa'i tshogs: chos skyong dang bcas phyi rgyud srung mas sgrol: mi mthun bgegs tshogs nye bar zhi ba dang : 'dod don bsam pa yid bzhin bsgrubs mdzad nas: dam tshig can la rtag tu skyong ba dang : dngos grub sna tshogs ster ba'i sdong grogs mdzod: om̐ lo ka pā la badz+ra pra tīts+tsha ye i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas dkar gtor phyogs gtsang sar bskyal: mdos sogs kyi sngon 'gro yin na de phyogs bskyal: sgrub pa'i skabs yin na sgrub khang gi mdun gang rung du 'bul: lam gtor yin na gar 'gro'i phyogs su 'bul: gzhi bdag so sor yin na der phyogs su 'bul: phrin las rang rang gang dgos pa'i gzhung bzhin bcol: 'di nyid dkyil 'khor sogs las kun gyi sngon 'gro yin pas med thabs med: phan yon chos skyong rogs dan bsgrub: phyi rgyud rnams kyis dngos grub ster: ko long sdom sogs gdug sems thams cad zhi nas bran bzhin du mchis: las gang la yang bar chad dang sgab 'dre mi 'byung : de phyir gtor ma gser skyems 'di kho na gtso che: khyad par yang sbas yul dben ri sna tshogs nyul ba'i tshe:

do gal: las can rnams gter 'byin pa'i tshe shin tu do gal: sa ma ya: e ma ho gsang sngags rgyal po rin chen za ma tog: nor bu bsam 'phel dgos 'byung 'od rab 'byin: ti la ka 'di dbyangs can bdag gis bgyis: de bas las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: spel rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje kā la drag po rtsal gyis me sprel lor mon sha 'ug brag nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ bgegs gtor byin brlabs ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang gzhung bgegs gtor la 'jug /byin 'bebs mgor/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa ltar byon nas rten bsgrub kyi rdzas dang rnal 'byor pa'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/

spos bdug gdung ba'i dbyangs rol mo sna tshogs kyis bskul bar bya'o/ /zhes byin brlab khag rnams o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zlos gar sprul pa'i gter 'byin pad rgyal gling pa'i zab gter las byung ba ste gter kha 'og ma'o/ /dzapa ྄khang dbye ba ni/ brgyud 'debs nas bstod pa'i bar btang*/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed la/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥs rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥs brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ / zhes se khol gtog pas gsal gdab la bzlas par 'jug go ༈ dbang sgrub sogs kyi skabs su rnam bum ched du sgrub tshe/ gzung thag 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥs phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas rtsa sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzla zhing*/ gzhung gi bsnyen thun 'jog khar thun mtshams mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ / las bum gong du ma bsgrub na 'dir bya'o/ /༈ dbang bskur gnas 'dren rab gnas sogs la 'brel ba'i tshe rig me dor la/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/

om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ /gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo// // ༈ skabs 'dir gsol kha rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dus tshod kyi long khom dang bstun nas bya ba yin la gang ltar yang gtor 'bul gyi bar du bya/ tshogs mchod kyi gong du skong bshags rgyas pa bya bar 'dod na na rag skong bshags dang ma lcogs na gsham gsal ye shes sku mchog dang sman raka gtor ma'i skong bsdus tsam sbyar bas kyang rung bas/ 'dir dang po ltar na/ ༈ nyams chag sdig sgrib thams cad bskang zhing bshags pa'i rgyal po na rag dong sprugs bzhugs so: rnal 'byor pas bla ma bde gshegs zhi khro yongs rdzogs rnams: mdun gyi nam mkhar nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la: dbang po'i mngon sum dang 'dra bar zhal lam mer bzhugs par bsams pa'i mdun du lus rdul snyed du sprul te: ngag bshags tshig: yid gnong sems dang bcas te dus thams cad du bshags pa bya'o: rjes lta bas kyang gsal gdab cing : dam tshig la bsgrim pa ni dngos grub myur ro: e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs dgongs: 'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: nyams chag na rag sbyang phyir phyag mchod bzhes: yon tan phun tshogs bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: dmigs med spros bral chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro mgon cir yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo:

gnas lugs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: yang dag mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: nyon mongs zhi mdzad zhi ba'i lha l log lta tshar gcod khro bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: thabs mgon tshe bdag 'jam dpal sku l skyon bral sgra sgrogs pad+ma gsung l yang dag don ldan badz+ra thugs l dug lnga'i nad sel bdud rtsi sman l dregs pa 'joms mdzad phur pa'i lha l 'byung ba mnga' bdag ma mo'i tshogs l sa dang lam rdzogs rig 'dzin tshogs l bstan pa srung mdzad dam can rnams l dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad sngags bdag tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rang rig rang shes 'khrul pa bral: mnyam nyid ngang las ye shes shar: kun tu bzang po yab yum la: yid chos dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: mi rtog dbyer med dgongs pa la: ye shes lnga yi 'od mdangs gsal: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa la: nyon mongs dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: dbyings kyi ngang las bskyed pa'i rgyu: ye shes lnga yi grogs su shar: dbyings kyi yum chen lnga rnams la: 'byung ba dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes sprul pa mang po'i tshogs: 'gro ba'i don du rang shar ba: byang chub sems dpa' brgyad rnams la: rnam shes dag phyir? ye shes ngang las yon tan rdzogs: ci 'dod dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad rnams la: yul dus dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: gdug pa 'dul mdzad dpa' bo'i sku: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i skyon dang bral: ta krita sgo ba bzhi rnams la: log lta dag phyir? byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang : btang snyoms bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad: sgo skyong khro mo bzhi rnams la: rtag chad dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: rtog pa drug las 'khor ba drug: ma rig dbang gis byung ba rnams: thugs rjes 'dul mdzad thub drug la: 'khrul pa dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: kun tu bzang po rig pa'i rtsal: che mchog gtso la phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga ma spangs mthar phyin pa'i: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo:

dbyings las skur bzhengs thabs shes sbyor: khro mo yum l thugs las sprul pa'i gsang chen mo: khro mo brgyad l za byed mche gshog pho nya mo: phra men brgyad l 'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom dgyes mdzad ma: sgo ma bzhi l 'jig rten cha lugs sprul pa mo: dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i gshed: rngam brjid dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: 'jam dpal sku l hūm̐: rta mgrin rgyal po dbang gi lha: dbang drag thabs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: pad+ma gsung l hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra he ru kaḥ rang snang gsal ba'i 'khor gyis bskor: yang dag thugs l hūm̐: bcom ldan che mchog he ru kaḥ zhi khro rab 'byams lha yis bskor: yon tan rgyas l hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu phrin las sku: khro bcu 'bar ba'i 'khor gyis bskor: phrin las mdzad l hūm̐: mngon rdzogs rgyal po he ru kaḥ 'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i 'khor: ma mo'i tshogs l hūm̐: rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal: sa dang lam la gnas pa'i 'khor: rig 'dzin tshogs l hūm̐: gsang ba'i bdag po gos sngon can: 'jig rten dregs pa rnams kyis bskor: bstan pa skyong l hūm̐: stobs ldan nag po mthu rtsal can: drag sngags bdag po mang pos bskor: dgra bgegs 'dul l de ltar rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: gang gis mtshan thos phyag 'tshal na: dam tshig nyams chag kun byang nas: mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa dag: na rag gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: las kyi rnam par smin pa'i skyon: ngag tu mthol la yid kyis bshags: smre sngags bton la gdung bas sbyang : mos pas thal mo snying gar sbyar: dad pas brkyang phyag brdabs te btsal: zhi khro'i lha tshogs mtshan nas brjod: rjes su lus lnga tshugs bcas te: rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bsgom: na rag dong sprugs snying po bzlas: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs? 'di dag dag par dus gcig la: ma yengs brgya rtsa brgyad brjod na:

dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su skye: hoḥ zhi khro rab 'byams dgongs su gsol: rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i lung : ji bzhin ma spyad 'gal zhing 'khrul: rdo rje slob dpon drin can la: gshe skur btab dang lta ba log: gzungs ma mched dang lcam dral la: ngan sems tshig rtsub chags sdang byas: brdeg btsog gnod pa dngos su shor: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: zhi khro'i lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: yi dam lha dang 'khor ma gsal: 'dzab dang bzlas brjod ma dag chag: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: rigs lnga zhi khro'i spyan sngar bshags: gsang bcu'i gnyer gtad dam bcas pa: kun la bsgrags shing dam rdzas bstan: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: rgyal ba zhi khro'i spyan sngar bshags: shes par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga: rigs lngar ma shes log par bltas: mi spang ba yi dam tshig lnga: ma rig dbang gis dug lngar gol: dang du blang ba'i dam tshig lnga: gtsang dmer bltas dang bag med spyad: bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga: rang la gnas par ma shes log: spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga: dbye gsal ma shes log par spyad: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams: yi dam lha yi spyan sngar bshags: bsnyen pa sgrub pa'i ting 'dzin g.yel: nya stong dus drug mchod pa chag: le lo g.yeng ba gnyid kyis rmugs: gsog 'jog ser snas rgyu rkyen chung : tshogs kyi spyang ku kha tshar shor: phud nyams lhag ma phri ba dang : bag med spyod pa rtsings pa yis: tshor dang ma tshor nyams pa'i skyon: mkha' 'gro dam can spyan sngar bshags: yid kyi dam nyams lta bas bshags: de yang kun gzhi byang chub sems: yin pa med pa'i lta ba rtogs: min pa med pa'i sgom nyams len: yin min med pa'i spyod pa rtogs: re dogs med pa'i byang chub sems: rtsa ba yan lag thams cad kyi: chag nyams ma byung ma skyes pa: bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med grol: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nyid spros pa med pa la: yod med gnyis su lta ba thang re chad:

dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: spros med bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: kun tu bzang po bzang ngan med pa la: gtsang dang rme bar lta ba thang re chad: bzang ngan gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: kun bzang bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: mnyam pa nyid la che chung med pa la: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba thang re chad: che chung gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: mnyam nyid bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: byang chub sems la skye shi med pa la: 'di dang phyi mar lta ba thang re chad: skye shi gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: 'chi med g.yung drung klong du bshags par bgyi: thig le chen po grwa zur med pa la: gzugs dang rdzas su lta ba thang re chad: grwa zur dbyibs su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: kun nas zlum po thig le'i klong du bshags: dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: thog ma tha mar lta ba thang re chad: 'pho 'gyur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du bshags: rang byung ye shes rtsol sgrub bral ba la: rgyu 'bras gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: rtsol sgrub gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: rang byung rtsol med klong du bshags par bgyi: rig pa ye shes rtag chad bral ba la: gzung 'dzin gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: rtag chad gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: rig pa ye shes klong du bshags par bgyi: chos nyid rnam dag spros pa med pa la: zug rngu gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: mtha' dbus gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: chos nyid rnam dag klong du bshags par bgyi: gzhal yas khang la yangs dog med pa la: phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad: yangs dog gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: gzhal yas yangs dog med pa'i klong du bshags: yum gyi mkha' la mtho dman med pa la: steng dang 'og tu lta ba thang re chad: mtho dman gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: bha ga yangs dog med pa'i klong du bshags:

chos kyi sku la gnyis su med pa la: phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad: snod bcud gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du bshags: ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can snying re rje: gzugs med chos la dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin: gang zag 'khrul pa'i sems ni yong re gol: skye med chos la nga dang bdag tu rtog: snang srid sgyu ma yin par ma shes te: zang zing nor la sems kyi chags pa skyes: 'khor ba rang bzhin med par ma shes pas: gnyen bshes 'khrul pa'i grogs la rtag par 'dzin: mi shes skye bo'i blo 'di yongs re gol: bden pa'i don bor mi dge'i las la brtson: ston pa'i bka' bor mi chos g.yeng bas bslus: rang rig don bor g.yeng ba'i las la brtson: 'di 'dra'i don med sems can snying re rje: dbye bsri med pa'i klong du bshags par bgyi: zhes lta ba'i bshags pa dang : tshogs dang sgrub pa'i dus skabs su: sman dang rak+ta gtor ma dang : mar me gsal ba'i mdangs kyis bskang : dang po bdud rtsi ka pā la: thogs nas 'bul ba'i stabs kyis btegs: 'di skad brjod la skong mchod 'bul: hūm̐: ma bcos rang byung chen po'i rdzas: gdod nas dag pas gtsang rme bral: rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong : rigs lnga rgyal ba bsgrub pa'i rdzas: dam tshig skong ba'i sman chen 'di: 'og min brdal khyab chen po na: rang bzhin bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams: ye shes lnga yi 'od kyis bskang : kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis bskang : thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang : thugs rjes sprul pas rigs drug grol: thog mi sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskang : rang las ye shes shar ba'i sku: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs bskang : thugs rje'i sprul pas 'gro don mdzad: rdo rje 'chang nas rim par byon: 'gro ba 'dren pa thams cad kyi: sku dang zhing khams mchod pas bskang : thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs gyur cig:

dam tshig nyams chag bshags par bgyi: de nas rak+ta thogs la: hūm̐: chos nyid rlan gyi ye shes chu: thugs rjes chags pa'i kha dog dmar: srid pa skyed pa rgyu yi khrag: pad+ma rak+ta rang byung khrag: zhing bcu bsgral ba srog gi khrag: rtsi bcud dmar po 'byung ba'i khrag: thams cad dag pa dbang gi rdzas: ma dag khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu: he ru ka yi dgongs pa yis: srid gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags bsgral: mchod pa'i rdzas su byin brlabs te: yum chen kun tu bzang mo la: ye shes 'char ba'i don phyir 'bul: khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs rnams la: thugs rje bskul ba'i mchod pa 'bul: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad la: dam tshig gso ba'i rdzas su 'bul: chos skyong bka' srung thams cad la: phrin las mdzad pa'i don phyir 'bul: dam tshig skongs la dngos grub stsol: de nas tshogs dang gtor ma thogs: lha la 'bul zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: khams gsum gso ba zas kyi rgyu: 'bru dang shing tog ro drug zas: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i phung po'i sha: dza gad dpa' bo 'bru yi bcud: zhal zas 'dod yon sna tshogs su: mos pas bsams te mchod par 'bul: chos kyi dbyings su mos pas 'bul: zhi ba'i lha la mdzes par 'bul: khro bo'i lha la brjid par 'bul: bla ma rnams la mnyes par 'bul: mkha' 'gro rnams la dgyes par 'bul: bka' srung rnams la tshims par 'bul: dam tshig skong ba'i rten du 'bul: de nas mar me skong bu thogs la: hūm̐: rdzas kyi kong bu brgya rtsa ru: gtsang ma'i sdong bu brgya rtsa btsugs: 'byung ba'i bcud mar zhun gyis bkang : gsal ba'i mar me brgya spar nas: dam tshig nyams chag bskang ba'i phyir: mos pas rgyal ba rnams la 'bul: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: ye shes 'od lnga bkrag dang ldan: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : snying ga chos kyi pho brang nas: ye shes sa bon thig le gsal: rang byung zhi ba'i thugs dam bskang : klad pa dung khang pho brang nas:

rang rtsal drod kyi 'od zer 'bar: rang byung khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : mos gus dad pa'i snang ba la: rig pa rang byung 'gag med gsal: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang : rtsa rlung thig le dwangs pa la: shes pa rang byung sa ler gsal: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : 'jig rten srid pa yangs pa la: gza' skar 'od kyi thig le gsal: phyi yi dam can thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams chag thams cad kun: thugs dam dbang gis dag par mdzod: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: skong ba bsdus pa ni: hūm̐: bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bla ma yi dam lha tshogs yongs rdzogs la: rang byung chos kyi dbyings kyi kong bu ru: rig pa ye shes mar me gtams te 'bul: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛ ta: sku lnga ye shes yongs rdzogs mchod pa 'bul: gtor gzhong rnam dag dpal gyi gtor mas gtams: 'dod yon yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul: khams gsum 'khor ba yongs grol mkha' dbyings dag: chags med rak+ta dmar gyi mnyes mchod 'bul: 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba dpa' bo'i rdzas: gzi byin bskyed phyir dza gad mchod pa 'bul: a la la te dgyes par bzhes su gsol: yang mar me smon lam ni: hūm̐/ bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /snying po byang chub lam la zhugs pa yis/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing*/ /chags sdang gcong rong gnas su mi skye dang*/ /log lta dmyal ba'i zangs khar rbab mi 'gril/ /'khon 'dzin gcan gzan gdug pa'i skad mi thos/ /nyon mongs mtshon rtse gdug pa'i zer mi phog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin che ba dang*/ /srog gis sbrel ba'i mched dang lcam dral dang*/ /gsum pa'i dbang gis sbrel ba'i rig ma gsum/ /skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sa bcu khyad par rim gyis bgrod par shog /nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brje'i dus byung nas/

/'khor ba'i g.yang sar lan gcig ltung srid kyang*/ /snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs gsal 'dis/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cing*/ /kun tu 'od kyi sa la rgyud sbyangs nas/ /pad+ma chen po'i sa la lhun gyis grub/ /'khor lo tshogs chen sa la gshegs pa'i tshe/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis mdun bsus shig /yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog rten cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sna drongs shig /ma tshogs dbang mo rnams kyis rjes skyongs shig /lcang lo can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /mi ldog pa yi sa la gnas nas kyang*/ /rdo rje khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal mthong nas/ /rig 'dzin rnams dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang*/ /bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog /hoḥ nam mkha'i mthar thug mtha' yas sems can kun/ ma 'bad bzhin du sku gsum mngon gyur te/ /pha ma 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa/ /phyam cig gdod ma'i sa la phyin par shog /ces so/ mchod bskang bsdus pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: na rag skong bshags zhi khro gsang ba yongs rdzogs rang shar gnyis las bstan pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa bsre bslad tshig gcig kyang med par lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas: pad+ma'i ming can gyis dge bar bris pa'o// // ༈ bshags skong bsdus pa ni/ om̐/ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang : thugs rje'i nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya cher rol pa'i lha/ /zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de/

/phyi nang gsang ba mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun/ /'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pas/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig /sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ /chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing*/ /rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/ /kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brdal ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams/ /gsang chen rab dgyes gzungs chen bdag nyid ma/ /mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+mor 'khyil ba la/ /gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing*/ /ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku/ /cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha/ /'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang*/ /byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi/ /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dang*/ /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bla med go 'phang bgrod par bya ba'i phyir/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang*/ /sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'da' ka dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer/ /spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /snga phyir mnos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal/

/yun du mi btang 'da' bar mi bgyid cing*/ /don la gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang*/ /gdod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis/ /klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang*/ /shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te/ sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs/ /tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis na/ /ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ /skad cig tsam yang 'phrad par mi bya zhes/ /bka' las byung zhing de ltar mi rtogs te/ /gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye gsal dka' ba dang*/ /mngon shes med pas skyon can ma lcogs te/ /nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang*/ /nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang*/ /nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa'i skyon la sogs/ /nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag gis/ /nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams/ /rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol bshags na/ /byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang : gnyis med dbyings las mi 'gyur bdag bkod de/ /mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang la bzhugs nas kyang*/ /gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /don dam dmigs med spros las 'das pa la/ /rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na/ /nongs pa mchis na rab gnong bzod par gsol/ zhes dri med rgyal po bshags pa'i rgyud las/ ye shes lha dang 'khon bcugs bshags pa'i le'u bzhi pa khul du phyung ba'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i bshags pa bzhugs/ rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na mū la pa dhi/ bod skad du/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun nas dwang bas bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni/ /rgyud las gsungs pa bshad par bya/
