/gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs gsungs/ /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad/ /dang po phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /gnyis pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /rdo rje'i spun la khros nas ni/ /nyes par brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /gsum pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /sems can rnams la byams pa spangs/ /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /bzhi pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /lnga pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /drug pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin/ /bdun pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid/ /de la smod pa brgyad pa yin/ /brgyad pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba dgu pa yin/ /dgu pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa/ /byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod/ /bcu pa phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la/ der rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa/ /bcu gcig phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa/ /bcu gnyis phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin nyid/ /mi bsten pa ni bcu gsum pa/ /bcu gsum phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /bcu bzhi phog pa mthol lo bshags/ /sngags pas 'di dag spangs nas ni/ /dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pa bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur/ /de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing*/ /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni/

/bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bla ma la/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod byas nas/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni/ /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /sngags pas 'bad de gzung bar bya/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// // ༈ rdo rje sems dpa' gsang ba dri med las: bshags pa'i snying po sbyangs pa'i rgyal po bstan: oṃ: gzhi thog dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang : rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje de bzhin gshegs: dpa' bo chen po 'gro ba skyob pa'i mgon: bdag la brtser dgongs ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: āḥ gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag kyang : 'khrul ngor blo bur shar ba'i kun rtog las: ma rig gzung 'dzin rkyen snang nyams chag kun: dag chen chos dbyings yum gyi klong du bshags: badz+raḥ gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje'i dam bsgrags pa'i: sku gsung thugs gsang sa ma ya 'bum gyi: dam las nyams shing tshig las 'gal ba gang : rab tu gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: sa twa: nyams pa'i skyon du gyur pa'i dus 'das nas: las kyi gnyer 'dzin rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi: bka' yi chad pa drag po'i rgyur gyur pa'i: 'di phyi'i sgrib gyur dmyal chen rgyu bsags bshags: hūm̐: 'dod pa'i rgyal po ye nas rdo rje che: dmigs su med cing nyams dang bshags pa bral: kun tu bzang po ye rdzogs rig pa'i klong : 'du 'bral med pa chos dbyings klong du āḥ bshags pa'i rgyal po rdo rje tshig gsum pa: 'khor ba dong sprugs lcags khams gser 'gyur rtsis: theb pa ji bzhin ma rig dam nyams pa: byang 'gyur 'gro ba skyob pa'i gdams pa 'di: kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi klong las shar: pad+mas phyi rabs don du brda ris bkod: nga sprul snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gu h+ya: shu bhaṃ: khrag 'thung las kyi dpa' bos brda ris las phab pa'o:

dge'o: skong ba bsdus pa ni: hūm̐/ bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bla m zhes smon lam ni: nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs/ ༈ tshogs kyi mgor rang lugs su rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi byin brlab sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ ༈ rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: gtor bsngos bsdus pa phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs so: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus tshogs la gus pas 'dud: de yang rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus shing rab 'byams zhing gi rdul snyed rnams gcig tu bsdus nas: tshogs zhing gi mchod pa la 'jug par brtsam na: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis sgrig chog 'di ltar bgyi'o: sa ma ya: thog mar dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs bkod pa ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par bgyis nas 'bul: ma 'grigs tshe yid sprul rgyas btab blo dang bstun pa'i 'dun pa bya: oṃ ram̐ āḥyam̐ hūm̐ kham̐ sarba swā hā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ho hrī hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ smug po las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bh+rūm̐ e dzeṃ kheṃ be ra shu la 'bru brgyad zhu ba las byung ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur: thod pa'i kha chod nyi zla rdo rje'i yu ba can: steng nyi ma la ā li: 'og zla ba la kā li: bar mu khyud la rten 'brel snying po: rdo rje'i yar gyi rwa lnga la oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mar gyi rwa lnga la mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: bhan+dha'i kha khyer phyogs bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i yi ge de rnams kyi sgras bskul ba'i rigs lnga yab yum gyis sbyor ba mdzad: sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gcig tu 'dres ting nge 'dzin gyi bdud rtsir gyur:

thabs kyi rlung g.yos shes rab kyi me sbar bdag 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs shing bdud rtsi khol: lbu ba'i rlangs pa las byung ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs: shab+da rū pa gan+dhe rā sa spar+she lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa sti sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta pū dza me gha swā hā: zhes pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur: oṃ hūm̐ a hrīḥtrām̐ bh+rūm̐ mūm̐ lam̐' mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥha ho hrī phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas mchod cing lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ hoḥ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong nor lha gter bdag gter srung gzhan yang phyi rgyud kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad: bka' yi dregs pa sde brgyad 'jigs byed chen po dgu: yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag zo dor dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis spyan drangs: thugs rje dang smon lam gyi bden pa'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: tshogs 'khor sogs kyi skabs yin na 'dir tshogs zhus sngon du song bas tshogs bskang ba'i bar chog gzhung ltar 'jug srol mchis/ de nas bha ling+ta bran pa'o: bdud rtsi yin na mchod: gsur rdzas yin na bsreg: bsgrub gtor yin na mchod kha gso: gtor snod stong gsum tsam gyi 'jig rten bcud kyi skye 'gro 'byung lnga'i dbang du bsdus pa thams cad yi dam lha'i gsol mchod dmigs la 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: hūm̐: phyi snod srid gsum yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: nang bcud 'jig rten bcud kun gtor mar bsgyur: khams gsum 'byung lnga sems can rtsis su gdab: sems kyis ma bzung skye gnas 'jig gsum sogs:

zhing rdul brtsegs pa'i grangs med mchod sprin rnams: 'bul byed mchod pa'i lha mo yid 'phrog rigs: nam mkha'i rgyun ltar gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis: bstod cing bsngags nas btud de 'bul lags na: thugs rje'i brtse bas nyer dgongs bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum ston pa rdo rje sems: rin 'byung snang ba mtha' yas don yod grub: spyan ma mā kī gos dkar dam tshig sgrol: rdo rje 'chang sogs sangs rgyas byang sems la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: gnas lugs chos skur rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gsang ba ye shes dga' rab rdo rje dang : shrī singha mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang : sa la gnas dang phyag rgya tshe la dbang : lhun grub rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin dang : dgongs brda brgyud kyi slob dpon thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: hūm̐ ka ra dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : klu sgrub snying po pra bha hastī dang : dha na saṃ skṛ bi ma mi tra dang : rom+bu gu h+ya shān+tiṃ gar+bha sogs: rig 'dzin grub thob drang srong thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐ḥ rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rin po che: man+da ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : ka la sid+dhi shākya dhe ma dang : bkra shis khye'u 'dren la sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: snyan brgyud 'dus pa'i slob dpon thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: tshe rabs rjes su bzung ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐ḥ bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor bla med rgyud: dam tshig dbang dang man ngag lung dang ni: shes rab rgyud dang nyams chag bskang ba yi:

theg pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon chen po dang : rje 'bangs nyer lnga lung 'dzin sum cu bdun: bka' bab brgyud 'dzin gter ston brgya rtsa brgyad: dbang lung man ngag brgyud dang brgyud 'gyur pa'i: drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: mi zad gter la spyod pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: rdo rje drag po dmar nag me phreng can: 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsung gi lha: yang dag thugs dang che mchog yon tan sku: phrin las phur pa ma mo rbod gtong lha: 'jig rten mchod bstod dmod pa drag sngags pa: ye shes pa dang las su grub pa sogs: sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dbyings kyi dbang phyug mthing 'od 'bar ma dang : rdo rje phag mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang : pad+ma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro dang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro khros ma nag mo dang : seṅge'i gdong can sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha hi: hūm̐: legs ldan nag po phyag bzhi yab yum dang : ma ning gdong bzhi phyag drug bram ze'i gzugs: srog bdag bya rog gdong can bka' 'khor bcas: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dpal 'bar zhing skyong seng gdong yab yum dang : sprul pa las byed baṃ ro pho mo gnyis: bka' yi 'khor bcas dregs pa sde brgyad bcas: stobs ldan bdud mgon nag po 'khor bcas la:

mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: ma rungs bstan dgra bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: thog 'bebs ljang sngon gza' mchog rā hu la: gza' brgyad gdong mo mched bzhi yab yum dang : skyes bu chen po dam can rdo rje legs: mgar nag sde bzhi mched 'khor sum brgya drug: srog bdag sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ma: 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma ti: ma mo mched brgyad bse mo khrag ral can: dam can sde gsum 'khor dang bcas pa la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: dam sri log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: a phyi chos sgron ti sgro sman btsun lnga: rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gcig dpal lha mo: bod skyong bstan srung mi sring 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: phrin las spel ba'i kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gnod sbyin chen po btsan rgod me 'od gdong : sprul pa sde bzhi rol pa khrag 'thung bzhi: shan pa rlung sgrub gnod sbyin khyung zhon dang : shan pa dmar nag rol pa bco brgyad dang : dgra srog dbang ba'i btsan rgod 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: pha rol dgra bo sdig can sgrol bar mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lha yi dge bsnyen tshangs pa dung thod can: srog bdag chos skyong chen po dpe dkar dang : sprul pa sde brgyad yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: dge bsnyen chen po klu bdud ti pa tsa: smyo kha mkhar nag ti pa dam 'dzin sogs: drag rtsal ldan pa'i chos skyong 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: ma hā dhe wa dbang phyug tshogs kyi bdag: rnam mang thos sras nor bdag dzam bha la: ku we ra dang rta bdag gnod sbyin brgyad:

phyugs lha ljang gu dpal ldan nor rgyun ma: lug lha gang bzang ra lha gtsang btsan dang : drel lha dud sol 'bru lha brtan ma sman: mdzo lha khyung rgyal khyi lha bya ra ba: nor bdag dkor cha'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dregs pa sde brgyad dregs chen bco brgyad dang : sde dpon sum cu dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig: 'jigs byed sde dgu dpal mgon bdun cu gnyis: srid pa'i lha dgu mgul lha bcu gsum dang : gter srung sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bya ra 'grub par mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lha klu gnod sbyin gzhi bdag zo dor dang : sa bdag chu bdag me bdag rlung bdag dang : nam mkha'i bdag dang rang bzhin 'gyu ba dang : shing spang rdza dang yul chen dur khrod brgyad: gangs gnyan chen po nyi shu rtsa gcig gi: srung ma gnas dang dus su 'gyu ba dang : gtsang ma res sogs 'jig rten skyong rnams la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: lo nyes nad 'khrugs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gzhan yang 'khor ba myang 'das ma lus kyi: ye shes las dang grub pa'i srung ma dang : dkar phyogs lha dang nag phyogs bdud la sogs: mgron du 'os kyang dmigs bsal ma mchis pas: rgya mtsho'i srub dang ri rab zom gyi shod: dpag bsam rtse sogs mkha' lding mi ma yin: tshe rabs bsags pa'i bag chags nyer len rigs: dbang po nyams pa glo bur 'gyu ba sogs: kun bzang thugs dang srin bu phra mo'i sems: thams cad chos kyi dbyings su bdal gyur pas: las dang ye shes grub pa'i tshogs rnams la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor bzhes: tshe rabs lan chags byang ba'i phrin las mdzod:

i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi bhan+dha'i snod nang du: rtsa gsum gtor ma phrin las bzhi ldan ni: rtse mo nor bu dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs: dpung gshog zla gam 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub: logs gsum chos 'byung ma sring dbang du bsdus: rtsa ba zlum pos nad gdon bar chad zhi: mtha' rnams gru bzhis phrin las sna tshogs 'grub: pad 'dab bzhis brgyan gling bzhi'i 'gro ba 'dul: skyu nyis bzhis bskor sde brgyad dam la gnas: ril bu bzhis bskor phyi rgyud mgron rnams tshim: rtse phran pa tra nor bu'i 'khor lo yis: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun tu mchod sprin g.yo: dkar rtsi dmar rtsi gur dang thig phran gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes par bskang : de ltar mthun rdzas gnyan po bha ling gis: chos sku longs sku sprul sku'i thugs dam bskang : dgongs brgyud brda brgyud rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang : snyan brgyud shog ser slob dpon thugs dam bskang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : chos skyong dam can nor lha'i thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : rigs drug pha ma lan chags thugs dam bskang : chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang du bskang : longs sku 'gag pa med pa'i ngang du bskang : sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa'i klong du bskang : 'khor gsum skye 'gag bral ba'i klong du bskang : bskang zhing dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bshags: 'dod rgu dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba dang : rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma ya du ta e haṃ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra bi ma la ye swā hā: zhes phrin las rgyun chags kyi gtor bsngos bsdus pa 'di nyid rang gzhung gi gtor ma yod na kha gso med na gang 'byor gyi gtor ma bsham: rab stong nyid kyi mchod pa zer ba yin kyang :

rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs la dkon mchog la mchod pa dang : nyam thag la sbyin pa btang ba sems bskyed rnams: rnam dag gi dge rtsa yin pas shin tu yang spros pa bya rung : spros bcas spros med gang byas kyang rung 'don brjod rnams kyang med kyang rung : des na dngos rdzas che phra gang 'byor bshams par bya: tshig kha yi 'don don yid la bsgom pa yin pas sgra yang dag par bya: ji bzhin nyams su blangs pas tshogs gnyis smin cing mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis grogs yang dag par bgyid do: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: thig le rgya: kho bo rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing*/ bdud 'dul sngags gling du shog ser nas bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /༈ tshogs kyi skabs yin na skong bshags nas tshogs rol gyi bar dang skabs su tshogs grangs bsags dgos tshe/ las tshogs gang rigs la sbyar chog pa'i tshogs bsdus ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshogs rdzas 'dod yon ye shes rol pa'i rgyan: tshogs rje tshogs bdag rig 'dzin bla ma dang : gdan gsum dkyil 'khor gnas yul nyer bzhi'i bdag: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong rnams: 'dir gshegs longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: 'gal 'khrul nongs dang dam tshig nyams pa bshags: phyi nang bar chad chos kyi dbyings su sgrol: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gu ru dhe ba ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ.uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi: tshogs bsdus grangs bsog ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: bde skyong bhan+dha'i snod yangs par/ /tshogs rdzas 'dod yon rol pa'i rgyan/ /bde ba chen po'i longs spyod 'di/ /rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sogs lha mtshan kha bsgyur lha tshogs mchod/ /gsang gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags/

/thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sgrol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ lhag gtor 'bul lo phrin las sgrubs/ /ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho/ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi/ gnam sprul gsum pas mdzad pa'o/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dbyings kyi bhan+dhar rig pa'i tshogs gtor bshams: sgron drug 'ja' zer thig le'i 'dod yon bkra: ngo mtshar bsam mi khyab pa'i dam tshig 'dis: rang rig rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du mchod pa 'bul: rtog pa'i grwa zur thig le chen por bshags: gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs skye med dbyings su sgrol: 'khrul snang gzhi thog sad pa'i phrin las sgrubs: lhun grub snang bzhi'i ye shes mthar phyin nas: ka dag gzhon nu bum skur byang chub shog: zhes pa'ang rang lo sum cu rtsa gsum pa me byi zla1tshes17la 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rje rang nyid khams 'dus kyi rim gror rdzogs chen pa 'khrul zhig rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs skor brgya phrag bsgrubs pa'i nub kyi tho rangs rmi lam du bud med gcig gis tshig 'di lhang lhang 'don par thos pa gnyid sad pa na'ang ma brjed par 'dug pas 'khrul snang gi ri mo yi ger btab pa ste de'i phyir nyin nad las grol ba'i dge mtshan kyang byung ngo*// // ༈ dngos grub dam rdzas tshogs la rol ba ni/ las slob kyis 'dus pa'i gtso bo la btud de phyag byas nas rnam lnga 'dod skor gyi phyag rgya dang sbrags/ hoḥ bla ma dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol/ /'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*/ /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ ces pa'i lan du slob dpon gyis kyang phyag rgya de nyid dang bcas/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/ /gzung 'dzin rnam par bral ba yi/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ a la la hoḥ zhes pas len zhing lag sor g.yas g.yon rigs lnga yab yum du mos nas rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor la nang gi sbyin sreg ltar 'bul ba ni/

slob dpon gyis bskul la tshogs pa thams cad kyis/ hoḥ bza' bca' btung ba yang dag rdzas/ /gdod nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo che/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha hoḥhrīḥ /zag med bde chen bdud rtsir gyur/ /bdag lus phung khams skye mched ni/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i ngo bo ste/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'gul bskyod thams cad bde ba che/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig bla na med/ /byang chub sems kyi sprin chen por/ /gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du rol/ /rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs rdzogs nas/ /zas kyi sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /gtan pa med pa'i sbyin bdag kyang*/ /theg chen 'bras bur spyod par shog /ces brjod nas rdo rje lus kyi dag dran 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod cha/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi/ rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad/ mig pañca ra ga sna pha gu/ so drwa ba drwa phyed/ lce mchu 'dod snam/ sna rta babs/ snying ga'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa bzhi sgo bzhi/ rnam par shes pa he ru ka /tshogs brgyad kau'u ri ma brgyad/ yul brgyad phra men ma brgyad/ rtag chad mu bzhi sgo ma bzhi/ sgal tshigs nyer brgyad dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ mi dge ba bcu khro bo bcu/ dge ba bcu khro mo bcu/ rtsibs ma bco brgyad ging chen bco brgyad/ rus mgo sum brgya drug cu pho nya sum brgya drug cu/ dbang po'i sgo bdun ma mo bdun/ lhu tshigs bcu gnyis brtan ma bcu gnyis/ mdor na lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor/ rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor/ khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ rlung ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ rig pa byang chub kyi dkyil 'khor te dkyil 'khor rnam pa lnga'i bdag nyid du mos par mchod pa'i tshul gyis tshims par rol/ de'i tshe tshogs kyi dam rdzas la smod pa dang*/ theg dman gyi blos blang dor du blta ba dang*/

'thab rtsod dang*/ ku co dang*/ shags la sogs pa ni sbom po brgyad kyi ya gyal yin pas spang bar bya'o/ ༈ skabs 'dir bsam lhun dang bar chad lam sel bla ma'i zhabs brtan rigs sogs gsung srol yod pas de ltar bya/ ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las: gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub bzhugs so: e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang mtha'i sprul pa 'dzam bu gling du byon: o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho las 'khrungs: in+d+ra bhū tis rgyal srid mnga' gsol mdzad: za hor rgyal po'i bstan pa chos la btsud: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal srid spangs nas dur khrod gnas brgyad byon: ta na ga na'i sbyor sgrol spyod pa mdzad: rgya gar mu stegs dmag tshogs dam la btags: man+da ra sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: rgya gar thams cad rin chen gter gyis bkang : rig 'dzin gtso bo o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i dgongs pas bod la gzigs pa'i tshe: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags: mkhan slob chos gsum bod la nyi ma shar: bsam yas la sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul grub: mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos kyi sgron me sbar: thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas mchims phur bde 'dus sgrub chen mdzad: rje 'bangs rgya mtshor chos kyi bka' chen phab: sku tshab nyer lnga bod kyi don la bzhag: dgongs brda nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i shog ser la: ye shes lnga ldan tshom bu'i tshul du zug: kha byang yang byang lung byang rgya chen bsdams: dus gsum kun mkhyen o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khra 'brug rtsa gsum bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: man+da ra ba mkha' spyod gnas nas byon: dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs bkra shis mtha' rten mdzad: 'gro don mthar phyin o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs sras lnga dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: zhal gdams don tshan ma 'ongs lung bstan bzhag: 'dzam gling khams kun rin chen gter gyis bkang : lho nub gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can don la gzigs: grub thob rgyal po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skal ldan las can gsol ba btab pa'i tshe: nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhal mjal lung bstan gnang : gnas chen dus bzang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: gtan gyi skyabs mchog o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gter la dbang sgyur smin grol dkyil 'khor gyi: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs: byin 'bebs dbang bskur bkra shis rab gnas mdzad: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med: byin rlabs kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: rigs dang dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar gyur nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bdag gyur pa'i: phrin las 'gro 'dren dpal du 'byung gyur cig: om̐ gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes gsol 'debs 'di o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs pa'o/

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // gnyis pa rdo rje'i glu gar bya ba mos na/ las slob kyis slob dpon la phyag byas te/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol/ mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por kun tu bzang po'i tshogs mchod rgya mtshos phyi nang gi 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba legs par mchod zin pa'i gnas skabs 'dir ni mu tig phreng ba las/ tshogs dang dbang bskur dkyil 'khor 'jug /de nas glu la brtson par bya/ zhes pa'i don ltar chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dgongs spyod rgya mtshos rdo rje'i glu gar la thugs gtad par zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa byung rgyal du bskyang ba'am/ chos nyid kyi glu dbyangs snyan pos len par bya/ zhes rgyun du 'jug pa bde phyir/ bla mchod dngos grub rgya mtsho dang spyod yul lam khyer sangs rgyas lam zhugs gnyis las khol du phyung ba dge'o// // ༈ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i tshogs glu rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can bzhugs so/ las smon rten 'brel dpag bsam ljon shing gi steng du/ /rgya gar shar gyi rma bya gzhon nu yang phebs byung*/ /rma bya'i gdugs skor dam pa'i chos phyogs la bsgyur dang*/ /gzhon pa nga tshos thar pa'i lam sna zhig zin yong*/ /bsod nams dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i shing rta la phebs pa'i/ /lho mon shing lo'i tshal gyi khu byug gi gsung snyan/ /ya gi dri za'i bu mo'i gling bu las snyan pa/ /dbyar gsum nam zla spro ba'i rten 'brel la yag byung*/ /'dir 'dus las smon mthun pa'i rdo rje yi spun grogs/ /nga tsho'i bla ma bzhugs pa'i chos ra la phebs dang*/ /smin grol bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i dga' ston gyi ngang nas/ /nyams dga' glu ru len pa'i khyad chos shig yod do/ /dgongs brgyud dag pa'i byin rlabs snying dbus su babs pas/ /skye med rig stong rjen pa'i gnas lugs de mthong byung*/ /rtog tshogs rang sar dag pa'i snang ba 'di dga' 'o/

/re dogs mtha' las grol ba'i skyid glu rang 'then no/ /gzhi dbyings spros pa bral ba'i pha phogs shig thob pas/ /gzhi snang dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ /snang sems ro gcig 'dres pa'i skal bzang gi snang ngor/ /'khor 'das bzang ngan 'byed pa'i spu ris kyang ma dmigs/ /ka dag gzhi klong yangs par skyid nyal zhig byas pas/ /sna tshogs grub mtha'i yid byed na bun bzhin dwangs song*/ /las nyon mun pa rig stong ye shes kyis bsal tshe/ /'bad med gzhan phan phrin las phyogs med du rgyas song*/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa'i rnal 'byor gyi snang ngor/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor tha dad du ma mthong*/ /zung 'jug bla ma mchog gi ngo bo ru rtogs pas/ /skye 'chi 'khrul pa'i rtog brtags sgyu ma ru shar song*/ /bde chen 'pho 'gyur med pa'i bzhugs gral gyi dbus nas/ /lha dang bla ma'i zhal ras ma bsgoms kyang mthong byung*/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i snying thig 'od gsal gyi theg pas/ /'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i dngos grub cig zhu'o/ /grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje'i gsung chu bo yan lag brgyad pa lta bu la ba tshwa can gyi chu 'babs pa ltar/ /bdag lta bu'i las nyon gyis non pa'i gang zag gis go ba tsam gyis lta ba mtho mtho skad pa tsam du mi rung na'ang*/ tshogs glu len pa'i tshe ha cang nyung che bas cung zad mang na legs zhes mched po rnams kyi thugs mos bzhin rtsed mo'i tshul du kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gzhung la nges shes thun mong ma yin pa skyes pa'i skal pa bzang po thob pa'i gang zag au ḍi yā nar 'bod pas bris pa dza yan+tu// // ༈ tshogs glu mkha' 'gro dgyes glu bzhugs so/ a ho ye/ ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings bzhugs brgyud gsum gyi bla ma/ /lhun grub zhi khro'i gar ston yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ /thugs rje gang 'dul der snang gnas gsum gyi ḍāk+ki/ /ma lus zag med tshogs kyi dga' ston la phebs shog

/phyi snod nam mkha'i 'khor lo bde skyong gi tshogs gzhong*/ /thabs shes ri gling rol mtsho sha lnga dang bdud rtsi/ /phyi snang gdod nas dag pa'i tshogs 'khor zhig bskor na/ /rang snang sprul sku'i lha tshogs dgyes rgu la rol mdzod/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan rang byung gi bhan+dhar/ /a ham̐ zung 'jug bde chen dga' bzhi yi dam rdzas/ /nang 'byung dag 'gyur bde stong tshogs 'khor zhig bskor na/ /rang rtsal longs sku'i lha tshogs dgyes ngoms la rol mdzod/ /shes rab rdo rje btsun mo'i stong chen gyi bha gar/ /thabs mchog bde chen rdo rje mnyam sbyor gyi dga' ston/ /zung 'jug bcu drug dga' ba'i tshogs 'khor zhig bskor na/ /rang gnas chos sku'i lha tshogs dgyes pa zhig bskyed do/ /sems nyid spros pa kun bral ka dag gi gzhong par/ /lhun grub snang bzh-i sgron drug ye shes kyi tshogs gtor/ /gsang mchog cir snang rang grol tshogs 'khor zhig bskor na/ /rang rig nyid sku'i bla ma dgyes ston la phebs shog /'gul skyod phyag rgya'i rang bzhin rdo rje yi gar stabs/ /sgra skad grags stong rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dang rol mo/ /dran rtog rang grol 'od gsal gnyug ma yi yo langs/ /gang shar 'dzin med rang grol tshogs 'khor zhig bskor na/ 'di snang 'khrul pa'i sprin tshogs gzhi med du dengs nas/ /rtsol med rang bzhag 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi gzhi klong*/ /lhun grub snang bzhi lam 'gros mig 'phrul bzhin bsgyur nas/ /tshe gcig 'od skur grol ba'i dngos grub cig zhu'o/ /zhes pa'ang sngar gtang rag tshogs 'khor gyi skabs shig sems kyi snang cha gang byung bris la/ mtha' ma dbyung bar 'dug pa slar shog thor las rab byung ri zla'i shing bya lor/ sa zla'i nyer bdun la khyung po dkar smad ba/ gnam lcags bstan 'dzin gyis a ri mnga' sde mong kran na e wam̐ 'dus sder bkod pa'o// // ༈ de tshe las rdor pas lhag ma gral mthar bkod nas phyag sngon du song bas lhag gtor byin gyis brlab pa la thugs gtad par zhu zhes gsol ba dang*/

'dus pa byings nas/ om̐ a kā ros sngags dang*/ lhag ma dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ zhes slob dpon nas mkha' lding gi rgya bcas zhal chab kyi bdud rtsis bran la las gzhung ltar lhag ma bsngo/ smon lam ni/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /ces dang gtor 'gugs ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'gugs la las byang gi bskul pa btang mthar mjug tu chos skyong gi gtor 'bul nyung bsdus gsham gsal dang mthar rig 'dzin brgyud pas gtor ma 'bul/ chad brtan grub nas gtor gzhong kha sbub la 'gugs pa ni/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis gnod byed sdang dgra gdug pa can thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug cig /dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rang rgya dang bcas rta bro brdung*/ gtor gzhong kha yar slog skabs slob dpon gyis phyag 'bru gtor la/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ā dgyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: hūm̐ bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams: hrīḥ'agrub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs stsol: trām̐ brtan par gyur cig smon lam mthu btsan shog: dngos grub len pa'am rgyun du so so'i gzhung ltar mchod cing bstod la nongs pa bshags/ brtan bzhugs ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ 'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ bsdu rim grub mtshams bsngo ba smon lam gyi rim pa la spro bsdu skabs dang sbyar shes par bya'o/ ༈ bzang spyod smon lam bzhugs so/ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bha dra tsar+ya pra ṇi dhā na rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seṅge kun/ /bdag gi ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dwang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*/ /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*/ /mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*/ /phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*/ /bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/

/bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*/ /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*/ /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*/ /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur/ /gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar/ /bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon/ /phyogs bcu ga la'i zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rgya cher yongs su dag gyur cig /byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shog /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni/ /mthun par gyur cig re ba'ang 'grub par shog /byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing*/ /'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par 'gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na/ /rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/

/bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*/ /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam par/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson zhing*/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur/ /sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las/ /grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang*/ /ji ltar pad+mo chus mi chags pa bzhin/ /nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa med ltar spyad/ /zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing*/ /'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ /sems can dag gi spyod dang mthun par 'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing*/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par gyur/ /bdag gi spyod dang mtshungs par gang spyod pa/ /de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang*/ /spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad/ /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston bgyid pa/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu 'phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung*/ /sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams/ /mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal bar blta/ ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing*/ /byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed/ /bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyong ba yang*/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad par bgyi/ /srid pa thams cad du yang 'khor ba na/

/bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad brnyes/ /thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang*/ /yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod cing blta bar bgyi/ /de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang*/ /skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang*/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis/ /rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i tshogs rnams rab tu bskor ba yi/ /de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la/ /blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang*/ /skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis ni zhugs par spyad/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seṅge gang*/ /de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta/ /rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa/ /de dag rdul gcig steng du mngon par bsgrub/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /de dag rim par 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor/ /myang ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston/ /mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o/ /kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang*/ /kun tu sgo yi theg pa'i stobs dag dang*/ /kun tu yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang*/ /kun tu khyab pa byams pa dag gi stobs/

/kun nas dge ba'i bsod nams stobs dag dang*/ /chags pa med pa gyur pa'i ye shes stobs/ /shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis/ /byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed/ /las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing*/ /nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu 'joms par byed/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs med rab byed cing*/ /bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyi/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*/ /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par grol/ /chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing*/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*/ /smon lam rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs par byed/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing*/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad par bgyi/ /gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yi/ /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams/ /bzang po spyod pas byang chub 'tshang rgyas nas/ /de kun ma lus bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya/ /mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyad pa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing*/ /spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag pa/ /bsngo ba bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra ba/ /de 'drar bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyad pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyi/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyang tshad bzung med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang*/ /de dag 'phrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam pa/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/

/bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog rnams kyang*/ /zhing gi rdul snyed bskal par phul ba bas/ /gang gis bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos nas/ /byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab mos shing*/ /lan gcig tsam yang dad pa bskyed pa na/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pas/ /des ni ngan song thams cad spong bar 'gyur/ /des ni grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong*/ /de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho/ /mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ong*/ /kun tu bzang po de yang ci 'dra bar/ /de dag ring por mi thogs de bzhin 'gyur/ /mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /gang gis mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang po spyod pa 'di brjod na/ /myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang*/ /rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mi thub/ /'jig rten gsum po kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste// /byang chub sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad btul/ /gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di/ /'chang ba dang ni ston tam klog na yang*/ /de yi rnam par smin pa'ang sangs rgyas mkhyen/ /byang chub mchog la som nyi ma byed cig /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*/ /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*/

/bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang*/ /thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bkang*/ /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang*/ /sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /des ni 'gro ba'i smon lam dge ba rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor bar shog /gang yang bzang po spyod pa 'di bsngos pas/ /bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa gang thob des/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bor bying ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /smon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchog gi gtso/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed cing*/ /kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub ste/ /ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stongs par shog /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po rdzogs so// // ༈ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong lha mig ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang yang*/ /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan 'gro las ni bzlog bgyid cing*/ /mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/

/bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi/ /bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gis/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa de/ /bdag ni kun mkhyen sa bon te/ /bdag gi byang chub mi zad shog /phyogs bcu dag gi zhing khams su/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa gang byung ba/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pas yi rang ba/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo*/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni ye shes mchog thob shog /phyogs bcu dag gi phyogs rnams su/ /sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog /'tshang rgya bgyid par bskul ma 'debs/ /byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing*/ /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas/ /srog chags kun la sman slad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /chos rnga chen po sgra yis ni/ /sdug bsngal sems can thar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying gyur cing*/ /srid pa'i srad bus dam bcings pa/ /'ching ba kun gyis bcings bdag la/ /rkang gnyis mchog rnams gzigs su gsol/ /sems kyi dri mar bgyis pa la/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni smod mi mdzad/ /sems can rnams la byams thugs ldan/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang*/ /gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa/ /de dag rjes su bdag slob cing*/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod gyur cig /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas/ /'gro drug sems can thar bgyid shog /mngon shes drug po mngon bgyis nas/ bla med byang chub reg gyur cig /ma skyes pa dang mi 'byung dang*/ /rang bzhin ma mchis gnas ma mchis/ /rnam rig ma mchis dngos ma mchis/ /stong pa'i chos ni rtogs par shog /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po ltar/ /sems can ma mchis srog ma mchis/ /gang zag ma mchis gso ma mchis/ /bdag ma mchis pa'i chos rtogs shog

/bdag 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos po kun la mi gnas par/ /sems can kun la phan slad du/ /ser sna ma mchis sbyin gtong shog /dngos po dngos por ma mchis pas/ /bdag gi longs spyod lhun grub shog /dngos po thams cad rnam 'jig pa'i/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sa'am yang na chu'am me/ /rlung gi khams ltar mi gnas shing*/ /bzod pa khro ba ma mchis par/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ brten spro le lo ma mchis shing*/ /stobs dang ldan pa'i lus sems kyis/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang*/ /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang yang*/ /rigs gsum mngon sum bgyis pa yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa dang*/ /'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar spyad pa spyod byed cing*/ /byams pa grags dang ldan pa yis/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas/ /sa bcu'i spo la rab gnas shog /de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams dpag med kyis/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro lha ma yin/ /gnas ngan len rnams rtag tu spangs byas nas/ rgyal ba byams pa'i zhabs drung skye bar shog // // ༈ na mo/ 'khor ba 'khor tshe skyes gnas thams cad du/ chos la bzod pa ma thob bar du bdag /ngan song gsum du nam yang mi skye zhing*/ mtho ris mi yi lus su skye bar shog mtho ris mi yi lus su skyes nas kyang*/

sdig spyod rgyal po ma skyes de yi blon po dang*/ dmag dpon zhal lce gcod pa'i lus su bdag ma skye/ khe byed til rdung chang 'tshong rkun mo dang*/ bran dang mo yi lus su bdag ma skye/ dge slong rnams la dbang byed bdag po dang*/ gnas brtan las byed pa dang nang khrims pa/ dge bskos gtsang sbyor ba dang dam bzhag pa/ gang zag las byed rnams su bdag ma skye/ mtha' 'khob kla klo'i skye bo'i yul rnams dang*/ glen lkugs 'on long phrag dog can rnams dang*/ mu stegs log lta can gyi rigs rnams dang*/ rigs ngan shan pa'i lus su bdag ma skye/ byang chub ma thob bar du rtag par bdag /lus kyi yan lag rgyas shing skyon med de/ dbang po tshang zhing rigs mtho bkur ba'i gnas/ dam chos spyod pa'i lus su skye bar shog dam chos spyod pa'i lus su skyes nas kyang*/ gzhon nu rab byung tshul khrims ldan pa dang*/ tshe la nad kyi bar chad med pa ru/ skyes ma thag tu chos dang 'phrad par shog skyes ma thag tu chos dang 'phrad nas kyang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum rigs pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ rnam shes drug po yul la ma yengs par/ ting 'dzin rtse gcig sems la dbang thob nas/ khams gsum ma lus sems can thams cad kyi/ don rnams ma lus bdag gis 'grub par shog // // ༈ kun tu bzang po'i smon lam bzhugs so/ tsit+ta āḥ de nas thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang pos 'khor ba'i sems can rnams 'tshang mi rgya bar dbang med pa'i smon lam khyad par can 'di gsungs so: hoḥ snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun: gzhi gcig lam gnyis 'bras bu gnyis: rig dang ma rig cho 'phrul te: kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyis: thams cad chos dbyings pho brang du: mngon par rdzogs te 'tshang rgya shog: kun gyi gzhi ni 'dus ma byas: rang byung klong yangs brjod du med: 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i ming med do: de nyid rig na sangs rgyas te: ma rig sems can 'khor bar 'khyams:

khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis: brjod med gzhi don rig par shog: kun tu bzang po nga yis kyang : rgyu rkyen med pa gzhi yi don: de nyid gzhi la rang byung rig: phyi nang sgro skur skyon ma btags: dran med mun pa'i sgrib ma gos: de phyir rang snang skyon ma gos: rang rig so la gnas pa la: srid gsum 'jig kyang dngangs skrag med: snang sems gnyis su med pa la: 'dod yon lnga la chags pa med: rtog med shes pa rang byung la: gdos pa'i gzugs dang dug lnga med: rig pa'i gsal cha ma 'gags pa: ngo bo gcig la ye shes lnga: ye shes lnga po smin pa las: thog ma'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga byung : de las ye shes mtha' rgyas pas: sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis byung : ye shes lnga yi rtsal shar bas: khrag 'thung drug cu tham pa byung : de phyir gzhi rig 'khrul ma myong : thog ma'i sangs rgyas nga yin pas: nga yi smon lam btab pa yis: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can gyis: rang byung rig pa ngo shes nas: ye shes chen po mtha' rgyas shog: nga yi sprul pa rgyun mi chad: bye ba phrag brgya bsam yas 'gyed: gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs ston: nga yi thugs rje'i smon lam gyis: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can kun: rigs drug gnas nas 'thon par shog: dang po sems can 'khrul pa rnams: gzhi la rig pa ma shar bas: ci yang dran med thom me ba: de ka ma rig 'khrul pa'i rgyu: de la had kyis brgyal ba las: dngangs skrag shes pa za zi 'gyus: de las bdag gzhan dgrar 'dzin skyes: bag chags rim bzhin brtas pa las: 'khor ba lugs su 'jug pa byung : de las nyon mongs dug lnga rgyas: dug lnga'i las la rgyun chad med: de phyir sems can 'khrul pa'i gzhi: dran med ma rig yin pa'i phyir: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: kun gyis rig pa rang shes shog: lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa: shes pa dran med yengs pa yin: kun tu btags pa'i ma rig pa:

bdag gzhan gnyis su 'dzin pa yin: lhan skyes kun btags ma rig gnyis: sems can kun gyi 'khrul gzhi yin: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi: dran med 'thib pa'i mun pa sangs: gnyis su 'dzin pa'i shes pa dwangs: rig pa'i rang ngo shes par shog: gnyis 'dzin blo ni the tshom ste: zhen pa phra mo skyes pa las: bag chags mthug po rim gyis brtas: zas nor gos dang gnas dang grogs: 'dod yon lnga dang byams pa'i gnyen: yid 'ong chags pa'i 'dod pas gdungs: de dag 'jig rten 'khrul pa ste: gzung 'dzin las la zad mtha' med: zhen pa'i 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe: rkam chags gdungs pa'i yi dwags su: skyes nas bkres skom ya re nga : sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: 'dod chags zhen pa'i sems can rnams: 'dod pa'i gdung ba phyir ma spangs: 'dod chags zhen pa tshur ma blangs: shes pa rang sor klod pa yis: rig pa rang so zin gyur nas: kun rtog ye shes thob par shog: phyi rol yul gyi snang ba la: 'jigs skrag shes pa phra mo 'gyus: sdang ba'i bag chags brtas pa las: dgrar 'dzin brdeg gsod hrags pa skyes: zhe sdang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe: dmyal ba'i btso bsreg sdug re bsngal: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi: zhe sdang drag po skyes pa'i tshe: spang blang mi bya rang sor klod: rig pa rang so zin gyur nas: gsal ba'i ye shes thob par shog: rang sems khengs par gyur pa la: gzhan la 'gran sems smad pa'i blo: nga rgyal drag po'i sems skyes pas: bdag gzhan 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal myong : las de'i 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe: 'pho ltung myong ba'i lha ru skye: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: khengs sems skyes pa'i sems can rnams: de tshe shes pa rang sor klod: rig pa rang so zin gyur nas: mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs shog: gnyis 'dzin brtas pa'i bag chags kyis:

bdag bstod gzhan smod zug rngu las: 'thab rtsod 'gran sems brtas pa las: gsod gcod lha min gnas su skye: 'bras bu dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung : sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: 'gran sems 'thab rtsod skyes pa rnams: dgrar 'dzin mi bya rang sor klod: shes pa rang so zin gyur nas: phrin las thogs med ye shes shog: dran med btang snyoms yengs pa las: 'thibs dang rmugs dang brjed pa dang : brgyal dang le lo gti mug pas: 'bras bu skyabs med byol song 'khyams: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: gti mug bying ba'i mun pa la: dran pa gsal ba'i mdangs shar bas: rtog med ye shes thob par shog: khams gsum sems can thams cad kun: kun gzhi sangs rgyas nga dang mnyam: dran med 'khrul pa'i gzhi ru song : da lta don med las la spyod: las drug rmi lam 'khrul pa 'dra: nga ni sangs rgyas thog ma yin: 'gro drug sprul pas 'dul ba'i phyir: kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyis: sems can thams cad ma lus pa: chos kyi dbyings su 'tshang rgya shog: a hoḥ phyin chad rnal 'byor stobs can gyis: 'khrul med rig pa rang gsal nas: smon lam stobs chen 'di btab pas: 'di thos sems can thams cad kun: skye ba gsum nas mngon 'tshang rgya: nyi zla gza' yis zin pa'am: sgra dang sa g.yos byung ba'am: nyi ma ldog 'gyur lo 'pho dus: rang nyid kun tu bzang por bskyed: kun gyis thos par 'di brjod na: khams gsum sems can thams cad kun: rnal 'byor nga yi smon lam gyis: sdug bsngal rim gyis grol nas kyang : mtha' ru sangs rgyas thob par shog: ces gsungs so: rdzogs pa chen po kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa zang thal du bstan pa'i rgyud las: smon lam stobs po che btab pas sems can thams cad 'tshang mi rgya ba'i dbang med par bstan pa'i le'u dgu pa khol du phyung ba'o: dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ ༈ sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: gsang sngags lam rim smon lam le'u bdun ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror 'dud: phyi nang mchod 'bul sdig ltung bshags: yi rang bskul bskor gsol ba yi: dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo: sku gsum rgyal kun dgongs pa 'dus: rdo rje'i bla ma che ba'i mchog: ma hā gu ru'i thugs bskyed dang : rlabs chen mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthus: smon lam gegs med 'grub par shog: 'di nas skye ba thams cad du: dkyil 'khor rdo rje slob dpon dang : mched lcam 'dus pa rgya mtsho bcas: las kyi 'phro bzang 'bral med shog: rtag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa dang : dam tshig rnam par dag par shog: skye kun rigs bzang lus thob cing : 'gro ba'i don la spyod par shog: bla ma lha dang dkyil 'khor sngags: 'bral med bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin shog: bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa yi: nam yang glags mi rnyed par shog: bdag gi stobs kyis bdud kyi sde: lhag ma med par bcom par shog: sbyor sgrol zab mo'i dgongs pa yis: khams gsum 'khor ba yongs sgrol shog: lta sgom rnam par dag pa yis: snying po'i bstan pa spel bar shog: gsang ba kun gyi gnyer 'dzin pa: rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bdag 'grub shog: gsang ba spyir smon pa'i le'u ste dang po'o: sa ma ya: dal 'byor ldan pa'i lus thob dus: snying po'i don dang ldan par shog: mi rtag 'chi bas rgyud bskul nas: theg pa mchog la 'jug par shog: las 'bras bslu med nyer dran nas: spang blang gnas la mkhas par shog: 'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin la: rnam kun nges par dbyung bar shog: lus la ban de'i chas bgos nas: skye bo'i las kun mi bsgrub shog: dur khrod ri khrod gangs khrod sogs: sgrub gnas dben pa bsten par shog: rtag tu ri dwags rmas ma bzhin: 'du 'dzi'i gnas kun spong bar shog: don med 'dengs rgya mi dran par: thos bsam sgom la gzhol bar shog: rgyud la sdom pa'i rten mnos nas: thar pa'i srog rtsa tshugs par shog: dam chos rnam dag sgrub pa la:

zol zog dri ma bral bar shog: chos min spyod pa kun spangs nas: dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin par shog: thun mong dang blo sbyong bar smon pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song nas: byang chub bar du 'bral med shog: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: phar phyin drug la slob par shog: pha rol phyin drug rab rdzogs nas: 'gro ba'i bla mar 'gyur bar shog: byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen sprin: sgrib pa bzhi dang bral bar shog: mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal: tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par shog: mi dge'i bshes dang sdig pa'i grogs: dus rnams kun tu mi 'phrad shog: mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa gang : mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten par shog: de yang sangs rgyas dngos mthong nas: gsang gsum byin rlabs thob par shog: gnas dus ston 'khor dam pa'i chos: phun tshogs dpal la spyod par shog: nad med bde ba'i lang tsho rgyas: tshe yang dpag med ring bar shog: bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang : chos ston phrin las rgyas par shog: 'phags tshogs rnam pa gnyis kyi sdes: sa yi khyon kun gang bar shog: rtag tu thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing : 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug par shog: rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba dang : 'gro kun bde skyid ldan par shog: rtsod ldan rgud pa kun zhi zhing : rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog: mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud rang grol nas: spobs pa'i gter kha 'byed par shog: bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung kun don: rtsol med rgyud la 'byong bar shog: byin rlabs dgongs pa'i bcud thob nas: rtogs pa mkha' dang mnyam par shog: sems can kun gyi rin po che: yid bzhin nor bu lta bur shog: rten 'brel thabs la mkhas pa yi: 'gro don phyogs med 'char bar shog: rgyud sbyong bar smon pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: sa ma ya: mtshan bcas bum pa'i dbang thob cing : ma hā yo ga'i gsang lam nas: snang ba sku yi phyag rgyar rdzogs:

rnam smin rig 'dzin mngon 'gyur shog: bde chen gsang ba'i dbang thob cing : a nu yo ga'i gsang lam nas: grags stong nā da'i dbyings su dag: tshe dbang rig 'dzin mngon 'gyur shog: shes rab ye shes dbang thob cing : tsaṇ+ḍa lī yi gsang lam nas: rtog tshogs 'od gsal chos skur smin: phyag rgya rig 'dzin mngon 'gyur shog: ka dag tshig dbang mchog thob cing : a ti yo ga'i gsang lam nas: mngon par byang chub sangs rgyas te: lhun grub rig 'dzin mngon 'gyur shog: 'da' dka'i dam tshig mchog mnos nas: lta sgom rnam par dag par shog: shes rab rnam pa gnyis ldan pa'i: stong nyid lta ba rtogs par shog: gang la 'dzin rtsol mi mnga' ba: sgom med gnas la mkhas par shog: spang blang rang grol spyod pa'i gsang : brtul zhugs lam du lhong bar shog: rgyud smin par smon pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o: sa ma ya: gsang ba kun gyi gnad bsnun ste: sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng par shog: tshe 'dir bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas: bar do sku gsum mngon 'gyur shog: srid pa'i dgon pa las bgrod de: mi gnas myang 'das mchog thob shog: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma yi: byin rlabs dbang chen 'pho bar shog: rab 'byams rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor dang : dbyer med dngos grub thob par shog: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis: 'bral med bu bzhin skyong bar shog: ma tshogs rnams kyis lung ston cing : dam can tshogs kyis srung bar shog: snang bzhi'i bgrod pa mthar phyin nas: 'pho ba chen por sangs rgyas shog: skye ba gcig gis las rdzogs nas: zhing khams thams cad dag par shog: sa bcu lam lnga rab rdzogs nas: gu ru nyid dang dbyer med shog: rgyud grol bar smon pa'i le'u ste lnga'o: sa ma ya: rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par sbyor: phrin las kun la dbang 'byor shog: sa gsum khyon la dbang byed cing : srid gsum bran du 'khol bar shog: zhi rgyas dbang gi sbyor ba yis:

gdul bya kha lo sgyur bar shog: mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun: sku gsum sa la sbyor bar shog: mkhyen pa mchog dang ldan pa yi: bstan pa'i srog rtsa mthud par shog: brtse ba rlabs dang ldan pa yis: snyigs dus gdul dka' 'dul bar shog: nus pa mthu dang ldan pa yis: ma rungs zhing bcu sgrol bar shog: phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi: rgyal kun dgongs pa rdzogs par shog: ma hā gu ru'i gsang gsum gyi: rnam thar ma lus 'grub par shog: gzhan don phrin las la smon pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o: sa ma ya: nam zhig 'brel bcas sems can kun: sku gsum zhing khams 'byong bar shog: tshe 'di'i 'brel thag chad tsa na: nad gcod sdug bsngal mi 'byung shog: gnyen dang nor rdzas rmi lam bzhin: 'khrul pa'i gdos thag chod par shog: bsam gtan bar do bskyed rdzogs mthus: 'chi kha bar do rang grol shog: 'byung bzhi'i thim rim shar tsa na: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bsu bar shog: rnal 'byor lus rgya grol tsa na: sems sangs rgyas pa mngon 'gyur ba'i: spro ba'i sems kyis 'pho bar shog: rigs sngags gshog pa'i sgros btegs te: sbrul mdud rang gis bshigs pa bzhin: skad cig btsan thabs 'pho bar shog: gal te rim gyis 'pho tsa na: snang mched thob gsum rdzogs pa'i rjes: rdo rje sems dpa'i nam mkha' che: chos sku'i dbyings su grol bar shog: gal te ma grol gnyis pa'i skabs: ji ltar ma pang bu 'jug bzhin: longs sku'i dbyings su grol bar shog: thim lugs brgyad kyi snang cha kun: rang ngo ma shes 'khrul tsa na: rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams su: skad cig rdzus te skye bar shog: bde ba can dang po tā la: pad+ma 'od sogs phyogs bcu yi: sku gsum zhing rnams nyul bar shog: don la sku gsum tha mi dad: sgyu ma'i skyes bu ji bzhin du: snang ba zhing la rig pa sku: sku gsum ston pa'i zhal mthong shog: phra ba'i shes sgrib der zad nas:

skal pa mchog dang ldan pa yi: mi 'jigs pa yi dbugs chen po: byang chub lung bstan rab thob shog: sku gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang : dbyer med chos kyi sku thob ste: ma 'gags mkha' mnyam ye shes rtsal: gzugs sku gang la gang 'dul gyis: 'gro don rgyun mi chad par shog: mtha' grol 'bras bur smin pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o: sa ma ya: ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha ma la: gsang sngags mos pa lam 'khyer las: tshul bzhin spyod pa nyin skar tsam: dus der lam cha tshang ba yi: smon lam stobs chen 'di btab na: ma 'ongs skye ba'i phreng ba ru: gsang ba'i lta spyod zab mo'i gnad: nyams su len pa'i skal ldan 'gyur: don la bsam gzhig zab mo'i tshig: rtag tu kha thon byed pa na: nges par 'byung zhing sa lam gyi: 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib lhag med dag: tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing rnyed dang ldan: sdig pa'i grogs dang mi 'phrad par: dge ba'i grogs kyis chos mthun sgrub: lha dang bla ma dam chos sogs: rtsol med mjal zhing rgyud la 'jug: phyi yi nad mug mtshon 'khrug dang : nang gi nyon mongs dug lnga kun: rang sar zhi zhing stong par 'gyur: rdzogs ldan dus sogs phun tshogs lnga'i: dpal la longs su spyod par 'gyur: rang rgyud smin cing grol nas kyang : phrin las rnam bzhis gzhan don kun: o rgyan nga dang mtshungs par spyod: nam zhig 'brel pas bsdus pa yi: 'gro kun sku gsum mngon 'gyur nas: gang mos dag pa'i zhing khams bgrod: sa lam thams cad rab rdzogs nas: byang chub dam par lung bstan thob: slar yang sprul dang yang sprul tshogs: nyi zer rdul ltar mkha' dang mnyam: 'gro ba bdun po ma lus pa: sangs rgyas sa la bdag gcig gis: sbyong bar 'gyur ba e ma hoḥ sa ma ya: 'di ni nges par thos grol yin: bsam mno med pa'i dud 'gro sogs: gang gi thos na don yod cing : khyad par sems can 'chi kha mar: rna lam gsal dag lan gsum mam: gcig brjod pas ni sgrib byang shing :

rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon zhog: skye ba bdun nas gsang sngags kyi: sgor zhugs byang chub rim gyis thob: gter 'di sa yi steng du ni: thon cing zhal phye tsam gyis kyang : dus kyi khug pa nges par gso: pad+ma nga yi thugs bskyed dang : smon lam zab mo'i khyad chos yin: log lta'i 'dam du tshud rnams kyang : mtha' can nyid du sangs rgyas kyi: gdul byar thabs kyi 'jog pa yin: sa ma ya: khyad par nga yi rjes 'jug rnams: nyin mtshan dus drug thun gyi gseng : yar mar dus kyi mchod pa'i skabs: kha zhe gnyis med rtse gcig tu: smon lam zab mo 'di btab na: bskyed rdzogs lam gyi gegs sel zhing : bogs 'don nyid du nges par shes: sa ma ya: 'di nyid ched du klog pa'i thabs: dus ni nya stong tshes brgyad sogs: sa g.yo nyi zla gza' 'dzin dus: sems ni rgya chen rab bskyed de: rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas ni: rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs can: snying khar kun bzang yab yum dang : tha mar rigs drug sems can dang : mdun mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas bsgom: lce steng ā li kā li yi: 'phro 'du gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus: lce ni rdo rje'i ljags bzang po'i: dag par brjod pa'i sgra che ba: rigs drug so so'i rang skad du: gsal la ma 'dres sgrogs par bsgom: de ltar rnal 'byor stobs chen gyis: rigs drug ngan song dong sprugs nas: sangs rgyas kyi ni mdzad pa 'grub: sa ma ya: e ma phyi rabs skal ldan rnams: nga yi dam chos zab mo 'di: spro ba bskyed la yi ger bris: rang gar ma 'jog nyams su longs: 'di ni nga yi nye brgyud yin: lam gzhan las lhag ches cher myur: ji ltar bsngags bzhin nges par 'grub: sa ma ya: dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu yi: rang byung dpal gyi ke'u tshang : he ru ka yi 'du khang du: gu ru rje 'bangs grogs bcas kyis: gsang chen dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bcud: dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe:

zab mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs: mthu chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang : gsang 'dzin jo mo mtsho rgyal mas: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi: maṇ+ḍal phyag bcas phul te zhus: da lta'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho bcas: nam yang 'bral ba med pa dang : ma 'ongs gter gyi 'gro don dus: gdul bya skyong thabs man ngag dang : 'brel zhing gsang sngags zab mo yi: lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam zhig: legs par gnang ba zhus pa'i ngor: bdag 'dra dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag: pad+ma rgyal pos yang dag sbyar: da lta dus min gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: -i thi: zhes pa'ang sbas yul chen po pad+ma bkod kyi byang gling dbang drag tshal gyi nye zhol 'brug la mar me kong 'bum gyi brag gur dbub pa lta bu'i nub logs nas 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas dngos grub tu thob pa'i zab gsang bla ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi chos sde chen po'i cha lag gsang sngags lam rim smon lam le'u bdun ma zhes bya ba 'di lo ngo drug tu gsang rgyas btab pa'i slar 'phags bod kyi mtshams gar sha mkha' 'gro'i gling gi bye brag yul srin mo gling gi dgon pa 'od gsal lhun grub gling du khro mo zhes pa 'byung ba gsum ldan shing pho 'brug gi lor ston 'bras bcud du smin pa khrums stod zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang por gtan la phab pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam dpal ri'i gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: rang bzhin rnam dag blo bral gnyug ma'i sbubs: gsal mdangs 'gags med bde stong longs sku'i rtsal: sprul sku'i zhing khams mi mjed bkod pa'i cha: zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog: 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba rdo rje gdan: dus gsum rgyal bas chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas: de yi nub byang rnga yab lang ka'i gling :

zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor? bkod pa lhun grub tsit+ta'i sa 'dzin spo: rtsa ba gdengs can 'jog po'i thod du bcings: sked par lus med mkha' 'gros tshogs 'khor bskor: rtse mo gzugs khams bsam gtan snyogs pa lta'i: zangs mdog? ri rgyal de yi rtse mo'i gzhal med khang : shar shel lho phyogs dbang sngon baiḍūr+ya: nub phyogs pad rāg byang phyogs in+d+ra ni: phyi nang bar med zang thal dbang gzhu'i mdangs: zangs mdog? khyams dang gru chad glo 'bur 'ja' ris 'khyil: 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed dang : shar bu mda' yab sgo rgyan rta babs can: chos 'khor gdugs tog brda don rtags rdzogs pa'i: zangs mdog? dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing dang bdud rtsi'i chu: ne'u sing sman ljongs dri bsung 'thul ba'i khrod: drang srong rig 'dzin bya tshogs bh+ra ma ra: theg gsum chos kyi sgra dang brda glu sgyur: zangs mdog? pho brang gzhal med chen po'i lte ba la: rin chen zur brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : bde gshegs kun 'dus rang byung pad+ma 'byung : sku gsum rigs 'dus 'ja' zer klong na bzhugs: zangs mdog? gang gi zab gsal bde chen ye shes rtsal: stong nyid snying rjer shar ba'i sgyu 'phrul las: phyogs bcu kun dang khyad par bod yul du: sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya bar med 'gyed: zangs mdog? g.yas kyi gral na rgya bod rig 'dzin rnams: 'od gsal rdo rje'i rol ngor 'byams su klas: g.yon gyi gral na 'phags bod paṇa grub rnams: bshad sgrub nyams rtogs bgro gleng chos sgra 'ur: zangs mdog? mtha' skor bar mtshams rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang : sprul pa'i gter ston grub pa'i khyu mchog rnams: theg pa rim dgu'i 'khor lo la spyod cing : g.yo med dgongs pa'i gzer gyi brtul zhugs 'dzin: zangs mdog? phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gru chad bar khyams kun: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki lha dang lha mos khengs: rdo rje'i glu gar mig 'phrul lta bur g.yo:

phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin stob par byed: zangs mdog dpal? de steng longs sku'i gzhal med bkod mdzes nang : phyag na pad+ma 'jig rten dbang phyug la: tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsam yas 'khor gyis bskor: rnam rtog bag chags dgra gdon thal bar byed: zangs mdog? de steng chos sku'i zhing khams nyams dga' bar: gzhi snang ye shes snying po kun tu bzang : snang mtha' rig pa'i 'khor la brda chos ston: ston 'khor dgongs pa mnyam pa'i phrin las can: zangs mdog? sgo bzhir bka' nyan rgyal po chen po bzhi: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad kun: pho nyar mngags nas mu stegs dam sri 'dul: dam can rgya mtsho dpa' rtags rgyal rnga brdung : zangs mdog? de ltar zhing gi bkod pa gsal btab nas: phyi rol yul gyi zangs mdog dpal ri la: yul can nang gi rig pas smon de'i mthus: rang lus mi mjed zhing gi bkod pa'i nang : rang snang zangs mdog dpal rir mngon par shog: khyad par bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rten 'brel gyis: rtsa gsum 'khor lnga'i mdud pa grol nas kyang : snying dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang cher: lhan skyes ye shes rol pa'i rtsal rdzogs nas: rang rig pad 'byung rje dang mjal bar shog: tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam lnga'i sbubs: rab dga' nas bzung kun tu 'od kyi bar: de las rdo rje theg pa'i sa mchog gnyis: khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yi: thun mong ma yin ye shes bla ma'i sa: byar med lhug pa'i ngang du rdzogs nas kyang : gzhi dbyings pad+ma 'od du grol bar shog: gal te dgongs pa'i rtsal chen ma rdzogs na: gsol 'debs smon lam drag po'i 'phen pa yis: nam zhig 'chi ba btsan thabs byung ba'i tshe: pad+ma'i pho nya mkha' 'gro gar mkhan mas: mngon sum lag pa'i khu tshur nas bzung nas: mkhar chen bza' dang gu ṇa nā tha ltar mthong snang sna tshogs yod pa'i lugs ltar bshad pa yin: bdag kyang pad+ma 'od du 'khrid par shog:

chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang : dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs rje yis: bdag gis smon pa'i yid bzhin 'grub gyur nas: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog: ces rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing khams dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing mchog dam par bgrod pa'i smon lam dpal ri'i gsang lam zhes bya ba 'di ni: snyan brgyud rdo rje'i btsun mo'i rnal 'byor pa dharma kirti'i bzhed skong du/ dpal o rgyan yab yum gyi zla zer snying la 'dzag pa'i byin rlabs las: 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i mngon sum gyi gnad la goms pa'i rnal 'byor pa he ru kaḥ pad+ma dbang chen gyis bsam yas mchims phu'i 'og min mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang gsang chen me tog phug gi mtshams mal du sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams sbyong ba'i sgrub thabs rig 'dzin myur lam bzhugs so: sku gsum dbyer med ston mchog pad+ma rgyal: bdag gi zhing mchog dpal ri pad+ma 'od: tshe 'dir mngon byed ston 'khor tshom bu bcas: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gral du 'khod 'dod na: tshe 'di blos btang phyi ma don du gnyer: chos kun sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsal sbyong la: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams ma shar bar: sku gsum zhing khams yid la yang yang bya: sku gsum lhun 'grub zhing mchog dam pa der: bdag nyid gcig pus 'gro rnams sgrol 'dod blos: rmad byung byang chub sems gnyis 'byong bar bskyed: lam mchog yo ga gsum gyi gnad ldan pas: sgrub thabs gzhung bzhin tshogs chen rnam gnyis bsags: dus gsum dge rtsa zhing khams bgrod pa'i rgyur: rang 'dod dri bral bsngo bas rgyas gdab na: tshe 'di 'phos ma thag tu dag pa'i zhing : pad+ma 'od sogs gang 'dod bgrod par 'gyur: de phyir skal ba ldan rnams nyams su longs: sa ma ya: the tshom med par smon lam gdab pa ni:

e ma hoḥ sdug bsngal ming med bde chen dag pa'i zhing : mtshan tsam 'dzin pas 'gro rnams dbugs 'byin pa'i: snang ba mtha' yas zhing mchog dam pa der: nam zhig mi rtag tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: skad cig mig 'phrul lta bur skye bar shog: skye ma thag tu sa lam rab rdzogs nas: sprul pa grangs med 'gro don dpag med pa: mgon po 'od dpag med dang mtshungs par shog: ngo mtshar rmad byung ri bo tā la'i zhing : ma lus 'khor ba dong sprugs thugs rje can: phyag na pad+mo'i zhing mchog dam pa der: nam zhig mi rtag tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: skad cig mig 'phrul lta bur skye bar shog: skye ma thag tu sa lam rab rdzogs nas: sprul pa grangs med 'gro don dpag med pa: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter dang mtshungs par shog: sku gsum lhun grub pad+ma 'od kyi zhing : rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'du ba'i gling : sprul sku'i zhing mchog zangs mdog dpal gyi rir: nam zhig mi rtag tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: skad cig mig 'phrul lta bur skye bar shog: skye ma thag tu sa lam rab rdzogs nas: sprul pa grangs med 'gro don dpag med pa: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal dang mtshungs par shog: de yang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang dang sgo srung sogs: som nyi med par pha khyim bu bgrod bzhin: rnga yab sprul pa'i zhing mchog dam pa der: skad cig mig 'phrul lta bur bgrod par shog: mi srin gdug pa'i lus su mi skye bar: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi gral dbus na: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: pha gcig gu ru'i zhabs drung skye bar shog: skye ma thag tu brtse ba'i rjes bzung nas: zab rgyas chos kyis rang rgyud smin cing grol: sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes pa skong nus pa'i: mkhar chen bza' dang rje 'bangs grogs lnga ltar: rmad byung sras kyi thu bor 'gyur bar shog: slar yang ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar: gang 'dul sprul pa'i 'gro don mkha' dang mnyam:

pad+ma rgyal po'i rnam thar yongs grub shog: rlabs chen gsang sngags zab mo'i rten 'brel dang : bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang : sku gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs kyis: smon lam rnam dag gegs med myur 'grub shog: rgyu bzhi tshang ba'i smon lam sus btab pa: ji bzhin yongs 'grub bzang ngan 'brel thogs bcas: gang mos sku gsum dag pa'i zhing rnams su: tshom bu dang bcas sangs rgyas e ma hoḥ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsang sngags lam rim smon lam don bsdus bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /rdo rje'i mched lcam 'dus pa rgya mtsho yis/ /smin grol gdams pas rdo rje'i rigs can gyi/ /skal bzang mngon gyur lam gyi snod ldan shog /srid las nges 'byung dal 'byor rnyed dka'i blos/ /'dir snang zhen med sgyu ma rmi lam dang*/ /rgyu 'bras spang blang yid ches dad pa yis/ /thun mong lam gyi yon tan mthar phyin shog /lam gyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro mtha' ru phyin/ /gzhan phan sems bskyed bsags dang sbyangs pa yis/ /rang rgyud rnam dag gzhan rgyud smin byed pas/ /don gnyis lhun grub theg chen spyod 'chang shog /bum pa'i dbang gis phung khams lha skur dag /gsang ba'i dbang gis rtsa rlung bde chen smin/ /gsum pa'i lam gyis lhan skyes dpe'i ye shes/ /bzhi pa don gyi 'od gsal rdzogs par shog /snang srid gzhir bzhengs bskyed rim mtha' ru phyin/ rtsa rlung thig le dbu ma'i dbyings su dag /ye shes chen po'i chos kun zad sar 'khyol/ lam bzhi mthar phyin rig 'dzin sa thob shog /rdo rje'i lam mthar son pa'i phrin las rtsal/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mdzad pa bsam yas pas/ /mtha' klas bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i sgo /'gyed pas mkha' khyab yid can sgrol nus shog /chos dbyings 'od gsal chen por byang chub nas/ /bde chen kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs/

/gang 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul spro ba yis/ sku lnga lhun grub mngon sangs rgyas par shog /ces pa'ang sngags rig 'dzin pa pad rgyal gling pa'i gter byon gsang sngags lam rim smon lam gyi don bsdus shig bris zhes de nyid kyis ched du gsung bskul ngor sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma'i 'bangs pad+ma gar dbang mdo sngags gling pas bris nas mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam bsam mi khyab pas bstan 'gro'i rgud pa sel zhing bshad sgrub las gsum gyi dga' ston 'phel rgyas brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cig // // ༈ sku gsum zhing khams sbyong ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam bzhugs/ kye ma kyi hud rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*/ /bdag 'dra las ngan snyigs ma'i sems can rnams/ /bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal don du gnyer/ /snying rus phyin ci log rnams su la re/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen/ /da lta nyid du zangs mdog dpal rir drongs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rgyal ba khyed lta bus/ /bod 'bangs bor nas rnga yab gling du gshegs/ /gdong dmar bod phrug spre'u'i tsha bo rnams/ /'di phyi'i re ltos skyabs gnas su la re/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen/ /da lta nyid du zangs mdog dpal rir drongs/ /tshe srog mi rtag g.yang kha'i bye'u 'dra/ /do nub tsam yang mi 'chi'i gdeng ni med/ /rtag tu sdod grab byed pa bdud kyis bslus/ /gshin rje'i pho nya byung na su la re/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen/ /da lta nyid du zangs mdog dpal rir drongs/ /'khor ba'i sems can sdug bsngal las la g.yengs/ /dam chos byed blo nam langs skar ltar yal/ /don chung g.yeng ba'i khol bor mi tshad zad/ /dgra chen 'chi ba byung na su la re/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen/ /da lta nyid du zangs mdog dpal rir drongs/ /byis pa'i rang bzhin so so'i skye bo kun/

/thos bsam sgom pa'i na tshod ches cher rgud/ /phar phyin drug gi 'dren byed ce re long*/ /'byung ba thim rim byung na su la re/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen/ /da lta nyid du zangs mdog dpal rir drongs/ /dge bcu'i lam la mos pas zhugs na yang*/ /rnam par dpyad na chos brgyad zob dang 'dres/ /mi dge'i rnam smin ma tshor shugs kyis 'go /bar dor dmyal thag gcod dus su la re/ thugs rjes gzigs shig rnga yab gling pa mkhyen/ /da lta nyid du zangs mdog dpal rir drongs/ /kye ma nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad/ /lus kyi mdangs shor dbugs kyi ngar sgra brtsegs/ /'degs byed rlung bros ngar skad can gyi ros/ /nye 'brel gdung sems 'brel thag gcod pa'i tshe/ /gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag po mi 'byung zhing*/ /mkha' 'gros bsu ba'i snang ba shar bar shog /kyi hud sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste/ /'byung lnga thim rim du ba smig rgyu dang*/ /me khyer mar me'i snang ba gsal ba'i rjes/ /phra ba'i thim rim snang mched thob gsum ste/ /'di ltar rnam shes snang ba la thim pas/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi zla gzas zin ltar/ /dmar lam 'char zhing dmar cha snying gar ldog /de rjes snang ba mched pa la thim pas/ /skar khung nang nas zla zer shar ba ltar/ /dkar lam 'char zhing dkar cha thur du babs/ /de nas mched pa nyer thob la thim pas/ /sprin med nam mkhar srod mun 'khrigs pa ltar/ /nag lam shar nas kun gzhi'i ngang du brgyal/ /slar yang srog 'dzin rlung brgyad gyes pa yis/ /cung zad brgyal sangs gdod ma'i ye gdangs shar/ /gsal la ma 'gags ston gyi nam mkha' bzhin/ /stong gsal sgrib g.yogs bral ba'i ngang la gnas/ /de tshe da lta'i ka dag blo bral dbyings/ /tha mal shes pa zang ka rgya yan la/ /nges par rnyed de mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthus/ /gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings nang gsal gsang ba'i sbubs/ khyad chos drug ldan kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong*/

/skad cig nyid la btsan sa zin par shog /gal te bar do dang por ma grol na/ /dbyings snang lhun grub 'od gsal la thim nas/ /sgra 'od zer dang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ /thim lugs brgyad kyi snang ba 'char ba'i tshe/ /chos nyid bar dor rang snang ngo shes nas/ /ma pang bu 'jug lta bur grol bar shog /de tshe sgra yis 'jigs te zer gyis dngangs/ /sku yi snang bas skrag ste ma grol na/ /chos nyid bden pa bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'khrul pa rmi lam sad pa'i cha tsam las/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams pad+ma'i sbubs/ /brdzus te skyes nas dbugs dbyung grol bar shog /rim dgu'i theg pa kun las 'das pa'i don/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen lam la zhugs de'i mthus/ /nam zhig gdod ma'i lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ /gang gi grol tshad sgra 'od sa g.yos dang*/ /rigs lnga'i gdung dang zhi khro'i snang brnyan sogs/ /kun gyi mthun snang grub tu mngon par shog /rig 'dzin bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag dang*/ /chos nyid rang bzhin ci yang ma yin pa'i/ /bden pa'i mthu yis khams gsum yid can dang*/ khyad par 'brel bas bsdus pa'i sems can kun/ /sku bzhi'i zhing khams rmad byung nyams dga' bar/ /tshom bu gcig tu phyam gcig grol bar shog /de ltar sku gsum zhing khams sbyong ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam 'di ni rang byung pad+ma'i gsung gi dben gnas 'og min rdo rje'i ke'u tshang du rang nyid gcig pur dben pa bsten skabs snga zhogs shig gi tshe na mig lam du has po ri mthong bas rkyen byas snang ba la/ ga re ma gi'i rtser mkhan slob rje 'bangs rnams kyi zhabs kyis bcags/ lha 'dre btul/ skyo sangs mdzad pa sogs lo rgyus cher snang mod/ de dag thams cad da lta ming tsam med/ 'di lta bu'i 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par yid ches/ rang nyid kyang lo shas tsam mi 'chi ba'i 'tsho rtsis byas kyang sang tsam nas 'jig rten pha rol tu mi 'gro ba'i nges pa ci cha snyam nas skyo shas nges 'byung tshad med skyes/
