o rgyan rje 'bangs rnams dran pa la tshad med kyi mchi ma 'khrugs pa zhig byung bas rkyen byas/ de'i tshe thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs dang 'brel bar bar do lam snang gi grol tshul rtsa tshig tu byas nas kha ton du bgyis chog pa'i smon pa 'di yang bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ smon lam mtshang 'don ma bzhugs so/ rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs ni/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma rjes/ /rang sems chos skur ngo sprod pas/ /bdag la sangs rgyas kun las lhag /re sa khyed las med pa la/ /thugs rjes klong nas 'dor phod dam/ /bshes dang sdig grogs 'du 'dzi'i khrod/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pa yi/ /skal pa ngan pa bdag cag gi /rgyud la nges 'byung skyo shas dang*/ /byang chub sems gnyis skye byin rlobs/ /sngon chad tshul khrims gos la re/ /dkon mchog dkor la bag med spyad/ /ltar snang chos brgyad chos dang 'khrul/ /da ni 'chi ba snying dran gyis/ /ri khrod nags khrod dben pa ru/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub byin rlobs/ chos kyi gegs ni cir yang brdzu/ /gnyen bshes 'du 'dzi zang zing dang*/ /rang don shor ba'i gzhan don dang*/ /'gran sems phrag dog snyan grags sgrub/ /dben pa bsten kyang zhi bder gzhol/ /sgo gsum tha mal shor ba'i tshe/ /rang skyon rang gis rig gyur nas/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag dran par shog /dran shes med pa'i dge sbyor dang*/ /lta bas ma zin bskyed rim dang*/ /go yul shor ba'i stong lta sogs/ /sangs rgyas lam la thag ring bas/ /bla ma mchog la gus pa dang*/ /zol zog med pa'i dad pa dang*/ /sems can pha mar shes pa yi/ /snying rje rgyun chad med par shog /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /rtsa ba byang chub sems la 'dus/ /de phyir gzhan la phan srid na/ /srog kyang gtong ba'i snying stobs can/ /de la'ang phyi gshol mi byed par/ /rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid kyi/

/dran pa'i rtsi dang mi 'bral shog /sems can kun la bu gcig ltar/ /brtse zhing mdzad pa'i phrin las kyis/ /'gro la phan pa lhur len pa'i/ /skyes bu dam pa thams cad dang*/ /bdag nyid smin grol la 'god pa'i/ /bka' drin can gyi bla ma mchog /zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa dang*/ /bdag nyid mos gus lcags kyu yis/ /bla ma dam pa'i lung rtogs kyi/ /dgongs spyod snying dbus spyan drangs te/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres gyur nas/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /cig car dong nas sprugs gyur cig /'jigs med gling pa'i gsung 'bum nas so// // ༈ na mo gu ru/ bskal mang gong nas g.yo sgyu spangs pa'i thugs/ /bcos ma'i tshul spangs drang zhing bden pa'i gsung*/ /tshul 'chos mi mnga' tshul dang mthun pa'i sku/ /thub pa drang srong chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /thub pa de sras bden pa'i don gzigs pa'i/ /bden gsung mnga' ba bden tshig grub pa'i tshogs/ /theg pa gsum gyi thar pa'i lam zhugs pa/ /de dag kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni deng nas skye dang tshe rabs su/ /rgyal ba sras bcas khyed dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /rgyal ba sras bcas khyed kyis rjes bzung nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas khyed bzhin 'grub par shog /lus spyod tshul 'chos med par dul ba dang*/ ngag tshig rdzun gtam med par bden pa dang*/ /sems spyod g.yo sgyu med par drang ba yis/ chos mthun grogs dang bshes gnyen bsten par shog /thar pa'i lam la dang po 'jug pa'i sgo/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas dang por bros pa'i lam/ /nyams len chos rnams kun gyi dang po'i 'go /bcos med nges 'byung rgyud la skye bar shog /yod na sangs rgyas sgrub la des chog cing*/ /med na sangs rgyas sgrub la thabs chags pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sa bon ma nor ba/ /rnam dag byang chub sems mchog skye bar shog /gong nas gong du byang chub sems mchog 'phel/ /tshe rabs kun tu byang chub sems mi brjed/

/yang dang yang du byang chub sems bsgom nas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod la 'jug par shog /thub pa mchog dang 'jam dpal dpa' bo dang*/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa gang yin pa/ /bdag gi tshe rabs spyod kun de 'dra bar/ /gyur nas don gnyis spyod pa lhun grub shog /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam bzang can/ /dus gcig don gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas po/ /tshul gcig 'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba yis/ /lam gcig rdo rje theg par 'jug par shog /lam 'di'i lam sgom rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /kun la bde stong bskyed pa'i grogs bgyid cing*/ /lhan cig skyes pa mtshon pa'i sgor gyur pa'i/ /'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gling du rol bar shog /bcos ma spangs pa'i sems nyid gnyug ma'i zhal/ /bcos ma min par rang ngo rjen mthong nas/ /bcos bslad bral ba'i mnyam bzhag rgyun bskyangs te/ /bcos med don gyi 'bras bu thob par shog /gnas skabs su yang bsam pa'i don kun 'grub/ /gson pa'i tshe na bsam pa ngan pa med/ /'chi ba'i tshe na gnad gcod sdug bsngal med/ /shi nas 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag med par shog /bdag mthong thos dang dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems dang lhan cig skyes/ /ji ltar rigs pa ji bzhin rgyud skyes nas/ myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas nyi ma mtshan dpe'i zhal mthong zhing*/ /dam chos nyi ma snying gi bdud rtsir spyod/ /dge 'dun nyi ma thar lam grogs gyur nas/ /mchog gsum nyi ma'i 'od dang mi 'bral shog /sgrub pa po nyi ma'i thugs bzhed bzhin btsun gzugs dpal dges bris pa'o// // ༈ tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i smon lam bzhugs so/ hrīḥ tshe mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med snang mtha' yas/ /tshe 'phrang 'jig kun skyob mdzad zil gnon rtsal/ /mi shigs tshe yi bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung*/ /mi brjed gzungs thob tshe 'dzin mtsho rgyal ma/

/'byung lnga'i bcud 'dzin tshe bdag sgo ma bzhi/ /'byung po tshe jag mthar byed h+ya ghṛ/ /zab gter gnyan gyi srung ma seṅge'i gdong*/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /rab gus gdung bas gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /myur mgyogs thugs rje lcags kyu'i rtsal phyung nas/ /'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas 'dir skyes chen zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ /dge 'dun 'dus sde'i sku tshe ring ba dang*/ /mkha' mnyam yongs la bde skyid 'byung bar shog /ces tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i smon lam bden tshig kun 'grub 'di yang rig 'dzin chen po mi 'jigs rdo rjes a chog yang dben du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ hrī/ rgyal kun thugs mchog gcig 'dus pad+ma 'byung*/ /mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal ma/ /zab gter mdzod 'dzin rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling*/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /nam zhig mi rtags 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /myur mgyogs thugs rje lcags kyu'i rtsal phyungs la/ /bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi zhing du drongs/ gnam lcags rdo rjes so// // ༈ phyogs dus kun khyab kyi gsol 'debs smon lam bden tshig dpang por gter ston nyid kyis mdzad pa ni/ hūm̐/ bde chen lhun grub sprul sku'i nam mkha' la/ /snang srid zil gnon thod phreng 'od stong 'khyil/ /dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal srid zhi'i smag rum bsal/ /sangs rgyas ye shes phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /rtsa gsum gling pas thugs rjes 'gro kun sgrol/ /pad zhwa cod pan 'dzin pa'i zhabs brtan zhing*/ /bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams rgya mtsho dang*/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter gyi bdag khyad par bstan pa'i bya ra gnyer 'dzin pa/ /rgyal yum lha mo dbyings phyug chos kyi sgron/ /legs ldan mgon po zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong*/

/gza' mchog rgyal po btsan rgod dpe ha ra/ /klu yi dge bsnyen gnod sbyin zangs khrab can/ /dam tshig bya ra gter srung bden pa'i mthus/ /rgya bod hor gsum dbang du 'du ba dang*/ /lha 'dre mi gsum gdul bya'i zhing du gzigs/ /'dzam gling 'dir gnas chos srid bstan pa rgyas/ /yul gru bkra shis nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /mi nor srid 'phel dpal brtan rlung rta dar/ /snyan grags dga' ston phyogs bcur khyab pa dang*/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin skye shi bgres rgud bral/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kun 'grub nas/ lha dang srung mas rtag tu skyong bar shog bkra shis dge legs yar ngo'i zla ltar du/ gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces phyogs dus kun khyab kyi smon lam dpang po'i bden tshig 'di yang kun dga' blo gros kyis bskul ngor ri 'bri gung shen ne'am sku rgyal zangs btsan 'bar ba'i lho zhol nas chos sgar thog tu rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas bris pa'o// // ༈ thugs rje chen po'i smon lam ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can: ma bcos lhun grub rang byung gzhal yas dbus: thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: rgyal sras sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: ngo mtshar bkod pa blo las 'das pa yi: ting 'dzin longs spyod gtum mo gos kyi mchog: byang chub chu rgyun longs spyod mi zad pa: snang stong lha'i khye'u pho mo grogs: 'phags pa'i nor bdun rin chen gter mdzod can: ye shes lnga yi sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: 'od gsal snying po ma rig ka nas dag: kun tshang bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa yi: mkha' spyod phun tshogs zhing khams de nyid du: bdag sogs 'di nas skad cig 'phos ma thag: ma nor bstan pa'i lam mchog rab rnyed nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skyes nas kyang :

sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog: 'khor 'das zil gnon byang chog nas byung ba rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma'o: dbu ma'i smon lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ mi mjed zhing gi 'dren pa shākya'i tog /rgyal sras thu bo rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'phags pa yab sras sogs/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' bral dbu ma'i don gzigs sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa'i mnga' bdag zhi ba lha/ /thal 'gyur shing rta'i srol 'dzin zla ba grags/ /gus pas 'dud do brtse chen thugs kyis dgongs/ /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal 'byor lus thob rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes kyis zin/ /rnam gsum dad pas tshul bzhin bsten par shog /nges don zab mo'i mdo yi dgongs pa bzhin/ /bshes gnyen mchog las legs par thob nas kyang*/ /shes rab gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i mthus/ /chos rjes 'brang ba'i dad pa thob par shog /dad dang snying rje chen po'i gzhi bzung nas/ /skyabs kyi yul du dkon mchog mi gtong zhing*/ /theg pa chen po'i lam la rab bzhugs te/ /bcos ma min pa'i sems bskyed thob par shog /lus srog yal bar 'dor ba'i snying stobs kyis/ /phyi nang dngos kun gzhan la gtong ba dang*/ /rnam dag khrims kyis rang gi rgyud bsdams nas/ /bcas pa'i mtshams las 'da' ba med par shog /gnod byed rnams la rin chen gter bzhin du/ /dga' dang gus pa'i yid kyis rab btud de/ /snying rjes drang ba'i rmad byung spyod pa yang*/ /tshe rabs kun tu bdag gis bsten par shog /rang bzhin rnam dag don dam chos kyi dbyings/ /yod med spros pa'i yul las rab 'das pa/ /ma rtogs log par rtog pa'i skyon bsal te/ /chos nyid bden pa mngon sum mthong bar shog /yod dang med pa'i lta ba spros pa'i mtha'/ /gnyis dang gnyis min 'dzin pa log pa'i blo/

/mtha' bzhi'i spros dang bral ba dbu ma'i lam/ /mkhas pas bstan pa'i de nyid mthong bar shog /phyi nang chos kun bdag las skye med cing*/ /gzhan las ma yin gnyis dang rgyu med min/ /'jig rten rab tu grags pa'i chos rnams la/ /blang dor 'jug ldog tshul bzhin byed par shog /bdag phung ngo bo gcig dang tha dad sogs/ /log par rtog pa'i 'du shes kun spangs te/ /rnam bdun shing rta'i rigs pa la brten nas/ /brten nas brtags pa'i nges pa rnyed par shog /shes bya'i chos kun ngo bo gdod nas stong*/ /ther zug gnas dang cung zad gnas pa sogs/ /yang dag don la sgrib pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi/ /rtog pa'i zung rngu drungs nas 'byin par shog /rdo khams gser dang bum nang sgron sogs kyi/ /dpe yis gzhal ba'i don bzang mngon du gyur/ /yab rje dpal mgon klu yi dgongs pa bzhin/ /sa lam mthar phyin chos sku thob par shog /de tshe phyogs mthar gtug pa'i rgyal sras dang*/ /dman dang mchog gi 'gro khams rgya mtsho la/ /rang rang blo dang mthun pa'i 'dul byed ni/ /bye ba phrag brgyar rtag tu snang bar shog /de ltar go 'phang dam par mchis kyi bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu mtha' bral dbu ma'i don/ /rang gis rtogs shing gzhan la ston mkhas pa/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa lha dang mnyam par shog /ces 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung lugs dri ba med pa skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du rang gis 'dzin cing gzhan la 'chad nus pa'i phyir dge rtsa dang 'brel ba'i smon lam sprang ban gzhan phan pas btab pa dge'o// // ༈ dbu ma'i smon lam bsdus pa bzhugs so/ nam zhig dpal gyi ri la klu sgrub rjes/ /skal ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi yongs bskor nas/ /mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam bzang 'chad pa na/ /bdag kyang 'khor gyi thog mar skye bar shog /de tshe shes bya'i chos nyid nam mkha'i mtha'/ /gzhal bar rnam dpyod mtshungs par med pa yis/ /chos ltar bcos pa thams cad sun phyung nas/

/'phags pa'i dgongs pa 'khrul med ston par shog /ces pa'ang gzhan phan snang bas so// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ rje rang byung rjo rjes mdzad pa'i nges don phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi smon lam rnams/ /ji bzhin 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur byin rlobs mdzod/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsam sbyor rnam dag gangs ri las skyes pa'i/ /'khor gsum rnyog med dge tshogs chu rgyun rnams/ /rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig /ji srid de ma thob pa de srid du/ /skye dang skye ba tshe rabs kun tu yang*/ /sdig dang sdug bsngal sgra yang mi grags shing*/ /bde dge rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par shog /dal 'byor mchog thob dad brtson shes rab ldan/ /bshes gnyen bzang bsten gdams pa'i bcud thob nas/ /tshul bzhin sgrub la bar chad ma mchis par/ /tshe rabs kun tu dam chos spyod par shog /lung rig thos pas mi shes sprin las grol/ /man ngag bsam pas the tshom mun nag bcom/ /sgom byung 'od kyis gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal/ /shes rab gsum gyi snang ba rgyas par shog /rtag chad mtha' bral bden gnyis gzhi yi don/ /sgro skur mtha' bral tshogs gnyis lam mchog gis/ /srid zhi'i mtha' bral don gnyis 'bras thob pa'i/ /gol 'chugs med pa'i chos dang 'phrad par shog /sbyang gzhi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug la/ /sbyong byed phyag chen rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ches/ /sbyang bya glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma rnams/ /sbyangs 'bras dri bral chos sku mngon gyur shog /gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa lta ba'i gdeng*/ /de la ma yengs skyong pa sgom pa'i gnad/ /sgom don kun la rtsal sbyong spyod pa'i mchog /lta sgom spyod pa'i gdeng dang ldan par shog /chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul te/

/sems ni sems med sems kyi ngo bo stong*/ /stong zhing ma 'gags cir yang snang ba ste/ /legs par brtags nas gzhi rtsa chod par shog /yod ma myong ba'i rang snang yul du 'khrul/ /ma rig dbang gis rang rig bdag tu 'khrul/ /gnyis 'dzin dbang gis srid pa'i klong du 'khyams/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad bdar chod par shog /yod pa ma yin rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs/ /med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ /'gal 'du ma yin zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam/ /mtha' bral sems kyi chos nyid rtogs par shog /'di yin zhes pa gang gis mtshon pa med/ /'di min zhes bya gang gis bkag pa med/ blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas/ /yang dag don gyi mtha' ni nges par shog /'di nyid ma rtogs 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor/ /'di nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas gzhan na med/ /thams cad 'di yin 'di min gang yang med/ chos nyid kun gzhi'i mtshang ni rig par shog /snang yang sems la stong yang sems yin te/ rtogs kyang sems la 'khrul yang rang gi sems/ /skyes kyang sems la 'gags kyang sems yin pas/ /sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par shog /blos byas rtsol ba'i sgom gyis ma bslad cing*/ /tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod par/ /ma bcos gnyug ma rang bab 'jog shes pa'i/ /sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong bar shog /phra rags rtog pa'i rba rlabs rang sar zhi/ /g.yo med sems kyi chu bo ngang gis gnas/ /byings rmugs rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /zhi gnas rgya mtsho mi g.yo brtan par shog /bltar med sems la yang yang bltas pa'i tshe/ /mthong med don ni ji bzhin lhag ger mthong*/ /yin min don la the tshom chod pa nyid/ /'khrul med rang ngo rang gis shes par shog /yul la bltas pas yul med sems su mthong*/ /sems la bltas pas sems med ngo bo stong*/ /gnyis la bltas pas gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol/ /'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog

/yid byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma chen po yin/ /'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya/ /gcig shes kun don rtogs pa'i gdeng thob shog /zhen pa med pa'i bde chen rgyun chad med/ /mtshan 'dzin med pa'i 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs bral/ /blo las 'das pa'i mi rtog lhun gyis grub/ /rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog /bzang zhen nyams kyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol/ /ngan rtog 'khrul pa rang bzhin dbyings su dag /tha mal shes pa spang blang bral thob med/ /spros bral chos nyid bden pa rtogs par shog /'gro ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu sangs rgyas kyang*/ /ma rtogs dbang gis mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i sems can la/ /bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog /bzod med snying rje'i rtsal yang ma 'gags pa'i/ /brtse dus ngo bo stong don rjen par shar/ /zung 'jug gol sa bral ba'i lam mchog 'di/ /'bral med nyin mtshan kun tu bsgom par shog /sgom stobs las byung spyan dang mngon shes dang*/ /sems can smin byas sangs rgyas zhing rab sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams 'grub pa'i smon lam rdzogs/ /rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang*/ /rnam dkar dge ba ji snyed yod pa'i mthus/ /de ltar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /smon lam rnam dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces nges don phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam zhes bya ba rje karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'o// // ༈ 'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i smon lam bzhugs so/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi bde gshegs sras bcas kyi/ /ye shes skur gyur gnyis med tshul 'chang ba/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang*/ /byar med don la lhun gyis grub gyur cig /gdod ma'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma la/ /mnyam nyid chos skur lta ba'i mos gus kyis/

/don brgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs snying la 'phos/ /rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob par shog /ye nas gnas phyir rtsol bas sgrub pa dang*/ /dbang po'i khyad par sogs la mi ltos kyang*/ /sla bas yid ma ches pa sems kyi gsang*/ /bla ma'i man ngag stobs kyis mthong gyur cig /spros shing dpyad pa kun rtog bsnon ma ste/ /btsal zhing bsgrub pa rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu/ /dmigs shing bsgom pa phyir zhing 'ching ba'i gzeb/ /zug rngu'i spros pa nang nas chod par shog /bsam brjod bral la mthong ba gang med kyang*/ /ma mthong lhag mar gyur pa gang yang med/ /rang sems kho thag chod pa zab mo'i don/ /mtshon par dka' ba'i de nyid rtogs par shog /spros kun ka nas dag phyir yod mtha' spangs/ /rig gdangs lhun gyis grub pas med mtha' bral/ /gnyis su brjod kyang rtog pa'i 'jug tshul tsam/ /dbyer med brjod bral mnyam pa'i don mthong shog /'di na mdzub mos zla ba ji bzhin du/ /dang por yid dpyod tshig gis mtshon byas kyang*/ /chos nyid rang bab yid dpyod yul las 'das/ /rang gis rang la rlan te mthong bar shog /'di la bsal bar bya ba ma mthong zhing*/ /bzhag ste bsgrub par bya ba ma dmigs pas/ /dgag sgrub rtsol bas ma bslad chos nyid dang*/ /lhun gyis gnas pa'i don la 'jug par shog /shes bya'i gzhi dang bgrod par bya ba'i lam/ /thob bya 'bras bu'i chos su btags pa yang*/ /rang bzhin gshis la nam mkha'i go rim 'dra/ /byar med don la lhun gyis gnas par shog /'khrul bas sgro btags ma dag 'khor ba'i chos/ /de las log pa dag pa'i snang ba yang*/ /ltos nas btags pa rnam par spros pa'i chos/ /spros med gshis la mi gnas mthong gyur cig /blo bral chos nyid gshis kyi bzhugs tshul la/ /lta dang sgom pas bslad kyin rtog pas bsgribs/ /tha mal gshis su son la lta sgom bral/ /rnal ma'i don la bab kyis gnas gyur cig /gang la dmigs par byas pa lta ba'i dug

/gang zhig rtsol bas zin pa sgom pa'i skyon/ /gang la blang dor bya ba spyod pa'i 'phrang*/ /zug rngu kun bral chos nyid mthong bar shog /spros pa'i gzeb tu ma tshud rig pa'i gdangs/ /blo bral mngon sum mthong la yid dpyod kyi/ /zhags pas mkha' la mdud pa mi 'dor bar/ /rang gzhag rnal ma'i don la mkhas gyur cig /de tshe rang rig gzhon nu bum pa sku'i/ /mkhyen cha rang 'od gsal ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /shes rab rang byung sgron ma'i snang ba yis/ /sgrib pa'i mun pa 'thibs po 'joms gyur cig /ma bcos 'dus ma byas pa'i chos nyid la/ /bcos ma'i lam gyis gsar du bsgrub med pas/ /rgyu las ma byung mthar thug 'bras bu'i don/ /rang la ye nas gnas pa mthong bar shog /yid dpyod tshig gi sbun pa 'khrul pa'i lam/ /ji ltar brjod kyang rtog pa'i drwa ba ste/ /lung las ma byung rang gis rig bya ba'i/ /man ngag zab mo snying la bsgom par shog /gzung 'dzin sems ni ngo bo nyid kyis 'khrul/ /gang ltar dmigs pa de bzhin nyid du min/ /sems las ma byung rang byung ye shes sku/ /nges pa don gyi sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /rig stong rig pa'i dbyings su chos thams cad/ /mnyam pa nyid gyur thig le nyag gcig la/ /'khor 'das re dogs zhig pa'i ngang tshul du/ /mi gnas chos sku'i gtan srid zin par shog /'di ltar lus dang yul du snang ba yang*/ /rab rib bzhin du rtog pa'i dbang gis snang*/ /mi rtog ye shes chen po'i rang mdangs kyis/ /chos zad gdod ma'i dbyings su byang gyur cig /de tshe mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ye shes sku/ /phyogs dus mu mtha' srid du 'gro kun gyis/ /phan bde'i don kun 'jo ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /sgrib bral 'bras bu'i mthar thug thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki nī wā ra hi'i rnam par 'phrul par yongs su grags pa rje btsun ma bde skyong ye shes dbang mos rab tshes me khyi zla3tshes4dus su dge bar bkra shis pa'i lha reg dang shel dkar phreng ba rin po che'i rgyan ldan bcas bka' yis bskul ba'i rkyen byas nas/

tshes de nyin la mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pa'am 'od gsal rdo rje zhes bya bas rdzogs par bris pa ste/ rdzogs pa chen po'i grub mtha'i rang skad thun min rang rkang tshugs par gang shar du smras pa'i dge bas 'gro kun gdod ma'i mgon po 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /thos pa tsam gyis nges par grol 'gyur zhes/ rdo rje 'chang gis legs bsngags lam gyi mchog /'di don sems par byed rnams smos ci 'tshal/ /chos nyid bden pas myur du grol bar 'gyur/ /rtsol bcas theg pas 'dul bar dka' ba'i tshe/ /kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa 'byung zhes su/ /bsngags pa'i lung bzhin snying po'i bstan pa yis/ /'jig rten kun tu khyab cing rgyas gyur cig /ces kyang smras so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ klong chen snying gi thig le las: gzhi lam 'bras bu'i smon lam bzhugs so: dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo: gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang bzhin spros dang bral: yod pa ma yin rgyal bas 'di ma gzigs: med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi: 'gal 'du ma yin brjod bya'i yul las 'das: rdzogs chen gzhi yi gnas lugs rtogs par shog: ngo bo stong pas rtag pa'i mtha' las grol: rang bzhin gsal bas chad pa'i mu dang bral: thugs rje 'gag med sna tshogs sprul pa'i gzhi: gsum du dbye yang don la tha mi dad: rdzogs chen gzhi yi gnas lugs rtogs par shog: bsam gyis mi khyab sgro 'dogs kun dang bral: yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'dzin rnam par zhig: 'di don brjod la rgyal ba'i ljags kyang rdugs: thog mtha' bar med gting gsal chen po'i dbyings: rdzogs chen gzhi yi gnas lugs rtogs par shog: rang ngo rnam dag skye med ka dag la: lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i gdangs shar ba: gud du ma bzung rig stong zung 'jug cher: rtogs pas gzhi yi dgongs pa tshad du phyin: lam gyi gnad la gol 'phyugs med par shog: ye nas dag pas lta ba'i ming yang med:

rang ngo rig pas sgom rgyu'i shubs nas thon: gza' gtad med pas spyod pa'i sgrog dang bral: rang bzhin lhums zhugs spros bral rjen pa'i ngang : lam gyi gnad la gol 'phyugs med par shog: bzang ngan rnam rtog phyogs su ma lhung zhing : btang snyoms lung ma bstan du ma 'byams par: shar grol ris med rgya yan lhun 'byams klong : spang blang ye zad rang bzhin yongs shes ngang : lam gyi gnad la gol 'phyugs med par shog: thog ma'i spyi gzhi nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang : gzhi snang rig pa mkha' la sprin dengs bzhin: phyi gsal shes pa nang du ldog pa las: khyad chos drug ldan gzhon nu bum sku'i sbubs: 'bras bu'i rgyal po btsan sa zin par shog: ye nas rang rig kun tu bzang po la: thob bya'i zhe 'dod mtha' dag dbyings su yal: bya rtsol blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i gshis: dbyings rig kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong sbubs: 'bras bu'i rgyal po btsan sa zin par shog: rab tu mi gnas dbu ma chen po'i don: khyab gdal lhun 'byams phyag rgya chen po'i ngang : mtha' grol klong yangs rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad: sa lam yon tan gzhir rdzogs lhun grub sbubs: 'bras bu'i rgyal po btsan sa zin par shog: thugs bcud klong chen zab rgya las: mtha' sdud smon lam zab mo 'di: bka' srung drang srong rā hu las: ban de'i tshul gyis bskul nas bkod: zab don spel ba don yod cing : rten 'brel smon lam mthar phyin phyir: nam mkha'i snying pos byin brlabs pa'i: kong smyon sbas pa'i rig 'dzin la: zab rgya bkrol te gtad rgya byas: 'gro don nam mkha' mnyam par shog: ༈ pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam sum cu pa ni/ bdag gzhan rnams kyi rgyud la brgyud ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig /don gyi ngo sprod gnad du chud par gyur cig /rtogs pa ji lta ba bzhin du rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /stobs bcu mi 'jigs lung bstan thob par gyur cig

/ltar snang 'grib cing rten 'brel 'char bar gyur cig /'gro rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus par gyur cig /sa lam gdan thog gcig tu bgrod nus par gyur cig /shes rab kyi spyan gyis chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong bar gyur cig /yon tan lo 'dab bzhin du rgyas par gyur cig /'bras bu dpag bsam bzhin du smin par gyur cig /mos gus ri rab bzhin du brtan par gyur cig /nges pa'i shes pa the tshom dang bral bar gyur cig /las kyi 'phro sad nas smon lam rnam par dag par gyur cig /go cha'i 'jig rten gyi dri ma dag par gyur cig /sgrub pa la bar chad med cing dka' thub btsal bar gyur cig /rtsa rlung thig le las su rung bar gyur cig /rtag tu bsam pa rnam par dag par gyur cig /byang sems la nyams pa med par gyur cig /chos theg chen gyi lta sgom nyams su myong bar gyur cig /gnyis snang gi shes pa rang sar grol bar gyur cig /rigs khyad par can du skye bar gyur cig /brgyud ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig /las kyi mtha' mi log par gyur cig /shes rab gsum la blo sbyong bar gyur cig /dbang gi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig /bde ba rdo rje lta bu thob par gyur cig /rnam shes rtsa rlung la rang dbang thob par gyur cig /rang lus gzugs sku 'grub par gyur cig /chos sku mngon sum du rtogs par gyur cig /sprul sku'i phrin las kyis gzhan don mthar phyin par gyur cig/ // ༈ bden tshig 'grub pa'i pra ṇi dha rnam mkhyen grong 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs/ dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas bla ma dang mchog gsum byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mi nga'i skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che thob ste rje btsun bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gdul byar 'gyur bar shog cig

/mngon mtho dang nges legs mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rang rgyud btul te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i rjes su slob par shog cig /chos la 'jug pa'i rtsa ba nges 'byung dang blo ldog rnam pa bzhi rgyud la ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes nas 'khor ba mtha' med kyi bya ba la btson dong dang me 'obs lta bur mthong bar shog cig /las 'bras bslu ba med pa la yid ches rnyed nas dge sdig gi las phra mo tsam la yang 'jug ldog byed par shog cig /gnas grogs 'du 'dzi rkyen ngan la sogs pa byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu tshud de skyes bu gsum gyi lam la slob par shog cig /bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bka' drin can gyi bla ma dam pa la the tshom dang mnyam 'grogs kyi mi ru bzung ba'i log lta spangs te sangs rgyas dngos su mthong bar shog cig /de'i mthu las mtshon byed dpe'i dbang bzhis sgo gsum smin par byas te rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i gseng lam la 'jug par shog cig /gsol 'debs dang mos gus kyi mtshams sbyor lam du longs nas mtshon bya don gyi dgongs brgyud bdag la 'phos te rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par shog cig /bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i nyams len mthar phyin nas snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum du shes shing rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i sa la bgrod pa rgyal sras pad+ma dang bi ma la lta bur 'gyur bar shog cig /lung a nu yo ga'i nyams len mthar phyin nas 'khor 'das kyi 'dzin rtog bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas te 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams la dbang sgyur bar shog cig /rdzogs chen a ti yo ga'i nyams len mthar phyin nas chos can gyi snang ba chos nyid kyi klong du zad nas gzhon nu bum skur grol ba rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje lta bur 'gyur bar shog cig

/mdor na bdag gis byang chub kyi spyod pa la bslab pa nas bzung ste sgo gsum gyis bya ba ci bgyis pa thams cad pha ma sems can thams cad kyi don du 'gyur bar shog cig /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du dam pa'i chos ma yin pa'i 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi bsam pa skad cig ma tsam yang sems la mi skye bar shog cig /gal te las dang bag chags dbang btsan par gyur nas phyin ci log gi blo skyes na'ang de nyid mi 'grub par shog cig /gzhan don du 'gyur na lus srog 'dor ba la yang nyam nga med pa gzhon nu don grub lta bur 'gyur bar shog cig /don gnyis lhun grub kyi sa la phyin nas khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs nus pa stobs bcu mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'i rtsal can du gyur cig /'dod pa dang bral ba'i smon lam de lta bu yongs su 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur mdzad par rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /drang srong bden par smra ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ dha re dha re bhan+dha re bhan+dha re swā hā/ dge ba stobs che bar gyur cig /smon lam mthu btsan par gyur cig /sdig pa 'dag skyen par gyur cig /dza ya dza ya sid+dhi sid+dhi pha la pha la 'a a ha sha sa ma/ ma ma ko ling sa man+ta/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gson gshin bsngo ba rgyas 'debs bya ba bzhugs so/ hoḥ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang : khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas: grub thob rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga: yongs grags rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba ye shes kyi dbyings nas dgongs su gsol: de dag gi nus mthu la brten nas gong ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang mnyam par gyur cig:

da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams su la'ang phan thogs pa thams cad sku tshe ring zhing sku khams bzang ba dang : mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur cig: khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi thugs kyis g.yel ba med pa'i grogs mdzad par gyur cig: 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang : lo 'bras rtag tu rgyas shing dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi nas mtshon gyi bskal pa ngan pa nyams par gyur cig: yul gyi mi nad phyugs nad 'go ba'i nad gdon dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad par gyur cig: rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po de rnams kyis thog drangs: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i skal pa dang ldan nas rten 'brel dge ba'i legs tshogs thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol du 'phos zhing : chaiga'i

'das pa 'das ma de nyid kyis thog drangs: ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs: lam sgrib gnyis byang : 'bras bu rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig: dkon mchog gsum la bkur sti dang rim gro bgyis te: zang zing gi chos bcu mi zad ting 'dzin bsgoms pa la sogs pa drang don nges don gyi chos thams cad smon lam brda ma log par rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su 'jug par gyur cig: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du dran pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs rgya chen po thob nas nam yang mi 'khrul zhing rang dbang thob nas gzhan don du phan thogs pa'i skye ba len nus par gyur cig: rigs mtho zhing cho 'brang dang ldan pa'i skye ba len nas chos dang 'phrad nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs shing spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mngon du gyur nas mtha' yas 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor nus par gyur cig: tshe 'phrang bdud las sgrol nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub ste: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal mngon sum du mjal ba dang lung bstan te rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su sangs rgyas par gyur cig: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhi khro na rag dong sprugs byang chog gzhung nas khol du phyung ba'o// // ༈ phyogs bcu rab 'byams kyi zhing khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang yi dam lha tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can chos srung gi tshogs dang bcas pa'i skyabs gnas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad bdag sogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis 'khor 'das dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs ji snyed pa mtha' dag gcig tu bsdoms te mtha' yas pa'i sems can thog med nas da lta'i bar gyi drin can pha mar gyur pa mtha' dag bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob pa'i rgyu dang sa bon nyid du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/

/de ltar bsngos pa la brten nas bla ma dam pa dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs zag med kyi klong du yongs su rdzogs pa dang sa lam gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad med par 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i chos sku mngon du mdzad nas thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar gyi rol pa rgyun mi chad pas gdul bya byang grol la 'god pa'i phrin las rmad du byung ba rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor mdzad par gyur cig /'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa kha lag zas gsum gyi 'brel ba thogs tshad kyis gtso byas te khams gsum 'khor ba bar do'i 'jig rten du 'khyams pa'i rigs gyur sna tshogs sdug bsngal gyi mnar zhing 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag gis bskyod pa'i skye 'gro thams cad kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pas rang rang so so'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas thar pa zhi bde byang chub kyi go 'phang dam pa myur du thob par gyur cig /da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i 'du tshogs mtha' dag sku khams bzang zhing thos bsam sgom pa dang 'dzin skyong bsrung spel gyi phrin las gcig tu mthun par mdzad pa la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing so so'i ji ltar bzhed don chos mthun du 'grub pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa'i skye 'gro mchog dman rnams kyang rgyal ba'i bstan la gus shing tshe ring nad med bde skyid longs spyod 'phel ba dang*/ /'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe med par 'jig rten khams kun dge legs dpal 'byor dam chos 'dod rgu'i char chen bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin 'babs pas skye dgu mtha' dag gnas skabs mthar thug gi don kun 'bad med du 'grub par gyur cig /'di ltar bsngos shing smon pa'i don rnams myur du 'grub nas/

bdag sogs mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa rgyu dag pa kun khyab bde gshegs snying por lhun gyis grub pa las/ lam dag pa zab mo don snying po bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mchog gi don ma nor mngon du gyur cing*/ 'bras bu dag pa bde ba chen po rang rig 'pho 'gyur med pa ye sangs rgyas pa'i snying po byang chub ste sprul pas 'gro don rgyun chad med pa 'grub par gyur cig /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid? ces sogs mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i smon lam byin rlabs can rnams kyi sham bu yang gdags par bya'o/ /'di ni gang zag spros pa chung zhing tshig tshogs nyung ba la mos pa dag pa dang*/ khyad par gtor ma sogs rgyun gyi dge sbyor sgrig ma'i mjug tu bgyi bar 'os pa zhig dgos zhes rang gi nye gnas bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs kyis bskul ba bzhin/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis bde gshegs tshe'i phug tu bkod pa maṅga laṃ// // e ma/ kun khyab dam pa bdag nyid kun gyi gtso/ /skye 'chi gnyis spangs mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku/ /zab rgya'i gter mdzod bskyed yum mtsho rgyal ma/ /gang 'dul phrin las mnga' brnyes rtsa gsum gling*/ /skal ldan rab gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'od zer drwa ba yi/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ /skye dang tshe rab rnga yab zhing bgrod nas/ /skye dgu'i mgon du ye shes rtsal 'char zhing*/ /thogs med 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shog khyad par skye dang gtan srid thams cad du/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rnams dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtag tu 'dzugs pa dang*/ /dngos sgrub rnam gnyis char gyi rgyun spyod tshe/ /bar chad bdud kyis 'tshe ba mi 'byung shog /bden pas skyongs shing smon lam mtha' btsan gyis/ /bkra shis dpal la rtag tu dge gyur cig /ces gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di'ang*/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs 'dzin pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal ngor/ phyogs nyul du rgyu ba sngags 'chang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas bgyis pa don dang ldan par smon no// // ༈ bod yul bde ba'i smon lam bzhugs so/ skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum/ khyad par gangs can mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /rje btsun sgrol ma gu ru pad+ma 'byung*/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs dam zhal bzhes dgongs/ /smon lam yongs su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /snyigs dus 'gro rnams bsam sbyor log pa dang*/ /phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis/ /sngar ma grags pa'i mi phyugs dal yams nad/ /gza' klu rgyal gdon nag phyogs 'byung po'i zer/ /btsa' sad ser gsum lo nyes dmag 'khrugs rtsod/ char chu mi snyoms gangs can bra byi'i than/ /sa g.yos me dgra 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa dang*/ khyad par bstan la 'tshe ba'i mtha' dmag sogs/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir gnod 'tshe'i rigs mtha' dag /myur du zhi zhing rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig /mi dang mi min 'gro ba mtha' dag gi /rgyud la byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /ngang gis skyes nas gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor bral/ /phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan nas kyang*/ /bod yul mtha' dbus bde skyid dpal gyis 'byor/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shog /rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i stobs/ /'khor 'das dge ba'i rtsa ba gang mchis dang*/ /bdag cag lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i mthus/ /gsol btab smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub gyur cig /ces rje bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas deng sang dus kyi 'tshub 'gyur shin tu che zhing ci ltar 'gyur cha med pas/ rje nyid nas bod yul bde ba'i smon lam nyin zhag rer lan drug re mdzad pa yin pas khyod nas kyang de ltar gal che zhes bka' stsal phebs pa ltar rang gi bsnyel gsos su bris pa ji bzhin 'grub par gyur cig

/ces blo gros mtha' yas kyis tsā 'dra rin chen brag tu rgyal zla ba'i dkar phyogs 'grub pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i snga dro'i char bris pa a thā sid+dhi rastu// // ༈ snga 'gyur bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam chos rgyal dgyes pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba/ de yang dus kyi tha mar rtsa gsum lha yi thugs rgyud bskul nas bstan pa'i snying po rin po che rgyas par gyur cig snyam du lan gcig tsam mos pa yang bsod nams tshad med pa dang ldan cing*/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs nas skye ba kun tu rgyal ba'i chos dang chos kyi snying po zab mo'i theg pa dang 'phrad nas 'dzin skyong spel bas myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la reg par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod pas/ skal bzang rnams kyis dus dus dang*/ khyad par tshogs mang gi skabs su 'di ltar smon lam gdab par bya ste/ na mo/ phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas/ khyad par mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ /rgyal sras brgyad dang gnas brtan 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid mchog rnams dgongs su gsol/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che/ /ston dang sems dpa' 'phags pa mchog rnams kyis/ yang yang dka' bas btsal zhing brnag pa'i don/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /mkhan slob chos rgyal sprul pa'i lo paṇa dang*/ /bka' gter rig 'dzin brgyud pa yi dam lha/ /ma mgon gza' rdor rgyud gsum dregs pa'i tshogs/ /snga 'gyur rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /thub bstan mdo dang sngags kyi tshul mtha' dag /gangs can ljongs su brtse bas drangs gyur pa/ /ches cher spel ba'i rdo rje'i dam dgongs nas/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /phyogs dus rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /rigs gsum sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul rol mo yis/ /gangs can phan bde'i nyi ma gsal bar mdzad/

/mtsho skyes? rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa chen po'i tshogs/ /bsam bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar nyer bzung nas/ /dri med rgyal bstan nor bu'i rgyal mtshan sgreng*/ /mtsho skyes? thun mong thun min gzhung kun rang dbang gis/ /ma nor bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa yis/ /gangs ljongs snang ba'i sgo chen thog mar phyes/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /skal bzang gdul byas mdo dang sngags kyi tshul/ /nyams su len la gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /bka' dang dgongs pa'i 'grel chen gzhung kun rdzogs/ /mtsho skyes? bden gsung bka' yi rgya mtsho chen po la/ /zab mo'i chos gter nor bus mngon par mdzes/ /mdo dang sngags kyi lam bzang zung du 'brel/ mtsho skyes? rmad byung za hor mkhan po'i spyod pa dang*/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan klu yi lta ba gnyis/ /zung 'brel brgyud pa'i bka' srol phyag rgyas btab/ /mtsho skyes? zab mo'i nang rgyud sde gsum dgongs pa'i bcud/ /thun min man ngag gsang ba'i lam mchog nas/ /'ja' lus chos skur gshegs pa'i ngo mtshar 'bar/ /mtsho skyes? rab 'byams zhi khro'i khyab bdag sgrub sde brgyad/ /bka' bab rig 'dzin so so'i dgongs bcud dang*/ /kun 'dus pad+ma'i bka' srol gcig tu 'khyil/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /rgyu dang 'bras bu gsang sngags theg pa che/ /tshang la ma nor rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i lung*/ /ḍāk+ki'i zhal gyi drod rlangs tho le ba/ /mtsho skyes? rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs don bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i zhal nas snyan du brgyud/ /rtog ge ngan pa'i rang bzos ma bslad pa/ /mtsho skyes? gser zhing nor bus spras pa'i yon gyis kyang*/ /mi 'gugs dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs mdzod chos/ /brtse bas rjes 'jug skal pa kho nar bkram/ /mtsho skyes? ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i ye shes la/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gdangs shar bas/

/blun sgom sems las 'das pa'i rdzogs pa che/ /mtsho skyes? yod med phyogs rer zhen pa'i dmigs gtad zhig /mthar 'dzin lta ba'i 'dzin stangs drung nas phyung*/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu snang stong zung du 'jug /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug don/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /rig stong mi shigs rdo rje grub pa'i mtha'/ /mtsho skyes? mang du thos pa lung gi sprin 'khrigs shing*/ /pha rol rgol 'joms rig pa'i glog phreng 'bar/ /man ngag gnad kyi bdud rtsi snying la sim/ /mtsho skyes? rmad byung a ti yo ga'i gsang lam nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ khyab bdag 'jam dpal rdo rjer rab bsgrubs pa/ /mtsho skyes? yang dag tshad ma gsum gyi nga ro yis/ /lta dman ri dwags tshogs rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /theg mchog seṅge'i sgra dbyangs sa gsum khyab/ /mtsho skyes? rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i gos bzang rtser/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i tog mdzes pa/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mtho/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /bdag sogs deng nas 'gro ba ji srid du/ /bstan dang bstan pa'i snying po yongs rdzogs pa/ /mkha' khyab zhing du 'dzin skyong spel ba yis/ /mtsho skyes? mdor na mkhas btsun grub pa'i rnam thar gyis/ /rgyal bstan spel ba'i phrin las mkha' khyab pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin dam pas sa steng yongs gang nas/ /mtsho skyes? dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan cing*/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar ba yis/ /chos srid mi nub nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes 'chi med mtshor 'khrungs rgyal ba'i bstan pa snga 'gyur rnying ma zhes grags pa 'di ni rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi mo yin cing zab gnad che ba du ma'i khyad chos dang*/

lta sgom rnam par dag pa rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang ma nor ba yin pa 'di ngo shes nas nor bu rin po che byi dor byas te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la mchod pa bzhin du gang zag skal pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phrin las rlabs po ches phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i thugs khur bzhes pa dang*/ de lta bu'i bzhed pa yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel smon tshig tu rnying bstan la lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos gnas dus rten 'brel dge bar gung thun la shar mar bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam drang srong bden tshig ces bya bzhugs so/ na mo/ phyogs dus rgyal dang byang sems nyan rang 'phags/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum rdo rje chos srung dang*/ /drang srong rig 'dzin bden tshig grub pa yi/ /ma lus skyabs gnas rgya mtshos dgongs su gsol/ khyad par bskal bzang zhing 'di'i bstan pa'i bdag /ston mchog mnyam med don kun grub pa'i dpal/ /ston pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang 'dzam bu'i gling*/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs par/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /thub bstan gzhi gyur lung dang rtogs pa yi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /srid pa ji srid 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon sogs nye ba yi/ /sras mchog brgyad dang rje btsun sgrol ma sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /thub bstan rtsa ba lung dang rtogs pa yi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /rdo rje 'chang dbang sa ra ha pa dang*/ /su ṣa sid+dhi la sogs 'phags yul gyi/ /grub chen brgyad cu rnal 'byor ma tshogs la/

/bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /thub bstan snying po rdo rje theg pa yi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /skal ldan rgyal po dza dang drwa ma lnga/ /lha klu mi yi rig 'dzin la sogs pa/ /gsang sngags don brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /snying po'i yang snying nang rgyud sde gsum gyi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig khyad par gangs ljongs thub bstan snang ba'i sgo/ /thog ma'i srol 'byed chos rgyal mes dbon gsum/ /mkhan slob rnam gnyis ka cog zhang sogs la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /thub bstan snying po gsang sngags rgyud sde yi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /sde gsum shing rta'i bka' bab gnubs mthu chen/ /so zur rma gnyags kun mkhyen rong klong dang*/ /mnga' ris paṇa chen sgrub brgyud 'dzin rnams la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /gsang sngags snying po nang rgyud sde gsum gyi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /rje 'bangs grub chen nyer lnga yer pa yi/ /grub thob brgyad cu mkha' 'gro nyer lnga dang*/ /rang grol rnal 'byor ma bdun la sogs par/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /gsang sngags snying po nang rgyud sde gsum gyi/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /chos sku'i ston pa kun bzang rdo rje sems/ /ston pa bcu gnyis dga' rab shrī seng*/ /bi ma pad 'byung kun mkhyen yab sras la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag po'i gsol 'debs na/

/snying po'i mthar thug 'od gsal rdzogs pa che'i/ /sgom sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /sprul sku rnam gsum gling pa chen po brgyad/ /rtsa gsum gling sogs gter chen brgya dang brgyad/ /gter phran stong rtsa chos bdag brgyud bcas la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /nye brgyud snying po'i zab gter ring lugs mchog /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /bka' gdams gsar rnying mar shangs bka' brgyud dang*/ /lam 'bras zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub sogs/ /gangs ljongs bshad sgrub srol 'byed thams cad la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /shing rta bco brgyad ris med thub pa'i bstan/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /mdo sgyu sems gsum rgyud sde bzhi drug dang*/ /sgrub sde bka' brgyad bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs/ /rab 'byams zhi khro yi dam lha tshogs la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /snga 'gyur bka' gter dag snang man ngag gi /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /chos sku yum chen rigs lnga'i ḍāk+ki dang*/ /phag khros seng gsum gsang ba ye shes sogs/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /snga 'gyur bka' gter dag snang man ngag gi /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ye shes mgon po dpal ldan 'dod khams rgyal/ /ma gza' dam gsum zhing skyong me 'od gdong*/ /pe har la sogs chos skyong dam can la/ /bdag cag gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /snga 'gyur bka' gter dag snang man ngag gi

/bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig khyad par rtsa gsum gter bdag gling pa yi/ /ring lugs zab gter bdun bcu rtsa gnyis sogs/ /gter kha gong 'og smin grol chos kyi mdzod/ /mi nub phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing*/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i phyogs kun khyab gyur cig khyad par dus ngan snyigs lnga bdo ba yi/ /bsam sbyor log par gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen las/ /sngar ma grags pa'i 'byung bzhi'i g.yo 'khrug sogs/ /mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa zhi gyur cig /sngar med dus kyi nad rims sna tshogs dang*/ /snod bcud skad cig thal bar brlag byed pa'i/ /ma rungs kla klo'i dug rdul mtshon 'khrug sogs/ /ma lus myur du zhi zhing nub gyur cig /phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bstan pa'i snying po rin chen byang chub sems/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i rgyud la skyes pa'i mthus/ /'dzam gling zhi bde'i rdzogs ldan gsar 'char shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu gang na su bzhugs kun/ /bslab gsum rdo rje'i khri la zhabs brtan cing*/ /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis phyogs kun khyab/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin nus shog /che brjid mkhas snyan chos brgyad mi 'gran par/ /thos bsam sgom dang bshad sgrub las gsum gyis/ /rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa 'dzin gyur cig /dge 'dun sde rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang dang*/ /spang klog 'khor lo gsum gyi dus 'da' bzhin/ /bslab gsum dam pa'i tshul dgu'i ngang tshul dang*/ /mi 'bral rgyal sras spyod la 'jug gyur cig /bstan gzhi gtsug lag chos 'khor dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'phel ba dang*/ /bstan la 'khu rnams rnam dkar sems skyes nas/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur 'bar gyur cig /snod la bcud 'phel bde skyid phun sum tshogs/

/bcud la g.yang chags mi nor chos gsum 'dzoms/ /kun nas kun tu bde legs rdzogs ldan gyi/ /lang tsho gsar pa'i dpal yon bzhad gyur cig /gzhi bde bde gshegs snying pos khyab pa'i 'gro/ /lam bde yo ga gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /'bras bde sku bzhi'i bdag nyid gdod ma'i mgon/ /rang rig mngon gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang gar gyi dbang phyug dam pa'i rol gar/ mchog sprul phrin las rgyal mtshan mchog gis bstan rgyas smon lam zhig bri rogs zhes/ lha reg dri bral gyis sna drangs rin chen gnyis pa brgya phrag lnga'i skyes bcas rang slob mi nub rgyal mtshan rgyud nan bskul ngor/ rang nas kyang rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag gnubs lo'i ring lugs rgyas pa'i smon lam zhig /bris na legs pa'i snang 'char bzhin sgo chen sprul ming 'bod pa'i gdol spyod pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis sbyar ba don dang ldan par gyur cig/ // ༈ gangs ri rwa bas bskor ba'i zhing khams su/ /phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ spyan ras gzigs dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi/ /zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig/ // ༈ om̐ swa sti/ 'gro 'dul 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos/ /gangs can mgon po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi/ zag med thugs kyi dgongs don ji bzhin du/ /sku tshe rtag brtan ri bo po ta lar/ /myur du khrir 'god rgyal bstan dar rgyas shog /ces 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes so// // ༈ oṃ swa sti/ sngon tshe gu ru pad+ma yab yum gyis/ /mā ra ti kar 'chi bdag bdud bcom nas/ /skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub brnyes pa yi/ /bden pa de yis dpal ldan bla ma rje/ /bum̐d+dham̐ bam̐dz+ram̐ zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan/ /thugs bskyed mthu grub bstan 'gro'i mgon dpung mdzad/ /bshad sgrub 'khor los rnying bstan me ro slong*/ /don gnyis lhun grub dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig

/ces pa'ang slob bu rasmis lha reg dang bcas bskul ngor bya bral bas/ mā ti ka'i gnas mchog tu bris pa sid+dhi rastu// // ༈ oṃ swa sti/ gdod nas srid zhi kun khyab rdo rje sems/ /lha sras dam 'dzin ye shes rol pa rtsal/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug pam̐d+mam̐ nom̐r bum̐'i mtshan/ /bka' drin bla med mgon khyod zhabs brtan gsol/ ces pa'ang snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan grub dbang chos kyi glang po'i yang srid zhabs brtan du dpal yul mchog sprul rin po che'i bkas bskul gnang bar brten/ /mkhan ming tshul khrims rgya mtshos gus pas phul ba de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /dge'o// // ༈ bslu med skyabs gnas mtsho'i byin mthu yis/ /'jim̐gs mem̐d thum̐b bstam̐n phrim̐n lam̐s dpam̐l 'bam̐r gyi/ /zhabs pad mi shigs bskal brgyar rab brtan nas/ /rlabs chen bstan 'gro'i bzhed don mthar phyin shog /ces rdo grub rin po che'i zhabs brtan du bya bral bla ma byang chub rdo rjes lha rdzas rin po che'i rten bcas bskul bzhin 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes 'dun smon du bris pa sid+dhi rastu// // ༈ om̐ swa sti/ gar dbang rdo rje'i bstan 'dzin bsam bzhin du/ /snang ba pad+ma'i rgyal tshab nyin mor byed/ /phrin las 'od zer gdul bya'i gling du shar/ /mchog gi sprul sku zhabs pad yun brtan shog /ces mchog sprul gong ma'i nye gnas bstan 'phel gyis zhabs brtan bskul ngor 7 rje drung 'jam dpal ming gis bris// // ༈ pad+ma'i phrin las gnam lcags rdo rje'i gar/ /sgyu 'phrul thogs med 'gro ba'i dpal mgon mchog /pad+ma karma dh+wa dza mchog grags pa/ /bskal brgyar zhabs brtan phrin las dar rgyas shog /ces pa 'di'ang sngags smyon shrī badz+ra'am rasmi 'bod pas legs par sbyar ba don dang ldan par gyur cig/ // ༈ om̐ swa sti/ phyi ltar so thar sdom pa'i zhing sa la/ /nang ltar byang sems myu gu legs 'khrungs shing*/

/gsam̐ng ba sngam̐gs kyi bskyed rdzogs 'bras smin pas/ /snyigs dus bstam̐n pa'i me ro bshad sgrub kyi/ /phrag par 'dzim̐n bzod bka' drin mnyam med rje/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ /rlabs chen phrin las gegs med yid bzhin 'grub/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde dge mtshan 'bar gyur cig /ces pa'ang rtsa gsum gling pa'i brgyud 'dzin rdo shul sgo chen sprul sku gsang sngags rin po che'i zhabs brtan smon tshig tu gang gi grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ngor sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa khro rgyal rdo rjes sgrub gnas yang le shod du bris// // ༈ na mo gu ru: sprel lo sprel zla ra ba'i tshes bcu la: bsam yas bar khang g.yu zhal can du rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: o rgyan gyis smon lam 'di gsungs pas rje 'bangs thams cad kyis thugs dam nar mar mdzad: phyi rabs rnams kyis 'di la thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzod: phyogs bcu dus bzhi rgyal ba sras dang bcas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: ma lus zhing gi rdul snyed gshegs su gsol: mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: rten mchog bde gshegs rnams kyi spyan snga ru: sngon gyi sdig pa'i tshogs la bdag gnong zhing : da lta'i mi dge 'gyod pas rab tu bshags: phyin chad de las ldog phyir bdag gis bsdam: bsod nams dge tshogs kun la yi rang ngo : rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams myang ngan mi 'da' bar: sde snod gsum dang bla med chos 'khor bskor: dge tshogs ma lus 'gro ba'i rgyud la bsngo: 'gro rnams bla med thar pa'i sar phyin shog: sangs rgyas sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag gis brtsams pa'i smon lam rab bzang 'di: rgyal ba kun tu bzang dang de sras dang : 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis mkhyen pa ltar: de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob shog:

bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma rin chen rnams: nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab par shog: nyi zla bzhin du kun la gsal bar shog: ri bo bzhin du rtag tu brtan par shog: bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun rin po che: thugs mthun khrims gtsang bslab gsum gyis phyug shog: bstan pa'i snying po gsang sngags sgrub pa'i sde: dam tshig ldan zhing bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin shog: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chos skyong rgyal po yang : chab srid rgyas shing bstan la smin par shog: bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs rgyal rigs blon po yang : blo gros rab 'phel rtsal dang ldan par shog: bstan pa'i gsos byed khyim bdag 'byor ldan rnams: longs spyod ldan zhing nyer 'tshe med par shog: bstan la dad pa'i yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun: bde skyid ldan zhing bar chad zhi bar shog: lam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyang : dam tshig mi nyams bsam pa 'grub par shog: bdag la bzang ngan las kyis 'brel gyur gang : gnas skabs mthar thug rgyal bas rjes 'dzin shog: 'gro rnams bla med theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas: kun bzang rgyal srid chen po thob par shog: de ltar gyi smon lam dus drug tu brtson par bya: sa ma ya: rgya: lha sras mu rub rnam 'phrul gter chen mchog gyur gling pas gnas mchog seng chen gnam brag gi g.yas zur brag ri rin chen brtsegs pa'i gong mo 'og ma nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'i bai ro'i sku chos dar shog ngos mtsho rgyal phyag bris bod yig bshur ma las/ de 'phral nyid du pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis dag par bshus pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ smon lam rdo rje'i rgya mdud ni/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /deng 'dir brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i dge ba dang*/ /dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdoms te bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /deng nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*/

/snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan/ /dpal ldan rdo rje'i theg la nges gnas shog /dbang gis smin cing dam tshig sdom par ldan/ /rim gnyis lam la bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin te/ /dka' ba med par rig 'dzin go 'phang bgrod/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag 'grub gyur cig /cir snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lor rdzogs/ /grags pa thams cad brjod bral sngags kyi sgra/ /sems kyi 'gyu ba rang rig 'dus ma byas/ /bde chen 'du 'bral med pa mngon gyur shog /nyams chag rtog sgrib ma spangs gnas su dag /phyi nang gsang ba dbyer med rtogs pas bskangs/ /gang shar rang grol kun bzang klong yangs su/ /ngan song dong sprugs srid zhi mnyam gyur cig /thig le chen po sku dang zhing khams rdzogs/ /dam tshig chen po spang blang mtshan ma dag khyab brdal chen po re dogs mdud pa grol/ /rdzogs pa chen po chos sku mngon gyur shog /brgyud pa gsum gyi byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lam gsang sems la rdzogs/ /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa yis/ /mu mtha' med pa'i+e 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /zhi khro sprul pa'i 'khor los lung ston zhing*/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bu bzhin skyong ba dang*/ /chos skyong srung mas bar chad kun bsal nas/ /yid la smon pa mtha' dag 'grub gyur cig /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi bzhed pa'i don kun 'grub/ /ma lus skye dgu'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*/ /phun tshogs mtha' dag yid bzhin 'byor gyur cig /ces pa'ang rig pa 'dzin pa 'gyur med rdo rjes so// // ༈ bkra shis ni/ om̐ ye dharmā sogs/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gsair gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/

/'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ ༈ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal dai+eng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can? de dag? tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can? de dag? gnas skabs su yang 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi/ /mthun rkyain tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i grogs dang lhan cig tu/ /bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang*/ /bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /bstan 'dzin bu slob dar zhing rgyas pa yis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /༈ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnaud pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chain dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phail/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog ༈ rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/

/lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsam pa dang*/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi mthu stobs dang*/ /bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis/ /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*/ /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /snyan grags nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa ste/ /gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*/ /mthun pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba ste/ /lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ /bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*/ /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa ste/ /drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ // ༈ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ /dpal ldan bla mas deng 'dir stsol/ /yi dam lha yis deng 'dir stsol/ /chos skyong srung mas deng 'dir stsol/ /gzhi bdag rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /shin tu bden par gsungs shing rdzun med pa/ /bden pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /deng kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /deng 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi gnod pa las grol ba bzhin du bdud dang spang bya bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig

/dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༈ gzhan yang 'di ltar/ kun bzang snang mtha' pad 'byung man chad dang*/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i yan chad kyis/ /'gro ba'i don du smon lam gang btab pa/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir 'grub gyur cig/ // ༈ sangs rgyas bden pa chos kyi bden pa dang*/ /dge 'dun bden pa dkon mchog bden pa dang*/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i bden pa dang*/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag 'grub gyur cig/ // ༈ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar smon lam btab bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ // gzhan yang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab ni/ khyad par khyod kyi ring lugs gdan sa che/ /'di na chos dang srid zhi'i dpal 'byor zhing*/ /mi mthun bar du gcod pas mi brdzi bar/ /bstan pa sa chen yongs la khyab gyur cig/ // ༈ spyir thub bstan yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /dgos zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa yi/ /rje pad+ma'i ring lugs rnying ma ba/ /phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/ // ༈ rtsa gsum gling pa'i bstan pa rgyas smon ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos srung bden mthu'i byin rlabs kyis/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje gnyis pa'i ring lugs che'i/ /chos srid dgon gnas dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i 'tshe ba kun bral la/ /zhi zhing bkra shis bde legs 'grub pa dang*/ /dgongs pa rnam dag bka' dang mthun pa yi/ /ma nor lam gyis dge ba ci 'grub pas/

/zab gter mdzod 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /bstan pa dar zhing yun ring 'bar gyur cig /ces dkyil 'khor spyi la 'jug pa'i cho ga'i mtshams sbyar 'di'ang gter kha gong 'og gi man ngag dang gtso bo gnam lcags gdan sa'i phyag srol bzhin gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pas bsgrigs pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ༈ dkyil 'khor spyi'i cho ga mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ na ma shrī māṃ gu ru we/ 'dir sbyin sreg sogs gang du bya ba'i sa phyogs de ma dul ba yin na/ gzhi de nyid du gtor ma dkar zlum rgyan ldan mchod pa dang bcas bshams/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ rang nyid skad cig gis rta mchog he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur par bsams la/ gtor ma rta sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs byin brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngos/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*/ longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/

dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥs rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas gdab pa ni don dam pa'i sbyong ba'o/ /zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu spel ba dge/ // ༈ ling khrus kyi man ngag shin tu bsdus pa ni/ liṅga tshad ldan bris la/ dug khrag /sha dmar/ re nag /byad thag sngo dmar/ rtsang dmar sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du g.yab dril/ gul yungs thun rdzas las bum rnams 'du bya/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du song ste bum pa bsgrub/ de nas bla gab med pa'i sar liṅga skam pas mgo mthur bstan du bzung la/ lam rgya gram gyi sa 'thor zhing*/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ chu mig lkug pa'i chu 'thor zhing*/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ ro sol dang drag shing gi me bskor zhing*/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ rlung la phyar zhing*/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ nam mkhar g.yug cing*/ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā/ āḥnyer gcig dbugs thengs gcig gis brjod cing khrus chu der yod kun la bkye'o/ mthar liṅga sha dmar gyis phyis/ dug khrag byug /dgra lteb ces lte ba bcag cing*/ zur gsum du lteb/ re nag gis dril/ byad thag gis bsdams shing rtsang gis gzir/ 'gugs gzhug lan gsum dang bcas thun gyis brab cing hom du gzhug /de dag ni sgrub chen sta gon gyi snga nur du bya ba'i lag len rje mkhyen brtse'i phyag bzhes mthong rgyun brjed thor bkod pa po ni gu h+ya'o//

// ༈ rgyal tho bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /rgyal tho'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa dang*/ /cho ga ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam/ om̐ dh+riṣ+ṭā rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod/ zab cing rgya chen gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces phrin las bcol/ gong gi sngags bzhi'i mthar/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hās brtan bzhugs bya/

gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ ces bkra shis brjod/ // ༈ tho len skabs mchod gtor bshams la byin brlab gong ltar/ spyan 'dren mi dgos/ gtor ma dang mchod bstod phrin las bcol mthar/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ zhes pas nongs pa bshags/ om̐/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs gsol bya/ bkra shis gang rigs brjod nas mchod gtor gtsang sar gshegs/ /tho blangs nas dben sar bzhag go /zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos so/ dge'o// // ༈ sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring gi dgong thun nas dngos grub kyi rdzas gsar pa bshams la dgong thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rnam pas bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bar bar gyur/ bsnyen sgrub sngags gsham du/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta gu na karma sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ phyi nangs thor thun la phrin las gzhung bsrangs te/ bzlas pa kha skong mchod bstod bcas grub nas dngos grub la mi dbang zhing lta ngan gyi bgegs tshar bcad pa'i phyir bgegs bskrad srung 'khor byin 'bebs bcas bya/ de nas ye shes lha la mkhon gcugs bshags phyir gnong 'gyod drag pos ye shes sku mchog ma/

yig brgya bcas song nas dngos grub blang ba dngos la 'jug pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs dam rjes su dgongs te sku'i gnas dang sbyor mtshams nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub rnams kyang byang sems bdud rtsi 'od zer 'bar ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bdag la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsams la/ bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi sham du/ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes btags pa brgya stong bzlas mthar rang gzhung gi dngos grub blang ba'i tshig brjod la/ sgrub rten lhar gsal ba'i gnas rnams nas 'od zer sna lnga rang gi gnas lngar thim pas mi zad rgyan 'khor lnga dang thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la/ sgrub rten rnams gnas lngar gtugs shing bdud rtsi myang*/ dngos grub kyi rdzas cha gsum du bgos pa'i phud dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lhar phul/ cha gcig sbyin sreg gi rdzas la bsre/ cha gcig rang gis longs spyod par bya'o/ /de nas gsol kha dang tshogs man rjes chog rnams mthar dbyung*/ ༈bsnyen mtshams sogs kyi skabs cha gsum rgyas par mi shes pas/ gtor ma gsum bran la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis brlab/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ om̐ dā sha di lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sngags de mthar/ wā ra na ma sarbsogs gsum/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin? sngags snga ma'i mthar/ wā ra gats+tsha/ 'byung gtor 'bru gsum gyis brlab/ om̐ ma hā bhū ta lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ om̐ ma hā? na ma sarb 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /chos don ldan pa la gnas nas/ /zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod/ /bdag cag byang chub ma thob par/ /gegs med bar chad med pa dang*/

/dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la/ /byang chub snying po'i sdong grogs mdzod/ ma hā bhū t ra gats+tsha/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig sarba bigh+nan gats+tsha/ zhes dang drag sngags gang rung gis bskrad do/ /su shu bha bar+dhan+tu/ ༈ bsnyen sgrub rgyun gyi kha skong 'khyer bde rdzas gcig la brten pa'i las bzhi'i me mchod nor bu sna tshogs mdog can zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de ba ḍāk+ki nī ye/ rig stong zung 'jug rtsa gsum lha/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam lta ba'i phyag /gnyis med ngang du 'tshal nas 'dir/ /bya sla don che'i man ngag bkod/ 'dir rtsa gsum chos srung bcas pa'i bsnyen sgrub gang gi skabs su'ang sngags kyi lhag chad sogs nyams chag skong zhing nus rtsal myur du 'byin pa'i man ngag khyad par can rgyun gyi sreg blugs rdzas gcig kho nar brten pa'i tshul brjod pa la gnyis/ spyi dang bye brag gi lag len no/ /dang po spyir/ bgegs zhi ba la yungs dkar/ tshe rgyas pa la dūrba/ dbang dang drag po'i bsgrub bya dmigs bsal la de dag gi rū pa khyad par rdzas dang sbyar bas mtshon/ las gang la ched du dmigs pa'i so so'i sreg rdzas 'du byas te sngags dang sham bu'ang de mtshungs skabs sbyar dgos kyang 'dir kha skong spyi rgyug tsam bshad na/ bsnyen sgrub gang byed kyang thun gyi dngos gzhi grol nas thun mtshams lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas rang gi mdun tu rtsig thab chung ngu ched du bcos pa'am/ me snod gang yang rung bar/ me khrol blugs pa dang*/ sreg rdzas nyid snod gtsang mar bkod do/ /gnyis pa la zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i dang po zhi ba ni/ sdig sgrib zhi ba'i khongs su thams cad 'dus pas ting phor sogs su til bsham/ me nang mchod kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ me nyid ngo bo gdod nas gos dkar mo/ /rnam pa ye shes me phung dkar gsal 'bar/

/de dbus che ge'i 'dir spyi la rtsa gsum dang bye brag bla ma sogs lha so so kha bsgyur/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /dkar gsal zhi 'dzum 'od zer dkar po 'phro/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams/ /rgyan chas yongs rdzogs dam ye dbyer med pa/ /zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod la dgyes pas bzhugs/ /bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags dang*/ khyad par sngags kyi lhag chad nor 'khrul sogs/ /rdo rje'i dam las 'gal ba'i nongs pa kun/ /sna sgo'i rlung dang lhan cig til la thim/ zhes rlung 'bud/ sreg rdzas zag med bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyur pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du 'bul ba yis/ /ye shes mchog gi dgyes pa'i gzi byin bskyed/ /byin rlabs me 'od zla ba'i mdangs can 'phros/ /rtog sgrib bag chags lhag med bsreg par gyur/ rtsa gsum spyi la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ lha so so'i snying po'i sham du/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ sgrub pa po'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes grangs ji ltar rigs pas phul la mthar rlung nang du rngub pa dang lhan cig me nang ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /rlung gi sbyor bas sna sgo nas drangs te/ /lte 'og gtum mo'i me dang gnyis med gyur/ /de las me 'bar lus kyi nang kun gang*/ /rtsa khams snyigs ma thams cad lhag med bsreg /dwangs ma bde chen bdud rtsir zhu ba yis/ /phung khams skye mched rang byung dkyil 'khor pa/ /zag med bde bas shin tu dgyes par gyur/ ces nang gi sreg blugs dang sbrel la dbyings rig zung 'jug gi dgongs pa bskyed/ zhi ba'i smon lam dang shis brjod bya'o/ /dmigs bsal bgegs dang bar chad zhi bar 'dod na/ rdzas yungs kar bsham/ lha bskyed sngar ltar la/ dgyes par bzhugs/ zhes pa'i 'phros su/ sreg rdzas zag med bdud rtsi'i rgyun sogs nas/ rtog sgrib bag chags zhes pa'i mal du/ gdon bgegs bar chad bsreg par gyur/ ces bsgyur/ lha sngags sham du sarba ar+tha sid+dhā ya swā hā/ gdon bgegs 'byung po rkyen ngan bar gcod thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar/ mthar lha rang la bstim/ nang gi sbyin sreg gong ltar byas kyang chog byad kha rbod gtong sogs la'ang tshig dang dmigs pa bsgyur bas chog go/ // gnyis pa rgyas pa ni/ rdzas dūrba sogs 'du bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: me nyid ngo bo gdod nas gos dkar mo/ /rnam pa ye shes me phung ser gsal 'bar/ /de dbus che ge'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /ser gsal sgeg nyams 'od zer gser mdog 'phro/ /phyag mtshan nor bu rin chen 'bar ba bsnams/ /rgyan chas yongs rdzogs dam ye dbyer med pa/

/rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod la dgyes pas bzhugs/ /sreg rdzas zag med bdud rtsi ser po'i rgyun/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du phul ba yis/ /ye shes mchog gi dgyes pa'i gzi byin bskyed/ /'od zer nyi ma'i mdangs can bdag la zhugs/ /sngags kyi ye shes yon tan rab rgyas gyur/ lha sngags sham du/ oṃ sarba sam+pa de swā hā/ sgrub pa po'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor sngags kyi ye shes thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pas kyang grangs ci 'grub phul/ rjes zhi ba'i skabs ltar ro/ /bye brag tu tshe sgrub gtso bor byed skabs sreg rdzas dūrba dang*/ tshig rkang tha ma la/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur/ ces dang*/ lha sngags sham du/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig sbyang*/ nyams rtogs rgyas par 'dod na/ chang la chos sman sbyar ba'i zas mchog phul/ de'i sngags sngar bzhin la/ sgrub pa po'i nyams dang rtogs pa'i ye shes thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes sbyar ro/ /gsum pa dbang ni/ sreg rdzas til mar dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang so ba/ khyad par rdzas pad+ma rak+ta'am zla mtshan/ sin+dhu ra/ me tog dmar po/ lan tshwa/ /thams cad myos byed kyis sbags pa'am ma 'dzom na me tog dmar po chang dang lan tshwas bran pa bshams la nang mchod 'thor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ me nyid ngo bo gdod nas gos dkar mo/ /rnam par ye shes me phung dmar gsal 'bar/ /de dbus che ge'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /dmar 'tsher chags nyams 'od zer dmar po 'phro/ /phyag mtshan pad+ma'i lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /rgyan chas yongs rdzogs dam ye dbyer med pa/ /dbang gi phrin las mdzad la dgyes pas bzhugs/ /sreg rdzas bde chen bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du phul ba yis/ /zag med bde bas rab tshim rjes chags g.yos/ /'od dmar lcags kyu'i dbyibs can mkha' khyab 'phros/

/sngags kyi ye shes mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal/ /'khor 'das snang srid bdag gi dbang 'dus gyur/ lha sngags sham du/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ mchog thun dngos grub sngags kyi ye shes khams gsum snang srid thams cad sgrub pa po'i dbang du gyur cig wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba lo ka wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pas kyang ji tsam nus pa 'bul/ dbang du bsdu bya dmigs bsal yod na/ de'i ming gi mthar/ sgrub pa po'i dbang du sogs spel tshig sbyar ro/ /bzhi pa drag po ni/ sreg rdzas spyir yungs dkar dug khrag gis sbags pa dang*/ bye brag mngon spyod gtsor bton pa'i rigs la ling chung sha dum khrag thigs sbyar ba bsngos la/ nang mchod 'thor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ me nyid ngo bo gdod nas gos dkar mo/ /rnam par ye shes me phung dmar nag 'tshubs/ /de dbus cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /rab khros gtum rngam 'od zer mthing nag 'khrugs/ /ral gri phur bu la sogs mtshon cha bsnams/ /'bar ba'i chas ldan dam ye dbyer med pa/ drag po'i phrin las mdzad la rings par bzhugs/ /sreg rdzas dgra bgegs sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /zhal du phul bas rngam pa'i stabs kyis bzhes/ /sku las me mtshon khro chung thog rgod 'phros/ /bar gcod byed pa'i dgra bgegs dam sri'i tshogs/ /ming yang med par rdul bzhin brlag par gyur/ lha sngags sham du/ sarba sha trun bigh+nan da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭ/ sgrub pa po la gnod cing bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces pas 'bul/ 'di ni drag po spyi 'gro tsam yin cing seng gdong ma dang chos skyong 'ga' zhig la dmigs su bsal ba yod kyang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/ tshul min spros pa rgyas kyang ngal bar zad/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas phyi nang sreg blugs kun/
