/'dis 'grub phyir na lag len gsal byas pas/ dus zhabs sgrub po'i dga' ston btsas su shog /ces pa'ang nye bar mkho zhing khyer bde lag len mgo rkang tshang ba'i yig cha khungs grub ma mthong bas/ dgongs 'dus rnam pa gsum gyi dgongs pa gung bsgrigs te pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ rtsa gsum spyi la 'jug pa'i me mchod phrin las bzhi ldan don gnyis dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i gter byon las bzhi me mchod bklag chog tu bkod pa la lnga/ dang po rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub kha skong zhi ba'i me mchod la/ thog mar sbyor ba'i rim pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs gang rung gi: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar son rnal 'byor pa'i: don gnyis 'bras bu myur du 'byin 'dod na: phyi yi 'byung khams gza' skar dus sbyor dang : nang 'byung lus kyang rgyan gos kha dog bsgyur: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi yi dang po la: thab dbyibs zlum dkar rdo rjes mtshan par byas: spungs rdzas spyi dang zhi bar til dkar nag: ces gsungs pa ltar/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang yar tshes gza' skar shis pa'i dus snga dro'i char rang nyid chas gos dkar po bsgyur la/ kha shar du gyu ba'i mdun g.yas su mchod rdzas gtor ma sman raka zhi ba'i 'bul gtor mchod pa sna bdun sogs mdzes par bkod/ g.yon du sreg rdzas rim par ku sha dpal 'bar rlung g.yab mar khu yam shing til dkar nag gtso bor byas pa'i spung rdzas dang tam+bu la gos zung rnams bkod/ rang mdun du ḍā ma ru rdor dril dgang blugs nang mchod sogs bzhag pa'i stegs mdun gangs ri bam̐ mtshan bris pa bcas tshags su tshud par bya/ sa slong sngon du 'gro ba'i mdun phyogs nye ba'i sar thab stegs gru bzhi ba byung gis byugs pa'i khar thig mtshon btab cing ba byung ngam dri'i chus chag chag gdab/

zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lte ba 'dab brgyad rdo rje'i mtshan pa phyi rol rdor phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i mtshan pa thams cad kha dog dkar por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ zhi bar 'os pa'i sman shing sogs kyi thab zlum por brtsegs pa slob dpon dang zhal sprod bya/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sngon du song nas bzlas pa'i rjes las bum sgrub pa ni/ las bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying dang mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ mthar khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur pas phrin las mdzad par mos: de nas bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu la rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha skur skad cig gis ldang*/ lha yi nga rgyal la gnas bzhin par/ rdor dril bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thabs kyi rdo rje las sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro bar gyur: om̐ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐:

zhes rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ āḥlas dbyings phyug yum lnga'i rang bzhin shes rab dril bu'i rnam pas sems can thams cad rig pa sad par byed pa'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad par gyur: om̐ ma hā ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes dril bu dkrol: rdor dril thabs shes kyi phyag rgyas snying khar bsnol zhing : hūm̐: thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon: ma lus 'gro rnams sad pa dang : sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: om̐ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ āḥ 'di nas sbyin sreg mthar dbyung gi bar du lag rdor dril dang ma bral ba dang lag pa pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba dang sems ting 'dzin las mi 'bral ba ste dam tshig gsum dran par byas la mchod rdzas rnams/ bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'phros pa yi: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ zhu ma dag dri ma sbyangs: bh+rūm̐ las sna tshogs rat+na'i snod yangs par: oṃ las dam tshig rdzas rnams bdud rtsir rtogs: āḥhūm̐ ho yis snang srid gang bar spel: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tkhaṃ swā hā sogs lan gsum dang*/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ bde stong ye shes kyi rnam rol kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho mkha' khyab tu phyag rgya sad par bsam mo/ sreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi'i bran la rdo rje rtse gcig pas reg ste/ oṃ swā hā/ rdzas rnams bkru/ yam shing la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhun mar la/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ ag+ne ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes pas me sbar/ hūm̐ gis rlung g.yab/ oṃ ag+ni swā hā/ zhes blug gzar mar khu'i thigs pas gso/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ ku sha bkram/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi snang srid rnam dag gi thab dang dam ye dbyer med kyi thab lha bskyed pa ni/ āḥ 'khor 'das ye dag lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing : sor rtog ye shes na bza' dkar mo'i mkhar: ye shes sgyu ma rol pa'i dkyil 'khor pa:

chu zla'i zlos gar ma 'dres rdzogs par gsal: hūm̐/ thab dbus skad cig dran rdzogs spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: rin chen thor tshug?lta bu 'khor 'das zil gnon ltar sbyar na dang*/ rdor sems ltar na/ hūm̐/ thab dbus skad cig rdo rje sems: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan 'bar: dbu skrdang mkha' 'gro ltar na/ hūm̐/ thab dbus skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ye shes mkha' spyod?sogs nas spyan 'dren bar btang*/ de nas bzhugs gsol dang phyag 'tshal grub nas mchod pa'i skabs mchod sngags kha phral la mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes spyi 'gros sam yang na lha mtshan kha bsgyur la/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ lta bu'i thab tu cung zad re 'bul/ de bzhin nang gsang gi mchod pa'i skabs sman raka gtor gsum 'bul ba sogs gzhung so so ltar sbyar la/ gzhung gang yin gyi bstod pa grub ma thag /de nas byon skyems dgang blugs kyis 'bul ba ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu ram̐ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dkar rab 'phros te: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang bcas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas lha ma gsal zhing sngags ma dag pa dang ting nge 'dzin ma gsal zhing cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa sogs nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad byang zhing lhag chad kha bkang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ ram̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod:

hoḥ thog med bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chag dang : sngon las 'phral rkyen byad phur rbod gtong sogs: mi mthun dgra gdon rkyen ngan bar chad kun: ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du zhi gyur cig: oṃ sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spung rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho na'i 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol gong ltar sbrel la bya/ tshul de lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong yin na bsnyen pa'i bcu cha dang gzhan du stong phrag gcig las mi nyung bar long skabs dang bstun te brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar la rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ sngar bzhin gzhung gi mchod pa'i skabs mchod rdzas gong bzhin lhag med thab tu dbul/ de nas sman raka gtor ma yang 'bul la/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swā hā/ zhes so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ gos zung yang 'bul/ phyag rgya dril stabs dang bcas bstod pa gzhung ltar bya/ las rdor pas thab dkyil la phyag 'tshal zhing bshags pa ni/ hoḥ chos nyid don la nor 'khrul mi dmigs kyang : lta dman rig pa'i 'ub tu ma chub pa'i: lha sngags ting 'dzin cho ga yo byad rdzas: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul rang gnong bzod par gsol: yi ge brgya pa bzlas pas 'khon bcugs sbyang*/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ sogs kyi mthar ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ zhes dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing*/ bsngo smon dang bkra shis mdor bsdus byas la rjes chog tshogs skong nas bkra shis bar mthar dbyung ngo*/ zhi ba'i me rang zhi la btang ba'am long khom med tshe 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chus gzhil la thal ba ri rtser rlung la bskur bar gsungs so/ de dag ni kha skong zhi ba'i me mchod spyi 'gros ltar grub bo/ dmigs bsal sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs nyin snga ma'i tshogs mchod grub nas mchod bstod mgor rtsa bsnyen mthar sa ma ya satwaṃ/

brjod pas tshom bu lha grangs dang mtshungs par bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol zhing mchod bstod sogs rgyun ldan ltar bya bas 'thus/ dngos gzhi sbyin sreg skabs me sbar te ku sha bkram pa'i rjes thog mar gzhung gi spyan 'dren btang la tshom bu spos rol dang bcas thab la bskor zhing tshom bu'i rtse mo bcad pa thab tu gtor la bzhugs su gsol/ āḥ 'khor 'das ye dag sogs thab lha bskyed la spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dor nas phyag 'tshal man gong dang mtshungs la sbyin sreg grub nas mchod bstod bshags pa'i rjes ye shes pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gshegs par gyur/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ zhes tshom bu dkyil 'khor du gdan drang ba khyad par ro/ de dag ni kha skong zhi ba'i me mchod grub bo/ ༈ zur du phrin las 'og ma gsum dang sbyar tshul yang*/ gter gzhung las/ 'og ma gsum yang gong bzhin rig pas 'phrul: nor bu mchog la byi dor mchod pa bzhin: gang zhig 'dir brtson 'bras ster e ma rmad: ces gsungs pa bzhin/ gnyis pa rgyas pa'i me mchod ni/ sbyor dngos phal cher zhi ba dang mtshungs la/ dmigs bsal ni/ gzhung las/ rgyas par gru bzhi ser po rin chen mtshan: zhes dang*/ rgyas par rin chen 'bru sman dar zab ser: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang yar tshes gza' skar shis pa'i dus nyin gung char rang nyid chas gos ser por bsgyur la/ kha lho ru gyu ba'i mdun g.yas su mchod rdzas gtor ma sman raka rgyas pa'i 'bul gtor ser po gru bzhi mchod pa sna bdun sogs mdzes par bkod/ g.yon du sreg rdzas rim par ku sha dpal 'bar rlung g.yab mar khu yam shing dkar gsum mngar gsum dang mar khu gtso bor byas pa'i spungs rdzas sogs sngar ltar mtshungs/ rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi lte bar 'dab brgyad nor bu'i mtshan pa phyi rol nor phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa thams cad kha dog ser por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/

rgyas par 'os pa'i yam shing 'bras bu can gyi shing sogs ser por kha bsgyur la sbrang rtsi dang mar khus brlan/ thab gru bzhir brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rdor dril byin rlabs nas mchod pa'i bar zhi ba ltar dang*/ gzhung gang yin gyi bstod pa grub ma thag /dgang blugs 'bul skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od ser rab 'phros te: rgyas pa'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khu'i blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang bcas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa lung rtogs yon tan thams cad oṃ sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa dang : nyams dang rtogs pa sa lam yon tan rtsal: stobs dang snyan grags gdul bya phrin las kun: rtsol med rig pa'i ngang du rgyas gyur cig: bh+rūm̐ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spungs rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho nas 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol gong ltar sbrel te brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar nas rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod bstod sogs snga ma ltar mtshungs la me thal gter bum du sba ba yin no/ ༈ gsum pa/ dbang gi me mchod ni/ sngon 'gro sogs gong ltar mtshungs la thab kyi khyad par ni/ gzhung las/ dbang la zla gam dmar po pad+mas mtshan: zhes dang*/ dbang la me tog glang sna dmar po sogs:

'bru sman shing 'bras dar zab dmar po'i rigs: sin+dhu ra dang li khri mtshal dang sbyar: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang zla ba mar gyi ngo dang dus tshes khyad par can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus sogs dgong mo'i char rang nyid chas gos dmar por bsgyur la/ kha nub tu gyu ba'i mdun g.yas su mchod rdzas gtor ma sman raka dbang gi 'bul gtor dmar po zla gam mchod pa sna bdun sogs mdzes par bkod/ g.yon du sreg rdzas glang sna ug chos sogs me tog dmar po'i rigs dang 'bru rigs shing tog sogs myos byed kyis sbags la mtshal dmar gyis kha bsgyur ba'i spungs rdzas sogs sngar ltar mtshungs/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor dmar po zla gam lte bar 'dab brgyad dang pad+ma'i lcags kyus mtshan pa phyi rol pad phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i mtshan pa thams cad kha dog dmar por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ dbang la 'os pa'i yam shing tsan+dan sogs kha dog dmar po'i rigs dang thab zla gam brtsegs pa spor byed kyang smad tshong ma'i lag nas byung ba'i me sogs khyad par ro/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rdor dril byin rlabs nas mchod pa'i bar zhi ba ltar dang*/ gzhung gang yin gyi bstod pa grub ma thag /de nas dgang blugs 'bul skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dmar rab 'phros te: dbang gi phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yon du bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang bcas/ khams gsum srid gsum rlung sems snang ba thams cad oṃ sarba wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul:

dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ rgyal ba'i mthu byin lha 'dre'i srog snying dang : che dgu gnyen bcu rgyal blon btsun mo sras: 'khor 'bangs pho mo zas nor longs spyod tshogs: 'bad med rig pa'i ngang du dbang sdud gyur: hrīḥ wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spungs rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho na'i grangs bzung la pad+ma'i rgya dang bcas g.yon ma'i kun spyod kyis 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol gong ltar sbrel la brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar nas rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod bstod sogs snga ma ltar mtshungs la me thal yang chu klung chen por 'dor ba khyad par ro/ bzhi pa drag po'i me mchod ni/ spyir snga ma rnams dang phyogs mtshungs la dmigs bsal gyi khyad par ni/ gzhung las/ drag po'i gru gsum mthing nag ral gris mtshan: zhes dang*/ drag por zangs lcags yungs dkar sha khrag tshwa: dug can shing dang 'bru nag dgra gzugs sbyar: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang drag po la shis pa'i zla ba mar gyi ngo nyer dgu sogs 'phrod sbyor rtsub pa'i dus srod kyi char rang nyid chas gos nag por bsgyur la/ kha byang du gyu ba'i mdun g.yas su mchod rdzas gtor ma sman raka drag po'i 'bul gtor nag po gru gsum mchod pa sna bdun sogs bkod/ g.yon du sreg rdzas gzhan spyi dang mtshungs la khyad par gyi rdzas tshwa sna gsum dang dug sna gsum lcags zangs thal ba sha khrag sogs las sbrus pa'i ril bu'am phye ma gang rung dang gzhan du dgra gzugs liṅga sogs 'du bya ba'am/ spyi ltar rdzas spyi mthun ltar la dug khrag dang nag po'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba tsam gyis kyang rung ngo*/ drag po'i dkyil 'khor nag po gru gsum lte ba ral gris mtshan pa phyi rol ral gri'i phreng ba thams cad kha dog nag por bsgyur/

drag por 'os pa'i yam shing dug shing dang tsher ma can sogs nag pos kha bsgyur ba dug khrag gis ngar gyis brlan pa thab gru gsum brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ dngos gzhi sngar dang 'dra la/ dgang blugs 'bul ba'i skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od ljang rab 'phros te: drag pos phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yon du bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang bcas/ nyon mongs dug gsum dang dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad sarba mā ra ya phaṭ/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ sngon las 'phral rkyen bstan dgra sgos dgra dang : ma rungs sems can gzugs can gzugs med dang : byad stems rbod gtong than dang ltas ngan bcas: skye med rig pa'i ngang du brlag gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spungs rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho nas grangs bzung la mthe chung sbreng ba'i g.yon kho nas 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol gong ltar sbrel la brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar nas rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod bstod sogs snga ma ltar mtshungs la me dug khrag gis bsad la thal ba yang mnan pa bzhin bya ba ni lag len gyi khyad par te so so'i skabs phyed par bya'o/ lnga pa las bzhi lhun grub kyi me mchod ni/ spyir zhi ba ltar la khyad par ni/ gzhung las/ lhun grub drag po dbus nas rim can sbyar: zhes dang*/ lhun grub til yungs me tog shing 'bras sogs: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang nyid chas gos sngon por bsgyur la/

'bul gtor las bzhi'i gdan can 'brang rgyas sngon po mchod pa zhi ba dang mtshungs la kha dog sngon por bsgyur/ bsreg rdzas zhi rgyas bzhin gtso bor byas/ dkyil 'khor drag po dbus su byas pa'i las bzhi ka tshang ba'i lte bar 'dab brgyad 'khor los mtshan pa phyi rol rdo ra 'od phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa thams cad kha dog mdzes mtshon la gzhi sngon por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ mchog gi las la 'os pa'i sman shing sogs la yam shing dang*/ thab dbyibs las bzhi'i rang gzugs ltar brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ dngos gzhi sogs zhi ba ltar dang*/ dgang blugs 'bul skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ sna tshogs 'od kyis rab 'byams las bsgrub bsam: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i sna tshogs 'od 'phros te: lhun grub rab 'byams phrin las sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yas bskor gyis lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags kyi mthar 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsir 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sdig sgrib zhi ba dang : tshe bsod dpal yon 'byor drug rgyas pa dang : 'khor 'das mos bzhi snang sems dbang du bsdus: gnod byed tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wā shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spungs rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho na'i 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol sbrel te brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar nas rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod bstod sogs zhi ba ltar mtshungs so/

ro sreg ni zhi sreg gi cho ga zla ba'i 'od zer du gsal bas 'dir ma bkod la/ mkhyen par 'dod na der shes par bya'o/ de ltar spros med bsnyen sgrub la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i las bzhi me mchod nor bu sna tshogs mdog can zhes zab gnad khyad par can 'di nyid rje gter chen bla ma pad+ma rgyal po 'gro 'dul gzhan phan gling pa rtsal gyis gnas mchog pad+ma bkod 'khor lo lnga yi ya gyal bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas 'brug la mar me kong bum nas gter du bzhes pa'i zab gter sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi cha lag rtsa gsum spyi la sbyar chog pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa 'di'ang gter kha gong 'og gi bsnyen sgrub nyams len pa rnams la nyer mkho'i ched rtsa ba'i gter gzhung la man ngag gis zur brgyan te bklag chog mar bkod pa 'di yang gter chen bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i 'bangs gu h+yas bgyis pa'i yi ge pa sgrub brtson au ḍi'o// // ༈ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus sgrub bkru byabs srung gsum rten khrus dang bcas pa stabs bder bkod pa bzhugs so/ gang zhig bya ba la 'jug par 'dod pa dag /rang nyid sha chang sogs ma 'bag par/ gtsang sbra dang bcas thog mar sgrub pa la/ stegs bu gtsang ma khebs dang ldan pa'i khar 'bru tshom bkod pa'i steng du/ rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa gtsang ma'i nang*/ bya rgyud bum rdzas nyer lnga dang dri bzang chus sum gnyis gang ba/ dar ljang gu'i mgul chings/ ku sha dang rma bya'i sgro chun gyi kha rgyan can/ khrus dar me long rdor dril bcas 'du byas la/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ na mo/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lhar/ /gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub mchog thob phyir/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms bsgom par bgyi/ lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/

/chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /lan gsum/ bdag mdun bum pa bskyed pa ni/ bdag mdun rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sku/ khro 'dzums ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /ye shes rang 'od 'khrugs pa'i dbus na gsal/ /mdun bskyed sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs/ /bum nang dag byed bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ /e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe a āḥswā hā/ nyer gcig bzlas la rang gis khrus chu 'thor 'thung byed/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drang*/ om̐ badz+ra bi dhā ra ṇa sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sogs shwa lo kas bstod nas/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ zhes pa nas gzungs ring lan gsum dang*/ snying po ci nus dang*/ nye snying gang mang bzlas la byin gyis brlab/ de nas bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod la/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes chus/ /skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la/ /gnas pa'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /bkru bar bgyi'o byang zhing dag gyur cig /yig brgya dang bcas chab bkye/ na mo/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos can gdod nas dag cing*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi dkar po lha'i dri ma/ nag po bdud kyi dri ma/ khra bo gza'i dri ma/ steng gdon gza' rgyu skar/ 'og gdon klu sa bdag /bar gdon 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad zhi ba khrus kyi sgo nas byang bar gyur cig /bum pa thogs te khrus chu spyi bo nas blugs bzhin du/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe a āḥswā hā/ spro na gzungs ring dang*/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ/ sarba pā paṃ bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba bigh+nān bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba ro ga bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba duṣ+ṭān bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba dz+wa re bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba u pa dra be bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba dur swa pa ni bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba dur+ṇi mṛt+te bh+ya shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥshīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bum pa'i chus khrus byas shing kha bshal lo/ byabs pa ni/ rma bya'i sgro chun lag tu thogs nas/ da khrus kyi bya ba rnams song te slar byabs pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /'o rma bya'i sgro mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sngags kyi phreng ba 'khod/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad/ phyags dar mkhas pa'i byed las bzhin byabs te mdun gyi khrus chu la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byabs la/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/

e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe a āḥswā hā/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ nas/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ bh+ya a pa na ye swā hā/ sarba bigh+nān bh+ya a p sarba ro ga bh+y sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ? sarba dz+wa re? sarba u pa dra be? sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu? sarba dur swa pa ni? sarba dur+ṇi mṛt+te? sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥ.a pa na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing byabs/ rgyun du srung ba man gsham gsal ltar bya'o/ spro na dri chu glud gtor dang bcas pa lhan cig tu bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dri glud 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: lan gsum/ ho/ khyer cig khyer cig stobs ldan rnams/ /sred dang chags dang zhen pa dang*/ /dran dang bsam dang gzung dang reg /glod dang zhi dang grol bar mdzod/ ces bsgrub bya la bskor zhing*/ phyir dor la/ na mo/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par?bden brdar sngar bzhin mthar bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas bsrung bya'i lus ngag yid gsum la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ sum+bha ni sngags kyis bskrad cing gu gul bdug la bka' bsgo ba yang bya'o khrus rkyang skabs ma byas kyang chog go /srung ba ni/ de nas srung ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /slob dpon rnam par 'joms pa'i phyag gi rdo rje rgya gram las/ rdo rje de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung bas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo dang*/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon/ dpyi g.yas g.yon rnams su re re/ de la de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung nas/ lus la rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lugs su gyon pas/

phyin chad nad gdon bgegs rigs gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe a āḥswā hā/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ nas/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ bh+ya rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥ sarba bigh+nān bh+y sarba ro ga bh+y sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ bh+y sarba dz+wa re? sarba u pa dra be? sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu? sarba dur swa pa ni? sarba dur+ṇi mṛt+te? sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+ya rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ spyi bo/ mdun/ rgyab/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon/ dpyi g.yas g.yon te gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram re bkod/ de las 'od 'phros te lus rdo rje'i go khrab kyis zhu lugs su g.yogs par bsams shing*/ mthar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro ba 'di ni bdag gis srung zin gyis/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /ces brjod/ sdig pa thams cad byang ba dang*/ zhes sogs nas/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ zhes pa yan chod brjod pas phan yon bstan/ mthar me tog 'thor zhing*/ oṃ/ sku mchog 'bar ba'i?sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ sems can nad pa ji snyed? smon lam mthu dang ldan p bgegs rigs stong phrag? de ltar 'grub pa'ang?sogs bsngo smon gyi mtha' dbyung bar bya'o/ yang gnas rten dang*/ mgon khang sogs la khrus gsol ba dgos tshe/ gang du bya ba'i gnas der zhi drag phyed ma gsum gyis bgegs sbyong ba la/ gong du bshad pa'i bden stobs mthar/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir khrus kyi cho ga zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i sogs kyis bsgyur ba'i sbyong ba sngon du 'gro/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ha la ha la ha la hūm̐/

zhes dang*/ sum+bha nis bgegs bskrad/ badz+ra rak+ṣas srung 'khor bsgoms la/ khrus dngos ni/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pas sku khrus gsol bar bgyi'o/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'aud chags bla re bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ thog mar lha khrus ni rten rnying par me long bstan la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bye brag sbyar bar mos na/ mar me mdzad sogs rgyal ba 'das pa dang*/ /byang chub chen po da ltar bzhugs pa dang*/ /byams pa la sogs phyis nas 'byon pa yi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams la sku khrus gsol/ khrus sngags brjod/ 'jam dbyangs phyag n sa yi snying po? nam mkha'i snying po? nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la sku khrus gsol/ khrus sngags brjod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: byin rlabs rtsa ba o rgyan rin po che: 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i: drin can bla ma rnams l sngags brjod/ zhi khro yi dam 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can: dngos grub rtsa ba thugs rje spyan ras gzigs: rta mgrin dbang chen 'khor 'das spyi dpal gtso: yi dam lha tshogs rnams l sngags brjod/ ma mo mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mo ste:

bar chad sel mdzad rdo rje phag mo yum: rigs kyi lha mo gsang ba ye shes dbyings: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs l sngags brjod/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /nor gyi bdag po ār+ya dzam bha la/ /dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /nor lha gter bdag rnams l sngon tshe o rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la/ /ma yis bu ltar skyong bar zhal bzhes pa/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs l khrus sngags brjod/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*/ /sems can sgo gsum sgrib sbyang phyir/ /gtsang ma chab kyi sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ de nas sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ kā ya bhi shwa dha na ye swā hā: de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag dag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la re re bzhin rten gsum byin ldan la me long bstan nas sku khrus gsol/ mthar khrus chu bum par blugs/ yul mkhar dang ri khrus bgyi na gang du bgyi bar me long bstan la/ hūm̐/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong slad du/ /sbyin pa dri yi legs bgos chus/ khrus legs mdzad phyir khrus bgyi'o/ khrus sngags brjod/ hūm̐/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /tshul 'chal dri ma sbyong slad du/ /tshul khrims dri yi legs bgos chus/ khrus legs mdzad phyir khrus bgyi'o/ khrus sngags brjod/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ khong khro'i dri ma sbyong slad du/ /bzod pa dri yi legs bgos chus/ khrus legs mdzad phyir khrus bgyi'o/

khrus sngags brjod/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong slad du/ /brtson pa dri yi legs bgos chus/ khrus legs mdzad phyir khrus bgyi'o/ khrus sngags brjod/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong slad du/ /bsam gtan dri yi legs bgos chus/ khrus legs mdzad phyir khrus bgyi'o/ khrus sngags brjod/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ shes 'chal dri ma sbyong slad du/ /shes rab dri yi legs bgos chus/ khrus legs mdzad phyir khrus bgyi'o/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ rten gsum dang lha rten ri khrus sogs yin na/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ sh+lau ka gcig om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes sku phyi zhing*/ de nas de la kha dog? sogs kyis gos zung 'bul lo/ gzhan dud khyim dang phyug lhas sogs la gong gi gzungs ring ngam nye snying mthar/ sarba pā paṃ sogs sngags tshan bcu po btags pas bum chu 'thor zhing khrus gsol ba gong ltar bya'o/ de ltar khrus gsol grub nas/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ sogs phan yon brjod pa sogs gong ltar mtshungs/ mthar mchod bstod ni/ om̐ badz+ra bi dhā ra ṇa sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sogs sh+lau kas bstod nas/ yig brgya bzla/ ma snyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/ badz+ra muḥ rang gi dpral bar om̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ dge ba 'di yis? dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga bkru byabs srung gsum dang rten khrus khyim khrus sogs stabs bde'i phyag bzhes 'di bzhin/ sngar gyi yig rnying khag dang mthong rgyun lag len bzhin nyer mkho'i yan lag tu sgo sprul pas sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/

// ༈ rab gnas shin tu bsdus pa'i lugs nyung gsal snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ 'dir rten la rab gnas shin tu mgyogs par bya dgos na/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ zhes rang nyid gnyug ma'i he ru ka lam gyis gsal/ rten rnams la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ha la ha la ha la hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sum+bha nis bgegs bskrad/ badz+ra rak+ṣas srung 'khor bsgoms la/ spro na 'dir khrus gsol bya/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta sogs/ rten rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /seṅge glang chen rta mchog rma bya dang*/ /shang shang rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*/ /rigs kyi sa bon phyag mtshan yongs gyur las/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin 'byung snang mtha' yas/ /don grub rang 'od rig ma'i bde bas dgyes/ /g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin/ /zhi tshul mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rgyan chas sgeg /ye shes lnga ldan mu med 'od zer 'bar/ /dbyings nas ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim/ /gnas gsum sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyas gdab/ /dbang lhas dbang bskur ye shes dbu rgyan gyur/ oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dri sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ pañca ka la mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥs man+ta tsak+ṣu shwa dha ni swā hā/ zhes spyan drangs 'gugs bstim rgyas gdab dbang bskur spyan dbye bcas grub nas/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /nyer spyod 'dod yon rig ma'i bde gar sogs/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed pas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mchod par bgyi/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ de nas snyim par me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyar la/ ji srid sa chu me dang ni/ /rlung gis bskal pa 'jig bar du/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ ces dang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab mthar/ ye dharma dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ me tog 'thor? gsum pa ni/ slar yang thal mo sbyar la/ sa dang chu dang me rlung las/ /lha rnams kun gyis rten 'di la/ /bskal pa brgya ru bsrung ba dang*/ /dgyes shing yid bzang gyur pa yis/ /slob dpon yon gyi bdag por bcas/ /kun nas zhi dang rgyas pa dang*/ /rtag tu bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /sems can re ba skong mdzad pas/

/bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ 'jig rten bde zhing sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char bsnyil bar bya'o/ tshul 'di ni rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs 'dod 'jo las shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gsungs pa nyid lag tu blang zhing khyer bde ba'i slad du ze chen pa 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyis bris pa maṅga laṃ// // ༈ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa 'bog chog mdor bsdus ni/ thog mar thub dbang sku sogs rten gsum bkram pa'i mdun/ slob dpon rang nyid thub pa'i dbang por bskyed cing*/ gang zhig bstan la zhugs par 'dod pa'i gang zag pho mo gang yin 'khod pas/ mdun rten rnams dkon mchog gsum dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa dang*/ rten dang bla ma la phyag lan gsum gsum du 'tshal zhing tsog pur thal mo sbyar te sdod bcug la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ 'gro ba'i tshul/ 'gro ba'i dus/ dgos pa sogs gnas skabs dang bstun/ brda 'phrod par bshad/ bsdu na/ 'o/ khyed rang rnams rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir/ don du gnyer bya ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la nan tan snying po bya ba nyid yin la/ de'ang phyi pa dang nang pa'i khyad par skyabs 'gro'i dbye ba yin la/ der ma zad nang pa'i lam thams cad kyi gzhi rten 'di kho na yin te/ ji skad du/ sdom pa kun la yod mod kyang*/ /skyabs su ma song ba la med/ /ces gsungs pas skyabs su 'gro ba las gal che ba med/ de'ang gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum yin zhing*/ de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul yang*/ sangs rgyas la ston pa dang*/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la grogs su khas len pa yin/ dus kyang 'dir theg chen gyi dbang du byas na/ dus 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar dang*/

dgos ched kyang theg chen gyi kun slong rang dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ gtan du bde ba rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas/ mchog gsum khas len pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming so so'i ming smos la zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ bdag ming smos bcug la 'di zhes bgyi ba skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du/ slob dpon gyis bzung du gsol/ zhes dang slar yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces sngar bzhin lan gsum gyi bar rjes zlos byar gzhug /tha ma'i skabs thob mtshams ngo shes dgos te/ slob dpon gyis/ thabs yin no/ zhes se gol gtog pa dang*/ slob mas kyang thob song snyam pa'i mos pa dang bcas/ legs so/ zhes brjod bcug /yang gtsug phud len par spro'am/ zhes dris par slob mas/ spro lags/ zhes brjod/ de nas gtsug phud lan gsum bcad la rten drung du phul zhing*/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha rnams dga' ba chen por mdzad du gsol lo/ dgyes pa chen po mdzad po mdzad du gsol lo/ tshul khrims bslab pa rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cing*/ /skyes pa nyams p'phel bar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su? spyod par shog /sogs smon lam dang slob dpon gyi mtshan zur nas chos ming gsar du 'dogs/ gsham du bslab pa rnams zhib tu brjod par bya'o/ de ltar bslab pa tsam gyis mi chog slob pa'i chos la 'bad dgos/ de la'ang dgag bya dang*/

bsgrub bya/ cha mthun bcas gsum gsum yod pa las/ dang po sangs rgyas la skyabs su song na/ 'jig rten pa'i lhar skyabs su mi 'dzin/ chos la skyabs su song na/ sems can la 'tshe ba spangs/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song na/ grogs mu stegs pa dang lta spyod mi bstun/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku rten sāts+tsha chag dum yan la/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag la/ de bzhin du chos dkon mchog gi rten yi ge ras ma yan chod la/ chos dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song na/ dge 'dun gyi na bza' bklubs pa yan/ dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bca'/ phyag mchod dang bkur sti dad gus rgyun mi 'chad par bya/ gsum pa ni/ za 'thung gi skabs su phud dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ rgyun du skyabs 'gro bzla ba la brtson pa dang*/ mdor na srog la bab kyang skyabs 'gro gtong bar mi bya/ de lta bu'i bslab bya rnams dran shes dang ldan pas dus rtag tu slob par gyis shig /ces brjod la phyag gsum 'tshal/ bsngo ba smon lam bgyis la rang gnas su btang ngo*/ skyabs sdom sbyin pa'i cho ga srol rgyun ngag lam du 'jags pa sgo sprul ming pas yig thog tu spel ba'o// // ༈ bla mar brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni/ brtan par gsol ba 'debs pa'i snyan 'bul gyis mtshams sbyar te maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gang ltar yang maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma rgyas par 'bul ba dkyus ltar la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid spyir btang 'bul skabs dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor 'tsho zhing bzhes la/ zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i slad du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du? sogs dang*/ khrid kyi skabs/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po'am spyir btang la

mtshungs med bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas/ theg pa chen po'i bka' chos zab mo zhu ba'i yon du 'am/ gsang sngags kyi skabs su/ rdzogs pa chen po ye shes bla ma'i smin khrid zab mo lta bu'am/ grol byed khrid kyi rim pa zhu ba'i yon du? dang*/ legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du? dbang gi skabs/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du/ sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du? smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon? gtang rag skabs/ legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ sa gzhi? sogs sbyar te maṇ+ḍal phul rjes/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs rim par 'bul zhing*/ sku rten la/ bstan 'gro'i gtsug rgyan rje btsun bla ma la/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan 'di phul bas/ /gang sku bskal pa rgya mtshor 'tsho gzhes pa'i/ /dge mtshan snang ba rtag tu 'bar gyur cig /gsung rten la/ chos kyi dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma la/ /theg mchog bdud rtsi'i glegs bam 'di phul bas/ /gang gsung yan lag drug cu'i sprin chen las/ /zab rgyas dam chos char chen dbab tu gsol/ /thugs rten la/ ye shes mchog brnyes rje btsun bla ma la/ /rgyal ba'i chos sku'i rten mchog 'di phul bas/ /gang thugs stong dang snying rje zung 'jug pa'i/ /gzigs pas bdag sogs 'gro la lhag par dgongs/ /yon tan gyi rten bum pa bcud ldan lta bu la/ yon tan rmad byung rje btsun bla ma la/ /'dod rgu 'jo ba'i bum bzang 'di phul bas/ /bral smin nor bu'i dga' ston mi zad pas/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i re skong mdzad du gsol/ /phrin las ky-i rten sna tshogs rdo rje lta bu la/ phrin las mtha' yas rje btsun bla ma la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'di phul bas/ /gang 'dul phan dang bde ba'i mdzad pa mchog /rtag cing khyab dang lhun gyis grub gyur cig

/ces pa lta bus 'bul zhing*/ gsol 'debs rten 'bul tshan sogs yod na'ang skabs 'dir rim par 'bul/ gang ltar yang 'dun pa rtse gcig pas zhabs brtan rigs 'don/ ༈ bsdu na/ sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /gsung mi 'gag tshangs dbyangs lta bur gsung du gsol/ /thugs mi g.yo ka dag chen por bzhugs su gsol/ bde chen rdo rje'i ngo bor 'tsho gzhes gsol// // ༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs chos skyong yongs rdzogs kyi gtor 'bul nyung ngur bsdus pa phrin las myur mgyogs thogs med bzhugs so/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: rdo rje dpa' bo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: bla ma dang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra kho bo rgya gar mkhas pa yis: yang snying dpa' bo lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi: bsgrub pa'i zab rgya gnad kyi man ngag bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thobs la rin chen gter du sbos: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po bsgrub pa'i bca' gzhi lag len ni: nyams dga' dben pa'i gnas su cha rkyen bsags: 'bru tshom kha ru bum gdan dkyil 'khor bzhag: de steng rnam rgyal bum pa rdzas kyis bkang : kha rgyan mgul chings la sogs gzhung bzhin bsham: tshogs dang mchod rdzas spyan gzigs gang 'dzoms bkram: bgegs bskrad bya zhing srung 'khor bsgoms nas su: mchod rdzas dmigs par byin brlabs dal du 'jug: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs 'gro ni: na mo: gdod nas lhun grub gnyug ma'i rtsa ba gsum: kun tu rang sems ma g.yos skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das mnyam yang phyogs lhung bye brag gnad: legs par rtogs pa'i de bzhin sems bskyed do: gsum pa mchod pa byin brlab ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ lan gsum/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: om̐ ma hā ga lak+ṣa pañca a mṛ ta om̐ āḥhūm̐:

zhes bum pa byin gyis brlabs: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes phyi mchod byin gyis brlabs: sman raka gtor gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes rim bzhin lan gsum gyis sbyangs: de nas skad cig dran rdzogs su: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid gzhal yas khang : e las rab 'jigs pho brang 'bar ba'i dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi chos 'byung ti ra'i dbus: rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag rngam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur bu bsnams: sgro gshogs brgyangs shing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis dam sri ru tra mnan: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gsang ye pang du 'khyud: gri thod mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: rus pa'i rgyan ldan bde chen rgyas par bsgom: yab yum sku la 'jigs byed me dpung 'khrigs: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dpa' bor gsal: hūm̐: dam tshig sems pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: yang dag ye shes dpal chen lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis med bstim: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlabs brtan par bzhugs: dug lnga rnam dag phyi nang mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a be sha ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe? shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter:

bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: bzlas pa'i phrin las bcol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la yāḥsarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ brgya stong khri 'bum gang thon bzlas: ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: stobs ldan phur pa nag po'i hūm̐ sgrub bzhugs: dpal chen he ru ka la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma rtsal chen stobs 'byin pa: yang phur nag po'i sgrub pa 'di: kun gyis thun mong ma yin zab: khyad par ban bon sngags pa dang : lha srin 'byung po gdug can gyis: bar chod 'tshe ba ldang gyur na: de tshe 'di nyid shin tu gces: spros med sgrub pa khyad mchog go: sa ma ya: dang po dran rdzogs lha bskyed ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: kham nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: khro gtum tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: g.yas gnyis gnam lcags rdo rje yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i ban bon 'joms: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ gyis: sde brgyad 'byung po'i srog snying phral: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa yis: rgyal bsen 'gong po rdul du rlog: sgro gshog spu gri brgyangs pa yis: snang srid kun gyi cho 'phrul zlog: 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chas brgyad kyis: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gyis: dam sri 'dre rgod snying khrag rol: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham gyis: stong khams ru tra'i srog dbugs phral: sku la me dpung 'khrigs pa yis: log 'dren bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs bsreg: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: khro rgyal stobs ldan kī la ya: bdud 'dul dpal gyi sku ru shar: dbang sdud zil gnon lhun gyis grub: bdud dgra tshar gcod las grub gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: grags stong ngang du ci nus bzlas: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las:

yang zab snying gi sgrub thabs bzhag: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma ru: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs nas sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las legs par bshus pa'o/ /yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzlas: de nas dbang blang ba ni: hūm̐: gdod nas lhan skyes rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: lnga ldan ye shes byin rlabs nus mthu yis: skal ldan bdag la dbang bskur rgyud smin te: mchog thun 'bras bu yongs rdzogs dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra ku mā ra baṃ ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dbang bzhi blangs shing dmigs pa'i spro bsdu ngang nas rang la bstim: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i yang snying dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi: man ngag gdams pa snying gi thig le bzhag: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so: sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ rgyal ba kun 'dus khyab bdag rol pa las/ chos skyong drag po sde lnga'i gsol mchod nyung bsdus bzhugs so/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ byad ma'i yar rtse rang byung snod mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas bstan dgra dkon mchog sku yi dgra/ /rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe/ /zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha ri khrag gi mtsho/ /rnam pa tsit+ta'i dpal bshos sha khrag brgyan/ /ngo bo bdud rtsi ro brgya lha yi zas/ /mchod rdzas bskang rdzas rten cing bskul ba'i rdzas/ /dam can rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i yo byad spel/ ha ho hrīḥ bh+yo/ dpal ldan ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ /'dod khams dbang phyug tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo yum/

/ma ning gdong bzhi phyag drug bram ze'i gzugs/ /yab yum sprul pa 'khor tshogs bcas pa la/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /las mgon zhing skyong bdud mo seng gdong yum/ /sprul pa bam gzugs spre'u gdong can gnyis/ /lha btsan klu mo dge bsnyen bdud dang gza'/ /dgra lha dam can la sogs sprul 'khor bcas/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /drang srong khyab 'jug khrag mig klu mo yum/ /nyi ma mig dmar phur bu sgra gcan dang*/ /spen pa pa sangs zla ba lhag pa brgyad/ /gdong mo bzhi dang rgyu skar 'gyu ba bcas/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gnod sbyin chen po btsan rgod me 'od gdong*/ /lha btsan klu btsan brag btsan tshangs pa dkar/ /shel ging gnam sman rol pa sde 'khor bcas/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dkor gyi bdag po srog bdag shel ging che/ /dpe har tshangs pa li byin bhi ha ra/ /dpe nag shing bya dpe dkar gnam lhar bcas/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dbyings phyug 'dod khams gtso mo dud sol ma/ /rje dang khol mo ming brgya mtshan ni stong*/ /bal lam dril sna gzer 'debs si le ma/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ khyad par srung ma klu bdud rdo rje rgyal/ /smyo kha mkhar nag ti pa zur phud can/ /zu ra rwa skyes bdud po zla ba'i gdong*/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang lha brgyad klu brgyad gnod sbyin brgyad/ /'bar ma pho nya drug cu 'jigs byed dgu/

/dpal mgon bdun cu brtan skyong ya ma bcas/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ phyi nang lha srin rje yi mgul lha dang*/ /srid pa'i lha dgu 'go ba'i lha lnga bcas/ /sa yul 'dir gnas yul lha mthu chen kun/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /da lo deng zhag dus tshes gza' dang skar/ /spar sme lo skor phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /snang srid brtan g.yo'i dregs sde thams cad la/ /mnyes pa'i dam rdzas dgra sha khrag mchod 'bul/ /bzhes nas sngags bstan rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ de ltar dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag snga 'gyur bstan/ /dpal ldan rnying ma'i chos srid nyin mo'i mgon/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu khyab par mdzod/ khyad par pad+ma'i dgongs bcud zab mo'i gter/ /gnubs lo'i skyes sprul gar dbang rtsa gsum gling*/ /gang des zab chos nya rgyas zla gsal mdzod/ /der 'dzin byed pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams/ /zhabs pad gdong lnga'i khri la bskal brgyar brtan/ /phrin las phyogs mthar khyab cing rgyas par mdzod/ /rig grol 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dam pa kun/ /bslab pa gsum gyi khri la rab tu gnas/ /bshad sgrub snying po gegs med mthar phyin mdzod/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag tu/ /sgang drug khyon 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /lo legs phyugs rnams 'phel ba nyid du mdzod/ /dad pa'i nor ldan sbyin bdag pho mo kun/ /tshe dpal longs spyod yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /bsod nams rnam dkar 'bum las phyug par mdzod/ /spyi dang bye brag bdag cag dpon slob 'khor/ /nor rdzas dngos por bcom 'phrog dgra dang bgegs/ /byad ma'i tshogs kun skad cig sgrol bar mdzod/ /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi/

/phrin las sna tshogs yid la gang rtsom pa/ /thogs med skad cig nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ ces drag po sde lnga'i yang snying bsdus pa phrin las myur mgyogs 'di/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'o// // ༈ hūm̐: khyad par srung ma dam tshig can: ye shes mgon po sde lnga dang : dbyings phyug lha mo re ma ti: legs ldan zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : drang srong gza' mchog rā hu la: gnod sbyin btsan rgod me 'od gdong : dkor bdag rgyal po dpe ha ra: klu yi dge bsnyen myur mgyogs can: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba sogs: dregs sde chos skyong mthu chen rnams: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: la chu 'phrang las sgrol 'don mdzod: ka cha dkor nor phyir la rgyugs: dgra rkun jag chom dbang po snubs: sngags 'chang bdag la dgra byung na: srung ma dam can ra mdar sbran: pha rol dgra bo rdul du rlog: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum rnams: rnal 'byor bdag gi dbang du sdus: ka cha dkor nor gnyer kha skyongs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma'o// // ༈ sku gsum dgongs 'dus las bka' srung ma mgon gsol bsdus ni/ gser skyems sogs gtor rdzas gang 'byor bsham/ 'bru gsum byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ 'og min gnas mchog phyogs bcu dag pa'i zhing : khyad par rdo rje he ru ka yi gnas: gnas yul dur khrod brgyad sogs gar bzhugs nas: ma mgon lcam dral 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs: thugs dam dbang gis sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: bstan pa bsrung phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: he ru ka dang brgyud gsum bla ma yi: dam las ma 'da' dgyes bzhugs phrin las mdzod: dngos su 'byor bsham yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: thun mong nyer spyod thun min dam tshig rdzas: rab 'byams nam mkha'i mdzod kyis dgyes pa skong :

phrin las rnam bzhis bstan pa srung ba dang : sgrub pa po la ma yengs bu bzhin du: byang chub snying po'i bar du srung skyob mdzod: de ltar bskang zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis: dus mtha' ma mo 'khrugs pa sor chud nas: phyi nas 'byung 'khrugs dbyings su cha snyoms te: snod bcud 'jig rten dge legs 'phel ba dang : ma mo'i dal yams mtshon gyi mu ge sogs: 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag dbyings su zlog: mthun rkyen 'bad med yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin: gong nas gong 'phel sangs rgyas bstan pa yi: snying po zab gsang 'od gsal rdzogs pa che: bstan dang bstan 'dzin chos srid sde dang bcas: dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas pa dang : byang chub bar du 'bral med bu bzhin skyongs: thugs dam ma g.yel srung zhing skyong bar mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes pa'ang las can chos kyi bdag po gu h+ya mtshan can gyi bzhed skong du kā ma la rā dzas gter gzhung gi bcud bsdus te sbyar ba'o// // ༈ ma gza' dam gsum gsol bsdus ni/ mchod gtor 'bru gsum byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dbyings kyi rgyal mo e ka tsa: khyab brdal chen po rā hu la: dbyer med badz+ra sa dhū rtsal: rig rtsal rgyud gsum srung ma'i sde: 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho dbyings nas gshegs: sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes: rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med sgrubs: rang bzhin a ti'i rnal 'byor gyi: glo bur rnam rtog dri ma sol: snang ba bzhi yi gdengs chen spor: sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon 'gyur mdzod: gter kha 'og ma pad+ma rgyal po'i gter gzhung las gter ston nyid kyis khol du phyung ba'o// // ༈ lha mo'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa ni/ bh+yoḥ 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma ti: 'dod rgu bsgyur ba'i dbyings phyug dpal 'bar ma: 'dod yon rnam lnga'i gser skyems 'di bzhes la: 'dod don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod:

rtsa gsum gling pas so/ gter srung las kyi ma mo'i mchod thabs bzhugs so/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung rig pa'i dbyings klong dbus: dur khrod tshogs khang ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas: ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: zab gsang ye shes bgyes pas gnas 'dir bzhugs: dam rdzas mchod gtor gser skyems gnyan po bzhes: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: ma yengs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: gter gzhung las so// // ༈ zhing skyong gsol bsdus ni/ hūm̐/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul rnams kun gyi bdag /nye ba'i 'thung spyod dpal gyi tsā ri ṭa/ /rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas/ /gā ya dha ra'i zhabs la gser skyems 'bul/ rtsa gsum gling pas so// // ༈ dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las: khyab 'jug gtor 'bul byad ma rtsad brlag bzhugs so: rdo rje gtum po rab tu 'bar ba la gus pas 'dud: de yang thun gtor 'bul ba ni: lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod gang du: dpal gtor g.yas gcus 'khor gsum la: dmar brgyan bcas pas spras nas su: hūm̐ dzaḥ bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas: mngon spyod las mdzad ki kang mi bsrun pa: khyab 'jug chen po 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: dug khrag nag po ngad ldan rlabs su 'phyur: dmar chen gtor ma bcud ldan ri ltar brjid: dgra bgegs don snying nang rol dbang po'i tshogs: drang srong ki kang rgyal po'i zhal du 'bul: sde brgyad stong rtsa brgyad kyi zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs cham la phob: gsang sngags gnyan la gdug pa'i dgra dar na: mthu ldan chos skyong khyed kyis sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ hrīḥrā hu la ki kang hrīḥshag ru raṃ dgra bgegs kyi bla srog la kha raṃ khā hi: rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter ma'o: ༈ btsan gsol bsdus pa ni/ btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad 'khor dang bcas/

/'dir gshegs mchod sprin sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs/ /sbyor sgrol bla med spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul srid pa'i 'dod yon rnams/ /thugs dam bskang phyir gnyis med bzhes nas kyang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas/ /tshe dpal nyams rtogs 'gro don phrin las spel/ /'gal rkyen bar chad bdud kyi g.yul ngo zlog /snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus/ /kun kyang theg chen chos la 'god pa dang*/ /yul 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod kun zhi zhing*/ /mi nor dge bcu yon tan gong 'phel nas/ /bla med bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces thugs mchog rdo rjes sbyar/ rgyal gsol bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐/ slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa/ /dregs sde yongs kyi gtso bo ni/ /shel ging gnod sbyin dpe ha ra/ /dkar smug srog bdag dgra bo'i gshed/ /mi bsrun dregs pa yang 'khor bcas/ /tha tshig bzhin du phrin las mdzod/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhing bcu'i bstan dgra phye mar shigs/ /mngon spyod rtags bzhin phrin las mdzod/ om̐ ru she la ging ka ra ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ rtsa gsum gling pas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gze rgyal gsol mchod bsdus pa ni/ hrīḥ gnas mchog dag pa shel gyi gzhal yas nas/ /rdo rje mched gsum brtse bas bdag la dgongs/ /gtor ma gser skyems 'bru sna'i mchod pa bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mi nor yul 'khor bcas/ /lha mchog khyed la srung skyob gnyer kha gtad/ /nyin mtshan dus kun bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ bstan 'dzin pad+ma phrin las kyis mdzad pa'o// // ༈ thang lha ni/ kye/ sa brgyad sems dpa' yul lha'i tshul 'dzin pa/ stong gsum mi mjed bdag po tshangs pa che/ bka' gnyan thang lha dgyes yum bka' 'khor bcas/ gsol lo mchod do 'dod rgu lhun 'grub mdzod// // ༈ ge sar gsol mchod ni/

kye/ sangs rgyas mi gzugs byon pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /mthu rtsal stobs ldan hor bdud cham la phab/ /'dre srin dam btags bod khams bde la bkod/ /dbu nag dgra lha skyes bu don 'grub la/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul pho lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /gzhi la bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /byes su gang bsam sgrubs la bar chad sol/ /bstan pa'i mnga' thang phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig/ rig 'dzin bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ ban thung gsol mchod ni/ hūm̐/ badz+ra gu ru rdo rje gro bo lod/ /bka' nyan ye shes mgon po stag la chibs/ /de bsgrub dgra lha 'brong pa ban thung ni/ /pha mes rgyud nas srung skyob 'bral med mdzod/ /'brong pas mchod na mgon pa'i lha srung rnams/ /dam tshig brtse gdung gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gser skyems gtor ma 'bul ba bzhes su gsol/ /'gro 'dug dus su bsu skyel 'bral med mdzod/ i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi/ bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ dge bsnyen gsol mchod bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐/ pad+ma'i bka' nyan rdo rje dbang grags rtsal/ /chu chen dbang sgyur nya gdong sbu ba can/ /klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong dang bcas/ /thogs med 'dir gshegs gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag mi nor bar chad chag sgo zlog /tshe dpal bsod nams longs spyod dngos grub stsol/ /'gro 'dug dus su bsu skyel sdong grogs mdzod/ /bcol ba'i phrin las g.yar dam brtan gyur cig /bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ skrag dbyi gtor 'bul ni/ kyai/ /dge bsnyen skrag btsan mched 'khor dang*/ /sman btsun la sogs skya dgu dang*/ /ya mar btsan gyi tshogs bcas gshegs/ /dkar gtor bshos bu spyan gzigs dang*/ /gser skyems bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /las dang bya ba gang bzhin sgrubs/ /'dzam gling dbyi shod ri bo che/ /dmag dpon dbyi rgyal mched 'khor sogs/ /mtsho bkra la sogs nang blon mched/

/a mgon mi thung blon 'khor gyis/ /bshos ldan spyan gzigs bkra shis rdzas/ /'bru bcud gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /bdag la rogs ldan sgrub pa dang*/ /rtag tu mi 'bral bstan pa skyongs/ /gang bcol phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ yul lha mchod thabs ni: kyaiḥ sa yul 'di la gnas pa yi: lha gnyan klu gnyan btsan gnyan dang : yul lha gnyan dang nags tshal gnyan: yul lha mthu chen bzhugs pa kun: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snga ma legs pa'i gtang rag yin: phyi ma legs pa'i zhu skyems 'bul: da yang las kyi zhu 'bul ni: bzhes nas 'dod don sgrub tu gsol: nyang gi gter ma'o// // na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /bka' srung rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /gzhi bdag rnams la 'dod yon sogs/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa/ thogs pa med par 'byung bar shog /phrin las bcol ba ni/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' sdod dam tshig can/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung dbang po khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde/ /'phel rgyas yun du gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams/ /zhabs pad brtan cing zab chos gong du 'phel/ /'gro kun smin grol bde la 'god pa dang*/ /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /bye brag rgyal bstan rtsa lag snga 'gyur bstan/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa kun/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar rgyas yun du gnas/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /sngags 'chang sgrub po gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /rigs dang chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i bu/ /zab chos nyams su len pa'i 'dus pa rnams/

/yon 'byor 'khor 'bangs kun tu dar rgyas mdzod/ /yang zab zab mo'i ring lugs snying po'i bstan/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar rgyas shing*/ /srid mthar bstan cing smin grol 'bras bu thob/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /yul ris rgyal khams sa phyogs thams cad du/ /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /'bru rnams bcud smin btsa' than sad ser zhi/ /nad mug dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba dang*/ /bu nor 'khor 'bangs mnga' ris rgyas par mdzod/ khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum gyi/ /skye 'gro'i snang ba dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung rgya 'dre 'gong po dang*/ /dam sri bdud rigs brlag dang bzlog par mdzod/ /ma rungs sems 'chang zhing bcu ldan pa yi/ /dgra bo phyi nang phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang*/ /ring bar khug la rngam pa'i stobs kyis sod/ /sha khrag lhag med rol la bstab par bzhes/ /mdor na o rgyan chen po'i spyan sngar ru/ /dam bca' bzhin du bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ /dam las ma 'da' brgyud 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs/ /'gro ba bde skyid dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces phrin bcol 'di nyid 7 rje btsun rin po che lo hā badz+ra gyi zhal slob phyogs med dā ri dra ma dā ya pas bris smon bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa yi/ /srung ma yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ 'gro mgon phag mo grub pas so// // ༈ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sa steng yongs la khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod/

/gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad mtshon mu ge dang*/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags shing*/ /gsang chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*/ /'gro kun bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas/ /gzhi byes lam sogs gang du gnas gyur kyang*/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs gyur nas/ /ma yengs bsrung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod// // ༈ dung dung snying nas mi brjed gsol btab tshe/ yang yang mchod cing bstod pa'i bdag sogs kun/ 'jigs 'jigs bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal zhing*/ 'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas dngos grub stsol/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang*/ sgrub brgyud yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ mdo sngags kun gyi gtsug rgyan pad 'byung rje/ dbyer med o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur cig/ // om̐/ mthun pa'i dngos grub 'dod rgu'i yid bzhin nor/ /deng 'dir sgrub la stsol zhing byin brlabs nas/ /yid smon rgyas par gyur cig srung ma'i tshogs/ /'gro kun sa bcu'i rtse mor rab gnas shog /gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ om̐/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: sngon tshe o rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la/ /ma yis bu ltar skyong bar zhal bzhes pa/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/

/lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi/ nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma snyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ zhes dang yi ge brgya pas nongs pa 'chags/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wā nāṃ/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje gzhon nu sogs/ smon lam rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang gsol kha rgyas pa ma lcogs par bdag 'dra le lo can dag la phan phyir spros med nyer mkhor dmigs te gnam lcags gsang sngags ming 'dzin gyis sbyar ba'o// //

༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs rgyun gsol phyogs bsdus cung zad 'bring po'i lugs su bkod pa phrin las mkha' khyab rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa yis: lhun grub phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin dang : rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: phrin las brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī sing*/ /pad+ma kā ra rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /so zur gnubs gnyags gter ston brgya rtsa brgyad/ /dus gsum rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /ngo bo gcig bsdus o rgyan rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /chos skyong bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /'bar ba'i cho 'phrul gar gyi rol pa yis/ /rnam 'phrul du mas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*/ /ma mgon lcam dral dam pa'i chos skyong rnams/ /ngo bo gcig bsdus o rgyan rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /chos skyong bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /phyi nang bar chad bdud sde'i g.yul ngo las/ /rnam rgyal dpa' bo khrag 'thung he ru ka'i/ go 'phang dam pa tshe 'dir thob gyur cig /ces ka ma rā dza dī pas yig rnying las kha bsgyur te bris pa dge/ // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi

/rgyun khyer snying po rab gsal ces bya ba bzhugs/ bla ma dang yang dag kī la ya gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo: sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su len par 'dod pa'i dang po sbyor ba spros bcas las byang rgyas 'bring ltar las/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su/ mdun bskyed bshams bkod sogs spros pa med kyang : phyi nang mchod tshogs spyi ltar bshams kyang tshogs rdzogs phyir ci 'byor bshams la/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal chen yang dag rdo rje phur bu gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs sad par bsams la thal sbyar bcas/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ lan gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam mo: gnyis pa dngos gzhi gter gzhung ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: oṃ ma hā ga lak+ṣa pañca a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes dang gsum pa byin brlab ni: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ ma hā bha liṃ ta te dz+wa ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha:

zhes rim bzhin lan gsum gyis sbyangs: de nas skad cig dran rdzogs su: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid gzhal yas khang : e las rab 'jigs pho brang 'bar ba'i dbus: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi chos 'byung ti ra'i dbus: rang nyid dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag rngam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur pa bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis dam sri ru tra mnan: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gsang ye pang du 'khyud: gri thod mgul 'khyud zhabs gnyis sked la 'khril: rus pa'i rgyan ldan bde chen rgyas par bsgom: yab yum sku la 'jigs byed me dpung 'khrigs: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dpa' bor gsal: zhes dang yang phur sbrags ma ltar na: dpal chen thugs kar tsit+ta ni: mthing nag zur brgyad lte ba ru: yang dag don gyi ye shes sems/ he ru ka dpal bde ba che: sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor: nyag gcig zhal dang thabs shes phyag: zung 'jug bde chen dbyings phyug sbyor: dur khrod dpal gyi chas kun rdzogs: rdo rje rtse lnga dung khrag bsnams: snang stong shin tu phra ba'i sku: tsit+ta zur brgyad gau ri brgyad: bde stong sku ni yungs 'bru tsam: de yi thugs kar ye shes sems: rdor sems dkar gsal longs sku'i chas: rdo rje dril bsnams phyed skyil bzhugs: tshon gang 'od kyi phung po ni: rin chen zur brgyad dbus na bzhugs: kun gyi spyi mgrin thugs ka ru: oṃ dkar a dmar hūm̐ mthing kaḥ bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus pa'i: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gyur: zhes dang*/ hūm̐: dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: yang dag ye shes dpal chen lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis med bstim: bdag la dbang bskur byin rlabs brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan: a be sha ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

dug lnga rnam dag phyi nang mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: ces mchod cing bstod/ de yi thugs kar tsit+ta ni: mthing smug mchong gi gur ltar mdzes: lte bar nyi steng rdo rje ni: rtse dgu nas kyi 'bru tsam sgreng : rdo rje'i lte ba hūm̐ mthing 'bar: mtha' bskor khrag 'thung snying po las: sngags phreng mtshams su gsung rdo rje: rta mgrin dmar pos bar chad srung : 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas: dpal chen gsang gsum gnyis med gyur: ces dmigs pa'i don yid la gzhol nas: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la yaḥsarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ phur pa/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang dag go /yang phur sbrags mar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bsnyen pa'i 'gros ltar bsnyen sgrub chig dril gyi dgongs pa dang : las sbyor gyi khyad par gter gzhung ltar bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā rid+dhi sarba badz+ra bh+rūm̐: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: zhes srung dmigs dang srung sngags ci nus mthar/

bsad pa'i dmigs pa ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dpal chen khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags spu gri'i 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor: bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtub: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra ma tri ya sho ṇi tri rak+mo hu lu shag rbad bh+yo bh+yo thun thun ta tri byad ma myog thum dza raṃ dza nan: zhes bsad sngags dang*/ zlog dmigs ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru kaḥ grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la log: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: oṃ e ka ya ma du ri sha li ṭa: nā ga ya ma kha dun rak+sha rbad: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma ya tu zlog: myog ti mā ra ya zlog zlog: tsi tri ru tri mā ra ya zlog zlog: ha la ka la byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbod gtong phur kha thams cad zlog zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha dang snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul thams cad dgra la zlog zlog: ces zlog sngags dmigs rim bcas dkyus ltar byas la gzhi bsnyen skabs bsnyen sgrub chig dril bcu cha tsam mam/ rgyun khyer skabs srung sngags bdun dang*/ 'og ma gnyis gsum re'i dmigs pa bcas sbyar ba shin tu zab par snang ngo*/ /mthar bdag bskyed nyer bsdu ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis lhar snang dbyings su bsdus pas rtag mtha' bral/ a a āḥs mnyam par bzhag /phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis lhar ldang gsang ba gsum gyis chad mtha' spang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje gzhon nu sogs/ smon lam rgyas gdab// // gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ thun bar gtor 'bul bya bar 'dod na/ gtor rdzas bdud rtsis bran/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ bdag nyid dpal chen thugs las spros pa yi/ /yaṃ raṃ keṃ las rlung me thod sgyed steng*/ /a las bhan+dha chos dbyings mnyam pa'i nang*/

/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyor steng gi mkhar/ /'bru gsum gnas pa'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med pa'i/ /'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs byin gyis brlabs la/ mgron bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla med byang chub sgrub pa por/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud 'dul ba'i/ /lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu dang*/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho bcas/ /chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥs spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ dngos 'byor yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i/ phyi mchod 'dod yon rgya mtsho dang*/ khyad par sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor los mchod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta pū dza khā hi/ sogs sman raka dang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ri i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ ho/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po badz+ra ku mā ra phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dam can srung ma dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/ sems can gyi phan bde spel/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sdong grogs mdzod/ sngags 'chang rnams kyi phrin las sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ khyad par dam tshig 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig

/ces 'dod don gsol/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i klong*/ /yang dag thugs mchog badz+ra he ru kaḥ /chos kyi dbyings su gnyis med sbyor ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod la/ hūm̐/ khyad par phrin las glog ltar myur ba yi/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis/ /gnyis med sprul pa sras mchog khro bcu'i sprin/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad phur srung bcu drug dang*/ /'bar ba'i pho nya gnod sbyin me 'od gdong*/ /btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad la sogs pa/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /rang bzhin dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la/ /dam tshig dbang gis sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byon/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs nas kyang*/ /sngon tshe he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du/ /sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cig sa ma ya/ /phyi nang gsang mchod spyan gzigs 'dod yon tshogs/ thugs kyis gang bzhed de ltar shar ba'i mchod/ /rig dang ma rig 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags/ /gnas skabs bla med byang chub sgrub pa la/ /bar chad kun sel phrin las rab 'byams sgrubs/ /mthar thug bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /ma yi bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin/ /las kyi 'bras bu ma lus mchis par mdzod/ ces 'dod don gsol zhing chos skyong gsol kha gzhan rnams kyang 'dir 'dzud/ spro bar mos na gsham gsal tshogs mchod kyang sbyar la mchod bstod gshegs/ mthar yig rgyas nongs pa bshags shing*/ mgron thabs ye shes pa brtan par bzhugs sam dbyings su gshegs/ 'jig rten pa badz+ra muḥs rang gnas su gshegs shing rjes kyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang zab chos 'di nyid kyi brgyud 'dzin/ sgo chen rgyal sprul gsang sngags bstan 'dzin mchog nas/ lha rdzas rin po che rgyal srid grangs ldan gyi skyes bcas bskul ngor/ gter gzhung rgyun khyer sor bzhag la/
