cung zad 'jug bde'i ched du/ dil mkhyen rin po che'i gnyags phur rgyun khyer dang*/ thog mtha'i ngag 'don kha skong bcas dkyus gcig tu bsdebs pa 'di'ang*/ gter chen nyid kyis byin brlabs kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa ka ma rā dza dī pas sbyar bas 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs mchod ni/ skabs 'gar tshogs mchod sogs cung zad spros par 'dod na/ tshogs rdzas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /pho bdud dregs pa brdzis pa'i gdan steng du/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dpa' bo'i sku/ /bdud 'dul khro bcu khra thabs 'khor gyis bskor/ /rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /dbang dang dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol/ /'dod yon zad med tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /thugs dam gnyan po chos kyi dbyings su bskang*/ /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul nongs pa dbyings su bshags/ /ma rungs zhing bcu'i ru tra zhal du sbyor/ /de ltar tshogs mchod bskangs bshags phul ba'i mthus/ /a bhi tsar+ya'i dngos grub deng stsol cig /phung khams skye mched gdan gsum 'khor lo'i lha/ /ye nas dag mnyam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshul/ /srid pa phur bus snang zhen lhar sbyangs pas/ /snang stong sku yi rdo rjer 'grub byin rlobs/ /rdo rje lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le'i sprin/ /byang sems phur bu'i a haṃ 'bar 'dzag gis/ /dga' bzhi'i 'gros thim sa lam dbu mar rdzogs/ /bde stong gsung gi rdo rje 'grub byin rlobs/ /dbyings rig zung 'jug 'od gsal gnyug ma'i gshis/ /sgron drug snang bzhi'i nye lam zla med phul/ /rig pa'i phur bu chos kyi dbyings thebs pas/ /rig stong thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub byin rlobs/ /tshad med snying rjes 'gro khams rgya yis thebs/

/rdzas kyi phur bus dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod/ /sgrol ba gnyis kyi thabs mkhas mdzad phrin gyis/ /don gnyis bsam kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ /ces pa'ang pad+ma bi dzas so// // ༈ tshogs rdzas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐/ rab 'byams rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor sgrub sde brgyad/ khyad par dpal chen phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /'dod yon lnga ldan zag med tshogs mchod 'bul/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag bshags/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol/ /gnyis med bde ba chen por thugs dam bskang*/ /sgrub mchog rnams la dbang bskur byin rlobs la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa'ang khrag 'thung phrin las grub pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge/ // ༈ gtor 'gugs ni/ na mo/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun du gtor snod dug gsum gyi khang sgrom shor med/ 'khor ba'i btson ra rgya khyon gzhal las 'das pa'i dbus su nṛ tri dza kham nag las/ ma rig nyams pa'i dgra gdon mi dge mya ngan gyi nyam gzugs/ lus la rang byas kyi rnam smin nad mtshon gyi dug rlangs 'tshubs pa de yi ro rkyang gi lam rgyud du/ dge sdig lha bdud dug sbrul dkar nag gnyis kyis khong khrag 'jib pa/ snying khar srog 'dzin gyi ngo bo nyon mongs khrag gi lbu ba de la/ chos nyid rnam dag gi 'khor lo la shes rab rig pa'i rno ngar dang ldan pas/ dgra bgegs kyi sgo gsum dbang lnga don snying thams cad gtubs par gsal lo/ /na mo/ byin rlabs nus pa'i bdag nyid/ grub dbang rtsa brgyud bla ma/ dbyings nas bden rtags rdzogs pa/ rab 'byams yi dam rgya mtsho/ ye shes rdo rje lus can/ khyab bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas/ brten yul rtsad nas 'gugs mdzad/ zhing sngags ma dang mkha' 'gro/ myur mgyogs las la shar ba'i/ bstan srung dregs pa'i sde tshogs/

thugs rje khros pa'i dpung chen/ ting 'dzin lha sngags phyag rgyas dmigs pa'i yul du mchis pa'i/ sdang dgra gnod byed byad ma thams cad/ rgyu 'bras las kyi pho nya/ stong gsum gang ba'i rdul dang mnyam pas/ 'gugs byed snying rje'i lcags kyus zungs la/ 'od gsal stong nyid zhags pas bsdams te/ lha srung rdo rje'i ra gur steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang du mchis kyang*/ dmar chen thun gyi gtor ma/ dmar nag khrag gi lbu ba 'di la khug cig nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥ bdag mdun thugs las reg chod rno ngar gyi/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug char sprin gtibs/ /byad ma lha dang dngos po ma lus pa'i/ /lus la phog pas khrag rlung rdul phran gyur/ /tshe bsod rlung sems nṛ yig rang la thim/ /a yig khrus byas bde stong rnam shes de/ /chos dbyings bde chen lam nas lha la thim/ /sha ri khrag mtsho rus pa gram ltar spung*/ /stong gsum khyon gang dam ldan dpa' bo'i zas/ /dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas ro mchog stong ldan pa/ /ka dag chos dbyings ye rdzogs zas su gyur/ ār+ya dh+wa dzas so// // ༈ bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor bsdus bzhugs so: bla ma dang mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis: ye shes mgon po'i gsol mchod bstan: sangs rgyas ye shes legs par zungs: brda gzugs rin chen gter du sbos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: mgon po'i gsol mchod rim pa ni : bhan+dha rgyan bzang gtor ma bsham: sman raka phud kyis legs par bran: dang po mchod pa byin brlab ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: hoḥ gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa: ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ ha ho hrī phaiṃ phaiṃ: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rang gi thugs ka nas ting 'dzin rol pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas:

shar lho bsil ba tshal nas dur khrod shing tsan dan rkang gcig pa'i drung nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣeṃ k+ṣe ṭa bigh+nān bi na ya ka baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bh+yo ma tri ka li tsaṇ+ḍa lī ku ru kul+le hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: oṃ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ hoḥ mgon po'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya bh+yo ma tri ka li hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes pas gtor ma legs par bsngo: gsum pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: che btsan dbang phyug ma hā kā la ya: mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal gsum rab tu 'khros: rigs bdag mi bskyod gtsug rgyan cod pan 'phur: dpral bar dam tshig sin+dhu ra yis byugs: 'bar ba'i gri gug thod khrag cang te'u g.yas: bhan dmar rtse gsum dgra 'ching zhags pa g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: glang po'i gdong can lha chen pho mo brdzis: k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ sgra sgrogs me dpung klong du bzhugs: tsan dan la gnas nag po phyag drug pa: sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong ba'i dpal chen po: yid bzhin nor bu mgon po khyod la bstod: hūm̐: sbyor ba'i yum mchog sngags bdag dpal 'bar ma: dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum pa mo: gri khug mgul 'khyud thod khrag yab la stob: dur khrod chas ldan ma sring pho nya 'gyed: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril: dbyings phyug lha mo 'dod rgu mchod sbyin ma: lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzhi pa gtor 'bul ni: hūm̐: legs ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ya: yum mchog sngags bdag 'dod khams dbyings phyug ma: nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor:

bstan srung mthu chen dbang phyu+ug khyed rnams kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub mchog bdag gi bka' nyon bu bzhin skyongs: ma rungs 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la k+ṣeṃ k+ṣe ṭa pā la bigh+nān bi na ya ka baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bh+yo tri ka li tsaṇ+ḍa lī ku ru ku lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: 'di nyid bstan srung kun gyi mchog: slob dpon shān+tiṃ ghar+bha ni: bsil ba tshal du bzhugs pa'i tshe: mgon pos dngos su zhal gzigs nas: tsan dan shing la thim pa yi: dur khrod shing rkang gcig ces pa'i: tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i mgon po ni: nags 'dabs ma hā kā lar grags: spyir na che btsan 'gran zla bral: ye shes mgon po nor gyi bdag: bsgrubs pas 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: pha rol dgra bgegs dmod pas brlag: de bas mthu rtsal rmad byung 'di: dam du bzung la legs par bsten: kun gyi thun mong ma yin rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs pa'o: sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ chos skyong kun 'dus gtor 'bul ni: hūm̐: dur khrod rngam chen me rlung 'tshubs pa'i klong : thod mkhar dmar nag pho brang so so'i dbus: bstan pa'i bka' srung las mdzad mi bsrun pa: legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi phyag drug pa: ma ning dang ni gdong bzhi bram gzugs can: las mgon seng gdong srog bdag bya rog gdong : gri gug bing chen dmar nag trag shad dang : gur mgon a gho ra dang stag zhon pa: ber nag can dang seng zhon mdung thung can: khyad par gza' brgyad ki kang rā hu la: e ka dzā ṭi dud sol re ma ti: tshe ring mched lnga a phyi chos sgron dang : srog bdag ma mo dam can rdo rje legs: btsan rgod khrag 'thung shan pa mdung dmar can:

drag po dge bsnyen klu dang bdud kyi rje: ging chen pho mo sha za bye ba 'bum: rgyal chen dpe dkar la sogs gter srung dang : sde dpon sum cu dregs byed yang 'khor la: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang : sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag la bu bzhin skyongs : snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: skye 'gro 'jig rten pho mo'i snying bsgul la: zas nor longs spyod gnas 'dir char bzhin phob: snyan grags mnga' thang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang : bdag la sdang zhing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: ces bka' brgyad nas khol du phyung ba'o: rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus kyi gsol bsdus bzhugs so/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i klong yangs nas/ /rtsa gsum rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa/ /rig 'dzin gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus bstan srung zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong dgongs 'dus yid bzhin nor bu'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor bcas spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshal/ /mchod sprin tshogs bzhes thugs dam bskang gsol bstod/ /las bzhi lhun grub mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus bka' srung dam tshig can/ /skal ldan rjes 'jug bdag gi srung mar mdzod/ /chos skyong bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs/ nyag bla 'ja' lus pa pad+ma bdud 'dul gyi bka' 'bum nas phyung ba'o// // ༈ na mo pad+ma kā ra ye/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bka'i srung ma/ sde lnga'i rgyun gsol skong bsdus grangs gsog la mchod gtor spyan gzigs rgyas par bshams shing*/ ar+ghaṃ dkar sngon zas sna sman phud ci 'byor ba bkram la/ na maḥ sarba ta thā?nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlabs la rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ kyai/ dgongs shig dam can srung ma rnams/

/dam las ma 'da' da tshur byon/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can/ /dam la gnas shing lha la 'khreng*/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'og min gnas mchog dam pa dang*/ /gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang*/ /dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ /zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong pa can/ /gza' brgyad gdong mo mched de bzhi/ /btsan rgod shan pa mi zan dang*/ /chos skyong ging gi rgyal po che/ /gzhan yang gnas gter srung ma rnams/ /ma thogs ma thogs myur du gshegs/ /sngon tshe pad 'byung spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam tshig mi dran nam/ /dam bca'i dus 'di da lags pas/ /'bod pa'i dus su snyan ma sra/ /g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul/ /bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma zhan/ /dam las ma 'da' da tshur byon/ kyai/ do nub snga ma'i gtang rag gtong*/ /do nub phyi ma'i zhu don 'bul/ /do nub las kyi gnyer zhig gtad/ /do nub nyams chag zhig ral gso/ kyai/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi/ /dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog 'bul/ /mi rta glang chen ba glang sha/ khyi sha sha chen sna tshogs dang*/ /gsur chen sbyar ba'i bdug spos 'bul/ /rkang mar zhag dang til mar sbyar/ /ro ras shi skra'i sdong bu mdzes/ /shan pa'i me la sbyar ba'i me/ /mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog pa 'bul/ /dug khrag thang khrom gu gul dang*/ /rgyu khrag la sogs mkhris sna'i chab/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ /'bru nag drag po'i zhal zas rngam/ /dgra bo'i sha khrag zhag dang bcas/ /'bru nag drag po'i zhal zas 'bul/ /thod pa ltag sprod phyag rgya rnga/ /rdza rnga rnga zlum rnga chen sgra/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ /lcang lo bcad pa'i bhan+dha'i nang*/ /'bru bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i dam rdzas 'di/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ /drag po'i snod mchog yangs pa'i nang*/

/dgra bgegs sha khrag klad rus dang*/ /rkang dang nang rol spungs pa 'di/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ /bum ril ka pā la yi nang*/ /byad ma'i snying khrag dug rlangs 'phyur/ /dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ kyai/ gzhan yang thugs dam skong ba ni/ /phyi snod 'jig rten bhan+dha ru/ /nang bcud sems can gtor mar sbyar/ /mthun bsgrub bskang rdzas ma tshang med/ /sman raka btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /rmad byung phyag rgyar sbyor ba'i mchod/ /dmigs med mtha' bral lta bas bskang*/ /bstan pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snying gi khrag /'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor/ /ru tra'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ /dpal chen sde bzhi las byed bzhi/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mchin khrag dang*/ /dug khrag chang dang nye bar sbyar/ /ma rungs dbang po rnam lnga 'di/ /zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong pa can/ /yab yum baṃ ro pho mo dang*/ /bka' 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad sogs/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i glo ba'i khrag /chang dang dug rigs sbyar ba'i phud/ /bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di/ /gza' mchog yab yum gza' chen brgyad/ /yum sras sprul par bcas pa'i tshogs/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ hūm̐/ ru tra bsgral ba'i mkhal ma'i khrag /chang dang dug rigs sbyar ba'i phud/ /bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di/ /gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po dang*/ /myur mgyogs sde brgyad sprul pa sogs/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i srog gi khrag /chang dang dug rigs sbyar ba'i phud/ /bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di/ /dpe har dgra lha'i rgyal po dang*/ /yum mchog shel ging dregs sde brgyad/ /sprul pa yang sprul la sogs pa'i*/

/dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po'i khrag /chang dang dug rigs sbyar ba'i phud/ /bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di/ dam can gter bdag myur mgyogs tshogs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa'i/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ kyai/ srung ma dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ /phrin las rnam bzhis mnga' gsol lo/ /sman raka gtor mas mnga' gsol lo/ /klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo/ /spyan gzigs dkor chas mnga' gsol lo/ /mthun rdzas du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /mnga' gsol bstod do phrin las mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /ma rungs dgra bgegs cham la phob/ /thugs 'gal dam tshig nyams chag rnams/ /do nub skong zhing bshags par bgyi/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces dang yi ge brgya pa brjod/ ces pa'ang gnam lcags mchog sprul rin po che'i bzhed skong du phrin las byams pa 'byung gnas su 'bod pas bris pa dge shing bkra shis/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ tu sarba dza ya// // ༈ dpal ldan dud sol bsod nams dbang gi rgyal mo'i gtor mchod yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so: dpal ldan dud sol bsod nams dbang gi rgyal mo bsgrub par 'dod na: rin chen snod du mchod pa rgya chen bshams la: rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun du dgos 'dod rin po che sna bdun pho brang gi dbus su: yi ge bh+yo ma yongs su gyur pa las ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma: sku mdog dkar mo mdangs dang ldan pa snang la rang bzhin mngon par ma grub pa gzi brjid 'od dang ldan pa: 'byung ba lnga yi bcud 'dzin pa khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gyur nas: phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa: de'i shar du rdo rje lha mo me long dang tshe bum 'dzin pa: lho ru rin chen lha mo rin po che'i sgrom bu dang tshe bum 'dzin pa: nub tu pad+ma lha mo pad+ma'i steng du sre'u dang tshe bum 'dzin pa:

byang du gnod sbyin lha mo kul+le ma: mi dang phyugs kyi g.yang thams cad bsdus pa: sku mdog ljang mo tshe bum dang ne'u le 'dzin pa: thams cad gzi brjid 'od dang ldan pa legs nyes thams cad sa ler gzigs pa: de'i 'khor du re re la: g.yang gi rgyal mo: dngos grub kyi bdag mo: dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag mo: tshe 'dzin bdag mo: srid pa'i bdag mo: dbang gi bdag mo: srid 'dzin bdag mo: nor gyi bdag mo: zas bcud kyi bdag mo: 'bru yi bdag mo: kha rje thub pa'i bdag mo: dbang thang thub pa'i bdag mo: thams cad kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar du spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: srid pa ye thog rgyal mo srid: bar du srid pa'i rgyal mo byon: tha ma dud sol rgyal mo byon: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: da dus rnal 'byor spyan 'dren no: dus ngan snyigs ma'i bskal ngan la: lha mo byon pa'i gnas ngan kyang : rnal 'byor 'bod sa khyod las med: sems can re ltos khyod las med: dgos 'dod 'byung mkhan khyod las med: dngos grub ster mkhan khyod las med: ci bsam sgrub mkhan khyod las med: log 'dren 'dul mkhan khyod las med: rgyal 'gong 'dul mkhan khyod las med: dam sri 'dul mkhan khyod las med: chos min 'dul mkhan khyod las med: khyod kyi thugs rjes ma bzung na: sngon byon rgyal ba'i bka' yang 'gal: rnal 'byor yi chad mi 'gyur ram: sems can log lta mi 'gyur ram: mchod sbyin chud du mi zos sam: dus ngan bstan bshig mi mtho'am: de bas myur du da tshur byon: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'dzin byed dbang gi lha mo khyod: rin chen pho brang 'dir bzhugs la: srid gsum dbang gi dngos grub stsol: zas nor longs spyod dngos grub stsol: brgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub stsol: ci 'dod phun tshogs dngos grub stsol: dngos grub char ltar 'bebs shing bzhugs:

sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ar+ghaṃ me tog mchod pa 'bul: dri zhim spos ngad mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: su ra chang gi mchod pa 'bul: 'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: bstan bshig bsgral ba'i snying khrag 'bul: srog bcad sha yi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas bla med dngos grub stsol: bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: bzhes nas bla ma'i sku tshe srings: bzhes nas rnal 'byor nyams rtogs spel: bzhes nas sems can bde skyid spel: bzhes nas yon bdag rkyen ngan zhi: dus ngan bstan bshig myur du sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bsnyen dmigs ni: lha mo'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pas bdag la dngos grub ci bsam thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bar bsam mo: rjes su lha mo yang 'byung ba lnga yi bcud du gyur nas bdag la thim pas: bdag kyang gzi brjid bkrag mdangs dang ldan par bsgoms la: zhes bsnyen pa khri stong bzlas: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi hūm̐: gtor ma dang bdud rtsi mchod la 'di skad bsgrag: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sku ni mi 'gyur ri rab lta bur brjid: gsung ni mi 'gags 'gro drug chos skad ston: thugs ni mi 'khrul nyi zla lta bur khyab: yon tan mi 'gyur dngos grub 'byung la bstod: phrin las myur mgyogs dmag zor rgyal mor bstod: bsod nams dbang gi rgyal mo khyod la bstod: 'chi med tshe 'dzin lha mo khyod la bstod: brgyud 'dzin srid 'dzin lha mo khyod la bstod : ma gcig dud sol lha mo khyod la bstod: ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo khyod la bstod: khams gsum gzi brjid zil gnon khyod la bstod: log lta dbang sdud tshar gcod khyod la bstod: gtor ma bran la bdud rtsi mchod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bdag gis khyod la mchod bstod gsol btab mthus: nad med tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

rgas med 'ja' lus dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'bru bcud zas kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub bstsal du gsol: srid gsum zil non dngos grub bstsal du gsol: dag snang chos spyod dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes gtor ma nam mkhar mchod bdud rtsi rang gi srin lag gis myong zhing : dmigs pa ni/ lha mo'i nu ma dang bha ga nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar byung nas: rang gi lus phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dang bcas pa dag nas: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur gyur nas mchog gi dngos grub thob par bsams la: bsnyen pa 'di ci nus bzlas: oṃ ma hā kā la ma ma ā yu sid+dhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ 'di yi dgos ched ni: dus ngan las ngan bstan bshig 'ga' yis ni: rngon ri brgyab dang rku jag las ngan sna tshogs byed pa: de'i skyon gyis ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong ri rab la zhal gzigs: steng nyi zla gza' skar mdangs nyams: bar gza' klu rgyal po 'khrugs: 'og sa bdag klu gnyan 'khrugs: de'i dus skyes chen dam pa rnams sku tshe thung : sa bcud nyams nas 'bru mi 'phel: mu ge sna tshogs 'byung : bsod nams cung zad 'phel kyang rkyen che: longs spyod mi thub rgyud 'dzin sre'u mi sos: bse rag 'byung po rlung ltar 'tshub: mo 'dre lha bab the'u rang rtags rdzun mang : de'i rtags su btsun pas 'dul khrims mi thub/ sngags pas dam tshig mi thub: dpon pos khrims mi thub: phal pas rang tshod mi thub: bud med kyis lus mi thub: sa yis gter dang rdo mi thub: dud 'gros chu rlung mi thub: chos byed kyis chos dang dge sbyong mi thub: de'i skabs su dpal ldan dud sol rgyal mo'am: dbang gi rgyal mo'am: srid pa'i rgyal mo'am:

rang byung rgyal mo'am: bsod nams bcud thub rgyal mo'am: phrin las dmag zor rgyal mo'am: 'di dus ngan yang mtha' ru shin tu zab cing snod min bstan bshig 'ga' la ni bka' gnyan zhing srog rtsa rgol bar bgyi bas zab bo: mye'o lha mo lung nas rtsa gsum gling pas gter nas phyung ba'o: maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung las: gter srung las kyi ma mo'i mchod thabs bzhugs so/ n-isbyaṃ rgya nam̐: gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: las kyi ma mo'i mchod thabs ni: rin chen snod mchog gang rung du: bshos bu zur gsum smad zlum la: bshos bu bzhi dang sman leb dang : bum pa bcas la dkar dmar brgyan: gser skyems dang bcas bshams par bya: rol mo'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung rig pa'i dbyings klong dbus: dur khrod tshogs khang ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas: ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: zab gsang ye shes dgyes pas gnas 'dir bzhugs: dam rdzas mchod gtor gser skyems gnyan po bzhes: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: ma yengs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: bh+yoḥ ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs ya la la: sku la dar dkar go zu gsol: rin chen thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan pu ru ru: phyag g.yas sna tshogs mda' dar 'dzin: g.yon pas 'phrul gyi me long bsnams: rat+na mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phyang ldan: klu yi chu rta sngon po chibs: sga srab dar stan khrigs se khrig: rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i shugs 'chang ma: gsang ba gter gyi grogs mdzad ma: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ma: las bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grog: ka cha dkor nor gnyer du gtad: dus drug srung zhing phyi la 'brongs:

zab chos bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: sngon tshe gu ru'i bka' bzhin du: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ gu h+ya ḍāk+ki yo gi ni ma mo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan gter bdag gling pas 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i brag nas gdan drangs pa'o/ hrīḥ mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rigs lnga ye shes mkha' 'gro skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir dgyes pas bdag la mdangs ston phyir: thogs med thugs rjes dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: sngon tshe ke'u ri gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : bde chen rig ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs 'ja' ltar shar: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: sgom pa'i lha tshogs gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan: gnas gsum la sogs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig dran dgongs la: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgyes pas mdangs phyung bsgrubs pa'i rtags bstan te: phrin las dngos sgrubs byang chub sa lam spel: 'gro ba'i bsod nams mnga' ba dbang du sdus: yid la 'dod rgu dpal 'byor phun tshogs nas: dbyings phyug lha mo bstan pa'i mel tshe sgron: rig 'dzin bdag gi sgrub pa'i rogs dan mdzod: om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki de wi ha ri ni sa ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: zhes mchod gtor 'bul: bdag byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar: mkha' 'gro dang 'bral ba med pa'i smon lam gdab: hrīḥ bde chen ye shes rgyas pa'i dpal lha mo: zab lam rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma: rtag tu 'bral med zung 'jug spyod pa yi:

phrin las dpal du bdag gis deng 'grub shog: gu h+ya mu ḍa maṅga la tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: gter gzhung nas so/ ༈ gtor ma dmar gtor gcig la 'khor gsum gyis bskor gser skyems mchod: hūm̐: bdag nyid gsang bdag gsal ba mdun gyi gnas: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung rab 'khrugs klong : pad nyi bam steng dre'u dmar nag steng : bh+yo yig 'phro 'du sbyor ba'i dran rdzogs su: dud pa'i sol ma mthing nag khro mo'i gzugs: gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: gsal ba'i thugs ka'i bh+yo las 'od 'phros pas: dud pa'i sol ma 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: bh+yo kā li kā li dhe wi kā li badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bh+yo: lha gnas gsum dang dur khrod brgya rtsa brgyad: mu le mthing mtsho dgu brtsegs thod mkhar sogs: gar bzhugs gnas nas dud sol dpon g.yog 'khor: chu zla'i gar snang ci bzhin sku bskyod la: spyan 'dren 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: khrag zhag pad nyi bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: om̐ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza la kha kha khā hi: ༈ bskang ba ni/ bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /gsang sngags bon du gyer ba'i tshe/ /phas zer bu yis mi nyan dus/ /dus ngan nye ba 'thab pa'i dus/ /gos ngan re thul gyon pa dang*/ /zas ngan lci ba za ba dang*/ /sde 'khrug nang dme byed pa'i dus/ /ma mo nag mo thugs khros nas/ /bud med sna tshogs stong khams gang*/ /mi nad phyugs nad sna tshogs gtong*/ /mkha' la nad sprin sngo dmar 'khrigs/ /dus kyi 'khrugs pa slong byed ma/ /mtshon gyi bskal pas 'jigs byed ma/ /glo bur mi la lhog rgod 'bebs/ /thog ser 'bebs pa'i snying mo che/ /sa bdag klu gnyan khyod kyi 'bangs/ /lha srin sde brgyad khyod kyi 'khor/ khyod kyis mi 'dul gang yang med/

/nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ khrag kyang ma mo khyod kyi khrag /spyi bdud nad kyi kha lo sgyur/ /bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma dang*/ /brtan rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas kyis/ /'khrugs pa'i ma mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang ngo sa ma ya/ /thugs dam bskangs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur/ khram kha phyes la shwa rdel spos/ /nad gdon bar chad bsgyur du gsol/ /mi nad phyugs nad bsgyur du gsol/ /mo ngan mtshan rtsub bsgyur du gsol/ /pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur/ /mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur/ /spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur/ /zlog sgyur chen po'i dus la bab/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /thog med dus nas ma rig dbang gyur pa'i/ /mi shes sgrib pa'i le lo dbang gis ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la 'gal ba rnams/ /sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /om̐ sa ma ya/ āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ trag rak+sha kha mun+t+ra e ka dzā ṭi snying kha rak+mo bh+yo dzaḥ om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs man ngag gi yig brgya dang lag g.yas mdzub mo srin lag gnyis mthil du bkug /mthe bong dang gong mo mthe'u chung gsum bsgrengs te tri shu la'i phyag rgyas/ hūm̐ phaṭ ma hā de wi kā li duṣ+ṭāṃ ta ka ha na da ha ru lu bhan+dha pa tsa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas pas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog lag gnyis sor mo bcu rtse mo cung tsam bsdus nas khog pa zlum po bdud rtsi bum pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ om̐ badz+ra dhā ki nī de wi ma hā kā li re ma ti kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi sa ma ya a we sha ya āḥ zhes brjod pas dngos grub blang*/ zhes lha mos 'khrug bskang rgyun khyer bsdus pa 'di ni rang gi thugs dam phyir sngags 'chang rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pas bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i yams nad rims nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig

/bstod bskul ni/ bh+yo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs sprul dpal lha mo/ /srid gsum skye 'gro'i mnga' bdag dus bzhi'i rgyal/ /'gro kun thugs rjes brtse ba bdud rtsi'i rgyal/ /dbul ba'i phongs sel mi zad gter gyi bdag khams gsum dbang sdud log lta'i 'ching ba khrol/ /ma rungs bstan dgra'i srog dbugs bla tshe rku/ /sgrub brgyud kun la rtag tu bya ra skyongs/ /dam tshig can la ma yi bu ltar brtse/ /dud pa'i sol ma 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /rtag chad mu bzhi bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa skyobs/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum dga' bzhi'i grogs mdzod la/ /chags zhan bo zag thig le'i gegs skyon sel/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa ma rtogs bar/ /dbyings kyi yum mchog lus dang grib bzhin 'grog /shāka thub phur pa'i skur bzhengs dam bzhag ltar/ /gsang sngags theg chen bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /om̐ kā li kā li de wi kā li i dam bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes pa'ang mchog sprul o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes shing bya lor hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes15la sngo ne brag gzim chung du sbyar ba yi ge pa yang bdag o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ ma mo e ka dzā ṭi'i gtor 'bul bzhugs so/ ma mo e ka dzā ṭi'i gtor ma tsit+ta zur brgyad kyi gzugs yod pa la dmar gyis brgyan te bshams la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bskal pa me 'bar khrag mtsho'i klong : rtsub 'gyur chos nyid dkyil 'khor nas: kun bzang ma gcig 'khros pa las: e ka dzā ṭi dmar nag gzugs: ral gcig spyan gcig nu ma gcig: rkang gcig stobs ldan 'dzam gling nyul: phyag gnyis spu gri dgra snying rol: ral pa sprugs pas dug char 'bebs: khrag nad dmar yams dgra la gtong : 'khor ni srog gcod srin mo bzhi:

sha za khrag 'thung ma mos bskor: sngags srung khro gnyer ral pa bsigs: gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma che: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngags srung khro mo dgra la bh+yo: dgra bo bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: sha za khrag 'thung mtshan ma gtor: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: khrag skyug nad kyis sod la shog: gsang sngags gnyan la dgra byung na: nyan thos yin kyang myur du sgrol: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' stsal pa: ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig bzhin: dam tshig bka' las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo rak+sha e ka dzā ṭi trig dgra bo mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phyogs gtsang sar lam dgra phyogs su bskyal: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngags 'chang karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gser gling nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ༈ de nas khyab 'jug gi gtor ma 'bul ba ni: gtor ma bya rog gis mtshan pa bshams la: hūm̐: dug rlangs dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong : gdug pa'i bu yug thog char dbus: ki kang rngam klong nang shed nas: srog bdag khyab 'jug nag po bzhengs: dbu dgu mun rub 'khrigs pa'i gzugs: zhal nas dug rlangs chi li li: spyan dmar tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: srog gzan bya rog dbang rtags rdzogs: g.yas gnyis thog mda' spu gri bsnams: g.yon gnyis lcags gzhu rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: sku stod srin po sku smad sbrul: mgo lus khyab par mig gis gtams: de'i nang sde brgyad dmag tshogs 'gyed: lte bar khro zhal bstan dgra 'joms: g.yon du srog gcod ma mo rngam: 'khor du gza' brgyad gdong mo 'gyed: hrul du sha za khrag 'thung bskor: ki kang thog 'bebs nag po che: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sdang ba'i dgra la thog ser phob: gza' nad steng grib 'tshub tu chugs: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra dang bgegs: sgos su bdag la sdang ba rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs snying khrag 'thung : dus la bab bo sa ma ya:

sngon tshe gsang bdag pad+ma yis: dam tshig ci ltar bka' bsgos bzhin: da lta sngags 'chang bdag gis bskul: ma thogs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hrīḥ rā hu la ki kang hrī shag ru raṃ dgra bo'i srog rtsa la yaṃ kha raṃ khā hi: zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs 'bul la: khyab 'jug dug mtsho nas khol du phyung ba'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gser gling nas karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gdan drangs pa'o: ༈ kī la che mchog khro rgyal las: skyes bu dam can gyi gtor 'bul bzhugs so: gter srung skyes bu dam can gyi gtor 'bul ni: 'bru nag gam ni gang rung zan: ra mgos mtshan pa'i dpal gtor gzugs: ra yi sha khrag gsur btang zhing : rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐ bh+yo tri: byang shar me rlung 'bar ba'i klong : skyes bu badz+ra sa dhu rtsal: dmar nag ra skyes kham pa chibs: phyag gnyis rdo rje dgra snying rol: btsan mdung ru dar lhabs se lhab: sku la dar dmar phod chen gsol: stag ral gzig shubs ral gris brgyan: btsan dmag yang 'khor sha za sde: drag bskul las la bos pa'i tshe: ma thogs gnas 'dir myur du byon: slob dpon ji ltar bka' bsgos bzhin: zab gter gnyan gyi bstan pa srungs: ra yi sha khrag gsur mchod bzhes: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: ka cha dkor nor gnyer du bcol: nyin mtshan srung ba'i mel tshe mdzod: gal te nyams pa'i dgra bo yi: gnod tshe gdug sems 'ching gyur tshe: skyes bu dam can las la chos: btsan rgod shan pa'i dmag sna drongs: the'u rang 'gong po'i phung shig thongs: yang 'khor sprul pa'i ru 'dren 'gyed: chos chos sdang ba'i dgra la chos: dgra bo'i mi nor phyags mas thobs: dgra bo'i yul zhing ser bas khongs: shwa kha khram sdeb snying rlung gyis: dgra bo bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: pho rgyud mo rgyud mngal nas skoms: rigs rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: dgra la dmag sna 'dren pa'i tshe: nam mkhar 'brug zhon nyi khri stong :

dgra yul thog gi khongs la shog: bar snang seng zhon nyi khri stong : dgra la smyo 'bog snying gzer thongs: sa gzhi ra zhon nyi khri stong : dgra la grib rgod sna tshogs thongs: sprul pa pho nya las mkhan rnams: ka cha dkor nor phyir la rgyugs: yang 'khor gcan spyang sha za tshogs: dgra bo'i nor rdzas bla 'khyams sdud: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: dam can dregs pa btsan gyi tshogs: sha khrag dmar gtor 'di bzhes la: gsang bdag rdo rje khro bo dang : dregs 'dul snang srid zil gnon la: yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu: khyod kyis srog phul bka' bsgos bzhin: zab chos gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: ka cha chas ka gang zhig de: nyes can rkun 'phrog bcom srid na: myur du phyir 'brongs dgra bo sgrol: gal te nyes 'gal byung srid na: skyes bu dam can med do skad: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: rgyud srung bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra sa dhu tsa rak+sha nag po dgra bo'i don snying la khā hi khā hi: zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam skyal: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma hūm̐ gis phag lor gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus pa'o// // sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ dpal mgon zhing skyong ma hā kā la'i ka bstod bzhugs: dpal mgon zhing skyong ma hā kā la'i sku la 'dud: gsol mchod gtor 'bul bsdus pa'i las rim ni: 'bru nag las byas dpal gtor bshams nas dang po 'di skad do: hūm̐: bzhengs shig dur khrod tsā ri'i gnas nas bzhengs: deng 'dir gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan srung phyir: zhing skyong 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs mchod gtor bzhes: bstan srung mthu rtsal bskyed pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: kā la seng gdong drag po mthu stobs rgyal: kha gdangs mche gtsigs dgra sha khrag la rngam: ga shal rgyan ldan ru dar dmar gtor 'dzin: nga ro ha ha sgrogs shing bdud rta chibs:

ca co rigs ldan ma rungs bstan dgra rnams: cha lugs du ma'i cho 'phrul 'gyed cing sgrol: ja chang phud rgod gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nya rgyas lta bu'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: ta thā ga ta'i bstan srung nag po che: tha dad gcig tu ma nges seṅge'i gdong : da dgra rtsad gcod snying dang kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: na 'chi rkyen ngan dgra la rbad pa'i tshe: pa sangs rgyu 'dra'i bdud rta rlung gshog chibs: pha rol byad ma'i sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: ba mor nyi ltar dgra bo bsgral bar mdzod: ma hā kā la'i bstan srung baṃ chen rngam: tsā ri ṭa sogs sbas yul zab gter srung : tsha grang 'khrugs 'dra mdog sdug 'jigs shing 'khrigs: dza lang byad ma bsgral zhing gtor ma bzhes: wa seng rtsal 'gyed ji ltar mngon par mdzod: zhe sdang 'byung po sgrol mdzad dregs pa'i tshogs: za gsod dbugs la rngam zhing ha sgra sgrogs: 'a cag rbad cing bskul lo pho nya'i tshogs: ya ma gshin rje'i dmag tshogs gtibs pa bzhin: ral gri mtshon cha'i dal yams dgra la phob: la yog kha smras ngan pa dgra la bh+yo: sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: sa steng dgra bo bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ha la zor thun char phob bsregs gtor nas: a don ngo bo chos dbyings la gnas shog: hūm̐: bskul lo zhing skyong dpal 'bar 'khor bcas kyis: pha rol byad kha log lta bdud rigs rnams: myur du bsgral zhing sha khrag don snying rol: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: mi kha dmod tshig do bsdo dgra dang bgegs: skad cig nyid la bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hrīṃ dzaḥ ḍāk+ki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hrīṃ dza: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hrīṃ dza: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes phul lo: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug mchog: rgyun gtor 'bul ba'i cha rkyen 'dis:

tshig nyung don 'brel nus rtag 'byung : rgyun khyer gtor 'bul e ma hoḥ skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog: bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i ming can gyis tshig nyung go bde'i cha rkyen grub pas 'dis kyang bstan srung mngon gyur shog /ces karma las 'brel gling pas jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod du dmar nag rak+ta'i mtsho nas drag po sha za 'gyu ba'i dus su gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༈ dbang drag kī la ya'i srung ma nyer bsdus phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs so/ rang nyid dpal chen 'bar ba yi/ /gzi byin 'bar ba'i stobs shugs kyis/ /sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams dang*/ /'byung lnga snod bcud mkha' klong nas/ /bka' dang gter srung rgya mtsho rnams/ /mchod sbyin slad du spyan drangs gyur/ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ hūm̐/ dbyings las ma g.yos cho 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ /snying srung mkha' 'gro sde lnga zhing skyong dbang*/ ma gza' rdor legs lha bdud btsan klu dang*/ /dge bsnyen sde bzhi lha srin sde brgyad sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la/ /rngam brjid drag po'i mthun rdzas sprin ltar gtibs/ /drag mchod sha khrag gling bzhi khyon ltar brdal/ /mngon spyod las byed shan pa rlung ltar 'tshubs/ /nyams dgra'i bla tshe srog dbugs bun ltar g.yo/ /sman raka gtor mchod dwangs ma'i zer ltar 'khrugs/ /'bod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas mnyes pa'i rdzas/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams gsum srid pa'i sprin/ /thugs rje'i rtsal las 'gogs med shar ba'i dpyid/ /ye shes 'jig rten pho rgyud mo rgyud sogs/ /bdud 'dul dpal gyi bka' nyan rnams la 'bul/ /srid pa dregs sde'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang*/ /thogs med phrin las gnyan gyi g.yar dam stsol/ om̐ pa shaṃ de wi ha ri ni sa bh+yo ra tri e du tsa na yak+sha tsa tur a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum/ hūm̐/ phrin las myur mgyogs tha tshig gnyer ba'i tshogs/ khyod la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /chos bzhin sgrub la bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dpal ye shes snyan grags gong du 'phel/ /lha 'dre mi gsum 'dod rgu dbang du sdus/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra zur dgra thal bar rlog khyad par zab gsang theg pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /nyi ltar gsal zhing mkha' ltar khyab cing brtan/ /snod bcud bde 'byor chos bzhin spyod pa sogs/ /bdud 'dul pad+ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las lhun 'grub mdzod/ ces pa'ang lha ri gyang rdo'i dben gnas nas dbang drag kī la yi bsnyen sgrub kyi tshe skyid grong smyon pas nyung bsdus 'khyer bder bkod pa'o// // ༈ bka' srung dregs 'dul gyi mchod bstod nye bar mkho ba bzhugs so/ pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ de nas bka' srung dregs 'dul gyi las byang bsdus pa ni/ mchod pa'i rdzas sman raka blos gang lcogs bshams nas/ 'bru gsum gyis sbyangs spel bsgyur te 'di ltar bsgrub par bya'o/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ bhan+dha lcang lo dum gcig 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /byad ma dgra bgegs rnams kyi klad khrag dang*/ /don snying dbang po ri ltar spungs pa 'di/ /dpal mgon legs ldan khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i tshogs/ /phyag bzhi pa dang ma ning gdong bzhi pa/ /phyag drug pa dang las mdzad dur khrod bdag /rigs bzhi khro mo la sogs yang 'khor la/ /'bul lo sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod/ /dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /ha ha dgod sogs dur khrod gnas kyi bdag /srog bdag mgon po las byed dregs pa'i tshogs/ /ma mo tsaṇ+ḍa gshin rje dur khrod bdag /dpal mgon zhing skyong ma mo sngags srung ma/ /gza' mchog dam can btsan rgod klu rgyal che/ /gnod sbyin dge bsnyen lha dang shan pa dang*/ /dam can dang ni khrag ral ma mo la/

/'bul lo dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral mdzad phyir/ /dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /klu sman dge bsnyen klu btsan shan pa dang*/ /sman btsun nā ga gnyan rgod las mkhan tshogs/ /mon pa la sogs dregs pa 'khor bcas la/ /'bul lo nyams pa'i byad ma tshar gcod phyir/ /dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ hūm̐/ /dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i tshogs/ /bka' yi las byed dregs pa can/ /phyi nang dam can rgya mtsho la/ /bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan pa 'di/ /skyong zhing rogs dan myur du sgrubs/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /byang chub snying po'i mthun rkyen du/ /mgon zhing sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol mchod kyis rab tu dgyes par mos nas/ dregs 'dul gyi gtor bsngos 'khyer bde 'di yang*/ mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po gsang sngags bstan skyong gi bkas bskul ngor/ sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag pas khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi tshal du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i gsol mchod ni/ mchod rdzas kyi dngos po thams cad ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ 'bru gsum dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma ra dza ḍāk+ki ha ri ṇi sa sa mā ya dza dza sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ om̐ pad+ma u ta pra mo ti ra ga dha ra hūm̐ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ om̐ pad+ma tsar+ya ra ga h+ya sha mu ṭa dhe wi ma ha gha na pa ti ku ru kul+le sarba pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun sarba sid+dhi dza sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ dngos grub mchog stsol o rgyan nor gyi lha/ /lha lcam mtsho rgyal ḍāk+ki gsang ba'i yum/ /yum chen dbang mo phyogs kyi mgyogs ma bzhi/ /gzhi 'dzin klu mo nor skyong klu rgyal che/ /che btsan rgyal po rnam mang thos pas sras/ /sras yum skya brgyad gnod sbyin bdun 'bum 'khor/

/'khor bcas dzam lha nor lha rta yi lha/ /lha chen dbang phyug chen po phyugs lha 'bum/ /'bum phrag nor lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rnam par bzhugs shing dngos grub 'byung ba'i rten/ /rten rdzas rnam rgyal khang bzang bkod legs mdzes/ /mdzes mtshon bkra shis rdzas rtags lha mi'i nor/ /nor bu bsam 'phel mchod 'dzin lha mo stong*/ /stong gsum gling bzhi'i 'byor rgu'i maṇ+ḍal tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir o rgyan nor lhar 'bul/ /'bul lo bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub rmad/ /rmad byung tshe dpal bsod nams phywa g.yang stobs/ /stobs ldan lha klu mi yi dbang thang khams/ khams gsum srid pa'i skye 'gro pho mo'i yid/ /yid la 'dod rgu'i zas gos nor longs spyod/ /spyod yul bdag gi bran dang dbang du bsdus/ /sdud byed srid pa'i rlung ltar myur mgyogs ston/ /ston zla'i dpal la 'khu ba'i rnam dkar dpyid/ /dpyid ka'i dpal yon rgyas bzhin gong du spor/ /spor byed dus mtha'i me bzhin nus stobs skyed/ /bskyed stobs 'grib med lung rtogs rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bstan 'dzin sde bcas dar rgyas 'jig rten kun/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang reg gyur cig /dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma yi dam mchog /zil gnon pad+ma rgyal po dbang 'dus rtsal/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho klu mo gter gyi bdag /phyi nang rtsa gsum lha yi bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang snyigs ma'i rgud pa gso ba'i phyir/ tshogs gnyis bsags dang phywa g.yang spel/ gter bum g.yang rten 'dzugs spel ched/ bum gter bca' sgrub skabs dang bstun/ bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'dabs bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling du nā gardzu na'i ming gis bris/ 'dis kyang bstan la sman gyur cig/ // lha chen gsol byang dbang gi lcags kyu bzhugs so/ hrīḥ rgyal kun so sor rtog pa'i ye shes sku/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul las/

/legs shar srid pa'i dbang phyug lha chen po/ /u ma yum dang rigs bzhi'i ḍāk+ki dang*/ /snang srid dregs ldan mthu chen tshogs dang bcas/ /bde chen 'od dmar 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs/ /brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud g.yo zhing sdud pa yi/ /rjes chags dbang gis phyag rgyar snang mdzod la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis legs par bshams pa yi/ /phyi nang gsang mchod snang srid 'dod rgu'i gter/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman raka gtor ma bcas/ /bde chen kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dgyes par bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /dgyes spyan ut+pal dmar po'i zur mig gis/ /rtag tu skyong zhing yid la 'dod pa'i don/ /'bad med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /skye dgu'i yid dang brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ khab len rdo yis lcags bzhin thogs med khugs/ /rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ om̐ ma hā de wa shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sa glang cho 'phrul zla ba yi/ /dkar phyogs yid kyi tshes grangs la/ /rgyal dang phur bu'i 'grub sbyor dus/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes spel/ hrīḥ srid gsum dbang mdzad dbang gi lha chen po/ /dbang phyug yab yum gsang ba ḍāk+ki bzhi/ /bka' sdod dregs pa'i lha chen 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do dbang gi phrin las sgrubs/ mi pham pas so// // ༈ gter srung btsan rgod gsol bsdus ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis/ ma la ya'i byang shar sogs rang rang gi gnas nas gter srung chen po me 'od gdong*/ rol pa bco brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs par bsam/

hūm̐/ dbang drag pad+ma'i bka' nyan gter gyi bdag /shin tu khro gtum dregs pa btsan gyi rje/ /btsan rgod dmar nag gnod sbyin me 'od gdong*/ /rol pa bco brgyad 'khor bcas gnas 'dir byon/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gzhon nu pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /rig 'dzin chen po gnam lcags rdo rje sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sgrub rten 'dir bzhugs sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ hūm̐/ snang srid dur khrod drag po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /nyams pa bsgral ba'i sha ri khrag mtsho dang*/ /sra brtan go khrab bla rdo srog 'khor sogs/ /gang bzhed mthun rdzas mkha' dbyings gang bas mchod/ hūm̐/ chos rnams bde stong sor rtog ye shes las/ /ma g.yos rtsal dang rol pa he ru ka'i/ /ye shes rol pa bco brgyad glog ltar myur/ /gter srung rgya mtsho'i gtso bor mnga' gsol bstod/ hūm̐/ dam tshig srog ldan rnal 'byor gang zhig gis/ /bsam pa tsam gyis zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs/ /phrin las rab 'byams thogs pa med pa ru/ /skad cig nyid la sgrubs shig sa ma ya/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas sogs brjod/ ces ka ma rā dza dī pas so// // gter srung btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad kyi gtor bsngos rgyun khyer bzhugs so: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos he ru kaḥ thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje lta bu'i klong : rdo rje gzhon nu yang dag ye shes rol: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma he ru kaḥ drag sngags 'bar zhing mched pa'i rang sgra sgrogs: sku yi rtsal 'byin 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: khro bo gar dgu sprul pa cir yang ston: de ltar dbyings las ma g.yos rang byung lha: dpal chen 'bar ba'i rtsal las shar ba yin: bka' yi las byed gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : srin po khros 'dra 'jigs rung rnam 'gyur can: 'od ldan zangs khrab rmog zhu nyi ltar gsal: ru dar dmar po bar snang 'tshub kyis 'gengs: zangs gri 'bar bas bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod:

thog ltar rgyu ba'i ru mtshon dgra la 'debs: ma rungs dgra snying gsol zhing btsan zhags 'phen: stag ral gzig shubs dpa' bo'i cha lugs 'chang : sga srab chas ldan zangs rta dmar po zhon: bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum yud kyis bskor: rang 'dra'i sprul pa btsan rgod las la 'gyed: shan pa'i sde dpon gnod sbyin ma ru rtse: cha lugs sna tshogs snang srid 'gengs par ston: bsam pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa: ༈ btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs/ /sbyor sgrol bla med spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul srid pa'i 'dod yon rnams/ /thugs dam bskang phyir gnyis med bzhes nas kyang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas/ /tshe dpal nyams rtogs 'gro don phrin las spel/ /'gal rkyen bar chad bdud kyi g.yul ngo zlog /snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus/ /kun kyang theg chen chos la 'god pa dang*/ /yul 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod kun zhi zhing*/ /mi nor dge bcu yon tan gong 'phel nas/ /bla med bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi gter srung btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad kyi mchod sprin rgyun khyer 'di bzhin rdzogs chen pad+ma sgrub mchog dpal bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa skyid grong smyon pas gzhung tshig la kha skong cung zad bgyis te brag skas pad+ma shel phug gis nye 'dabs su bris/ dza yan+tu// // ༈ btsan gyi gtor 'bul ni: dzaḥ rab 'jigs pho brang mchong lding smug po'i gnas: rtag tu 'gyu ba'i byang shar ma ru rtse: sham bha la yi gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : me ri 'bar ba gsang bdag gtum po yis: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gral du bzhag: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i gnyer byang gtad: bla med dkyil 'khor skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin:

de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung rin chen gter gyi bya ra mdzod: ta ma la ru pra bha hastī la: gsang bdag gtum po bka' bab lung bstan rnyed: yang phur 'bum sde'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal tshab mnga' gsol tshe: rdo rje lta ba klong yangs rgyud sde'i don: rig 'dzin rnam gnyis dbyings rig gcig tu rdzogs: dgongs don brda bzhi'i gnyer kha gtad pa'i tshe: gnod sbyin khyod kyis khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: gsang sngags tha tshig gnyan las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter srungs phyi nang bar chad sol: yang le shod du gsang phur bka' rgya gdams: jo mo mtsho rgyal phur pa'i gdeng tshad thob: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags: mchims phur yang dag snying po sgrub pa mdzad: rje 'bangs grogs lnga gsang phur gtad pa'i tshe: bka' yi tha tshig rol pa mched la gdams: ma 'ongs brgyud 'dzin skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin : sngon tshe pad 'byung bka' las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rtsa gsum gling pas mon sha 'ug brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ༈ btsan gsol bsdus pa ni/ hrīḥ pad+ma'i bka' srung gnod sbyin me 'od gdong*/ /rol pa bco brgyad sprul 'khor yang sprul bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstod/ /bstan skyongs phrin las rnam bzhi ma g.yel sgrubs/ /btsan gsol grangs gsog rdo ban gyis bskul ngor khyung sngags gu h+yas so// // ༈ rgyal gsol bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐/ slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan pa/ /dregs sde yongs kyi gtso bo ni/ /shel ging gnod sbyin dpe ha ra/ /dkar smug srog bdag dgra bo'i gshed/ /mi bsrun dregs pa yang 'khor bcas/ /tha tshig bzhin du phrin las mdzod/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re/

/dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhing bcu'i bstan dgra phye mar shigs/ /mngon spyod rtags bzhin phrin las mdzod/ om̐ ru she la ging ka ra ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ rtsa gsum gling pas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ jo bo gze rgyal gyi gsol kha spu gri dmar po bzhugs so: gu ru pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: pad+ma'i gsal bkod legs bris mchod bstod bstan: bkra shis byin chags yid 'ong dkyil 'khor dbus: mchod pa'i rigs sogs gzhung bzhin bshams byas te: dbus su dpal gtor zlum po dmar gyis brgyan: sde brgyad 'khor dang mtheb skyus bskor bar bya: de nas dkar gtor gtsang ma gnyis byas la: mdun rgyab gnyis su 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs skad cig dran rdzogs su: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag po kī la'i thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros lha btsan 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ dhe wa tsa tri shu la siṃ ha mu kha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub drag po'i gzhal yas nas: dge bsnyen rdo rje bdud 'dul gze rgyal zhes: yum chen drag mo ḍāk+ki seng gdong ma: lha srin sde brgyad yang 'khor dmag tshogs rnams: pho brang dur khrod gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: klong yangs pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan khri la: mi g.yo brtse bas dgongs te bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag sku lnga'i rang bzhin la: mi dmigs blo 'das chen por phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ hūm̐: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor tshogs 'bul: om̐ dhe wa tsa tri shu la siṃ ha mu kha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: lha yi dge bsnyen zhing skyong rgyal po'i tshul: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba bdud 'dul ni: sku mdog dkar gsal mdangs ldan zhi ma khro:

sku la shel khrab dbu la shel rmog gsol: phyag g.yas mdung dar dkar po mkha' la phyar: g.yon pas lcags kyus khams gsum dbang du bsdus: rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang rag pa rting dkar chibs: lha dmag sdud cing pha rol rgol ba 'joms: rdo rje bdud 'dul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: de yi yum chen ḍāk+ki seng gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag drag mo khros pa'i gzugs: phyag g.yas rtse gsum ma rungs gdug pa 'dul: g.yon pas bhan+dha sgrub mchog dngos grub gter: ral pa dmar nag bar snang sprin bzhin g.yo: chibs su rdzu 'phrul bar snang glog la chibs: mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs lam gyi bar chad sel: g.yul las rnam rgyal ḍāk+ki dpal 'bar ma: drag mo seng gdong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa sde brgyad gri thogs shan pa'i tshogs: rang rtags phyag mtshan log lta tshar gcod tshul: chibs su rdzu 'phrul mgyogs pa rlung gshog chibs: sha za khrag 'thung rngam pa'i nga ro sgrogs: sgrub mchog skyong zhing bstan dgra'i srog dbugs bsdus: log lta tshar gcod sde brgyad tshogs la bstod: de nas bskul ba'i tshul gyis: hūm̐: bskul lo dge bsnyen rgyal po las la bskul: mdzod cig ḍāk+ki seng gdong phrin las mdzod: rbad do dregs pa sde brgyad dgra la rbad: chos so yul lha gzhi bdag dmag la chos: byad kha rbod gtong bsam ngan 'chang ba yi: pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dgra bo 'di: lo zla zhag dus za mar ma bzhag la: srog gcod dbugs longs sha khrag don snying rol: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' ma bcag: da lta sngags 'chang bdag gi dam ma bkral: mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba chud ma zos: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo sgrol la shog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ dhe wa tsa tri shu la siṃ ha mu kha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pa la kha kha khā hi: dmod bcol bya zhing drag sngags bzlas la thal mo brdab:

gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang bar bya'o: drag sngags mi 'gyur ā thaṃ rgya: hūm̐ ka ra artsig gis jo bo gze rgyal gangs khrod nas gdan drangs rjes shog ser las bsgyur ba'o: jo bo gze rgyal gsol mchod bdud rtsi sprin phung bzhugs so/ kyaiḥ 'dzam gling byang skyong dpal ldan he ru kaḥ yid kyi phrin las gar khyab sku lnga po: dge bsnyen gze 'od rgyal po 'khor dang bcas: dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: mdun du rin chen pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab dang : zhal zas rol mo ma lus rab tu bshams: phye mar dkar mngar sbrang rtsi shing thog 'bras: dza gad gtor ma sha khrag dar mtshon dang : khrab rmog spyan gzigs sna tshogs rab tu spungs: gze rgyal dge bsnyen mched lngas dgyes par bzhes: gze rgyal mnga' gsol yid bzhin dbang lhun bzhugs so/ kyai/ 'dzam gling bod yul mnga' bdag 'dod khams rgyal/ /gang 'dul bstan srid 'gro 'di'i rgyal mtshan che/ /dge legs ya mtshan las grub gze rgyal zhes/ /bkra shis rma g.yang phyugs gter rgyas pa yi/ /las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub par dbang bskur zhing*/ /zab gsang ring lugs spel ba'i phrin las che/ /gsang sngags zab chos lde mig skyong ba'i gnyan/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan kun ldan gnas kyi mchog /rin chen shel gyi ri bo lhun mthug la/ /rta bdun stong gi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i gzugs/ /rigs gsum sprul pa'i zlos gar rdo rje mched/ /'dir gshegs mchod sgrub slad du spyan 'dren gshegs/ /bkod legs rang 'os gdan bzhugs gus pas bstod/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul snang srid khyon 'gengs pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas bye brag kun/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /mkha' lding khyung dang seṅge g.yu 'brug stong*/ /rin chen rigs gyur 'bru sna dar zab tshogs/ khrab rmog go mtshon bla rdo rten mdos dkar/

/nyag phran dar gyis mgul rgyan dngul dkar gyi/ /me long 'brang rgyas dkar po rba dkar dang*/ /bal ldan snying dang rin chen khu ba yi/ /bris pa'i srog yig rol mo bye brag bcas/ /gzhan yang chos ber phod kha mchod cha'i rigs/ /rta glang dril mdzo g.yag lug za le 'bri/ /stong gsum phyur ba'i g.yung dwags rnam pa kun/ /bya gcan ri dwags chu gnas ma lus pa/ khyed la rtag tu mnga' gsol rten du 'bul/ /'das dang ma byon rgyal kun bstan bskyang phyir/ /lha mchog sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /rigs gsum rdo rje mched du mnga' gsol lo/ /chos sku'i mnga' gsol skye med cho rol las/ /longs sku'i mnga' gsol zhi rgyas dbang drag gzugs/ /sprul sku'i mnga' gsol gang 'dul cir yang ston/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo/ /bla ma'i mnga' gsol rigs kun bdag nyid 'chang*/ /yi dam mnga' gsol dregs sde mthu dpung ldan/ /mkha' 'gro'i mnga' gsol rdzu 'phrul myur shugs stobs/ /chos skyong mnga' gsol pha rol g.yul las rgyal/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo/ /dzam lha'i mnga' gsol dgos 'dod gter kha rdol/ /dregs sde'i mnga' gsol sde brgyad bran du khol/ /yul lha'i mnga' gsol yul gru dgon sde skyongs/ /gter bdag mnga' gsol dkar po'i dge tshogs sgrubs/ /dgra lha'i mnga' gsol byad ma bstan yul rlog /dam tshig mnga' gsol lus dang grib bzhin 'grog /de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mnga' gsol lo/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par? /dge 'dun sde dgon skyong bar? /gang bsam thogs med 'grub par? /yul gru bde legs 'grub par? /nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi bar? /tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par? /snang srid dbang du 'du bar? /dgra gdon drag tu bsgral bar? /mnga' gsol 'di bzhes bdag cag bsam rgu sgrubs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rgyal gyur nas/

/bcol ba'i phrin las 'bad med lhun 'grub shog /ces pa'ang gnas kyi nyer gnas pa ār+ya dh+wa dzas byang chen mer gzhung mtsho dmar kha la sbyar ba'o// // ༈ phrin las bcol ba rdo rje'i bden tshig bzhugs so/ ho/ rigs gsum sprul pa'i zlos gar/ lha klu gnyan gyi sde dpon/ rgyal ba yongs kyi bstan srung*/ gsang sngags sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad/ dkar po dge ba'i gnyan po/ 'dzam gling yul gru'i mnga' bdag /rin chen gter gyi srung ma/ rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lha/ sdang byed dgra bo'i gshed ma/ pha rol sgrol ba'i mtshon cha/ dregs byed kun gyi yang rje/ legs nyes las kyi stangs 'dzin/ lha mchog rdo rje mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la phrin las su bcol ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i bka'i tha tshig gnyan po'i phrin las g.yel ba med par sgrubs shig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad mug mtshon 'khrug mi mthun pa 'jigs pa brgyad kyi g.yul ngo phyogs ngan thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i tshe bsod snyan grags rlung rta dbang thang thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu rgyas par mdzod cig khams gsum srid pa'i phywa g.yang*/ lha klu gnyan gyi longs spyod/ gling bzhi skye 'gro'i mnga' thang snang zhing srid par gnas pa'i/ ka cha dkor nor thams cad khab len rdo yis lcags phye blangs pa ltar dbang du sdus shig /sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo lha srung dang bcas pa dgra jag chom rkun gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad/ drag po'i stobs kyis bya sgro me la shor ba ltar srung ba'i gur shigs/ skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ dmag mi dang 'og rta phyes la go cha dang mtshon cha sil bur thongs shig /dpa' ba'i snying gtor cig /dbang lnga don snying bzhes la bstan srid ma lus pa thams cad thal zhags rlung gis gtor ba ltar phyogs med du choms shig

/bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas ci bsams pa'i don 'bras mchog gi dngos grub chen po/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rang bzhin bsgom med a ti'i rgyal sa zin cing 'phro rgod bying ba'i rtog tshogs spun po'i bar chad rnams gtan nas gzhom pa dang*/ thun mong rim gnyis kyi dngos grub tshe chos zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang snyan grags dpal 'byor thams cad/ yid bzhin nor bu ltar dgos 'dod 'byung zhing ri rgyal ltar dpangs mtho la/ rgya mtsho ltar gting zab cing*/ lho sprin ltar mthug cing phyug pa klu rgyal chen po brgyad kyis yang*/ 'gran bzod bral ba'i bde skyid phun sum 'tshogs shing ci bsams pa'i 'bras bu thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba dang*/ zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan srid zab mo lha klu gnyan gsum gyis tha grur khyab cing*/ dkar po dge ba'i rgyal mtshan lha gnas yangs pa'i rtse mor gyen du bsgreng ba'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig /ces pa'ang rang 'dod kyi bcol tshig 'di rgyal ming gis 'bri gung du bris pa'o// // ༈ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phyi ltar thogs med dge bsnyen gze 'od rgyal/ /dkar dmar dar dkar la thod nor bus brgyan/ /ru dar rba lcag stag ral gzig shubs bkra/ /rang 'dra mched bzhi ru dar 'tshubs shing 'gengs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan srung khyod la bstod/ /nang ltar dpal ldan ma hā kā la ya/ /stobs ldan srid gsum gyad rngam seṅge'i gdong*/ /rta nag ber nag mtshon 'khrugs 'od zer 'phro/ /ru dar nag po dmar gtor g.yas g.yon 'dzin/ /stag ral gzig shubs ral gri mtshon cha 'phro/ /bka' yi 'khor brgyad bdud dmag bsam mi khyab/ /dpal ldan zhing skyong nag po khyod la bstod/ /gsang ba btsan rgod chen po 'jigs byed sku/ /dgra bo'i srog len yang 'khor btsan dmag brgya/ /sprul pa yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /me 'od gdong can lha btsan khyod la bstod/

/don la rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rnal 'byor pa/ /pad+ma'i bka' nyan chos skyong dam tshig can/ /lde mig sum brgya drug cu'i gnyer kha 'dzin/ /thogs med rdo rje 'bar ba khyod la bstod/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan srung rdo rje gze rgyal khyed/ /dgyes pa'i ba liṃ dpal gyi gtor ma 'bul/ /gsang sngags bstan skyongs mi nor zas gsum spel/ /rnal 'byor don sgrubs dus 'khrug lo nyes zlog /yag la kha 'dzin nyes la bka' chad phob/ /ma g.yel sngon gyi dam bca' ji bzhin du/ khyad bzhi'i phrin las rtag tu legs sgrubs mdzod/ ces pa 'di yang rig 'dzin bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen gyi gtor 'bul ni/ hūm̐: yid 'ong rgya mtsho gling gi mnga' dbang sgyur: rin chen gter gyi rgya bsrung bya ra gyis/ /rtag tu gsang sngags bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: sgrub pa'i bu la brtse bas ma bzhin skyongs: mchog thun yid bzhin dngos grub char ltar phob: bsod nams re skong phrin las sna tshogs sgrubs: 'dod rgu srid la 'dzam gling kha lo sgyur: 'bad rtsol med pa'i dbul phongs pre ta sol: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra dbyings nas skyongs: sngags 'chang bdag la lus dang grib bzhin 'grog: phyag rgya drug gis grol lam dga' bzhi skyed: phun tshogs yar zla ltar bskyed phrin las mdzod: grogs ldan dgyes pa'i klu dbang yab yum gyis: dam rdzas gser skyems phud dang dkar gsum sogs: gtsang sbyar gtor ma 'bul ba bzhes su gsol: mnyes shing dgongs pa dgyes par bskyed nas su: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: dgos 'dod bsod nams dpag med nam mkha'i khyon: ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu mchis pa'i grogs: klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pas 'grub par mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛ ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dge bsnyen gtor 'bul pad+ma rgyal po nas khol du phyung ba'o/

༈ sprul pa'i dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po'i gsol mchod bzhugs so/ dpal chen he ru ka la na mo/ sprul pa'i dge bsnyen chen po'i gsol mchod 'bad pa ni/ lcags min pa'i snod gang rung du/ bshos bu sngon po sbrul dkris can g.yas su lha bshos/ rgyab tu zur gsum g.yon du khram ris can/ mdun du gser skyems bsham/ bsang sbyangs spel gsum sngon du song nas las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa ni/ kyai/ phyogs phyogs dag cing pha ki na/ /nyi ma steng 'og phyogs bcu yi/ /'gyu ba'i gnas chen nges med de/ /rab 'jigs ri bo'i khong gseng nas/ /rgya mtsho sngo nag me re ba/ /mun gling dgu yi gnas mchog nas/ /klu rgyal chen po skur bzhengs shig /'dir gshegs mthun pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ dzaḥ khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /klu bshos bdud rtsi sna tshogs 'bul/ khyed kyi gnas brgyad ru 'dren pa/ /lha dang gshin rje dregs pa 'bum/ /rang rang mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul/ /gsol lo mchod do dgyes par bzhes/ /klu g.yang 'dod rgu char bzhin phob/ kha 'dzin rogs dan sgrub pa dang*/ /bcol ba'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod/ hūm̐/ klu rgyal chen po drag rtsal can/ /myur mgyogs sprul pa 'gyed pa'i tshe/ /dri za'i yul du zur phud lnga/ /lha yi yul du tshangs pa che/ /lho rgyud bdud po zla ba'i gdong*/ /mon kha seṅge bkrag med zhes/ /mkhar chu'i dge bsnyen smyo kha ba/ /pho mar klu bdud mgo dgu ba/ /lci shod klu bdud rdo rje rgyal/ khams kyi nya nag dpral mdangs can/ /lci yi klu rgyal zla skyong ba/ /ngom gyi dge bsnyen bdud 'joms pa/ /spu bo nā ga yak+sha ba/ /nyin mo gling bzhir 'gyu ba'i tshe/ /shwa rbud drag po 'tshub ma 'khyil/ /mtshan mo gling bzhir 'gyu ba'i tshe/ /srod dang mun rub dus su nyul/ /rbad pa dgra la chas pa'i tshe/ /sngo nag khros pa srog gi bdag /g.yu khrab rmog zhu lams se lam/

/dar mdung sngon po pu ru ru/ /gri gug dang ni lcags par thogs/ /yan lag tshigs bzhi mig gis brgyan/ /bra nag rting dkar chas mdzes zhon/ /gcan spyang sna tshogs sngon la 'phyo/ /lha dang gshin rje 'bum gyis bskor/ /mi sngon sna tshogs las la 'gyed/ /chu chen bco brgyad dbang yang sgyur/ /pho brang lcags mkhar dgu la chags/ /ri nag bco brgyad dbang du sgyur/ /mtsho nag dgu yi pho brang skyong*/ /las su bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad/ /zas su dgra bgegs sha la za/ /dben ri dang ni dgon gnas skyong*/ /myur mgyogs dge bsnyen drag rtsal can/ /rbad do dam nyams dgra la rbad/ /zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig can la/ /mdze skya me ltar 'bar du chugs/ /mdze nad rlung ltar 'tshub tu chugs/ /gnyan rgod lhog yams dgra la phob/ /ti pa ra tsa'i dus la bab/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ti pa ra tsa dgra bgegs kyi bla srog la kha kha khā hi/ zhes pa dge bsnyen gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa 'di yang grwa slob rnams kyis bskul ngor/ 7 gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi gsol mchod dgos 'dod char 'bebs bzhugs so/ om̐ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mtsho skyes pa/ /dbyer med gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gus pas lan brgyar zhabs pad gtsug btud nas/ /dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba 'di na bri/ 'dir rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi gsol mchod kyi rim pa ni/ bca' bsham spyi 'gros mthong brgyud lag len bzhin bshams pa'i gung du/ rnam sras gtor ma zangs snod du gdan ri rab bang rim gsum brtsegs khar rin chen zur brgyad/ de steng gter bum khar gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhi yis mtshan pa/ zur brgyad la bshos bu brgyad/ mtshams rnams su ril bu rnams bzhag /rgyan khra nor bu gang mdzes bya/ rgyun gtor dkar gtor 'bul/ sa ma ya/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥkyis bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du 'bru gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i/ gtor ma 'dod rgu'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa so so rang rang rigs kyi yid mthun nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+g rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ rgyal po chen po rnam sras 'khor dang bcas pa mchod sbyin gyi slad du skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ 'dzam gling ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /rgyal chen btsun mo sras bzhi blon 'bangs dang*/ /dzam lha rigs lnga nor rgyun gnod sbyin brgyad/ /'khor bcas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir mchod phyir gshegs/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba thub pa chen po dang*/ /gar dbang pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga ru/ /ci ltar khas blangs dam bca' dran mdzod la/ /sna tshogs rin chen yid mthun khri la bzhugs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod/ /'dod rgu char 'bebs rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ye dzaṃ bha la dza lan dha ra ba su dha ra ye i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: lan gsum/ bai/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam sras dang*/ /dzam lha nor rgyun gnod sbyin gter bdag brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchod bstod bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ bai/ mi 'jigs stobs chen seṅge'i khri steng du/ /bai las byung ba'i ngal gso dge ba'i rgyal/ /sa le sbram gyi mdangs ldan sgeg pa'i nyams/ /phyag g.yas srid gsum dbang sdud rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon pas dgos 'dod char 'beb ne'u le dang*/ /dbu la rin chen sna lnga'i prog zhu gsol/ /gos dar g.yul las rgyal ba'i go khrab dang*/ /rgya lham swag chen gsol zhing phyed skyil bzhugs/

/sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi 'bar ba'i/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug chen po khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi blon 'bangs dang*/ /dzam bha la dang lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad dang nor gyi lha/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /nor gyi bdag po ār+ya dzam bha la/ /dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ longs spyod 'dod yon dngos grub char 'bebs stsol/ /mchod sbyin bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med zas nor dang*/ /snyan grags mnga' thang chos srid rin chen gter/ /'dod rgu'i rgyun gyis zad med brlan par mdzod/ sarba gats+tsha: gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ zhes pa 'di yang stag lor bcad rgya'i skabs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo'i rmi lam du rgyal chen gyis rang gzugs bstan nas/ 'di ltar gyis dang phrin las bsgrub stsal ba ltar/ rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje'i zlos gar gsum par rag gan gser brdzus pas tshes bco lnga zhag mtshams su sa skyong rgyal po'i zhabs pad dbu rtse ru sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig /dge'o/ bkra shis par shog // // ༈ gnyan chen thang lha'i gtor 'bul bzhugs so/ om̐ ā kā ro sogs? om̐/ dri za'i rgyal po sa brgyad gnas pa'i mchog /stong gsum gzhi bdag kun gyi rje bor gyur/ /'khor tshogs dang bcas rgyal byin sras mo ni/ /mtsho sman bcas pa 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes/ /bdag gi bsam pa thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ /bstan pa 'phel zhing 'dod rgu rgya cher ldan/ /gdug 'dre'i nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang*/ /thams cad bde gar spyod pa'i bkra shis stsol/ om̐ a ma nu khe nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi/ om̐ badz+ra thaṃ ka ra mu nyid khu sha li a mṛ ta khā hi swā hā/

hūm̐/ yang gcig bzhengs shig ti pa ra tsa khyod/ /byang phyogs rgyud du che ba'i skur ston pa/ /gnyan chen thang lha zhes su mtshan yang gsol/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun rkyen sol mthun rkyen bsam pa sgrubs/ /sprul pa dung g.yag dung gi bya khra dang*/ /lcags sdig mgo dgu'i tshul du 'dir byon la/ /gnod byed rgyal 'gong smyo 'dre rdul du rlog /dam bca' dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra 'bar ba rtsal bigh+nān rā dza mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces gtor 'bul la sbyor/ med na gtor bsngos dang mnyam du 'don/ zhes sgrub chen dus dgos pa ci bzhin byung nas/ rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pa rje dharma shwa ras mdzad pa dang gter kha gsum nas bsdus// // ༈ ge sar gsol mchod ni/ kye/ sangs rgyas mi gzugs byon pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /mthu rtsal stobs ldan hor bdud cham la phab/ /'dre srin dam btags bod khams bde la bkod/ /dbu nag dgra lha skyes bu don 'grub la/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul pho lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /gzhi la bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /byes su gang bsam sgrubs la bar chad sol/ /bstan pa'i mnga' thang phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /rig 'dzin bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ ban thung gsol mchod ni/ hūm̐/ badz+ra gu ru rdo rje gro bo lod/ /bka' nyan ye shes mgon po stag la chibs/ /de bsgrub dgra lha 'brong pa ban thung ni/ /pha mes rgyud nas srung skyob 'bral med mdzod/ /'brong pas mchod na mgon pa'i lha srung rnams/ /dam tshig brtse gdung gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gser skyems gtor ma 'bul ba bzhes su gsol/ /'gro 'dug dus su bsu skyel 'bral med mdzod/ i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi/ bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ dge bsnyen gsol mchod bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐/ pad+ma'i bka' nyan rdo rje dbang grags rtsal/

/chu chen dbang sgyur nya gdong sbu ba can/ /klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong dang bcas/ /thogs med 'dir gshegs gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag mi nor bar chad chag sgo zlog /tshe dpal bsod nams longs spyod dngos grub stsol/ /'gro 'dug dus su bsu skyel sdong grogs mdzod/ /bcol ba'i phrin las g.yar dam brtan gyur cig /bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ skrag dbyi'i gtor 'bul ni/ kyai/ dge bsnyen skrag btsan mched 'khor dang*/ /sman btsun la sogs skya dgu dang*/ /g.ya' mar btsan gyi tshogs bcas gshegs/ /dkar gtor bshos bu spyan gzigs dang*/ /gser skyems bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /las dang bya ba gang bzhin sgrubs/ /'dzam gling dbyi shod ri bo che/ /dmag dpon dbyi rgyal mched 'khor sogs/ /mtsho bkra la sogs nang blon mched/ /a mgon mi thung blon 'khor gyis/ /bshos ldan spyan gzigs bkra shis rdzas/ /'bru bcud gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /bdag la rogs dan sgrub pa dang*/ /rtag tu mi 'bral bstan pa skyongs/ /gang bcol phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ yul lha mchod thabs ni/ kyai: sa yul 'di la gnas pa yi: lha gnyan klu gnyan btsan gnyan dang : yul lha gnyan dang nags tshal gnyan: yul lha mthu chen bzhugs pa kun: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snga ma legs pa'i gtang rag yin: phyi ma legs pa'i zhu skyems 'bul: da yang las kyi zhu 'bul ni: bzhes nas 'dod don sgrub tu gsol: nyang gi gter ma'o// // ༈ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /bka' srung rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /gzhi bdag rnams la 'dod yon sogs/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung bar shog/

// rgyun gsol skabs sangs rgyas bstan srung bzhag 'og gi skong ba la 'jug /mchan/ ༈ de nas gser skyems btegs la/ sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phangs bstod/ /dge 'dun sde skyongs rnal 'byor tshe srog srings/ /snyan ba'i dar phyar grags pa'i dung bus la/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod/ /rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs rgyas/ /mig la ya mtshan ltad mo che ba dang*/ /rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing*/ /dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral mdzod/ /zas skom 'byor pas ro 'dzin tshim byed cing*/ /lus la reg 'jam bde ba kho nas 'tsho/ /yid la rnam par grol ba'i shes rab kyi/ /zag med bde bas nam yang ngoms par mdzod/ /rtag tu khyed brten khyed gsol khyed sgrub na/ /mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che ba dang*/ /gzhis la bkra shis longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /byes su lam 'phrang chu las sgrol 'don mdzod/ /'jigs sar dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyobs/ /mdor na bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar mdzad pa yi/ /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sa steng yongs la khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ༈ skong ba byin brlab ni/ skong rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las gnas khang dur khrod drag po'i zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab par/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa/ spyan gzigs mthun rdzas/

rten rdzas/ skong rdzas la sogs pa/ thams cad srid zhi'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa mkho dgu tshang ba/ bzang dgu'i 'byor pa/ mdzes rgus brgyan pa/ ngo bo ye shes sgyu ma'i rang bzhin bde ba'i rnam pa thams cad 'char bas nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum dang*/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pas byin gyis brlab cing zad mi shes par spel la/ de nas skong ba ni/ hūm̐: dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa la: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni: dmar chen yon chab dbang po'i me tog dang : sha gsur bdug spos tshil chen zhun me sbar: dug khrag dri chab 'bru nag dpal gyi bshos: sna tshogs rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogs pa dang : bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sman mchog bdud rtsi rgya mtsho kyi li li: bla med nang gi mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil: dung khang zhal bur rak+ta phyu ru ru: sha chen zhag g.yo lbu ba kya ma kyo: drag po'i snod du bha ling ri ltar spungs: dbang po rnam lnga'i rgya mtshan ye re re: lcang lo'i snod du dgra sha ri ltar bskyil: bsgral mchod nang rol sna tshogs nyi li li: rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa dbyings dang mnyam: mtho snyogs longs spyod bcud mchod chi li li: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho bskyil: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid: de bzhin blo yis blangs dang rang bzhin gyis: dngos 'byor yid sprul rgyu las byung ba yi: mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas rten pa'i rdzas: 'bod rdzas sgrub rdzas mnyes pa'i rdzas la sogs: spyan gzigs du ma gzugs 'gros sna tshogs dang : snang srid stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad du: ci srid de dang de srid 'byung ba dang : 'byung 'gyur spyad dang spyod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis:

dpal chen phyag bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : las mgon bya rog gdong can thugs dam bskang : myur mdzad phyag drug pa yi thugs dam bskang : ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi'i thugs dam bskang : dpal ldan dud sol lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma'i? zhing skyong mgon po yab yum? gza' mchog rā hu la yi? dam can rdo rje legs pa'i? gnod sbyin me 'od gdong can? dkor bdag rgyal po dpe har? gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen? lha chen dbang phyug chen po'i? gze yi lha btsan 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : rnam sras dzam lha dmar po'i thugs dam bskang : chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad? chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad? dam can tha tshig gnyer ba'i? gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi? yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi? mchod 'os bstod 'os rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsol ba dang : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo dam tshig ldan pa'i lha: deng 'dir sngags 'chang sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: bskyed rim ma gsal rdzogs rim ma rtogs dang : bzlas brjod grangs nyung mchod rdzas g.yel ba dang : phud lhag 'dres shing dus kyi mchod pa chag: dam bca' dor bas nus mthu nyams pa dang : mngon spyod rtsal chung dgra bgegs ma bsgral sogs: le lo btang snyoms g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur nas: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya shwa dha ya shwa dha bi shwa dha ni sa pā ri bi shwa dha na dharma pā la sarba shud+dhe ye swā hā: yig brgya sogs kyis bshags// // ༈ sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: rtsa gsum srung ma'i bstod bskul gnam lcags 'khor lo zhes bya ba: yi dam lha yi bsnyen song rnal 'byor pas:

bstod bskul drag po gzhol 'dod na: 'bru nag dmar gtor sha khrag brgyan ldan la: dgra bgegs dmigs bya'i rnam shes bkug bstims nas: bdud rtsir byin brlabs sngags kyis so sor bsngos: dar nag g.yab cing rkang sogs rol mos bskul: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo'i yang mtha' 'dir: skye bo'i sdig spyod chos byed srung sdom nyams: dge 'dun nang dbyen bstan pa'i rtsa lag rul: mdo sngags nang 'khon chos spangs sdig chen bsags: phyi nang rten 'brel log pas 'byung ba 'khrugs: las ngan mtsho rdol mi 'dod rlung dmar 'tshubs: ma mo thugs 'khrugs lha srung bdud du bab: nad mug mtshon sprin sdug bsngal char rgyun 'bebs: 'gro rnams nyam thag rgyal bstan nub la nye: spyod ngan 'bras smin dus ngan me 'bar tshe: rgyal ba thugs rje'i rang bzhin ye shes spyan: mi mngon dbyings nas gzigs pa'i dkon mchog gsum: ma g.yel bzhengs shig stobs bcu'i bdag nyid dgongs: dus la bab bo rgyal ba sras dang bcas: chos dbyings mkha' las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs shing : sna tshogs thabs mkhas cho 'phrul rgya mtsho'i gnas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol: khyad par ma mgon lcam dral 'khor tshogs dpung : brgyud gsum dregs pa'i dmag tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: zhi rgyas dbang drag mdzad pa dpag med kyis: 'gro mang thabs kyis sgrol ba'i thugs rje rmad: phrin las mkha' dang mnyam par bdag bstod do: dam rdzas sman dang dmar chen rak+ta'i mtsho: 'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod gtor dam pa 'dis: nyams pa skong la g.yar dam sor stsol zhing : ma mo 'khrugs dang srung ma'i 'khon bcugs byang : ma g.yel ma g.yel phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon bgegs: shugs sgrol stobs kyis bdud sde'i dpung chen choms: dregs pa'i za kha kla klo'i dpung la ya: gtor ma 'di dang dgra bgegs dbyer med par: zo zhig rold cig kha rje dbang thang khams:
