ming gi lhag mar mdzod cig mā ra ya: srung ma dam la mi dgongs ci la dgongs: drag rtsal dgra la mi rbad su la rbad: rnal 'byor lha la mi 'phrengs gang la 'phrengs: gdung shugs drag pos 'bod rbad deng bskul bas: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mi mdzad rgyu: khyod rnams sngon gyi thugs dam gang du gnyan: de phyir ma g.yel lha dang srung ma'i tshogs: nyam thag snyigs ma'i 'gro la nyer dgongs te: gsang gsum rdo rje'i rtsal shugs cher bskyed nas: gnyer gtad las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: gtor ma dgra phyogs dor la gnyer kha gtad: dgra dpung rdo rje yin kyang 'jig nus pa'i: sgyogs chen gsang 'dzin dpa' bo'i lag cha 'di: dam med rang 'dod can la shor ra re: bag med spyad na rang nyid phung bas gzob: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྀatshaḥ zhes pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i sbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi chos sde yang dag pa'o// // ༈ phrin las bcol ba ni/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' sdod dam tshig can/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung dbang po khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde/ /'phel rgyas yun du gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams/ /zhabs pad brtan cing zab chos gong du 'phel/ /'gro kun smin grol bde la 'god pa dang*/ /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /bye brag rgyal bstan rtsa lag snga 'gyur bstan/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa kun/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar rgyas yun du gnas/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /sngags 'chang sgrub po gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /rigs dang chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i bu/ /zab chos nyams su len pa'i 'dus pa rnams/ /yon 'byor 'khor 'bangs kun tu dar rgyas mdzod/ /yang zab zab mo'i ring lugs snying po'i bstan/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar rgyas shing*/

/srid mthar bstan cing smin grol 'bras bu thob/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /yul ris rgyal khams sa phyogs thams cad du/ /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /'bru rnams bcud smin btsa' than sad ser zhi/ /nad mug dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba dang*/ /bu nor 'khor 'bangs mnga' ris rgyas par mdzod/ khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum gyi/ /skye 'gro'i snang ba dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung rgya 'dre 'gong po dang*/ /dam sri bdud rigs brlag dang bzlog par mdzod/ /ma rungs sems 'chang zhing bcu ldan pa yi/ /dgra bo phyi nang phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang*/ /ring bar khugs la rngam pa'i stobs kyis sod/ /sha khrag lhag med rol la bstab par bzhes/ /mdor na o rgyan chen po'i spyan sngar ru/ /dam bca' bzhin du bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ /dam las ma 'da' brgyud 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs/ /'gro ba bde skyid dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces phrin bcol 'di nyid 7rje btsun rin po che lo hā badz+ra gyi zhal slob phyogs med dā ri dra ma dā ya pas bris smon bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa yi/ /srung ma yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ 'gro mgon phag mo grub pas so// // ༈ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sa steng yongs la khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad mtshon mu ge dang*/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags shing*/ /gsang chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*/

/'gro kun bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas/ /gzhi byes lam sogs gang du gnas gyur kyang*/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs gyur nas/ /ma yengs bsrung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dung dung snying nas mi brjed gsol btab tshe/ /yang yang mchod cing bstod pa'i bdag sogs kun/ /'jigs 'jigs bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas dngos grub stsol/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang*/ /sgrub brgyud yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /mdo sngags kun gyi gtsug rgyan pad 'byung rje/ /dbyer med o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur cig/ // om̐/ mthun pa'i dngos grub 'dod rgu'i yid bzhin nor/ /deng 'dir sgrub la stsol zhing byin brlabs nas/ /yid smon rgyas par gyur cig srung ma'i tshogs/ /'gro kun sa bcu'i rtse mor rab gnas shog /gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ om̐/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: sngon tshe o rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la/ /ma yis bu ltar skyong bar zhal bzhes pa/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi/ nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma snyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/

/gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ zhes dang yi ge brgya pas nongs pa 'chags/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wā nāṃ/ mthar bdag bskyed nyer bsdus ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis lhar snang dbyings su bsdus pa'i rtag mtha' bral/ a a āḥs mnyam par bzhag /phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥkyis lhar ldang gsang ba gsum gyis chad mtha' spang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma kā wa tsi rak+ṣa maṃ/ zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje gzhon nu sogs/ smon lam rgyas gdab/ bkra shis ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /yi dam lha yis rjes bzung dngos grub thob/ /mkha' 'gro dam can lus dang grib bzhin 'grog /gang bsam lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'dir yang bkra shis shing*/ /nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la/ /mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar kyi li li/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bkra shis bde legs shog /gzhan yang bkra shis bsngo smon sogs mtha' rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i gdan sa/ khrom gzigs gsang sngags chos gling gi 'dus sde rgya mtsho'i rgyun gyi phrin las/ bka' gter gyi rdo rje chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ phrin bcol bya thabs 'khyer bde go rim khrigs chags su de nyid kyi skye ba'i sprul 'phreng gsum pa 7o rgyan 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis mdzad pa la gzhi byas/ thugs sprul rim byon gyi gdan sa khyung po gnam lcags rdza spang ri khrod kyi yab mes gong mas gsung srol dang*/ 'khor lo'i mgon po gwa grwa bla ma nyi ma 'od zer gyi chog khrigs rnams bsdebs la/

dgos pa'i dbang gis 'ga' zhig bsnan nas cung zad 'bring po'i lugs su gyur pa/ phrin las mkha' khyab rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di'ang bal yul yang le shod gsang sngags phur pa gling gi sgrub sde ba rnams kyi/ dgos mkho'i ched 'di ltar chog khrigs gyis zhes yang yang bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin/ rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje'i rigs chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa/ gnam lcags bla brang gi rigs kyi smyu gur son la sgo chen sprul sku'i skye srid du btags pa'i blun po gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pas bgyis pa 'dis kyang*/ rgyal bstan spyi dang e haṃ lo ha badz+ra gang gi zab gter ring lugs phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // de ltar thun bzhi'i nyams len la gnas pa dag la thun mtshams su nye bar mkho ba'i chos spyod dang*/ zhar byung rgyun spyod zhal 'don khag gcig dang*/ cho ga'i yan lag nyer mkho'i kha skong*/ rgyun gsol bsdus 'bring bcas phyogs gcig tu bkod pa'i chos spyod ngag 'don nyer mkho 'dod 'byung sa brtol ljon bzang zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rang lugs chos spyod mi 'dra ba khag gsum tsam rnyed pa la gzhi byas kha skong dag rigs mthun gzhan las kyang blangs te phyogs gcig tu bsdebs la ma phyi du ma blta bsdur gyi tshig ris mi mthun pa rnams blo yi ci dpog gis zhu dag dang bcas gtan la phab pa 'di'ang bal yul yang le shod gsang sngags phur pa gling zhes snga 'gyur gnam lcags sgrub sde'i mtshams grwa rnams kyis 'di ltar dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba ma zad ma dpe bsdu 'tshol dang zhu dag gi mthun sbyor kyang mdzad par brten/ sgo chen sprul ming pas bod rab rgyan sa yos lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar chog khrigs su spel ba 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ slar smras pa/

spros pa'i mtshan ma mtha' dag rab zhi nas/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob 'dres pa'i rdzogs chen par/ /thun dang thun mtshams nyin mtshan dbyer med pas/ /nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rnams la mi dgos kyang*/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub par dam bcas shing*/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i lam zhugs gsar bu rnams/ /thun bzhi skyong zhing bar med sgrub tshugs kyis/ /thun mtshams nyams len 'bung la 'di nyid mkho/ /grub gnyis yid bzhin 'dod rgu 'jo ba la/ /bsnyen sgrub las kyi phrin las gyer 'dod kyang*/ /phyag bzhes nyams len zhan pa'i gang zag la/ /cho ga'i zur 'debs mdzes rgyan 'di nyid mkho/ /zab mo'i lam la mos pa'i skal ldan yang*/ /thos chung 'khos zhan chos gzugs bdag 'dra la/ /dpe mang mi rnyed rnyed kyang lcogs dka' na/ /rgyun spyod zhal 'don sna 'dzoms 'di nyid mkho/ /de phyir nyer mkho sa brtol ljon bzang 'di/ /lugs 'dir mos pa mi phyed dge ba can/ /phur gling gnam lcags sgrub sde'i nyams bzhes ched/ /bskul phyir rang lugs gung bstun gu h+yas bsgrigs/ /'di byed mkhyen gnyis gshog ldan khyung chen min/ /stobs 'byor lus rtsal rgyas pa'i gnyis 'thung min/ /snyan dang grags pa'i ral ldan seṅge min/ /thos myong khron gnas lag 'gro'i rjes mthun phyir/ /'di la bstod smad ci 'byung cha med kyang*/ /rdo rje'i gsung la tshad ldan phyag bzhes kyi/ /rgyan 'di dam pa kun gyi lam srol snang*/ /de lta na'ang ma rtogs log rtog dris/ /bslad dang ma 'brel nyes pa ci mchis pa/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags bgyis shing*/ /legs par sgrubs la gsol ba lan brgyar 'debs/ /'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar cha mchis na/ /snga 'gyur spyi dang chos tshul 'di nyid kyi/ /ring lugs bstan pa phyogs bcur khyab pa dang*/ /'gro kun smin grol byang chen myur thob shog /ces pa'ang dad gtong nor gyis phyug pa'i rang slob ma lan+d+ra pi tsi kus yon sbyor nas rnam dkar chos kyi sbyin pa'i 'du byed 'phrul gyis yi ger drangs shing dpe skrun byed skabs sgo chen sprul ming gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nas bgyis pa'o//

// ༈ bka' gter sri zhu e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas dpar du bskrun/ kam pu'i ṭar la dpe 'dzud mkhan btsun ma tshe ring dbang mo dang*/ 'jam dbyangs pad+mo/ dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur o rgyan gsang sngags/ jus 'god pa gcung mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs/ zhu dag pa 'brong pa karma longs spyod bcas kyis 'gan 'khur bzhes par thugs rje che zhu/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o// //
